chapters.title: Chapter 251: A Decisive Battle to the Death
paragraphs: Listening to the discussions of the Advisor, the Undead Demigod also breathed a sigh of relief, feeling much more at ease.
Before being captured by the Human Race, he had browsed through the basic data of many races.
In his eyes, the Human Race should have been crafty, cautious, good at laying out plans, unpredictable, and resourceful.
How could the Human Demigod encountered this time be so crazy?
Exhausting so many resources to fight a Divine Kingdom War.
Even if he wins, how many benefits can he actually gain?
Although his Divine Kingdom possessed quite a few Human Race S-rank spoils of war.
But with the output of these resources, how many years would it take to recover the investment of this battle?
Doing some random financial management with these resources would be much more cost-effective than fighting this war!
Madman, idiot, completely unreasonable!
The Undead Demigod cursed Yang Fan frantically in his heart.
Even if neither side could do anything to the other.
Once the opponent retreated, his Divine Kingdom would also be riddled with holes.
“I have remembered your Divine Kingdom coordinates.”
“If one day I can escape and return to my race.”
“I will definitely wash your Divine Kingdom in blood!”
Another ten days passed in the Real World.
Six days ago, Ma Yu had already transferred the tax revenue of Xiling Planet into Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom.
Yang Fan was not anxious; instead, he deliberately slowed down his pace just to paralyze the opponent.
In the opponent’s Divine Kingdom, it had been a full six years.
Yang Fan arranged for Yang San to pour in holy water and other resources bit by bit.
Sometimes, they even deliberately stopped for a whole month.
At this moment, deep within the Undead Race Divine Kingdom Core, everyone was as silent as cicadas in winter, and the air seemed to have frozen.
“Not speaking anymore?”
The Undead Demigod’s voice was icy cold, oppressive like a demon from Hell, “Speak, what should we do now?”
“Reporting to my King, this Human Race Divine Kingdom has a terrifying foundation, but judging by its dumping frequency in recent years.”
“The opponent’s funds are probably bottoming out, and they might even be selling their Divine Kingdom buildings cheaply to raise funds, which is why it has been intermittent.”
“I still suggest retreating another ten thousand kilometers; the opponent has already reached their limit.”
The Undead Demigod gazed deeply at the Advisor without responding, his mind filled with doubts.
Retreating ten thousand kilometers, retreating another ten thousand kilometers, retreating another ten thousand kilometers...
If this continues, wouldn’t this Divine Kingdom be handed over on a silver platter?
“My King, there are no other choices left.”
“The external life aura is extremely rich. If we dispatch troops to fight a decisive battle to the death with them, we will only fall into a passive position.”
“Stalling is the best strategy!”
The scene fell into a dead silence, with no other Advisor echoing the sentiment.
Everyone’s heart was filled with unease.
Although the probability was low, if this Human Demigod really had enough Divinity Points.
Continuing to retreat meant handing the battle line over on a silver platter, wouldn’t that be sticking one’s neck out to be slaughtered?
The Undead Demigod took a deep breath, “Since the opponent has placed such a heavy bet, then I will cede another ten thousand kilometers.”
His voice was low, yet filled with coercion.
“However, wanting my territory is not that easy either.”
“Issue a Divine Decree!”
“Make those unranked Skeleton Soldiers form a city wall to block the river water!”
“Isn’t he rich? I want to see how much more he can invest!”
“My King is wise!”
In the Real World, another twenty days passed.
At this moment, deep within the Undead Race Divine Kingdom.
The dense killing intent almost materialized, pressing down on the entire world until it was deathly silent.
“My King... how about we continue to retreat...”
The Advisor’s words hadn’t even finished yet.
Boom!
Black qi that had condensed to the extreme suddenly erupted.
The black fog churned crazily like a living thing, instantly wrapping around his entire body.
The next moment.
Screams didn’t even have time to be emitted.
The Advisor’s entire skeleton quickly began to rot and shatter.
Finally, it turned into flying black ash all over the sky and scattered.
The surroundings instantly fell quiet.
All the high-tier believers of the Undead Race lowered their heads, their bodies trembling slightly.
The Undead Demigod stood on high, the killing intent in his eyes almost condensing into substance.
That pale face constantly twisted.
The Divine Kingdom shook, and the sky was faintly turning black.
“Retreat?”
“Today we cede ten thousand kilometers.”
“Tomorrow we cede ten thousand kilometers.”
“If we keep retreating, why don’t we just hand the Divine Kingdom Core directly to the opponent!”
The roar of fury resounded through the entire Divine Kingdom.
The area of the Divine Kingdom Core region was less than one hundred thousand square kilometers to begin with.
Now almost all believers were compressed here.
A large number of ranked believers had already begun to crowd tightly together.
And the outer periphery was the continuously spreading river water.
Those river waters were filled with a rich holy aura, and ordinary members of the Undead Race would be purified the moment they touched it.
Even believers in the Qi Refining Realm would clearly feel weak when approaching.
If they continued to retreat, in order to ensure sufficient living space.
He would have to actively abandon a large number of low-tier believers, which was unacceptable.
More importantly...
The Undead Demigod completely failed to understand Yang Fan anymore.
Resources were poured in endlessly, as if there was never an end.
“So many resources...”
“Is this really something a demigod can possess?”
The Undead Demigod slowly clenched his fists.
Finally, he raised his head, and an icy Divine Decree descended.
“Pass down my Divine Decree, reorganize and prepare for battle.”
“Today, a decisive battle to the death!”
“All believers shall deploy the Formation according to the combat sequence.”

“Activate and strengthen the sacrificial Formation, adjust the concentration of Death Qi to the limit, in preparation for summoning at any time, vowing to cut down the invading enemies of the Human Race within the Divine Kingdom.”
Boom!
The Divine Decree fell.
Countless members of the Undead Race within the entire Divine Kingdom simultaneously became restless.
A large number of high-tier members of the Undead Race began to move.
The bone legion assembled, the death knights put on armor, and the necromancers began to carve large-scale death magic Formations.
“My King, the external life aura is currently too rich.”
“If we forcefully break out, our army’s losses will be extremely heavy.”
The Undead Demigod slowly raised his hand.
“Take out all the Human Race buildings captured previously.”
The many Advisors were suddenly startled.
“But My King, we are the Undead Race, and we don’t have Intelligent Life similar to the Mechanical Civilization, so it’s very hard to control them!”
The Undead Demigod looked at them coldly.
“Idiots.”
“Who asked you to use them for combat?”
“Just for transportation, as long as we charge out.”
“We can have a decisive battle to the death.”
“Yes, My King!”
Meanwhile, Yang Fan’s consciousness also descended upon the Divine Kingdom Battlefield.
With such a huge commotion from the opponent, Yang San had already completed the report.
Such an important Divine Kingdom War.
As a deity, how could Yang Fan possibly be absent?
And just as Yang Fan’s gaze cast toward the depths of the Divine Kingdom.
Suddenly.
Rumble!
The earth shook.
Two steel giants standing a thousand zhang tall slowly walked out from the depths of the Divine Kingdom.
Yang Fan’s pupils constricted slightly; those were not believers at all, but rather resembled two moving steel cities.
Their entire bodies were composed of a large amount of silver-gray metal, with complex Mechanical patterns spread across the surface.
Shoulders, chest, back, arms, and even legs.
All were installed with densely packed advanced turrets.
Energy railguns, heavy particle cannons, missile nests, close-in defense guns, and ultra-large electromagnetic launchers.
Innumerable weapons almost covered their entire bodies.
Inside the giants’ bodies, it was completely a moving city.
Countless members of the Undead Race stood on the steel platforms, densely packed and crowding every inch of space.
Subsequently, an even more bizarre scene appeared.

chapters.title: Chapter 252: Survive
paragraphs: Boom——
A bloody river suddenly rushed out from the core area of the Divine Kingdom.
The river water crazily spread outward, and a large number of the Undead Race actually soaked directly in the river and swam outward.
Yang Fan was completely dumbfounded.
“The Undead Race...”
“What kind of tricks are they playing?”
“No matter how you look at it, these buildings don’t match them at all, right?”
Yang Da, at this moment, was full of excitement.
“Congratulations, Master, this is an S-Rank Building—Mechanical War Puppet.”
“One of the core war resources of the Mechanical Civilization.”
“It possesses a super-large railgun System, heavy energy matrix, defense shield generator, and firepower coverage System.”
“Its positioning is similar to a mobile war fortress, and its value is slightly lower than the Great Void Warship.”
“And it won’t be sold on the market at all.”
Yang Da became more and more excited the more he looked.
“The Undead Race doesn’t know how to drive this at all.”
“They actually use this kind of thing as a means of transportation!”
Yang Fan looked over.
Sure enough, a large number of the Undead Race were flustered inside the Mechanical War Puppet.
An S-Rank war building was currently swaying left and right, and even walking crookedly.
Seeing this scene, Yang Fan likewise couldn’t help licking his lips.
He knew in his heart that the Mechanical War Puppet was probably captured by the other party from the Human Race Prodigy’s Divine Kingdom.
It was just that this Undead Demigod was imprisoned by the Primordial Academy and was completely unable to communicate with the outside world.
Even precious resources like S-Rank Buildings could not be sold in exchange for development resources.
Although neither the school nor the materials given to him by Gu Le had this thing, Yang Fan was not surprised.
What buildings a Divine Kingdom had were a god’s biggest secret, let alone a Human Race Prodigy; naturally, they would keep a few trump cards.
This Undead Demigod... was probably richer than imagined.
“What is this river again?”
Yang Fan continued to ask.
Yang Da looked at the blood river, his electronic eyes suddenly lighting up.
“This is the Nine Nether River, an S-Rank Building.”
“Its function is extremely special; the river water can continuously modify the Physical Body of life.”
“Long-term soaking can grant recovery capabilities far exceeding normal life forms.”
“Severed limbs can be reborn, flesh and blood reconstructed, and as long as the heart and brain are not destroyed, rapid recovery can be achieved.”
After hearing Yang Da’s introduction.
Yang Fan’s eyes instantly lit up.
“Good stuff.”
“This building is of great use to believers of both the Cultivation Route and the Martial Route.”
After finishing, Yang Fan slowly cast his gaze toward Yang San and other high-tier war-type Intelligent Life forms.
“What are you still waiting for?”
“Do you want to wait for the other party to come out completely before fighting to the death?”
A cold voice rang out.
Yang San and the other Intelligent Life forms instantly reacted, their electronic eyes flashing wildly.
The next moment, countless war commands were rapidly transmitted.
“The Boundary-Suppressing Profound Heaven Great Wall enters maximum firepower mode.”
“All long-range firepower units, free coverage, prioritize attacking the Nine Nether River.”
“Believers at the Foundation Establishment Realm and above are permitted to freely cast long-range arts.”
“Elf Legion, prepare.”
“Now—is the time for you to swear allegiance to the Divine Kingdom!”
Accompanied by the issuance of the command, the entire Divine Kingdom’s defense line instantly went into operation.
Boom!!
The Boundary-Suppressing Profound Heaven Great Wall opened fire first.
Countless laser cannons cut through the sky, and thick beams of light bombarded into the Nine Nether River one after another.
Rumble!
The bloody river was directly blown open with a huge hole.
A large amount of river water evaporated, and countless Undead Race moving in the river didn’t even have time to react before their bodies instantly vaporized.
“Help!!”
“My King, save me!!”
“I don’t want to die!!”
“Run!! Run away!!”
The desperate screams of the Undead Race resounded across the battlefield.
However, before the blood river could recover, the second wave of artillery fire had already fallen.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
The river was continuously blown through, and a large number of the Undead Race directly turned into powder.
The Mechanical War Puppet on the other side was an S-Rank Building after all, even though the Undead Race did not know how to control it.
But that massive steel structure still blocked a large amount of attacks.
Countless laser cannons hit the steel armor, leaving only charred marks.
The artillery fire of the Smart Weapons had little effect on it, but Adult Elves were different.
Swish!
Swish!
Countless arrows cut through the sky.
The Adult Elves pulled their longbows one after another.
Their expressions were cold, and their arrows were precise to the extreme.
All arrowheads had long been soaked in holy water in advance.
Accompanied by the falling arrow rain, those Undead Race hiding inside the Mechanical War Puppet began to fall crazily.
The arrows passed through the gaps, through the observation ports, and through the armor joints.
Accurately hitting target after target.
“Holy power!!”
“Save me!!”
A large number of Qi Refining Stage Undead Race constantly fell, and even powerhouses at the Foundation Establishment Realm began to suffer casualties.
The war had not truly begun yet, but the high-tier combat power was already decreasing wildly.
Hit him while he is down.
For this Divine Kingdom War, Yang Fan had invested so many resources; how could he easily let them out now?
At this moment, the entire battlefield completely turned into a meat grinder.
Hundreds of millions of the Undead Race had no ability to resist.
They couldn’t even effectively counterattack and could only passively endure.
One batch fell, and another batch continued to top up.
Behind the Mechanical War Puppet, the boundless Undead Race legion was moving slowly.
Affected by the breath of life, their auras were extremely weak, and they could only move forward hiding under the shadow of the Mechanical War Puppet.
But the cover ultimately had loopholes.
Boom!
Suddenly, a laser cannon passed through a gap and fell directly into the rear legion.
The explosion spread, and a large number of the Undead Race instantly flew backward.
If it were placed in the past, such a shell might only kill ordinary believers.
But now, under the suppression of the breath of life, even believers at the Qi Refining Realm began to die in patches.
Powerhouses at the Foundation Establishment Realm similarly suffered continuous casualties.
And within the Void Realm, the Undead Demigod quietly watched all this.
Every second, a large number of believers died.
His heart was bleeding.
Regret, unprecedented regret.
If he had known this earlier, he would never have stubbornly defended the core of the Divine Kingdom.
Much less would he have allowed the other party to build embankments, dig rivers, and construct defense lines on the periphery.
His caution and his fear of death ultimately forced him into a desperate situation instead.
It’s just that there is never any medicine for regret in this world.
Everyone must pay the price for their own choices.
He could admit his mistake, but he had no regrets.
Because even if he started over once, he was afraid he would still make the same choice.
Who could have thought that a demigod would invest such terrifying resources for a war.
Rather than dwelling on the past, he needed to consider the future even more.
Win the war, or drag it out.
Drag it out for a hundred years, drag it out for a thousand years.
Wait for Yang Fan to graduate in reality, wait for the other party to leave.
As long as the Divine Kingdom was still there, he was still alive.
No god wanted to die, even if their Physical Body in reality had already become a prisoner.
But in the Divine Kingdom, he was still the sole faith of hundreds of millions of believers.
The Undead Demigod slowly raised his head, looking across the Void Realm to meet Yang Fan’s consciousness from afar.
Within those eyes, there was no madness, only a desire to survive that was strong to the extreme.
“Survive...”
“I must survive...”

Who could have thought that a demigod would invest such terrifying resources for a war.
Rather than dwelling on the past, he needed to consider the future even more.
Win the war, or drag it out.
Drag it out for a hundred years, drag it out for a thousand years.
Wait for Yang Fan to graduate in reality, wait for the other party to leave.
As long as the Divine Kingdom was still there, he was still alive.
No god wanted to die, even if their Physical Body in reality had already become a prisoner.
But in the Divine Kingdom, he was still the sole faith of hundreds of millions of believers.
The Undead Demigod slowly raised his head, looking across the Void Realm to meet Yang Fan’s consciousness from afar.
Within those eyes, there was no madness, only a desire to survive that was strong to the extreme.
“Survive...”
“I must survive...”

chapters.title: Chapter 253: Priority Defense of the Nine Nether River
paragraphs: Despite being tens of thousands of kilometers apart,
the advance speed of the Undead Race army was currently exceptionally slow.
On one hand, they had to constantly be on guard against the long-range firepower suppression from Yang Fan’s side.
On the other hand, they needed to rely on the Mechanical War Puppet to provide cover for the rear legions.
The believer army needed to continuously adjust their angles in coordination with the two behemoths.
Sometimes turning sideways, sometimes shifting directions,
trying their best to use the steel bodies to block more artillery fire.
Although it was impossible to completely block them, eighty to ninety percent of the attacks still landed on the Mechanical War Puppet.
Boom! Boom!
Massive amounts of laser cannons bombarded continuously.
However, those attacks, which were powerful enough to easily annihilate believers in the Foundation Establishment Realm, only left charred marks when falling on the Mechanical War Puppet.
The high-strength alloy body was almost completely unharmed.
Looking at this scene, Yang Fan could not help but fall into deep thought.
There were too many alien races in the Real World, and each race had its own strengths as well as its own flaws.
Even an S-Rank Building, if it did not match the divine kingdom system, would similarly have its brilliance obscured.
The true value of a building was never just about the rating.
What suited oneself was the best.
Fortunately, this Undead Race did not have subordinates similar to Intelligent Life.
Otherwise, if they could fully unleash the combat power of the Mechanical War Puppet, I am afraid only two Great Void Warships could suppress them.
The losses in this battle would then be extremely heavy.
Because he was currently in the decisive battle stage,
Yang Fan spent most of his time staying in the Alien Divine Kingdom.
After giving instructions to Gu Le, he directly returned to his room and locked the door tightly.
His consciousness re-entered the divine kingdom to oversee the battle.
In the Real World, five days had passed.
Inside the divine kingdom, however, five years had already passed.
For a full five years, the Undead Race legion still had not finished walking this stretch of road.
However, the distance between the two sides was now less than a thousand kilometers.
The closer they got, the more severe the losses of the Undead Race became instead.
Because the distance shortened, the error in the bomb landing points became smaller and smaller, and the hit rate of the elf arrows became higher and higher.
At the same time, the Undead Race finally began to counterattack.
On top of the Mechanical War Puppet, a large number of high-tier Undead Race members began casting Spells.
Fireballs, ice spears, thunder, and death Spells,
rained down overwhelmingly toward Yang Fan’s position.
Everything had only one purpose: to cover the army’s advance and disrupt the attack rhythm of Yang Fan’s legion.
Right at this moment, Yang Da suddenly spoke.
“Master.”
“The surprise troops I arranged are at just the right distance.”
Yang Fan slightly turned his head. “What is the success rate?”
Yang Da shook his head and spoke, “It cannot be calculated.”
“The secret passageways in the design of the Mechanical War Puppet are extremely small. If the opponent knows about them,”
“they only need a few high-tier believers to guard them, and our army will not be able to break through.”
“But if the opponent does not know... perhaps before the true decisive battle begins, we will be able to take control of the two Mechanical War Puppets.”
“At most it’s just a few hundred thousand high-tier believers; even if we fail, the losses will be limited.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan slowly nodded. “Granted.”
Receiving the order, Yang Da waved his hand.
Yang San quickly retreated to make arrangements.
Meanwhile, the interception on the frontal battlefield continued without the slightest pause.
A massive amount of war supplies was continuously transported to The Frontline through the spatial passage.
Cannonballs, Spirit Stones, arrows, and Medicinal Pills almost never stopped.
The Adult Elf units were even more exhausted long ago; many elves had their palms rubbed until they blistered or even tore.
When one batch was injured, they would return to the divine kingdom to recuperate, and another batch would continue to replenish them.
Over the past five years, they no longer knew how many batches had been changed.
But even so, not a single elf complained of hardship.
Because all the elves knew that this was a divine war.
Once they failed, they would likewise lose their homeland.
All the elves loved the current environment of the Elf Kingdom, and as dependents, they were naturally willing to put in effort.
Because Yang Fan constantly modified the environment of the other party’s divine kingdom, this region had long since become unsuitable for the Undead Race to survive in.
Over the five years, the losses of Yang Fan’s believers were not considered very large.
On the contrary, the Undead Race had already suffered over ten billion deaths.
But even so, the soldiers of the Undead Race still seemed to have no end in sight.
Behind the Mechanical War Puppet, the endless Undead Race legions were still continuously appearing, as if they could never be killed completely.
And right at this moment, about one hundred thousand troops in the corner of the battlefield began to move slowly.
The number was not large, but they were extremely elite.
Most of them were Second-class Intelligent Life, mixed with Martial Masters and Foundation Establishment believers.
Placed on a battlefield of this scale, they were like a group of inconspicuous ants, and no one paid attention to them at all.
Yang Da gave a cold order.
“Firepower blanket attack.”
“Start launching smoke bombs.”
“Within one month, I want this area to be completely covered by mist.”
Once the order was issued, a large number of shipping containers were transported onto the city walls.
The container doors opened, and inside were densely packed with a large number of special-grade smoke bombs.
These smoke bombs were extremely valuable and could even interfere with a deity’s perception of the divine kingdom.
The next moment, the Intelligent Life units began loading.
Click.
Click.
Click.
Tens of thousands of launching devices adjusted their angles simultaneously.
Afterwards,
Boom——
a deafening roar resounded across heaven and earth.
Countless smoke bombs soared into the sky simultaneously.
That scene was as if the entire sky was spitting flames.
Densely packed shells drew huge arcs, obscuring the firmament.
It was like a meteor shower covering the entire battlefield.
A few minutes later, the first batch of smoke bombs landed.
Boom!
Thick white fog began to spread.
Then the second round, the third round, the fourth round...
Countless mists continuously stacked, covered, and spread.
Finally, between the Boundary-Suppressing Profound Heaven Great Wall and the Undead Race legion, a foggy area spanning a thousand miles was formed.
Looking afar, it was as if the entire battlefield was forcibly cut into two worlds.
These were smoke bombs worth fifty million Divinity Points; their effects were feared not to dissipate for hundreds of years.
Yang Da was very satisfied with this. As long as the opportunity succeeded, this bit of investment was nothing.
Seeing this scene,
the Undead Demigod, who was also overseeing the battle, also gradually turned solemn in expression.
“My King, this thing will affect our judgment of the battle situation.”
“Now the central area of both sides has completely turned into a fog zone.”
“This Human Race... is probably preparing to send out surprise troops.”
That Advisor slowly spoke.
The Undead Demigod turned his head to look at him. “What are your thoughts?”
The Advisor slightly lowered his head.
“Reporting to my King, since they are surprise troops, their purpose is none other than two kinds.”
“Either they want to seize special buildings, or they want to split the battlefield and heavily damage our army.”
Speaking of this, the Advisor slowly raised his hand and pointed toward the Nine Nether River direction.
“The original buildings were long ago emptied out.”
“Now the most likely target is only left here.”
“The Nine Nether River.”
“This river is our race’s most important marching route.”
“Because there is no protection from the Mechanical War Puppet, the losses have always been the most severe.”
“Although the advance method has been changed and there are now a large number of high-tier believers forming Formations to advance and defend against attacks,”
“if the enemy suddenly has an elite force appear and tears open the Formation,”
“then the rear legions... will become live targets.”
Speaking to the end, the Advisor’s voice gradually lowered.
“Around the Nine Nether River, key defense must be maintained.”
Hearing this analysis, the Undead Demigod nodded slightly.
Then he looked at the Mechanical War Puppet again.
“What about those two Mechanical War Puppets?”
The Advisor was obviously prepared beforehand.
“My King need not worry. Although the Mechanical War Puppet does not belong to our race and cannot unleash its full combat power,”
“it is still an S-Rank Building. Even if it is just a mobile fortress of war, its defense is definitely not something a demigod can break open.”
“Now the opponent has relied on the terrain to build a defense line outside.”
“Our army only needs to rely on the Mechanical War Puppet to push through, which will be enough to smooth out most of the disadvantages.”
Hearing this, the Undead Demigod finally nodded slowly.
“Just as you said.”
“Notify the lower ranks to increase troop deployment around the Nine Nether River.”
“At the very least, we must not be caught off guard.”
“Yes, my King.”

chapters.title: Chapter 254: The Surprise Troops Have Arrived
paragraphs: The war was still ongoing.
As the order was issued, more and more of the Undead Race began to land from the Nine Nether River.
Even while enduring the erosion of the aura of life, they stubbornly acted as sentinels, beginning to patrol, investigate, and stand guard.
Seeing this scene, Yang San naturally would not stand on ceremony.
“Increase the firepower density in the Nine Nether River area.”
“Focus on comprehensive coverage.”
As the order was given, countless artillery fire poured down once again.
Boom!
Boom!
A massive amount of attacks continuously landed on the riverbank.
After all, the Nine Nether River was an S-Rank Building, possessing its own unique energy that could isolate a portion of external influences.
Although this power could not strengthen the Undead Race, it could help them isolate environmental erosion.
Therefore, this river became their most important marching route.
But now, for the sake of vigilance, more and more of the Undead Race had no choice but to go ashore.
Once they left the river, not only did they lose the protection of the Formation, but their bodies also began to weaken rapidly.
Boom!
A laser cannon shot landed.
Patches of the Undead Race were directly evaporated.
Attacks that could previously only blow up ordinary believers could now easily heavily injure Foundation Establishment cultivators and exterminate Qi Refining ones.
Almost every shell could take away two to three times the normal casualties.
But the more Yang San did this, the more it proved one thing in the hearts of the Undead Race.
The Human Race was probably truly preparing to launch a surprise attack on the Nine Nether River.
Thinking of this, more and more of the Undead Race began to land and patrol regardless of the cost.
Right at this moment, a wisp of consciousness suddenly drilled out from space.
“Master!” Ling Xuzi’s little tail wagged frantically, his expression full of excitement.
“My believers have found a safe route!”
“The route map has already been given to Lord Yang Da!”
After witnessing this Divine Kingdom War, Ling Xuzi became even more determined in his resolve to follow Yang Fan.
When he originally followed the Beast-Race Demigods, his Void Spirit Race were forever mere slaves.
Meritorious service yielded no rewards.
No one cared about death.
But now it was different.
For Yang Fan, even if a large number of his believers died, he was still willing to risk his life.
Because he could see the future.
Yang Fan nodded slightly.
“Very good.”
“Once this battle ends,”
“you will receive the reward you deserve.”
Hearing these words, Ling Xuzi almost jumped up in excitement.
Rewards! They could have rewards too!
A main god like this was impossible to find anywhere.
Ling Xuzi slowly lowered his head, filled with deep emotion in his heart.
In the past, he drifted with nowhere to rely on; today, he finally knew he had met a wise master.
If he could receive divine grace to illuminate his path ahead, he would not hesitate to repay this lifetime with his remaining soul.
At this moment, only a single thought remained in his mind.
A man dies for one who knows him.
What need was there for rewards, as long as his believers weren’t left to starve!
On the battlefield,
Yang Fan’s surprise troops were slowly advancing.
Relying on the route provided by Ling Xuzi, the army of one hundred thousand bypassed along the way and successfully arrived near the Mechanical War Puppet.
By this time, the surroundings had long been completely covered by thick fog.
Looking out, the ground could hardly be seen clearly.
Moreover, the Mechanical War Puppet was already a thousand zhang tall, resembling two walking divine mountains of steel.
To avoid being affected by clustered artillery fire, those Undead Race believers did not stick close to the Mechanical War Puppet.
Instead, they maintained a distance of dozens of kilometers.
After all, the ankle area of the Mechanical War Puppet was too small to completely block the clustered artillery fire.
The closer they were to the Boundary-Suppressing Profound Heaven Great Wall,
in order to better adjust their angles, they instead distanced themselves further and further from the Mechanical War Puppet, using its main body area as cover as much as possible.
Because of this, when the army of one hundred thousand reached its feet, not a single member of the Undead Race discovered them.
Yang Ten looked at the crowd, his voice cold.
“According to the Lord’s orders, split into two teams.”
“The password is .”
“This is the initial password of the Mechanical War Puppet, and it is usually not modified.”
“If the structure falls into the hands of foreign races,”
“this secret passage will be an important guarantee for our Human Race to retake the structure.”
Finishing his sentence, Yang Ten continued to speak.
“Each team will carry one thousand specially-made high-concentration holy water bombs.”
“If you enter the interior, detonate them all.”
“The power is not large, and it will not damage the Mechanical structure.”
“But for the Undead Race... it is lethal enough.”
As the order was issued, the one hundred thousand people quickly split up.
Soon, at the ankle position of the left foot of the Mechanical War Puppet,
a hidden structure slowly appeared.
The Intelligent Life quickly entered the password.
Click.
Accompanied by a slight Mechanical sound, an extremely inconspicuous small door slowly opened.
The entrance was extremely small, only allowing four or five people to pass through at the same time.
The internal space was even narrower, steeper, and gloomier.
If the foreign races discovered this place, then this secret passage would be almost meaningless.
Because they would only need a few high-tier believers to completely block a million-strong army.
This was intentionally designed this way by the Human Race in the first place.
Otherwise, once the foreign races knew the password, they could likewise use this path to attack the Human Race.
This secret passage was truly a place where one man could guard the pass, and ten thousand men could not get through.
Meanwhile, Yang Da on the other side suddenly looked excited.
“Master, news has come from The Frontline.”
“The one hundred thousand troops have all entered the Mechanical War Puppet.”
“Currently... they have reached the knee joint area.”
Speaking of this, even Yang Da’s voice showed fluctuations.
With Yang Fan’s current status, he naturally had the qualification to query the back door of the Mechanical War Puppet.
Even some high-ranking members of the foreign races knew about it.
But it was still worth gambling on.
If the opponent really didn’t know...
Then the two s-class war structures would change hands before the battle.
“Shift more firepower toward the Nine Nether River.”
“Continue to divert their attention.”
“Maintain contact. If it is confirmed that no one is stationed there,”
“at the instant the passage is opened, turn all firepower toward the Mechanical War Puppet.”
“Coordinate with them to annihilate the Undead Race inside.”
Yang Fan calmly gave the order.
Inside the Mechanical War Puppet, millions of high-tier Undead Race were gathered.
If not for the narrow internal space and the advance preparation of special bombs,
relying solely on one hundred thousand people would make it completely impossible to take down.
“Understood, Master!”
Yang Da’s expression was excited.
Inside the Mechanical War Puppet, the two Human Race armies finally arrived at the target area.
Everyone stood quietly.
Ahead was a heavy steel door.
Even across the door, they could still feel the dense Death Qi coming from the other side.
Behind the door were millions of high-tier Undead Race.
The air gradually quieted down.
“Master, the time has come.”
Yang Da’s voice even trembled slightly.
This Undead Demigod... actually didn’t know about this secret passage.
Right now, only the final step was left.
Yang Fan slowly raised his head, “Execute the plan.”
As his voice fell, the entire battlefield instantly changed.
On the Boundary-Suppressing Profound Heaven Great Wall, countless Intelligent Life units simultaneously turned their muzzle cannons.
Click.
Click.
Tens of thousands of gun muzzles simultaneously locked onto the Mechanical War Puppet.
Foundation Establishment believers took to the air simultaneously, countless Flying Swords ascending into the sky, densely suspended across the firmament.
The City-Annihilating Cannon on the city wall slowly turned its direction, and terrifying energy began to gather.
The Adult Elf also received the order.
Draw the bow, nock the arrow, and aim.
The next moment,
Boom!!!
Countless artillery fire poured down simultaneously, Flying Swords were like rain, and arrows blotted out the sky.
The Mechanical War Puppet was not completely sealed.
No matter how tight the armor was, gaps would always exist.
A large number of bombs continuously passed through the gaps and smashed into the interior.
Moreover, the elven arrows were even more precise.
Over ninety percent shot directly into the interior of the Mechanical War Puppet.
“Defense!!”
The high-tier Undead Race believers, who had been somewhat lax just moments before, were instantly jolted awake.

in order to better adjust their angles, they instead distanced themselves further and further from the Mechanical War Puppet, using its main body area as cover as much as possible.
Because of this, when the army of one hundred thousand reached its feet, not a single member of the Undead Race discovered them.
Yang Ten looked at the crowd, his voice cold.
“According to the Lord’s orders, split into two teams.”
“The password is .”
“This is the initial password of the Mechanical War Puppet, and it is usually not modified.”
“If the structure falls into the hands of foreign races,”
“this secret passage will be an important guarantee for our Human Race to retake the structure.”
Finishing his sentence, Yang Ten continued to speak.
“Each team will carry one thousand specially-made high-concentration holy water bombs.”
“If you enter the interior, detonate them all.”
“The power is not large, and it will not damage the Mechanical structure.”
“But for the Undead Race... it is lethal enough.”
As the order was issued, the one hundred thousand people quickly split up.
Soon, at the ankle position of the left foot of the Mechanical War Puppet,
a hidden structure slowly appeared.
The Intelligent Life quickly entered the password.
Click.
Accompanied by a slight Mechanical sound, an extremely inconspicuous small door slowly opened.
The entrance was extremely small, only allowing four or five people to pass through at the same time.
The internal space was even narrower, steeper, and gloomier.
If the foreign races discovered this place, then this secret passage would be almost meaningless.
Because they would only need a few high-tier believers to completely block a million-strong army.
This was intentionally designed this way by the Human Race in the first place.
Otherwise, once the foreign races knew the password, they could likewise use this path to attack the Human Race.
This secret passage was truly a place where one man could guard the pass, and ten thousand men could not get through.
Meanwhile, Yang Da on the other side suddenly looked excited.
“Master, news has come from The Frontline.”
“The one hundred thousand troops have all entered the Mechanical War Puppet.”
“Currently... they have reached the knee joint area.”
Speaking of this, even Yang Da’s voice showed fluctuations.
With Yang Fan’s current status, he naturally had the qualification to query the back door of the Mechanical War Puppet.
Even some high-ranking members of the foreign races knew about it.
But it was still worth gambling on.
If the opponent really didn’t know...
Then the two s-class war structures would change hands before the battle.
“Shift more firepower toward the Nine Nether River.”
“Continue to divert their attention.”
“Maintain contact.
If it is confirmed that no one is stationed there,”
“at the instant the passage is opened, turn all firepower toward the Mechanical War Puppet.”
“Coordinate with them to annihilate the Undead Race inside.”
Yang Fan calmly gave the order.
Inside the Mechanical War Puppet, millions of high-tier Undead Race were gathered.
If not for the narrow internal space and the advance preparation of special bombs,
relying solely on one hundred thousand people would make it completely impossible to take down.
“Understood, Master!”
Yang Da’s expression was excited.
Inside the Mechanical War Puppet, the two Human Race armies finally arrived at the target area.
Everyone stood quietly.
Ahead was a heavy steel door.
Even across the door, they could still feel the dense Death Qi coming from the other side.
Behind the door were millions of high-tier Undead Race.
The air gradually quieted down.
“Master, the time has come.”
Yang Da’s voice even trembled slightly.
This Undead Demigod... actually didn’t know about this secret passage.
Right now, only the final step was left.
Yang Fan slowly raised his head, “Execute the plan.”
As his voice fell, the entire battlefield instantly changed.
On the Boundary-Suppressing Profound Heaven Great Wall, countless Intelligent Life units simultaneously turned their muzzle cannons.
Click.
Click.
Tens of thousands of gun muzzles simultaneously locked onto the Mechanical War Puppet.
Foundation Establishment believers took to the air simultaneously, countless Flying Swords ascending into the sky, densely suspended across the firmament.
The City-Annihilating Cannon on the city wall slowly turned its direction, and terrifying energy began to gather.
The Adult Elf also received the order.
Draw the bow, nock the arrow, and aim.
The next moment,
Boom!!!
Countless artillery fire poured down simultaneously, Flying Swords were like rain, and arrows blotted out the sky.
The Mechanical War Puppet was not completely sealed.
No matter how tight the armor was, gaps would always exist.
A large number of bombs continuously passed through the gaps and smashed into the interior.
Moreover, the elven arrows were even more precise.
Over ninety percent shot directly into the interior of the Mechanical War Puppet.
“Defense!!”
The high-tier Undead Race believers, who had been somewhat lax just moments before, were instantly jolted awake.

chapters.title: Chapter 255: Highest Authority Transfer Successful
paragraphs: A massive amount of spells erupted simultaneously as the frost mages raised their hands in unison.
Snap!
A large amount of hard ice rapidly spread, and the gaps of the Mechanical War Puppet began to be frantically sealed.
At the same time, countless necromancers waved their staves.
Numerous skeletons crawled out from the aura of death, crazily piling up and squeezing against each other.
They forcefully formed walls of bones one after another, creating barriers and bone shields.
The entire interior of the Mechanical War Puppet instantly descended into chaos.
The sounds of explosions and arrows piercing flesh rang out frantically.
At the same time, those Human Race believers who had been prepared to strike abruptly pushed open the heavy iron doors.
Almost at the exact moment the iron doors opened,
a large number of specially-made holy water bombs were thrown out simultaneously.
Hundreds of bombs drew arcs through the air, precisely landing directly above the high-tier Undead Race believers.
Seeing the enemies suddenly appearing behind them, those high-tier Undead Race all froze for a moment.
“How could there be a Human Race appearing here?”
A doubt appeared in the minds of countless Undead Race at the same time.
At this moment,
the Undead Demigod located in the core area abruptly stood up.
Terrifying black Qi spread frantically in all directions from the soles of his feet.
A roar suddenly resounded.
The next moment, the bombs made of high-concentration holy water exploded simultaneously.
Boom——!!
The holy water fell like a torrential rainstorm inside the Mechanical War Puppet.
Chi chi chi——
Merely upon contact, a large number of Undead Race bodies began to frantically emit white smoke.
Their bones rapidly corroded, making a harsh sound.
Even the Undead Race in the Foundation Establishment Realm let out miserable screams at this moment.
Some Undead Race knelt on both knees, some tightly covered their bodies, and others even curled up into a ball in pain directly.
Having lost energy supply, the defensive spells that originally enveloped the interior instantly dissipated.
And the great battle completely erupted at this moment.
“Kill!!”
Foundation Establishment believers rushed out first, and a large number of Second-class Intelligent Life started their combat programs simultaneously.
The high-tier Undead Race had yet to recover from the holy water’s corrosion.
The harvesting had already begun.
Streaks of arrows whistled out, precisely sinking into the glabella of the Undead Race believers.
Boom!
The next moment,
the holy water stored inside the arrows burst open directly.
Skulls shattered.
Inside the Mechanical War Puppet, although the 50,000 Human Race army was small in number,
they were all the elite of the elite.
Facing a group of high-tier Undead Race weakened by holy water, with their spells failed and states plummeted,
the outcome was long since doomed.
Almost every second, a large number of high-tier Undead Race fell.
At the same time,
outside the Mechanical War Puppet, the long-range firepower support of the Boundary-Suppressing Profound Heaven Great Wall had also arrived.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
Streaks of attacks crossed a long distance and precisely landed inside the Mechanical War Puppet.
The lives of those high-tier Undead Race were crazily harvested like weeds at this moment.
The entire interior of the Mechanical War Puppet had completely turned into a slaughterhouse.
Seemingly having received the Divine Decree,
the Undead Race army that originally followed far behind went crazy at this moment and began to charge toward the Mechanical War Puppet.
Countless Undead Race began to climb upwards from the ankle position.
Viewed from afar, it was like countless ants covering the body of the Mechanical War Puppet.
Several hours passed, and at this moment, the lower half of the entire Mechanical War Puppet was hung full of Undead Race believers.
They stepped on their companions’ bodies to continuously climb, getting higher and higher.
Bang!
A bomb landed on the waist of the Mechanical War Puppet.
The violent explosion instantly blew a large number of skeleton soldiers flying away.
After falling to the ground, their bodies were torn apart.
Then, under the influence of the rich aura of life, they began to rapidly dissolve.
But even so, those skeleton soldiers still went forward one after another, fiercely fearing no death.
They had already received the Divine Decree; no matter what price was paid, they must recapture these two S-Rank Buildings.
“The signs of defeat are already showing, why bother struggling bitterly.”
Yang Fan’s gaze was like a torch as he looked toward the core location of the Undead Race Divine Kingdom, a sneer appearing at the corner of his mouth.
Now he only needed to buy time.
As long as the believers in the Mechanical War Puppet seized control, this war would have no more suspense.
At this moment, in the core area of the Undead Race Divine Kingdom, the Undead Demigod was so angry that his entire body’s bones were making a chi-chi sound.
The Advisors below were each as silent as cicadas in winter.
They did not even dare to raise their heads.
“You told me not long ago—”
“that their target is the Nine Nether River?”
The voice was low, but the killing intent could no longer be suppressed.
“My King... This defies common sense...”
“Go to hell!!”
Boom!!
A giant bone claw suddenly descended, and that Advisor was instantly smashed into bone paste.
But even so, the giant bone claw continued to fall.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
The bone claw continuously struck the ground; it seemed that only in this way could he vent the fury in his heart.
“We must take them back...”
“These are two s-class war structures after all...”
The Undead Demigod’s voice began to tremble.
In their hands, the Mechanical War Puppet was merely a means of transportation.
But if it fell into the hands of the Human Race, it would be a true war nuclear weapon.
Had he known this earlier, he would have rather never exposed it.
“Could it be...”
“My Divine Kingdom path...”
“has truly reached its end?”
At this moment, this Undead Demigod felt despair in his heart for the first time.
Inside the Mechanical War Puppet.
High-concentration holy water continuously sprinkled down.
A large number of Undead Race emitted white smoke all over their bodies, with less than ten percent of their combat power remaining.
In the distance, the archer legion composed of Adult Elves continuously drew their bows.
Streaks of arrows crossed a distance of several thousand meters and precisely landed among them.
Whenever a high-tier Undead Race attempted to organize a counterattack, the next second their skull would be pierced by an arrow.
Under the cover of the Martial Masters and Foundation Establishment believers,
dozens of Second-class Intelligent Life finally broke through heavy obstacles and arrived at the core control area of the Mechanical War Puppet.
Above the cold metal platform, a large number of runes and Mechanical patterns constantly flickered.
Intelligent Life figures simultaneously extended their palms, and countless data streams poured in frantically along the interfaces.
The connection between the Mechanical Civilization and the Mechanical Civilization began to be established.
[Information synchronizing...]
[Authority parsing...]
[Civilization authentication...]
The entire control hall was covered in blue light.
A few seconds later, an emotionless Mechanical voice resounded throughout the field.
[Connection complete]
[Identity verification]
[Human Race Mechanical Civilization]
[Highest Authority Transfer Successful]
The moment the voice fell,
the Mechanical War Puppet that was still moving forward suddenly stopped.
The entire battlefield seemed to quiet down for a split second.
Shortly after,
Rumble——
the two thousand-zhang-tall Mechanical War Puppets began to vibrate violently.
Viewed from the outside,
under the frantic shaking of those huge steel bodies,
a large number of Undead Race skeletons hanging on them didn’t even have time to react before they fell down like a torrential rainstorm.
“Hold on!”
“Don’t fall down!”
Miserable screams rang out one after another.
Dense numbers of Undead Race constantly plummeted.
Viewed from afar, it was as if a white bone rain was falling from the sky.
Seeing this scene, Yang Da could no longer suppress his excitement.
“Master!”
“The control of these two Mechanical War Puppets is already in my hands!”
“Very good.” A smile also appeared on Yang Fan’s face, “Show us the power of these s-class war structures.”

chapters.title: Chapter 256: Make a Desperate Stand
paragraphs: “Yes, Master!”
The command was issued.
All weapon Systems inside the Mechanical War Puppet activated simultaneously.
Boom!
A large number of extremely weak high-tier Undead Race members were thrown directly from tens of thousands of meters in the air.
Some were smashed to pieces the moment they flew out, and some were blasted into fragments by the firepower below before even hitting the ground.
Then the two Mechanical War Puppets slowly turned around.
The pitch-black muzzles began aiming at the ground, aiming at the Nine Nether River, and aiming at the endless Undead Race army.
The next second.
Destruction descended.
Hum——
A blue beam of light hundreds of meters in diameter erupted first.
The railgun tore apart the heavens and the earth.
Wherever it passed, countless Undead Race members evaporated instantly.
The earth was forcefully plowed into an abyss tens of miles long.
Immediately afterwards, hundreds of main energy cannons fired simultaneously.
Boom!
Boom!
Countless balls of light fell, and each explosion could cover a range of several thousand meters.
Large areas of the Undead Race vanished as if wiped away by an eraser.
In the sky, tens of thousands of micro tracking missiles were launched simultaneously.
Dragging long tails of flame, they fell into the corpse tide.
The explosions merged into one, and the firelight covered the earth.
Moreover, at the chest position of the Mechanical War Puppet, a huge energy matrix slowly unfolded.
The next moment.
Lasers all over the sky poured down like a torrential rain.
Wherever it passed, white bones shattered and the undead were annihilated.
Even the Undead Race gathered near the Nine Nether River had large areas forcefully cleared out.
The entire battlefield completely turned into a one-sided massacre.
Seeing this scene, joy similarly appeared on Yang Fan’s face.
Solely in terms of power, this Mechanical War Puppet was not weak at all compared to the Great Void Warship.
If there was any difference, it was that its load-bearing capacity was slightly inferior.
In terms of transporting legions, the Mechanical War Puppet was far inferior to the warship.
But as a weapon of war, its value was equally astonishing.
This was definitely an unexpected pleasant surprise.
This kind of war-type S-Rank Building was far too important for Yang Fan.
“With these two Mechanical War Puppets, that Human Race Prodigy who walked the Mechanical Path actually still lost?”
Yang Fan’s gaze looked towards the direction of the Divine Kingdom Core, but his eyes did not relax in the slightest.
The Nine Nether River, the Mechanical War Puppets—these were all spoils of war that the opponent had once obtained.
He firmly did not believe that this Undead Demigod only had these trump cards.
“Master.”
“Now that there are two more S-Rank Mechanical War Puppets, should we change our strategy?”
Yang Da said excitedly.
Yang Fan shook his head.
“No.”
“Execute according to the original plan.”
“Arrange for Intelligent Life to pilot the Mechanical War Puppets to intercept the Undead Race.”
“In addition, continue pouring holy water resources.”
Speaking of this, Yang Fan’s gaze was calm.
“The closer we are to victory, the less we can be careless.”
“Most of the time, failure does not appear during a disadvantage, but when one thinks they have already won.”
“A Divine Kingdom War is never child’s play.”
“No one knows what will happen the next moment.”
“Since consuming Divinity Points can trade for a secure victory, why bother taking risks just to save resources?”
Possessing the SSS-Rank Evolution Talent, time was always on Yang Fan’s side.
Facing such an opponent, he was unwilling to bear any risks.
Regarding this, Yang Da obviously had a different opinion.
But thinking of his sealed palace, he ultimately closed his mouth wisely.
As the two Mechanical War Puppets joined the battlefield, the Undead Race’s advance speed completely fell into stagnation.
The original largest defensive barrier had already failed, and a large number of Undead Race members began to die in batches, and even the military formations began to collapse.
“Run!”
“We can’t hold them off!”
“Why is it like this!”
“That is our Mechanical War Puppet!”
“Our King! Save us!”
Terrified shouts kept sounding, and more and more Undead Race members began to flee.
But facing the artillery fire covering the entire battlefield, they had nowhere to escape at all.
Mountains of bones continued to pile up in the distance.
Across a thousand miles of land, there were white bones and wrecks everywhere.
The dense aura of life was even diluted quite a bit.
However, Yang Fan did not have the slightest worry.
As resources were continuously invested.
It wouldn’t be long before there would no longer be a foothold in the opponent’s Divine Kingdom Core area.
“What other means do you have?”
“If you still don’t use them,”
“You won’t have the chance anymore.”
Yang Fan looked towards the depths of the divine kingdom, his gaze as deep as the sea.
At this moment, in the Undead Race’s Divine Kingdom Core area.
The Undead Demigod’s mental state had withered to the extreme.
Over the years, the backlash brought by the death of a large number of believers had continuously accumulated.
Even as a demigod, he had long since reached the end of his tether by now.
“Our clan’s casualties are so huge...”
“Has that Human Demigod still not launched a general attack?”
The Undead Demigod’s voice was hoarse.
Below, an Advisor tremblingly knelt on the ground.
“Reporting to our King.”
“The Human Race is still continuously pouring high-concentration holy water.”
“Even though this subordinate deliberately arranged for low-tier believers to throw their lives away, it still failed to make the opponent let down their guard.”
Hearing this, the Undead Demigod suddenly laughed.
The laughter grew louder and louder, finally even turning frantic.
“Hahaha!”
“Good!”
“What a good Human Race!”
“He is actually of the same kind!”
“With such an advantage... he can actually still hold back from launching a general attack...”
“The heavens want to destroy me...”
“The heavens want to destroy me!!”
His voice was hoarse, yet there was no anger, only despair.
“My King!”
“We still have the Eternal Corpse Mine!”
“As long as we have time, we can still gather a large army again!”
The Advisor spoke hurriedly.
“Opportunity?”
The Undead Demigod slowly raised his head.
In his hollow eye sockets, only exhaustion remained.
“Now we are already turtles in a jar.”
“We can’t even charge out, where is there still an opportunity for a major battle.”
“The Eternal Corpse Mine can indeed manufacture legions, but look...”
He slowly raised his hand, pointing towards the outside.
“In our divine kingdom nowadays, how much Death Qi is still available for use?”
“In the core area, the aura of life is almost even thicker than Death Qi.”
As the voice fell, all the Advisors fell completely silent.
If back then they hadn’t chosen to hold their ground, but instead fought a decisive battle directly.
It might not have been impossible to win.
Wanting to use the sacrificial grand array of the core area to completely annihilate the opponent.
In the end, they instead trapped themselves to death here.
“Bastard... possessing such resources... and yet still just a demigod...”
“How could there be this kind of person...”
The Undead Demigod’s heart was filled with frustration.
In this Divine Kingdom War, the resources invested by the opponent even exceeded many low-tier gods.
For six hundred years, he had never fought such a suffocating Divine Kingdom War.
Finally, the Undead Demigod slowly stood up.
Those gloomy pupils gradually became resolute.
“Continuing to hold our ground is boiling a frog in warm water, we will undoubtedly die.”
“In that case... then let us make a final desperate stand.”
The next moment, a Divine Decree descended.
The entire divine kingdom trembled simultaneously.
“My believers.”
“Death is not the end, and destruction is not the finish.”
“Today, I shall be with you.”
“Sacrifice everything, destroy everything.”
“For the Undead Race! For the divine kingdom!”
“Open the sacrificial grand array!!”
Boom——
The entire divine kingdom shook violently.
At the same time.
In the Real World, Yang Fan, who was still reading books, suddenly heard Yang Da’s voice.
“Master!”
“Quickly enter the divine kingdom!”

But as a weapon of war, its value was equally astonishing.
This was definitely an unexpected pleasant surprise.
This kind of war-type S-Rank Building was far too important for Yang Fan.
“With these two Mechanical War Puppets, that Human Race Prodigy who walked the Mechanical Path actually still lost?”
Yang Fan’s gaze looked towards the direction of the Divine Kingdom Core, but his eyes did not relax in the slightest.
The Nine Nether River, the Mechanical War Puppets—these were all spoils of war that the opponent had once obtained.
He firmly did not believe that this Undead Demigod only had these trump cards.
“Master.”
“Now that there are two more S-Rank Mechanical War Puppets, should we change our strategy?”
Yang Da said excitedly.
Yang Fan shook his head.
“No.”
“Execute according to the original plan.”
“Arrange for Intelligent Life to pilot the Mechanical War Puppets to intercept the Undead Race.”
“In addition, continue pouring holy water resources.”
Speaking of this, Yang Fan’s gaze was calm.
“The closer we are to victory, the less we can be careless.”
“Most of the time, failure does not appear during a disadvantage, but when one thinks they have already won.”
“A Divine Kingdom War is never child’s play.”
“No one knows what will happen the next moment.”
“Since consuming Divinity Points can trade for a secure victory, why bother taking risks just to save resources?”
Possessing the SSS-Rank Evolution Talent, time was always on Yang Fan’s side.
Facing such an opponent, he was unwilling to bear any risks.
Regarding this, Yang Da obviously had a different opinion.
But thinking of his sealed palace, he ultimately closed his mouth wisely.
As the two Mechanical War Puppets joined the battlefield, the Undead Race’s advance speed completely fell into stagnation.
The original largest defensive barrier had already failed, and a large number of Undead Race members began to die in batches, and even the military formations began to collapse.
“Run!”
“We can’t hold them off!”
“Why is it like this!”
“That is our Mechanical War Puppet!”
“Our King!
Save us!”
Terrified shouts kept sounding, and more and more Undead Race members began to flee.
But facing the artillery fire covering the entire battlefield, they had nowhere to escape at all.
Mountains of bones continued to pile up in the distance.
Across a thousand miles of land, there were white bones and wrecks everywhere.
The dense aura of life was even diluted quite a bit.
However, Yang Fan did not have the slightest worry.
As resources were continuously invested.
It wouldn’t be long before there would no longer be a foothold in the opponent’s Divine Kingdom Core area.
“What other means do you have?”
“If you still don’t use them,”
“You won’t have the chance anymore.”
Yang Fan looked towards the depths of the divine kingdom, his gaze as deep as the sea.
At this moment, in the Undead Race’s Divine Kingdom Core area.
The Undead Demigod’s mental state had withered to the extreme.
Over the years, the backlash brought by the death of a large number of believers had continuously accumulated.
Even as a demigod, he had long since reached the end of his tether by now.
“Our clan’s casualties are so huge...”
“Has that Human Demigod still not launched a general attack?”
The Undead Demigod’s voice was hoarse.
Below, an Advisor tremblingly knelt on the ground.
“Reporting to our King.”
“The Human Race is still continuously pouring high-concentration holy water.”
“Even though this subordinate deliberately arranged for low-tier believers to throw their lives away, it still failed to make the opponent let down their guard.”
Hearing this, the Undead Demigod suddenly laughed.
The laughter grew louder and louder, finally even turning frantic.
“Hahaha!”
“Good!”
“What a good Human Race!”
“He is actually of the same kind!”
“With such an advantage... he can actually still hold back from launching a general attack...”
“The heavens want to destroy me...”
“The heavens want to destroy me!!”
His voice was hoarse, yet there was no anger, only despair.
“My King!”
“We still have the Eternal Corpse Mine!”
“As long as we have time, we can still gather a large army again!”
The Advisor spoke hurriedly.
“Opportunity?”
The Undead Demigod slowly raised his head.
In his hollow eye sockets, only exhaustion remained.
“Now we are already turtles in a jar.”
“We can’t even charge out, where is there still an opportunity for a major battle.”
“The Eternal Corpse Mine can indeed manufacture legions, but look...”
He slowly raised his hand, pointing towards the outside.
“In our divine kingdom nowadays, how much Death Qi is still available for use?”
“In the core area, the aura of life is almost even thicker than Death Qi.”
As the voice fell, all the Advisors fell completely silent.
If back then they hadn’t chosen to hold their ground, but instead fought a decisive battle directly.
It might not have been impossible to win.
Wanting to use the sacrificial grand array of the core area to completely annihilate the opponent.
In the end, they instead trapped themselves to death here.
“Bastard... possessing such resources... and yet still just a demigod...”
“How could there be this kind of person...”
The Undead Demigod’s heart was filled with frustration.
In this Divine Kingdom War, the resources invested by the opponent even exceeded many low-tier gods.
For six hundred years, he had never fought such a suffocating Divine Kingdom War.
Finally, the Undead Demigod slowly stood up.
Those gloomy pupils gradually became resolute.
“Continuing to hold our ground is boiling a frog in warm water, we will undoubtedly die.”
“In that case... then let us make a final desperate stand.”
The next moment, a Divine Decree descended.
The entire divine kingdom trembled simultaneously.
“My believers.”
“Death is not the end, and destruction is not the finish.”
“Today, I shall be with you.”
“Sacrifice everything, destroy everything.”
“For the Undead Race!
For the divine kingdom!”
“Open the sacrificial grand array!!”
Boom——
The entire divine kingdom shook violently.
At the same time.
In the Real World, Yang Fan, who was still reading books, suddenly heard Yang Da’s voice.
“Master!”
“Quickly enter the divine kingdom!”

chapters.title: Chapter 257: Hiding So Deep
paragraphs: Yang Fan did not hesitate, and his consciousness descended instantly.
As soon as he entered the Divine Kingdom, his pupils contracted slightly.
In the distance, within the core area of the Undead Race.
An indescribably massive blood-red Formation slowly emerged.
Countless Formation patterns shot up into the sky, and blood-colored lines covered the world.
Looking from afar, it felt as though the entire sky had been torn apart.
Massive runes floated in the Void Realm.
Connected to each other, covering hundreds of thousands of kilometers.
The entire world seemed to be dyed in blood color.
“Yang Da, what is this?”
Yang Fan’s voice was solemn.
Yang Da stared intently into the distance, a trace of lingering fear actually present in his eyes.
“Reporting to Master, based on my review of the data.”
“This should be an extremely powerful sacrificial grand array.”
“Sacrificial grand array?” Yang Fan frowned, “What is its purpose?”
Yang Da took a deep breath.
“Master, there are extremely many types of sacrificial Formations.”
“But they all share one thing in common, and that is the price is extremely huge.”
“It requires sacrificing a large number of believers to set up the Formation.”
“Moreover, the world is fair. To gain stronger power, one must accumulate more energy.”
“Even after the Formation is completed, it still needs continuous input of energy to maintain its operation.”
“Furthermore, this type of Formation can usually only be used once.”
“Once used, the grand array is completely scrapped.”
Speaking of this, Yang Da’s eyes were complex.
“Under normal circumstances.”
“No race would deploy this kind of Formation.”
“Because the price is too high, it would seriously slow down the development of the Divine Kingdom.”
Speaking of this.
Yang Da suddenly looked at Yang Fan, admiration appearing in his gaze for the first time.
Some things, data cannot represent everything.
Some choices cannot be judged solely by probability.
If it were according to Yang Da’s judgment, whether after obtaining the Mechanical War Puppets or before, a general attack should have been launched.
But if they had truly entered this grand array... the billions of believers on The Frontline probably wouldn’t have been able to survive.
Hearing this, Yang Fan was silent for a moment, then spoke.
“Since that’s the case, our army is currently entirely outside the Formation.”
“What is the significance of him activating this Formation?”
To this, Yang Da did not reply.
To be precise, he did not know either.
There are millions of Formations in this world; even if they are all sacrificial Formations, their effects are completely different.
However, the answer would obviously appear soon.
The next moment, as the grand array operated completely.
Yang Fan’s expression suddenly changed.
He saw that the massive amounts of holy water poured into the Divine Kingdom actually began to rapidly lose their effect.
The originally extremely dense vitality breath also began to constantly dissipate.
Replacing it was an even denser Death Qi.
The black aura blotted out the sky, and the entire Divine Kingdom turned eerie again.
Yang Fan’s eyes narrowed slightly.
Being able to wipe out three Human Race Prodigies was indeed not that simple.
He had paid such a heavy price, only for it to be cracked by a Formation.
However, the truly terrifying part had just begun.
Those mountain-like piles of white bones in the distance suddenly vibrated.
Crack.
Crack.
Countless bones began to move, and the shattered bones spliced back together.
Skeleton after skeleton stood back up.
Bone Dragons flapped their wings, and Bone Giants roared.
Those Undead Race members who had long been exterminated actually all revived at this moment.
More and more,
in the blink of an eye, the entire Divine Kingdom Core area,
their number... reached hundreds of billions.
Seeing this scene.
Yang Fan couldn’t help but laugh out of anger.
“Good fellow, everyone is using cheats together, huh.”
“Yang Da, transfer another twenty billion troops from the Divine Kingdom.”
“Let the battle begin.”
“Yes, Master.”
Yang Da immediately gave the order.
Although the number of Undead Race believers far exceeded their own side, most of them were only low-tier skeleton soldiers.
Those truly dead high-tier Undead Race members clearly had not been resurrected.
Regarding this, Yang Da actually felt that Yang Fan was a bit overly cautious.
Relying solely on the billions of troops on The Frontline, plus the Mechanical War Puppets and the Great Void Warship.
According to his calculations, the win rate was already exaggeratedly high.
However, transferring troops also had its benefits.
The more troops invested, the smaller the final losses would be.
At the same time, the resurrected Undead Race army began to advance forward.
Skeletons, bone beasts, Bone Dragons, and ghouls.
Countless Undead Race members converged into a white torrent, sweeping toward the Boundary-Suppressing Profound Heaven Great Wall.
However, what greeted them was firepower covering the heavens and the earth.
Boom!
Boom!
Boom!
Countless Spells rose from the Great Wall.
Fireballs, thunder, wind blades.
Densely covering the entire battlefield.
A large number of Smart Weapons activated simultaneously, and tens of thousands of gun barrels began to turn their directions.
The next moment.
On the Boundary-Suppressing Profound Heaven Great Wall, the City-Annihilating Cannons that already spread across the city walls lit up simultaneously.
Dazzling energy began to gather.
“Fire.”
Along with the falling command.
Tens of thousands of beams of light blasted out simultaneously.
The earth trembled, and the corpse wave was instantly torn open with countless gaps.
Large swaths of the Undead Race directly evaporated.
The Martial Master believers did not make a move.
Right now, it was still a war of attrition; if these alien races wanted to approach the Boundary-Suppressing Profound Heaven Great Wall, they had to die off in batches first.
At the same time, a large amount of war resources were continuously transferred from the depths of the Divine Kingdom to The Frontline.
Martial Apprentices, Qi Refining Cultivators, first-class Intelligent Life, Adult Elfs, Tier 5 Beings.
Countless believers left their homes and rushed to the battlefield.
In the Divine Kingdom Core area, the Undead Demigod let out a ghoulish, weird laugh.
“Good, very good.”
“Human Demigod, you hide deep enough, and you are cautious enough as a person.”
“To think there are still so many believers who haven’t gone to The Frontline.”
As the master of the Divine Kingdom, the outer situation naturally could not be hidden from him.
Looking at those nearly twenty billion Human Race reinforcements, he even felt a bit like laughing.
With this kind of troop strength, what grounds did he have to win?
He had originally thought that his last-ditch struggle would at least have a shred of a chance.
Now looking at it, it was simply a joke.
What chance was there?
The reason he was able to hold on until now was entirely because the other party was steadier than him.
Even back then, so what if billions of the Human Race had directly killed their way into the core area?
Once the sacrificial grand array ended, he still wouldn’t be able to win.
The foundations of both sides’ Divine Kingdoms were simply not on the same level.
With such an exaggerated gap in combat power, the opponent insisted on slowly wearing him to death.
“Does he have so much resources that they’re burning with it?!”
At the same time, those two S-class Mechanical War Puppets completely transformed into war machines.
Countless laser weapons began to strafe in all directions.
Beams of light all over the sky covered the entire battlefield.
Wherever they passed, a large number of skeleton soldiers instantly turned into powder.
Bone Dragons were pierced through, and Bone Giants collapsed.
Patch after patch of the Undead Race continuously vanished.
Looking from afar, the two Mechanical War Puppets were like two moving meat grinders.
However, the number of the Undead Race was too vast after all.
Even though they kept dying, the overall battle line still slowly advanced.
Getting closer and closer to the Boundary-Suppressing Profound Heaven Great Wall.
Seeing this scene.
Yang Fan did not hesitate, “Yang San, deploy one Great Void Warship.”
“Yes, Master.”
The next moment.
The Void Realm suddenly twisted, and a behemoth slowly emerged.
At first, it was only a few hundred meters.
But as space continuously oscillated, its volume began to expand crazily.
Dozens of li, a hundred li, two hundred li.
Finally, a giant warship spanning several hundred li in length floated in the sky, its shadow covering the entire battlefield.
Everyone who looked up could only see the hull that blotted out the sun.
