chapters.title: Chapter 258: I Can Negotiate Too
paragraphs: Great Void Warship.
Descended.
Immediately afterward, countless Void Cannons lit up simultaneously across the hull.
Boom——!!
The first cannon fired.
Space itself seemed to be torn apart.
A massive pillar of black light pierced through the battlefield.
Wherever it passed, nearly a million ordinary Undead Race members vanished instantly, leaving not even wreckage behind.
The second cannon, the third cannon, the fourth cannon.
A single volley evaporated millions of Undead Race members.
Divine Kingdom Core area.
The Undead Demigod gripped the ancient mirror in front of him so tightly that his finger bones turned white.
Looking at the sky-blocking Great Void Warship, he suddenly burst into wild laughter.
“Hhahahaha!”
“I admire you!”
“You’re steady enough! And ruthless enough!”
“You actually still have trump cards!”
As the Great Void Warship joined the battlefield.
Those ordinary Undead Race armies could barely advance.
As time continuously flowed, the reinforcements summoned by Yang Fan finally arrived.
A large number of believers began to board the Boundary-Suppressing Profound Heaven Great Wall.
More and more firepower joined the battlefield.
Long-range attacks grew increasingly terrifying, causing not only large-scale deaths among ordinary Undead Race members.
Even high-tier believers gradually began to fall in patches.
This was a war that possessed all the advantages of timing, terrain, and unity of people.
Even those elite believers of the Martial Route were still resting in the rear to avoid occupying space.
Only if the enemy could genuinely advance to the base of the wall would it be their turn to strike.
But looking at it now, the enemy seemed completely unable to advance.
Yang San and other combat-type Intelligent Life forms were still carefully directing the battle.
Yang Yi and Yang Er constantly allocated war supplies.
Across The Frontline, everyone was busy.
Only Yang Da had somehow brought over a grand master chair, placing it directly in the absolute center of the Boundary-Suppressing Profound Heaven Great Wall.
And Yang Fan was sitting right there, appreciating this nearly one-sided crushing war.
At this moment, Yang Da stood to his left.
Ling Xuzi stood to his right, wagging his tail, his small face smiling almost into a bundle as he continuously and attentively poured wine for Yang Fan.
“Master, the enemy has already exhausted their tricks.”
“As things stand now, apart from somehow using an unknown method to rapidly nurture believers in large numbers.”
“With this Undead Race lacking special war structures, the outcome of the battle is set!”
Yang Da was full of excitement.
As he spoke, his gaze even involuntarily glanced towards the distant Divine Kingdom Core.
Clearly, he had already started coveting those core structures.
On the other side, while pouring wine, Ling Xuzi frantically flattered him.
“Master’s Divine Might is peerless.”
“Today’s battle has truly opened this subordinate’s eyes.”
“Having lived for so many years, this subordinate has never seen someone as omniscient and infallible as Master.”
“Every step of the enemy is within Master’s calculations.”
“If Master had been born in antiquity, I’m afraid all the gods would have to abdicate and yield their positions.”
“What Demigod?”
“Although Master is currently a Demigod, in this subordinate’s eyes, there is no difference from a True God.”
“Being able to follow Master is practically like the ancestral graves of the Void Spirit Race smoking green smoke for eighteen generations.”
“If I had known earlier that Master was so majestic, this subordinate should have knelt down to sign the contract back then.”
The more Ling Xuzi spoke, the more excited he became, eventually even turning his eye sockets somewhat red.
“Master, if not for you.”
“This subordinate would probably still be a muddle-headed little demigod.”
“Being able to stand here pouring wine for you now is this subordinate’s honor!”
Hearing this series of words, Yang Da’s mouth at the side couldn’t help but twitch.
This Void Spirit Race demigod... is far too good at bootlicking.
Hearing such words, even he felt embarrassed.
“Not bad.” Yang Fan picked up his wine glass and nodded with satisfaction.
“When this battle ends, there will be a heavy reward.”
Ling Xuzi was instantly overjoyed.
“Many thanks, Master!”
As he spoke, his wine-pouring actions accelerated by a fraction.
Beside him, Yang Da was even more speechless.
Ever since his own master got rid of his womanizing bad habit, how did he pick up a new hobby?
Isn’t this getting close to flatterers and distancing oneself from virtuous officials?
However, thinking of his own palace, Yang Da ultimately kept his mouth shut in silence.
Right at this moment, the entire battlefield suddenly quieted down.
All the Undead Race believers stopped in their tracks simultaneously.
The next moment.
An illusory figure slowly condensed.
The Undead Demigod appeared.
Yang Fan couldn’t even be bothered to raise his head, still holding his wine glass and gently sipping.
The next second.
Bang!
A dull sound rang out.
A dignified Undead Demigod actually knelt down right in front of his own believers, in front of Yang Fan’s billions of troops.
He knelt straight down.
“I beg for mercy! I am willing to offer everything!”
The Undead Demigod prostrated himself on the ground, his head pressed tightly against the earth.
Seeing this scene.
Those Undead Race believers similarly knelt down in unison.
For this Undead Demigod, facing the Human Race, even if defeat was certain, he would still choose to fight desperately.
But at this moment, he suddenly saw another path.
Because he was inside his own divine kingdom, he could clearly perceive it.
Aside from Yang Fan present here, this Void Spirit Race member wagging his tail and pouring wine was likewise a demigod.
The other party actually accepted an Alien Demigod as a Subordinate God.
Why couldn’t he?
Since he could see no path of survival, he would just change his way of living.
The Undead Demigod suddenly felt that he might still have a glimmer of survival.
Regardless of what this alien and the Human Race talked about, or why they signed a Subordinate God Contract!
But given the current situation.
He expressed: “I can negotiate too, and I can be a Subordinate God too!”
“What is the meaning of this?”
Yang Fan chuckled and put down his wine glass.
The Undead Demigod hurriedly raised his head.
“I want to be like him and become My Lord’s Subordinate God.”
“I only ask for a glimmer of survival.”
“My divine kingdom talent is proliferation. Coupled with special structures, my believers are virtually endless.”
“In the future, when My Lord launches a Divine Kingdom War, I can completely act as cannon fodder.”
“Scouting the path, throwing my life away, and consuming the enemy.”
“My usefulness is huge!”
“I only ask to stay alive!”
As he spoke, the Undead Demigod was even somewhat excited.
Because in his perception, Ling Xuzi was pitifully weak.
If trash like that was acceptable, why wouldn’t he be?
“You want to be my Subordinate God?” Yang Fan was somewhat surprised.
“That’s right.”
“You still have so many believers.”
Yang Fan’s gaze swept towards the distance.
“You wouldn’t be trying to trick me into entering the Divine Kingdom Core,”
“while holding other means up your sleeve, would you?”
Hearing this, the Undead Demigod’s gaze turned ruthless.
He turned his head directly to look at the hundreds of millions of believers below.
Afterward, a Divine Decree descended.
“My believers, you were born because of death.”
“Now, it is also time to return through death.”
“The time for the divine kingdom’s survival has arrived; offer up your remnant bodies.”
“Return the Death Qi and go back to heaven and earth.”
“Use your end in exchange for the continuation of the divine kingdom.”
“This is both an honor and a bestowal.”
As the Divine Decree descended.
Those Undead Race believers below the Qi Refining Realm showed not the slightest hesitation.
The next moment.
Boom!
Countless Undead Race members simultaneously detonated themselves, and massive amounts of skeletons scattered about.
Dense Death Qi surged into the sky.
The entire heaven and earth was once again shrouded by death.
Seeing this scene, Yang Fan was stunned for a moment.
Then he couldn’t help but burst into loud laughter.
“Interesting, truly interesting.”
“Fighting until the very end, you actually still want to be my Subordinate God?”
Yang Fan put down his wine glass, his gaze falling back towards the distance, and then spoke calmly.
“Pass down the order, send out the troops.”
“Seize the enemy’s Divine Kingdom Core.”

sentences.text: Great Void Warship.
Descended.
Immediately afterward, countless Void Cannons lit up simultaneously across the hull.
Boom——!!
The first cannon fired.
Space itself seemed to be torn apart.
A massive pillar of black light pierced through the battlefield.
Wherever it passed, nearly a million ordinary Undead Race members vanished instantly, leaving not even wreckage behind.
The second cannon, the third cannon, the fourth cannon.
A single volley evaporated millions of Undead Race members.
Divine Kingdom Core area.
The Undead Demigod gripped the ancient mirror in front of him so tightly that his finger bones turned white.
Looking at the sky-blocking Great Void Warship, he suddenly burst into wild laughter.
“Hhahahaha!”
“I admire you!”
“You’re steady enough!
And ruthless enough!”
“You actually still have trump cards!”
As the Great Void Warship joined the battlefield.
Those ordinary Undead Race armies could barely advance.
As time continuously flowed, the reinforcements summoned by Yang Fan finally arrived.
A large number of believers began to board the Boundary-Suppressing Profound Heaven Great Wall.
More and more firepower joined the battlefield.
Long-range attacks grew increasingly terrifying, causing not only large-scale deaths among ordinary Undead Race members.
Even high-tier believers gradually began to fall in patches.
This was a war that possessed all the advantages of timing, terrain, and unity of people.
Even those elite believers of the Martial Route were still resting in the rear to avoid occupying space.
Only if the enemy could genuinely advance to the base of the wall would it be their turn to strike.
But looking at it now, the enemy seemed completely unable to advance.
Yang San and other combat-type Intelligent Life forms were still carefully directing the battle.
Yang Yi and Yang Er constantly allocated war supplies.
Across The Frontline, everyone was busy.
Only Yang Da had somehow brought over a grand master chair, placing it directly in the absolute center of the Boundary-Suppressing Profound Heaven Great Wall.
And Yang Fan was sitting right there, appreciating this nearly one-sided crushing war.
At this moment, Yang Da stood to his left.
Ling Xuzi stood to his right, wagging his tail, his small face smiling almost into a bundle as he continuously and attentively poured wine for Yang Fan.
“Master, the enemy has already exhausted their tricks.”
“As things stand now, apart from somehow using an unknown method to rapidly nurture believers in large numbers.”
“With this Undead Race lacking special war structures, the outcome of the battle is set!”
Yang Da was full of excitement.
As he spoke, his gaze even involuntarily glanced towards the distant Divine Kingdom Core.
Clearly, he had already started coveting those core structures.
On the other side, while pouring wine, Ling Xuzi frantically flattered him.
“Master’s Divine Might is peerless.”
“Today’s battle has truly opened this subordinate’s eyes.”
“Having lived for so many years, this subordinate has never seen someone as omniscient and infallible as Master.”
“Every step of the enemy is within Master’s calculations.”
“If Master had been born in antiquity, I’m afraid all the gods would have to abdicate and yield their positions.”
“What Demigod?”
“Although Master is currently a Demigod, in this subordinate’s eyes, there is no difference from a True God.”
“Being able to follow Master is practically like the ancestral graves of the Void Spirit Race smoking green smoke for eighteen generations.”
“If I had known earlier that Master was so majestic, this subordinate should have knelt down to sign the contract back then.”
The more Ling Xuzi spoke, the more excited he became, eventually even turning his eye sockets somewhat red.
“Master, if not for you.”
“This subordinate would probably still be a muddle-headed little demigod.”
“Being able to stand here pouring wine for you now is this subordinate’s honor!”
Hearing this series of words, Yang Da’s mouth at the side couldn’t help but twitch.
This Void Spirit Race demigod... is far too good at bootlicking.
Hearing such words, even he felt embarrassed.
“Not bad.” Yang Fan picked up his wine glass and nodded with satisfaction.
“When this battle ends, there will be a heavy reward.”
Ling Xuzi was instantly overjoyed.
“Many thanks, Master!”
As he spoke, his wine-pouring actions accelerated by a fraction.
Beside him, Yang Da was even more speechless.
Ever since his own master got rid of his womanizing bad habit, how did he pick up a new hobby?
Isn’t this getting close to flatterers and distancing oneself from virtuous officials?
However, thinking of his own palace, Yang Da ultimately kept his mouth shut in silence.
Right at this moment, the entire battlefield suddenly quieted down.
All the Undead Race believers stopped in their tracks simultaneously.
The next moment.
An illusory figure slowly condensed.
The Undead Demigod appeared.
Yang Fan couldn’t even be bothered to raise his head, still holding his wine glass and gently sipping.
The next second.
Bang!
A dull sound rang out.
A dignified Undead Demigod actually knelt down right in front of his own believers, in front of Yang Fan’s billions of troops.
He knelt straight down.
“I beg for mercy!
I am willing to offer everything!”
The Undead Demigod prostrated himself on the ground, his head pressed tightly against the earth.
Seeing this scene.
Those Undead Race believers similarly knelt down in unison.
For this Undead Demigod, facing the Human Race, even if defeat was certain, he would still choose to fight desperately.
But at this moment, he suddenly saw another path.
Because he was inside his own divine kingdom, he could clearly perceive it.
Aside from Yang Fan present here, this Void Spirit Race member wagging his tail and pouring wine was likewise a demigod.
The other party actually accepted an Alien Demigod as a Subordinate God.
Why couldn’t he?
Since he could see no path of survival, he would just change his way of living.
The Undead Demigod suddenly felt that he might still have a glimmer of survival.
Regardless of what this alien and the Human Race talked about, or why they signed a Subordinate God Contract!
But given the current situation.
He expressed: “I can negotiate too, and I can be a Subordinate God too!”
“What is the meaning of this?”
Yang Fan chuckled and put down his wine glass.
The Undead Demigod hurriedly raised his head.
“I want to be like him and become My Lord’s Subordinate God.”
“I only ask for a glimmer of survival.”
“My divine kingdom talent is proliferation.
Coupled with special structures, my believers are virtually endless.”
“In the future, when My Lord launches a Divine Kingdom War, I can completely act as cannon fodder.”
“Scouting the path, throwing my life away, and consuming the enemy.”
“My usefulness is huge!”
“I only ask to stay alive!”
As he spoke, the Undead Demigod was even somewhat excited.
Because in his perception, Ling Xuzi was pitifully weak.
If trash like that was acceptable, why wouldn’t he be?
“You want to be my Subordinate God?” Yang Fan was somewhat surprised.
“That’s right.”
“You still have so many believers.”
Yang Fan’s gaze swept towards the distance.
“You wouldn’t be trying to trick me into entering the Divine Kingdom Core,”
“while holding other means up your sleeve, would you?”
Hearing this, the Undead Demigod’s gaze turned ruthless.
He turned his head directly to look at the hundreds of millions of believers below.
Afterward, a Divine Decree descended.
“My believers, you were born because of death.”
“Now, it is also time to return through death.”
“The time for the divine kingdom’s survival has arrived; offer up your remnant bodies.”
“Return the Death Qi and go back to heaven and earth.”
“Use your end in exchange for the continuation of the divine kingdom.”
“This is both an honor and a bestowal.”
As the Divine Decree descended.
Those Undead Race believers below the Qi Refining Realm showed not the slightest hesitation.
The next moment.
Boom!
Countless Undead Race members simultaneously detonated themselves, and massive amounts of skeletons scattered about.
Dense Death Qi surged into the sky.
The entire heaven and earth was once again shrouded by death.
Seeing this scene, Yang Fan was stunned for a moment.
Then he couldn’t help but burst into loud laughter.
“Interesting, truly interesting.”
“Fighting until the very end, you actually still want to be my Subordinate God?”
Yang Fan put down his wine glass, his gaze falling back towards the distance, and then spoke calmly.
“Pass down the order, send out the troops.”
“Seize the enemy’s Divine Kingdom Core.”

chapters.title: Chapter 259: Victory in the War, Banquet
paragraphs: As soon as those words were spoken, the Undead Demigod kneeling on the ground was momentarily stunned.
In fact, Yang Fan had never thought about taking him in.
Unlike Ling Xuzi, the Void Spirit Race had almost no frontal combat capability.
Weak in strength and clear in value, they could still be utilized.
But the Undead Demigod before him was completely different.
His strength was too great, his foundation too deep, and his warfare capabilities were simply exaggerated.
If a Subordinate God was stronger than the main god, who would dare guarantee there wouldn’t be a backlash?
Furthermore, this was a demigod imprisoned by the Primordial Academy.
As a dignified Peerless Prodigy of the Human Race, taking an Undead Demigod as a Subordinate God...
would somewhat affect his reputation.
Some things could be done in private, but once brought out into the open, they easily became targets of gossip.
After all, words not conducive to unity should be spoken less.
As for actions not conducive to unity, if the benefits were sufficient, they could be done, but it was best not to let others know.
Yang Fan felt that he had always been a low-key person.
At this moment, that Undead Demigod was completely dumbfounded.
He simply could not understand.
Why was someone as trashy as Ling Xuzi acceptable, yet he wasn’t?
“Human Race...”
His voice was trembling.
Yang Fan simply waved his hand gently, “Don’t struggle. Given your current situation, there is no second possibility.”
“You made your believers commit suicide, which saved me a lot of effort, and you can also suffer a little less.”
“It’s good for everyone.”
Hearing this, the Undead Demigod fell into complete silence.
However, even up to this moment, Yang Fan still did not directly dispatch his main force to go deep.
Instead, he had Foundation Establishment, Martial Masters, and Second-class Intelligent Life form an elite legion of one hundred million people.
Along with two Mechanical War Puppets.
They pushed horizontally all the way.
After all, the shock caused by the sacrificial grand array just moments ago...
Even now, Yang Fan still remembered it vividly.
Who knew if this old fellow had any other trump cards.
Whether his recent surrender was sincere or fake, no one knew.
To be safe, Yang Fan still decided to test the waters first.
Anyway, the opponent’s Alien Divine Kingdom no longer had the ability to resist.
He certainly didn’t want to be backstabbed at the final moment.
However, facts proved that Yang Fan was indeed overthinking this time.
The remaining remnants were completely not worth worrying about.
A large number of elite believers pushed forward all the way and easily reached the Divine Kingdom Core area.
Afterwards, they took out the Divine Kingdom Core.
Accompanied by the detachment of the Divine Kingdom Core, the Undead Demigod could no longer maintain the near-invincible state within the Divine Kingdom.
Yang San quickly issued an order, setting up the Ten Kings of Hell Formation.
The scythe of the King of Hell’s phantom fell down.
This Undead Demigod who had dominated for several hundred years finally completely perished.
At the same time, Yang Fan’s consciousness descended upon the core area.
The next moment.
His gaze changed.
Surprise, shock.
Even his breathing paused slightly.
Because the most exaggerated thing before him was not those S-Rank Buildings.
But the Divine Kingdom Core.
Looking around, there were actually forty to fifty Divine Kingdom Cores placed on the ground.
Among them, aside from those belonging to the Undead Race itself, there were three largest Divine Kingdom Cores, standing a full three to four meters tall.
Yang Fan instantly reacted.
“This is probably...”
“The Divine Kingdom Cores of those three Human Race Prodigies.”
Although the Divine Kingdom Cores were seized, this Undead Demigod had never absorbed them.
Seeming to see Yang Fan’s doubt,
Yang Da explained:
“Master.”
“According to observations, the opponent’s Divine Kingdom area has already exceeded ninety million square kilometers.”
“If he continues to absorb them, he will break through to a deity.”
“And his Divine Kingdom coordinates were long ago grasped by the Primordial Academy.”
“Once he breaks through to a deity, he will lose his value and be immediately subjugated.”
Yang Fan nodded as if he understood, but still had some doubts.
“I can understand not daring to break through.”
“But why would he stockpile so many Divine Kingdom Cores?”
Yang Da pondered for a moment, then spoke.
“This subordinate guesses that when he was captured, his Divine Kingdom area should have been close to its limit.”
“The reason he didn’t break through...”
“Is probably because he wanted to stay in the demigod stage and accumulate resources, buildings, and foundation.”
“Judging from this war, the opponent’s source of troops was somewhat abnormally sufficient.”
“It’s normal that ordinary Human Race Prodigies were not his match.”
“Possessing this kind of strength, he definitely belongs to the top tier among demigods.”
Speaking of this, Yang Da concluded:
“Simply put, he liked bullying the weak.”
“And he worried that after breaking through to a deity, he wouldn’t be able to beat other deities, so he kept himself stuck at the demigod stage.”
“Constantly accumulating.”
“As a result... he had bad luck and was caught by the Primordial Academy.”
After listening to the analysis, Yang Fan suddenly understood.
After all that, they turned out to be birds of a feather.
It’s just that the opponent’s cheat wasn’t as strong as his.
Thinking of this, Yang Fan spoke directly.
“Carry out comprehensive land reclamation work as soon as possible, and let the believers cooperate with Yang Er.”
“Report the harvest to me before tomorrow morning.”
“Afterwards, rewards will be distributed based on merit.”
Leaving these words behind, Yang Fan’s consciousness exited the Divine Kingdom.
The Divine Kingdom War with the Undead Race had finally ended.
And next was the time for a true harvest.
The results of this war were enough for him to digest for a period of time.
His consciousness returned to reality.
Yang Fan slowly opened his eyes.
But as soon as his vision recovered, a soft figure threw herself directly into his arms.
“Husband!!”
Gu Le directly hugged Yang Fan, her voice full of excitement.
“You really succeeded!!!”
Her eye sockets were a bit red, and the love in her eyes was almost overflowing.
Her man was indeed extraordinary.
In his sophomore year, he successfully challenged one of the strongest demigods in the Level 2 area of the Alien Divine Kingdom Zone.
Looking across the Human Race Federation for nearly a thousand years, such a thing was probably in a league of its own.
How could she not love such a man?
How could she fail to love such a man?
“You found out so quickly?”
Yang Fan gently stroked her cheek, his voice gentle.
Gu Le smiled and said:
“In the entire Alien Divine Kingdom Zone, there are only a few truly powerful demigods.”
“Now that the God-Trapping Box has been moved away by the Primordial Academy, the news simply cannot be kept hidden.”
“Many people from the Five Great Families have been keeping an eye on it, and news is spreading around in group chats.”
“Now, anyone with a bit of status basically knows about it.”
Speaking of this, Gu Le suddenly smiled even more happily.
“Also, after Father learned about this news, he decided to host a banquet for you.”
“A banquet?” Yang Fan was slightly stunned.
Gu Le explained:
“It’s similar to the first cocktail party we attended.”
“However, this time it’s within the Gu Family.”
“Fearing that you’ll have too much pressure, the ones invited are all the younger generation under five hundred years old.”
“There are business elites, novae of The Frontline, and also some second-generation prodigals.”
“This is Father helping you build connections.”
While speaking, Gu Le reached out to tidy Yang Fan’s collar with a gentle movement.
Yang Fan nodded, “When are we going?”
“No rush.”
Gu Le said with a smile, “You are the protagonist tonight, after all.”
“The protagonist naturally makes their entrance last.”
“That’s the only way to make people remember.”
After saying that, Gu Le suddenly leaned closer, her voice soft.
“The doctor said my condition has been stable recently, and you’ve been fighting Divine Kingdom Wars every day during this period.”
“Would you like to...”
Yang Fan was stunned, “What?”
Gu Le’s face flushed slightly as she reached out to gently hug him, her voice soft.
“Let me hug you a little longer.”
“Lately, I always feel...”
“That I’m becoming more and more inseparable from you.”
“The beacons of the Divine Kingdom illuminate the long sky, my heart is at ease as my lord breaks the strong enemy.”
“Tonight bright lanterns welcome the honored guest, willing to hold my lord’s hand together through the mortal world.”
Yang Fan was slightly taken aback, then smiled, “Well written.”
Gu Le whispered, “I thought about it for a long time.”

chapters.title: Chapter 260: Connections
paragraphs: The greatest convenience of the Virtual World is that distance loses its meaning.
As long as one puts on a virtual helmet, consciousness can easily cross worlds.
Everyone can gather without any cost.
The venue for this banquet was chosen to be a luxurious villa specifically for entertaining guests in the Gu Family Territory.
At this moment, the entire villa was brightly lit, with a huge crystal chandelier hanging overhead.
Music flowed slowly.
The men were dressed in suits, and the women wore evening gowns.
Some people raised their glasses to talk, while others chatted and laughed cheerfully.
The strength span of the people here was extremely large.
The strong ones even reached the Tier 3 God level.
The weak ones were still only Divine Beings.
But interestingly, no one here was arrogant, nor did anyone feel inferior.
Because being able to come here in itself represented a qualification.
Some relied on strength, some relied on talent, and some relied on background.
Some had just undergone Awakening and were already brought into this circle by their Elders in advance.
The world has always been like this.
Hard work is very important, but most of the time the starting point is even more important.
What some people strive for a lifetime to achieve might just be what others were born with.
Recognizing the gap is not scary; what is scary is both failing to see reality and mistakenly believing that the world operates solely on hard work.
In the hall, someone raised a glass to talk.
“Which company controlled by your subsidiaries has been purchasing Blood Clotting Flower recently?”
“There are changes at The Frontline again?”
Another person laughed and said:
“Just stockpiling in advance.”
“Recently, several Alien Divine Kingdoms in the eastern front have been a bit restless.”
“It pays to be prepared.”
A young man nearby raised his glass and smiled,
“Brother Zhantian, long time no see.”
“Last time at The Frontline, I was targeted by five Alien Gods. If it weren’t for your help, I’m afraid I would have been in big trouble.”
The man called Zhantian waved his hand.
“Small matter. How is your branch doing recently?”
“I heard you are preparing to support the Seventh Elder on Minghai Star?”
“Haha, Family matters, better not talk about them.”
“Let’s drink first.”
Just at this moment, the entrance of the villa slowly opened.
All the sounds suddenly quieted down.
Yang Fan slowly stepped into the villa.
Wearing a black suit and a neat tie, his whole posture was upright and calm.
Beside him, Gu Le wore a bright red evening gown, linking arms with Yang Fan.
Her face carried pride, yet without losing politeness.
The two slowly walked into the hall, smiling and nodding to the crowd.
At this moment, the entire hall suddenly fell silent.
Everyone’s gaze converged all at once.
This banquet was originally arranged by the faction of the Third Elder of the Gu Family.
Although limited to those under five hundred years old,
being able to come here, looking across the entire Human Federation, meant their influence would not be small.
And everyone knew that they came here tonight just to see one person,
to see the future star of this branch of the Gu Family,
even... a Peerless Prodigy who might become a future pillar.
“Brother-in-law.”
“It really is true that after three days apart, one should look at another with new eyes.”
A familiar voice suddenly came over.
Gu Jiuheng walked over holding a wine glass, with a smile on his face.
“Although I have been staying at The Frontline during this period,”
“yet the commotion you stirred up at the Primordial Academy is simply thunderous.”
Yang Fan smiled and nodded, “Greetings, Brother Jiuheng.”
Gu Jiuheng waved his hand, then gently snapped his fingers.
The next moment, the soothing music sounded again, and the entire venue seemed to resume operation.
The banquet officially began.
However, interestingly, the crowd did not immediately swarm over.
No one who could come here would not understand the rules.
If you want to build connections, you also have to mind the order.
The higher the status, the less one can afford to be discourteous.
Gu Jiuheng took the initiative to walk to Yang Fan’s side and began introductions.
“This is Gu Tianyu. He controls twelve large listed companies under his command,”
“involving pharmaceuticals, weapons, shipping, and Divine Kingdom coordinate trading.”
“He is an important figure in the commercial aspect of the Gu Family.”
The introduced youth raised his glass and smiled,
“I’ve heard so much about you. If there is resource cooperation in the future, we can chat about it.”
Gu Jiuheng continued to introduce.
“This is Li Ran, one of the Human Race Prodigies originally invested in by the Gu Family.”
“Now in the Ninth Legion at The Frontline, the number of Alien Gods who have died at his hands has exceeded twenty.”
Li Ran was tall and just smiled.
“If there is a chance, we can go to The Frontline together. There is still a difference between a Divine Kingdom War and a real battlefield.”
Then Gu Jiuheng continued his introductions.
“This is Zhou Yuan. His Family does cross-Star Domain transportation and has more than a dozen stable shipping routes.”
“This is Qin Xue, who specializes in Divine Kingdom investments and participated in three Divine Kingdom incubation projects last year.”

“This is Zhao He. Don’t look at him as still being a Divine Being; his grandfather is a Seventh-Order God retainer of the Gu Family, and he has already started taking over some of his Elders’ industries.”
Gu Jiuheng had obviously made full preparations.
The order of introduction was clearly arranged in advance.
Yang Fan was not arrogant.
Facing the crowd, he always politely returned the courtesy.
From these introductions, one could hear that these people might not be very strong in personal strength, but the influence they wielded was immense.
Even if any one of them was pulled out at random, their influence might not be weaker than a Fifth-Order God like Ma Yu.
This was the benefit of having a big Family as a backing.
Society would never disappear just because it entered the Divine Kingdom era; it would only become more complex.
Wherever there are people, circles will form.
And a person’s status has never been determined solely by strength.
Wealth, background, potential, resources, and connections.
All of these things would become standards of measurement.
“Brother Yang,”
Gu Tianyu took the initiative to smile and say,
“I heard you have a living planet called Xiling Planet. I just checked it.”
“It’s only a few light-years away from my living planet. Maybe we can cooperate in the future.”
Qin Xue beside him smiled and took over the conversation.
“Brother Yang’s current Divine Kingdom expansion speed is so exaggerated; future resource consumption will only get larger and larger.”
“If there is a financing need, we could talk about it.”
Everyone chimed in one after another, and the atmosphere was very relaxed, yet no one said anything overly flattering.
Because the people here understood that making friends was more about exchanging value.
Facing these expressions of goodwill, Yang Fan always behaved politely and restrainedly.
He neither refused nor directly agreed.
Because before coming, Gu Le had already given instructions.
The identities of the people who came here today were not simple.
This was a small circle, and in this circle,
everyone talked about relationships, but talked even more about interests.
No one would deliberately curry favor with anyone just because of status.
Because everyone had a background.
And truly smart people never play all their cards on the first meeting.
This banquet did not have any melodramatic twists.
Those who could appear here were either core members within the Gu Family or big figures with extremely deep relations with the Gu Family.
Everyone gathered in twos and threes.
Some chatted about Divine Kingdom investments.
Some chatted about the battle situation at The Frontline.
And some discussed the development plans of a certain living planet for the next few decades.
Equity penetration, resource integration, civilization cultivation, cross-Star Domain trade...
Many major events in the outside world sufficient to affect the destinies of countless people were finalized here in just the time of a few glasses of wine and a few words.
Amidst the clinking of glasses and exchanging of cups,
the future development directions of living planets quietly underwent changes.
Before the banquet ended, everyone exchanged contact information one after another.

sentences.text: The greatest convenience of the Virtual World is that distance loses its meaning.
As long as one puts on a virtual helmet, consciousness can easily cross worlds.
Everyone can gather without any cost.
The venue for this banquet was chosen to be a luxurious villa specifically for entertaining guests in the Gu Family Territory.
At this moment, the entire villa was brightly lit, with a huge crystal chandelier hanging overhead.
Music flowed slowly.
The men were dressed in suits, and the women wore evening gowns.
Some people raised their glasses to talk, while others chatted and laughed cheerfully.
The strength span of the people here was extremely large.
The strong ones even reached the Tier 3 God level.
The weak ones were still only Divine Beings.
But interestingly, no one here was arrogant, nor did anyone feel inferior.
Because being able to come here in itself represented a qualification.
Some relied on strength, some relied on talent, and some relied on background.
Some had just undergone Awakening and were already brought into this circle by their Elders in advance.
The world has always been like this.
Hard work is very important, but most of the time the starting point is even more important.
What some people strive for a lifetime to achieve might just be what others were born with.
Recognizing the gap is not scary; what is scary is both failing to see reality and mistakenly believing that the world operates solely on hard work.
In the hall, someone raised a glass to talk.
“Which company controlled by your subsidiaries has been purchasing Blood Clotting Flower recently?”
“There are changes at The Frontline again?”
Another person laughed and said:
“Just stockpiling in advance.”
“Recently, several Alien Divine Kingdoms in the eastern front have been a bit restless.”
“It pays to be prepared.”
A young man nearby raised his glass and smiled,
“Brother Zhantian, long time no see.”
“Last time at The Frontline, I was targeted by five Alien Gods.
If it weren’t for your help, I’m afraid I would have been in big trouble.”
The man called Zhantian waved his hand.
“Small matter.
How is your branch doing recently?”
“I heard you are preparing to support the Seventh Elder on Minghai Star?”
“Haha, Family matters, better not talk about them.”
“Let’s drink first.”
Just at this moment, the entrance of the villa slowly opened.
All the sounds suddenly quieted down.
Yang Fan slowly stepped into the villa.
Wearing a black suit and a neat tie, his whole posture was upright and calm.
Beside him, Gu Le wore a bright red evening gown, linking arms with Yang Fan.
Her face carried pride, yet without losing politeness.
The two slowly walked into the hall, smiling and nodding to the crowd.
At this moment, the entire hall suddenly fell silent.
Everyone’s gaze converged all at once.
This banquet was originally arranged by the faction of the Third Elder of the Gu Family.
Although limited to those under five hundred years old,
being able to come here, looking across the entire Human Federation, meant their influence would not be small.
And everyone knew that they came here tonight just to see one person,
to see the future star of this branch of the Gu Family,
even... a Peerless Prodigy who might become a future pillar.

“It really is true that after three days apart, one should look at another with new eyes.”
A familiar voice suddenly came over.
Gu Jiuheng walked over holding a wine glass, with a smile on his face.
“Although I have been staying at The Frontline during this period,”
“yet the commotion you stirred up at the Primordial Academy is simply thunderous.”
Yang Fan smiled and nodded, “Greetings, Brother Jiuheng.”
Gu Jiuheng waved his hand, then gently snapped his fingers.
The next moment, the soothing music sounded again, and the entire venue seemed to resume operation.
The banquet officially began.
However, interestingly, the crowd did not immediately swarm over.
No one who could come here would not understand the rules.
If you want to build connections, you also have to mind the order.
The higher the status, the less one can afford to be discourteous.
Gu Jiuheng took the initiative to walk to Yang Fan’s side and began introductions.

He controls twelve large listed companies under his command,”
“involving pharmaceuticals, weapons, shipping, and Divine Kingdom coordinate trading.”
“He is an important figure in the commercial aspect of the Gu Family.”
The introduced youth raised his glass and smiled,
“I’ve heard so much about you.
If there is resource cooperation in the future, we can chat about it.”
Gu Jiuheng continued to introduce.
“This is Li Ran, one of the Human Race Prodigies originally invested in by the Gu Family.”
“Now in the Ninth Legion at The Frontline, the number of Alien Gods who have died at his hands has exceeded twenty.”
Li Ran was tall and just smiled.
“If there is a chance, we can go to The Frontline together.
There is still a difference between a Divine Kingdom War and a real battlefield.”

chapters.title: Chapter 261: Eternal Corpse Mine
paragraphs: Especially Yang Fan.
There were as many as twenty or thirty people attending this dinner, and they came from all walks of life.
Now, a group of truly high-quality friends had been added to his Feixun friend list.
Any one of these people could perhaps decide the fate of countless others with a single word.
Yang Fan knew in his heart that this was another investment Gu Xuanting was making in him.
Although it didn’t have a clear, tangible value like Xiling Planet,
the value contained within these connections far exceeded even that of a life planet.
After all, the most profitable and safest business in this world had never been buying and selling Resources, but rather information asymmetry.
And these people happened to stand at the very top of their respective industries.
Sometimes, a casual chat, a piece of information inadvertently revealed, or even a seemingly ordinary Moments post
could contain opportunities that ordinary people would never come across in their entire lives.
Its value simply could not be measured in numbers.
Returning to the Real World, Yang Fan reached out to pull Gu Le into his arms, saying with a smile,
“My dear wife, thank your father on my behalf.”
“This is all what that old man should do. Why thank him?”
Gu Le waved her hand dismissively.
Hearing this, Yang Fan only smiled and said nothing more.
He then gently held Gu Le in his arms.
Feeling the warmth in his arms, his long-tensed mind finally relaxed.
Lately, the war with the Undead Demigod had been highly anxious.
Although with his current strength, even going without rest for several months would not affect him,
the mental fatigue was very real.
Soon, Yang Fan slowly closed his eyes and drifted into a long-awaited sleep.
Early the next morning.
Gu Le was still fast asleep.
However, Yang Fan’s consciousness had already entered his Divine Kingdom.
At this moment, the Undead Divine Kingdom was already a scene of desolation.
If they were to rely solely on those foreign collectors to slowly clear the land,
it would take at least several years in Divine Kingdom time to completely clean up the entire Divine Kingdom.
But Yang Fan clearly did not have that kind of patience.
In any case, the thirty billion troops on The Frontline currently had no battles to fight.
To transport the assets back to his Divine Kingdom as quickly as possible,
under Yang Da’s arrangement, all believers were mobilized for the land-clearing work.
Some mined, some transported, and some dismantled buildings.
Only a single night had passed in the Real World,
yet the entire Undead Divine Kingdom’s assets had been completely cleaned out.
Even the detailed statistics had already been completed.
Inside the palace, only Yang Fan and Yang Da were present.
“Master, the land-clearing work has been fully completed.”
Yang Da’s face was filled with excitement.
“Focus on the important parts.”
Yang Fan’s tone was calm.

“This land clearing yielded a total of thirty S-Rank Buildings, five hundred thousand A-Rank buildings, and as for B-Rank and below buildings, because there are too many, they are still being counted. The total value is simply immeasurable!”
Yang Da’s voice trembled slightly as he spoke, clearly deeply shocked by this harvest.
As the highest-level Intelligent Life in the Divine Kingdom,
he never dreamed that a god at the demigod stage could accumulate such terrifying assets, almost comparable to their own Divine Kingdom.
“So many? Thirty S-Rank Buildings?”
Yang Fan also sucked in a breath of cold air.

“Reporting to Master, the most valuable among them is the Eternal Corpse Mine, which is the most core strategic building of the Undead Race. Its value is not in the least inferior to the Goddess of Wisdom.”
“Next are the ten thousand dao evolution sanctuary, the Life Essence Conversion Pool, the void energy core, the Nine Nether River, and the Mechanical War Puppet.”
“Calculated according to the official guide price, these buildings are worth approximately between two billion and twenty billion Divinity Points.”
“However, if they were actually sold on the market, the transaction price for each would not be lower than fifty billion Divinity Points.”
“One tier below would be resource-type S-Rank Buildings like the Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nest and the Necrotic Land.”
Yang Da quickly reported.
Sure enough, once they truly conquered the enemy’s Divine Kingdom,
they discovered several unfamiliar S-Rank Buildings that had never appeared in the records.
Yang Fan was not surprised by this.
After all, within one’s own Divine Kingdom, as long as the Divine Kingdom Core was still there, hiding a few buildings was simply too easy.
Whether it was the school’s public materials or the information provided by Gu Le,
in essence, they were all just external intelligence gathered through various channels.
It was only natural for there to be discrepancies.
Thinking of this, Yang Fan’s gaze suddenly became solemn.
If one formulated a battle plan for every Divine Kingdom War based on known intelligence, while the enemy hid several trump cards capable of changing the course of the battle,
the consequences would be unimaginable.
A Divine Kingdom War was never a competition of paper data; any overlooked detail could become the key to deciding victory or defeat.
It seemed that no matter what enemy he faced in the future, he had to leave enough margin for error.
Never assume that one has seen through the opponent’s entire strength just because they possessed a portion of intelligence.
Hastily launching a war was often the most dangerous course of action.
Speaking of which,
Yang Da’s face showed some sigh of lament.
“Although this Undead Demigod had a wealthy family background, many of his assets were completely useless to him, and even harmful.”
Yang Fan raised his eyebrows slightly. “Oh?”
“For example, the Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nest.”
Yang Da chuckled.
“There are as many as fifteen of this type of S-Rank Building, but all of them are life and Spiritual Qi attribute resource buildings.”
“The same goes for the two hundred thousand Spiritual Veins.”
“He didn’t even load these buildings into his Divine Kingdom.”
At this point, Yang Da’s expression became increasingly complex.
“Thinking about it now, it’s actually somewhat fortunate.”
“If the opponent had been able to establish contact with the outside world and convert all of these Resources into combat power,”
“this Divine Kingdom War would probably have been more than ten times harder.”
Thinking of those piled-up Resources, even Yang Da couldn’t help but sigh.
A demigod besieged for countless years could actually accumulate such an exaggerated foundation; it was truly terrifying.
“What is this Eternal Corpse Mine?”
Yang Fan did not continue to lament what had already happened.
In Yang Da’s evaluation, this building could actually be compared to the Goddess of Wisdom.
Its value would certainly not be simple.
“Here is the detailed information, please take a look, Master.”
Yang Da raised his right hand.
The next moment, a deep blue light burst from his eyes, and countless data streams rapidly converged.
Eventually, they formed a massive blue light screen in mid-air.
[Eternal Corpse Mine]
[Rank: S-Rank]
[Official Price: 100 Billion Divinity Points]
[Description: A special growth-type building evolved from the Heavenly Pole Undead Secret Realm]
[The interior of the building forms its own space, which can continuously expand as the Divine Kingdom’s Rank increases, with a limit area of up to one-third of the Divine Kingdom’s total area.]
[This space is connected to the Divine Kingdom, sharing the laws of heaven and earth as well as the Divine Kingdom’s amplification effects.]

[All Spiritual Qi, life aura, holy aura, and light aura within the space will be automatically decomposed and dissolved, and it can only nurture negative attribute energies such as Death Qi, Evil Qi, Corpse Qi, and Nether Qi.]
[For living organisms that die within it, there is a very low probability that their remains will be affected by the spatial aura and convert into special resource units.]
[Evaluation: Suitable for non-living system civilizations such as the Undead Race, Wraith Clan, Sea Corpse Clan, and Specter Clan, with immeasurable strategic value.]
[Special Federal Regulation: This building is prohibited from flowing into foreign race forces through black markets, smuggling, intermediary transactions, or any other forms.]
[Violators can face up to the death penalty, and all associated responsibilities will be prosecuted.]
[If voluntarily handed over to the Federal Government, a reward of 200 Billion Divinity Points and 10 Million Military Merit Points can be obtained.]

chapters.title: Chapter 262: Loading Buildings, Harvest
paragraphs: After reading the information, Yang Fan couldn’t help but feel a slight shock.
Until this moment, he finally understood
why this Undead Demigod was able to possess such a massive army.
It turned out that inside the other party’s Divine Kingdom Core, there was actually hidden a “Small Divine Kingdom”.
Although it was besieged in the core area,
in reality, the usable land area far exceeded the range seen from the outside.
If not for the fact that he was willing to spend a massive amount of Resources to forcibly change the combat environment of the other party’s Divine Kingdom Core area,
even if this war could be won in the end,
the losses would probably have skyrocketed a hundredfold or a thousandfold.
“This item is indeed powerful.” Yang Fan sighed softly.
“Indeed powerful.”
Yang Da said with a face full of regret.
“It’s a pity it cannot be used for the growth of believers.”
“For us, we can only choose to hand it over to the Federation.”
“Otherwise, keeping it in our hands would also be a waste.”
The environment in this Eternal Corpse Mine was extremely special.
Any Spiritual Qi, Immortal Qi, or life aura that entered it would be rapidly dissolved.
Human Race believers, let alone Cultivate, staying there for a long time might even cause their blood and Qi to decline and their Cultivation to regress,
ultimately leading to large-scale deaths.
A top-tier building that increased the divine kingdom’s area by a full one-third,
yet could not be used normally, was truly heart-wrenching.
However, Yang Fan did not respond immediately; instead, he quietly looked at the introduction on the light screen, his eyes becoming increasingly profound.
Handing it over to the Federation in exchange for 200 billion Divinity Points and 10 million military merits
was indeed an astonishing fortune.
But for some reason, he always felt that the true value of this building went far beyond this.
After all, this mine also belonged to a part of his own divine kingdom.
Since that was the case, could it also enjoy the blessing of the Evolution Talent?
If it could undergo Evolution... could it be used to Cultivate special combat power?
Or Plant Yin-attribute Heaven And Earth Treasures?
Thinking of this, Yang Fan’s heartbeat couldn’t help but speed up a bit.
Suddenly, he seemed to think of something, and his eyes grew even brighter.
“No rush for now.”
Yang Fan slowly withdrew his gaze.
“First, introduce the other S-Rank Buildings to me.”
“Yes, Master.”
Yang Da nodded, and then new information emerged.
“This is the Life Essence Conversion Pool.”
“As the name implies, its greatest function is to convert energy attributes.”
“Whether it is flesh-and-blood creatures, life spring water, or Resources containing life Origin such as Sun Essence and Moon Dew, they can all be used as conversion raw materials.”
“After control, they can be converted into various special aura energies such as Spiritual Qi, Immortal Qi, ghost Qi, Death Qi, corpse Qi, and grievance Qi.”
“And the conversion direction can be freely adjusted.”
“However, the shortcoming is also very obvious: raw materials must be actively invested, and the loss during the conversion process is extremely huge.”

“Back then, the other party probably relied on the power of the sacrificial Formation to pour a large amount of life-type Resources we invested into it all at once, and then completely converted them into Death Qi.”
“That was how the death frenzy that swept across the entire Divine Kingdom Core area was formed.”
“As for this void energy core, it is somewhat tasteless.”
Yang Da waved his hand to bring up the information.
“The greatest function of this building is to continuously supply energy for various facilities.”
“The other party’s sacrificial Formation being able to maintain operation for a long time back then probably relied on it.”
“However, the Master’s divine kingdom temporarily does not have super buildings or large Formations that consume a lot of energy.”
“So this thing can currently only be used as a decoration.”
After speaking, Yang Da brought up the information of the last building.
“As for the Land of the Undead, it is somewhat similar to the Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nest.”
“However, what it nurtures is not spiritual milk, but a special resource called Undead Liquid.”
“For the Undead Race, this thing can be called a Cultivation holy medicine, which can greatly increase the Breakthrough probability.”
“But for the Master’s divine kingdom, it likewise does not have much value.”
Aside from these S-Rank Buildings,
the quantity of A-Rank Buildings harvested this time was also astonishing.
Among them, quite a few were obtained by the Undead Demigod plundering the divine kingdoms of other Human Race Prodigys over the years.
The most numerous were various Spiritual Veins.

However, nowadays Yang Fan’s divine kingdom was covered with Spiritual Veins, and those 200,000 newly added Spiritual Veins couldn’t even find a place to load, so they could only be temporarily left idle.
At this stage, ordinary A-Rank Buildings could hardly arouse Yang Fan’s interest.
“First load the ten thousand dao evolution sanctuary, Nine Nether River, and Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nest into the divine kingdom.”
Yang Fan gave a direct order.
“Yes, Master.”
Yang Da respectfully accepted the order.
The next moment, the massive divine kingdom began to vibrate slightly.
The first to descend was the ten thousand dao evolution sanctuary.
It did not appear above the Heavenly Court, but under Yang Da’s control, it slowly fell towards the very center of the divine kingdom.
——City of Trade.
This was a core civilization building that could simultaneously affect the three major systems of Cultivation, Martial Arts, and Mechanical Civilization.
Naturally, it had to be placed in the most core position of the divine kingdom.
Boom!
Accompanied by the sanctuary completely falling, an invisible fluctuation spread in all directions.
Yang Fan immediately sensed that
the rules of the entire divine kingdom seemed to have undergone a subtle change.
Between heaven and earth, it seemed to have become clearer.
Those high-tier believers had already sensed the change.
However, Yang Fan’s divine kingdom’s environment was already extremely good.
For ordinary believers, this bit of improvement was almost imperceptible.
Subsequently, the second building descended.
Nine Nether River.
Rumble——
A blood-colored great river poured down from the vault of heaven.
The river water surged and roared, and rich energy auras permeated heaven and earth.
Finally traversing tens of thousands of miles of territory, it flowed into the region where the Wanxiang Martial Court was located.
Seeing this scene,
Yang Fan directly issued a Divine Decree.
A grand and mighty voice instantly spread throughout the entire divine kingdom.
“My believers, this river is named the Nine Nether River.”
“It is a land of fortune bestowed by the god, and the river contains the power of heaven and earth Origin.”
“Entering the river for Body Tempering can strengthen blood and Qi, refine tendons and bones, and strengthen viscera.”
“Residing by its side for a long time can increase recovery abilities and forge an indestructible body.”
“All Martial Artists can enter the river to temper their Physical Body.”
“All Cultivators can use the river to comprehend the Dao and Cultivate.”
“How much Opportunity you can obtain depends entirely on your own fortune.”
As the Divine Decree fell, the entire Wanxiang Martial Court instantly boiled with excitement.
Countless Martial Arts believers knelt on the ground one after another, their eyes extremely fanatical.
“Thank you, my god, for the blessing!”
“Praise my god!”
“My god is eternal!”
Finally, the fifteen Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nests were also loaded into the divine kingdom.
Compared to the first two buildings, they appeared much more low-key.
They merely made the Heaven and Earth Spiritual Qi a bit denser, without causing too much change.
After finishing all this, Yang Fan’s gaze slowly shifted.
Finally landing on a special zone in the central area of the divine kingdom.
Standing there was an A-Rank Building —— Interdimensional Research Institute.
Around it were also distributed a large number of cloning nutrient pods.
The next moment, Yang Fan’s thought stirred.
The Eternal Corpse Mine descended with a bang.
As the building was successfully loaded, a massive amount of information instantly flooded into his mind.
Yang Fan instantly perceived that boundless space inside the mine.
Looking out, heaven and earth were dim and gray.
Extremely dense Death Qi shrouded all directions like thick fog.
The air was permeated with auras of decay, coldness, and death.
A large number of bizarrely-shaped buildings were scattered everywhere.
Some looked like barracks, some like altars.
And some were like huge tombs.
Most eye-catching of all were those constantly operating barracks.
Accompanied by roaring sounds, skeleton soldiers were continuously produced one after another.
However, as soon as they were born,
the soul fire in their eye sockets instantly extinguished, and then with a clatter, they scattered all over the ground, transforming back into ghastly white skeletons.

Until this moment, he finally understood
why this Undead Demigod was able to possess such a massive army.
It turned out that inside the other party’s Divine Kingdom Core, there was actually hidden a “Small Divine Kingdom”.
Although it was besieged in the core area,
in reality, the usable land area far exceeded the range seen from the outside.
If not for the fact that he was willing to spend a massive amount of Resources to forcibly change the combat environment of the other party’s Divine Kingdom Core area,
even if this war could be won in the end,
the losses would probably have skyrocketed a hundredfold or a thousandfold.
“This item is indeed powerful.” Yang Fan sighed softly.
“Indeed powerful.”
Yang Da said with a face full of regret.
“It’s a pity it cannot be used for the growth of believers.”
“For us, we can only choose to hand it over to the Federation.”
“Otherwise, keeping it in our hands would also be a waste.”
The environment in this Eternal Corpse Mine was extremely special.
Any Spiritual Qi, Immortal Qi, or life aura that entered it would be rapidly dissolved.
Human Race believers, let alone Cultivate, staying there for a long time might even cause their blood and Qi to decline and their Cultivation to regress,
ultimately leading to large-scale deaths.
A top-tier building that increased the divine kingdom’s area by a full one-third,
yet could not be used normally, was truly heart-wrenching.
However, Yang Fan did not respond immediately; instead, he quietly looked at the introduction on the light screen, his eyes becoming increasingly profound.
Handing it over to the Federation in exchange for 200 billion Divinity Points and 10 million military merits
was indeed an astonishing fortune.
But for some reason, he always felt that the true value of this building went far beyond this.
After all, this mine also belonged to a part of his own divine kingdom.
Since that was the case, could it also enjoy the blessing of the Evolution Talent?
If it could undergo Evolution... could it be used to Cultivate special combat power?
Or Plant Yin-attribute Heaven And Earth Treasures?
Thinking of this, Yang Fan’s heartbeat couldn’t help but speed up a bit.
Suddenly, he seemed to think of something, and his eyes grew even brighter.
“No rush for now.”
Yang Fan slowly withdrew his gaze.
“First, introduce the other S-Rank Buildings to me.”
“Yes, Master.”
Yang Da nodded, and then new information emerged.
“This is the Life Essence Conversion Pool.”
“As the name implies, its greatest function is to convert energy attributes.”
“Whether it is flesh-and-blood creatures, life spring water, or Resources containing life Origin such as Sun Essence and Moon Dew, they can all be used as conversion raw materials.”
“After control, they can be converted into various special aura energies such as Spiritual Qi, Immortal Qi, ghost Qi, Death Qi, corpse Qi, and grievance Qi.”
“And the conversion direction can be freely adjusted.”
“However, the shortcoming is also very obvious: raw materials must be actively invested, and the loss during the conversion process is extremely huge.”

“Back then, the other party probably relied on the power of the sacrificial Formation to pour a large amount of life-type Resources we invested into it all at once, and then completely converted them into Death Qi.”
“That was how the death frenzy that swept across the entire Divine Kingdom Core area was formed.”
“As for this void energy core, it is somewhat tasteless.”
Yang Da waved his hand to bring up the information.
“The greatest function of this building is to continuously supply energy for various facilities.”
“The other party’s sacrificial Formation being able to maintain operation for a long time back then probably relied on it.”
“However, the Master’s divine kingdom temporarily does not have super buildings or large Formations that consume a lot of energy.”
“So this thing can currently only be used as a decoration.”
After speaking, Yang Da brought up the information of the last building.
“As for the Land of the Undead, it is somewhat similar to the Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nest.”
“However, what it nurtures is not spiritual milk, but a special resource called Undead Liquid.”
“For the Undead Race, this thing can be called a Cultivation holy medicine, which can greatly increase the Breakthrough probability.”
“But for the Master’s divine kingdom, it likewise does not have much value.”
Aside from these S-Rank Buildings,
the quantity of A-Rank Buildings harvested this time was also astonishing.

The most numerous were various Spiritual Veins.

chapters.title: Chapter 263: Zombie General
paragraphs: Yang Fan immediately recognized it.
This was precisely the building that continuously produced Skeleton Soldiers in the peripheral battlefield back then.
Unexpectedly, they had all been hidden inside the Eternal Corpse Mine by the opponent.
What a pity.
The deities were dead; even if these buildings could still passively produce believers, they would lose their Souls the moment they were born.
If he weren’t Human Race, unable to gain the faith of these undead skeletons, Yang Fan wouldn’t really mind cultivating a brand-new troop system.
“Master, this is a B-rank building, Skeleton Barracks.”
Looking at the large swaths of buildings in the distance, Yang Da finally wore a look of sudden realization.
“No wonder we couldn’t find them during land reclamation.”
“So they were all hidden inside the Eternal Corpse Mine.”
Afterwards, a look of regret surfaced on his face once again.
“It’s just that no matter how many there are, it’s meaningless.”
“These buildings still don’t help Master’s Divine Kingdom much.”
“Ultimately, we can only find a way to sell them.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan didn’t mind at all.
“No matter.”
“Seal them all up first.”
“We can find channels later to sell them in bulk and exchange them for Divinity Points.”
Having said that, his gaze still lingered deep within the Eternal Corpse Mine.
At this moment, a thought stirred in his mind.
Countless working robots stopped what they were doing one after another, turned and left from beside the cloning nutrient pods, and marched mightily toward the Eternal Corpse Mine.
These Robot Soldiers had extremely high efficiency.
In just over a month inside the Divine Kingdom, the entire Eternal Corpse Mine was completely cleared out.
Only the Death Qi accumulated for who knows how many years deep within the mine remained dense, permeating between heaven and earth like a black fog that lingered for a long time.
“Yang Da, does this Death Qi have any effect on zombies?” Yang Fan asked.
His Cultivation and Martial Arts believers could not enter and Cultivate within it.
But zombies were different; the Interdimensional Research Institute was only an A-rank building after all.
Although its area was large enough, it couldn’t accommodate high-tier living beings.
This also led to the result that no matter how dense the corpse qi was inside, it could only nurture ordinary zombies.
As the Divine Kingdom continued to grow, the role of ordinary zombies was becoming smaller and smaller.
But the alien races he would face in the future would become more and more numerous.
Except for special races like the Undead Race that were naturally immune to the zombie virus, the vast majority of living races could be infected.
What Yang Fan truly wanted to Cultivate were zombies with intelligence and thoughts.
For example, the Zombie General and Zombie King.
Or even passing down cultivation methods in the future to transform them into a lineage of corpses following a special Cultivation Route.
This would become a completely new fourth path outside of the three major systems of Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom.
“Reporting to Master, there is no effect.”
“As a large number of zombies enter, this Death Qi will slowly transform into corpse qi.”
Yang Da’s face was full of excitement.
Obviously, he had already guessed Yang Fan’s idea.
Mainly because the Divine Kingdom Wars participated in recently were either unilateral crushing or major battles against the Undead Race.
The zombie legion almost had no chance to perform.
Therefore, even Yang Da had overlooked this direction.
“Go, transfer all the human zombies in the Interdimensional Research Institute to the Eternal Corpse Mine.”
“As for those monkey zombies, throw them all into the Life Essence Conversion Pool, transform them into corpse qi, and inject them into the mine.”
“Purchase a large number of cloning nutrient pods again, clone alien corpses at the lowest cost, and throw them all into the conversion pool.”
“The more corpse qi, the better.”
Yang Fan’s eyes were profound, continuously deducing the future development direction of this brand-new system.
Zombies with intelligence, and zombie believers who could Cultivate in the future.
These must be based on the Human Race, because only the Human Race could become his believers.
As for those alien zombies, they naturally lost their value.
They could simply be directly converted into corpse qi to make use of waste.
“Yes, Master! I will arrange it immediately!”
Under the blessing of the Hundredfold Evolution Talent.
Yang Fan merely took a sip of tea in the Real World, and the modification work within the Divine Kingdom had already been completely finished.
The number of ordinary-grade human zombies was about fifty billion.
The remaining ape-like zombies were all thrown into the Life Essence Conversion Pool, turning into billowing corpse qi.
The cloning nutrient pods were also expanded by Yang Da to ten million units.
Every day, a massive number of alien corpses were cloned, and then continuously transported to the conversion pool by the Robot Soldiers.
The Interdimensional Research Institute was directly listed on the Divine Shop for sale.
Plants like the Corpse Flower and rotting-bone vines planted within it were also all transplanted to the Eternal Corpse Mine.
To further modify the environment, Yang Da also purchased a large amount of yin-attribute Spirit Plants from the Divine Shop.
In a very short time, the entire Eternal Corpse Mine had completely changed its appearance.
Looking out, the sky was dim and devoid of light.
The dense Death Qi and corpse qi intertwined to form a layer of heavy black fog, completely enveloping the entire world.
The earth presented an eerie grayish-black color, countless withered trees grew twistedly, and their trunks were covered with tumor-like growths resembling human faces.
Corpse Flowers bloomed everywhere, their dark purple petals swaying gently.
Constantly spitting out wisps of corpse qi.
Occasionally, white bones could be seen half-buried in the soil.
The entire mine was terrifyingly silent.
Only the wailing sound made when a chilly wind blew echoed endlessly.
Tens of billions of zombies wandered all over the mine.
Their movements were stiff, and their faces were pale.
Looming faintly in the black fog.
Like countless ghosts wandering aimlessly in Hell.
And the corpse qi permeating all around was constantly and instinctively absorbed by them.
Along with the corpse qi entering their bodies, the decaying bones inside them gradually became hard.
Their originally yellowish fangs became increasingly sharp, and their pitch-black nails continuously extended, flashing with a heart-palpitating cold light.
Not knowing if it was due to living in the Interdimensional Research Institute for a long time, the corpse qi accumulated within these ordinary zombies had long reached its limit.
Now losing the rule suppression, they finally ushered in the moment of transformation.
Yang Fan quietly watched all of this.
Suddenly, an ordinary zombie let out a low hiss.
A massive amount of corpse qi surged madly from all directions, continuously pouring into its body.
Its rotting flesh began to shrink rapidly, while its bones continuously expanded and strengthened.
Snap!
Snap!
Dense bone-popping sounds rang out continuously, and its originally hunchbacked body slowly straightened.
Its height continuously climbed, and its arms became thicker and more powerful.
A layer of faint grayish-black stratum corneum even began to emerge on its body.
Several minutes later, the corpse qi gradually subsided.
That zombie slowly raised its head.
Within its originally turbid and lifeless eyes, a trace of elusive clarity actually appeared.
Much like a child who had just been born with intelligence.
It was just that besides clarity, that gaze was also mixed with dense confusion and puzzlement.
It had successfully broken through, becoming a true Zombie General.
And such a change did not happen in just one place.
After losing the rule suppression of the Interdimensional Research Institute, a large number of long-accumulated zombies began to break through simultaneously.
One hundred, one thousand, tens of thousands.
More and more Zombie Generals were continuously born, and the rich corpse qi swept across the entire mine.

chapters.title: Chapter 264: Rewards
paragraphs: Seeing this scene, Yang Fan immediately pulled up the current information on his Divine Kingdom.
“Divine Master: Yang Fan
Divine Kingdom Area: 80 million square kilometers
Talents: Omitted

Believers: Foundation Establishment Realm (15 million), Martial Master Realm (14 million), Qi Refining Realm (5.5 billion), Martial Disciple Realm (10.2 billion), Second-class Intelligent Life (12 million), First-class Intelligent Life (5.1 billion), Zombie General (30,000)...
Dependents: Adult Elf (450 million)
Techniques:...
Divinity Points: 32 billion (Reality daily output: 88.7 Divinity Points)

Buildings: Moon Well x 200 million, Sun Spring x 200 million, Fountain of Life x 990,000, War God Codex (S-grade), Heavenly Court (S-grade), Goddess of Wisdom (S-grade), Great Void Warship x 2 (S-grade), Mechanical War Puppet x 2 (S-grade), ten thousand dao evolution sanctuary x 1 (S-grade), Nine Nether River x 1 (S-grade), Life Essence Conversion Pool x 1 (S-grade), Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nest x 26 (S-grade)...
Wonders: Dragon Marsh Water Mansion x 110,000 (deployed), Worlds Number One Martial Arts Arena x 10,000 (deployed), myriad manifestation battle stele x 1,000

Assets: Spirit Vein Planet x 11, Spirit Plant Star x 10, Dragon Fish fry (x 1.1 billion), f-class transformation pod x 30 million, Second-class Smart Weapon x 150 million, First-class Smart Weapon x 10 billion, Mechanical Heart x 10,000, cloning nutrient pod x 10 million...”
In order to simultaneously obtain the Heavenly Court and the Goddess of Wisdom, Yang Fan had sacrificed ten Spirit Vein Planets.
However, after several months of Ma Yu’s development on Xiling Planet, tax revenues had significantly recovered.
Now, for Yang Fan, his overall income had not decreased; instead, it had actually grown.
At this moment, however, he was not focused on his income of Divinity Points.
With his current financial power, nurturing these current believers was already effortless.
For the overall future development strategy of the Divine Kingdom,
the vast majority of the Divinity Points were used by Yang Da to purchase f-class transformation pods.
Yang Fan fell into deep thought before slowly speaking after a moment, “Yang Da.”
“Your subordinate is here,” Yang Da’s figure appeared instantly.
“Summon all the Intelligent Life, as well as Ling Xuzi.”
“Yes, Master.”
Yang Da acted extremely fast. In less than a moment,
Yang Yi through Yang Ten, as well as Ling Xuzi, had all arrived.
Everyone knelt respectfully on the ground.
Yang Fan’s gaze slowly swept across everyone before he spoke in a deep voice.
“This Divine Kingdom War has lasted for several years.”
“Through everyone’s joint efforts, our Divine Kingdom ultimately routed the Undead Demigod and won this war.”
His voice was not loud, but it resounded clearly throughout the entire hall.
Excitement showed on everyone’s faces.
Especially Yang San and the other Intelligent Life responsible for operations on The Frontline; their eyes were filled with immense pride.
This battle had not been easy for them to win.
“I once said that faults will be punished and merit will be rewarded.”
“Now that the great war has ended, it is time to fulfill that promise.”
As Yang Fan’s words fell, anticipation flared in the eyes of all the Intelligent Life.
“Yang Yi, you assisted Yang Da in allocating the Divine Kingdom’s Resources, coordinating logistics, and supporting The Frontline. For your meritorious service,”
“you are rewarded with fifty Mechanical Hearts.”
“Thank you, Master!”
Yang Yi immediately bowed respectfully.
“Yang Er, you organized the Otherworldly Collectors and believers to reclaim wasteland. You are rewarded with thirty Mechanical Hearts.”
“Thank you, Master!”
“Yang San, you commanded the war on The Frontline and repeatedly led troops to rout the enemy’s main forces. You are rewarded with fifty Mechanical Hearts.”
“In addition, you receive discretionary authority over 100 million Divinity Points.”
Hearing the last sentence, even though Yang San was usually calm, a flash of joy flared in his eyes.
“Thank you for the generous gift, Master!”
Then Yang Fan looked at Yang Four through Yang Ten in turn.
“Yang Four through Yang Ten, each of you fulfilled your duties diligently, contributing significantly.”
“Each of you is rewarded with thirty Mechanical Hearts.”
“Thank you, Master!”
All the Intelligent Life bowed respectfully in unison.
The atmosphere inside the hall grew increasingly enthusiastic.
Finally, Yang Fan set his gaze upon Yang Da.
“As for Yang Da...”
Having said this, Yang Fan suddenly fell silent.
As the primary Intelligent Life of the Divine Kingdom, Yang Da held authority secondary only to Yang Fan himself.
He could already prioritize allocating Resources such as the Mechanical Heart for himself.
For a moment, Yang Fan actually did not know what to reward him with.
Just then, Yang Da cautiously raised his head.
“Master, could my palace be...”
As he spoke, a look of intense anticipation appeared in those Mechanical eyes.
Upon hearing this, Yang San and the other Intelligent Life showed slightly strange expressions on their faces.
Clearly, they were well aware of what that palace was actually used for.
The corner of Yang Fan’s mouth twitched hard, almost breaking his expression.
After a few seconds of silence, he cleared his throat.
“In that case, considering your hard work if not your grand achievements,”
“it will be temporarily unsealed for you.”
As soon as the words fell, Yang Da’s body shuddered violently.
“Thank you, Master!”
His voice rose a few pitches in excitement.
He could not even resist turning his gaze toward his distant palace, a silly grin plastered across his face.
He looked like someone who could not wait to go home.
Yang Fan couldn’t be bothered to look at his lustful, impatient expression.
He shifted his gaze directly to Ling Xuzi, his expression turning solemn.
“Ling Xuzi, in this battle, your merit is the greatest.”
As soon as these words were spoken, everyone’s eyes focused on Ling Xuzi.
Ling Xuzi’s body trembled slightly, feeling somewhat at a loss.
“Had the Void Spirit Race not gathered intelligence in advance and discovered the traps in the enemy’s Divine Kingdom Core region,”
“our Divine Kingdom would have surely suffered heavy losses in this war.”
Yang Fan spoke in a serious tone.
These words were not mere polite pleasantries, but heartfelt truth.
In this war, the Void Spirit Race had fully demonstrated their terrifying value in the Realm of intelligence gathering.
It was no Wonder so many gods chose to enslave this race.
Ling Xuzi’s face turned bright red as he listened, the little tail behind him wagging frantically, and he was so excited he nearly fainted.
“Therefore, these ten Divine Kingdom Cores shall serve as your reward.”
“In addition, besides food supplies, I will provide extra Medicinal Pills and Cultivation Resources in the future,”
“to help your believers raise their strength as quickly as possible.”
With those words, Yang Fan gently waved his hand.
Ten fist-sized Divine Kingdom Cores floated out slowly, eventually landing in Ling Xuzi’s arms.
Although these Divine Kingdom Cores were merely remnants left behind by ordinary demigods, to the Void Spirit Race, they were already unimaginable priceless treasures.
Ling Xuzi froze completely.
He held the Divine Kingdom Cores with both hands as if holding something beyond comprehension.
His eyes were filled with utter disbelief.
In his understanding, for Yang Fan to grant some Medicinal Pills and Resources would already be an astronomical favor.
Yet now, what lay before him were actually Divine Kingdom Cores.
Those were Divine Kingdom Cores!
Was a weak race like their Void Spirit Race truly worthy of absorbing such treasures?
Ling Xuzi suddenly remembered the previous masters he had served.
Every time a Divine Kingdom War ended, being granted ordinary food like wormwood and millet was already considered merciful.
As for Divine Kingdom Cores, those were something they didn’t even dare to dream of.
Thinking of this, Ling Xuzi’s eyes turned faintly red.
“M... Master...”
He opened his mouth, but he was so overwhelmed with excitement that he couldn’t utter a full sentence.
Seeing this, Yang Fan simply spoke calmly.
“So long as you can demonstrate your proper value, I will naturally nurture you well.”
“This is the reward you deserve.”
