chapters.title: Chapter 265: Framed by Treacherous Sycophants
paragraphs: Merely ten ordinary Divine Kingdom Cores.
For Yang Fan nowadays, this was simply nothing worth mentioning.
With his current Divine Kingdom combat power.
As long as he was willing, he could purchase Divine Kingdom coordinates from the Divine Shop at any time and start multi-line Divine Kingdom Wars.
But for Ling Xuzi.
This reward was enough to change the destiny of the entire Void Spirit Race.
Ling Xuzi tightly hugged the Divine Kingdom Core in his arms, his body trembling slightly.
Then he heavily prostrated himself on the ground, his forehead pressing against the floor, and did not raise his head for a long time.
After everyone left, only Yang Fan and Yang Da remained in the grand hall.
“Master, do you have any other instructions?”
Yang Da rubbed his hands together, his face full of eagerness.
That expression looked as if he couldn’t wait to fly back to his own palace immediately.
Giving Yang Fan a headache.
“What kind of Intelligent Life is like you?”
“As if you’ve never seen a woman before?”
Hearing this, Yang Da immediately became unconvinced.
“Master, you are mistaken.”
“I am the highest Intelligent Life of the Divine Kingdom, the extension and Incarnation of your will.”
“Although Yang Yi and the others also possess intelligence and thoughts, their behaviors are essentially driven by underlying code.”
“And I am different.”
Yang Da puffed out his chest.
“According to human understanding, I possess a complete Soul.”
“And strictly speaking, my personality should have been inherited from you, Master.”
Speaking of this, Yang Da suddenly scratched his head, his face full of puzzlement.
“Why are you so resistant to this matter?”
“Could you be envious?”
Veins throbbed slightly on Yang Fan’s forehead, and he was almost angered into laughter.
This was completely turning the tables.
“I suddenly feel that the reward I gave you just now should be taken back.”
“Don’t, Master!”
Yang Da instantly panicked.
“I’ve held it in for so long!”
“You can’t treat me like this!”
At this moment, Yang Da’s face was filled with grief and indignation, looking just like someone who had suffered a monstrous grievance.
As the highest Intelligent Life of the Divine Kingdom, even such a small hobby wasn’t allowed.
It was simply tragic and inhumane.
Yang Fan was left speechless at the sight, and finally waved his hand.
“Alright.”
“As long as it doesn’t affect the development of the Divine Kingdom, I have no interest in managing what you want to do.”
“The reason I asked you to stay is because there are new arrangements for the overall strategy of the Divine Kingdom next.”
Hearing about serious business, Yang Da’s expression immediately returned to seriousness.
“Please instruct me, Master.”
Yang Fan nodded slightly.
“First.”
“Next, the output of the Divine Kingdom and the taxation of Xiling Planet should no longer be used to purchase f-class transformation pods.”
“At the Demigod stage, I still have one more Divine Kingdom War to fight.”
“Keep more funds in reserve for a rainy day.”
“Yes, your subordinate understands.”
Yang Da recorded it seriously.
“Second.”
“The number of high-tier zombies is still too small.”
“In addition to cloning nutrient pods, continue to procure alien corpses from the Divine Shop.”
“In addition, there are countless Divine Kingdoms in the Human Race territory, and someone must be following the zombie or jiangshi path.”
“Search for relevant Resources and see if there are any Medicinal Pills, secret techniques, or special Materials suitable for them.”
“The temporary goal is not only the Zombie General, but also to Cultivate a Zombie King comparable to the Foundation Establishment Realm.”
“There is no need to have any concerns regarding investment; do not calculate the input-output ratio.”
“Now that I have the Gu Family as my backing, I have sufficient financial support.”
Yang Da nodded, “Your subordinate understands.”
After explaining everything, Yang Fan’s consciousness slowly returned to reality.
Now that the Divine Kingdom War with the Undead Race had just ended, the Divine Kingdom still needed time to digest the harvest brought by this epic battle.
Among them, the most important was the Zombie System in the Eternal Corpse Mine.
The overall strength of the current zombie believers was still relatively weak.
Compared with the Cultivation, Martial Arts, and Mechanical Paths, they simply couldn’t make it to the stage.
Of course, Yang Fan never intended to let them fight head-on.
In his plan, this force would become the most special trump card of the Divine Kingdom in the future.
They did not need to charge in coordination with other systems.
Instead, they would sneak into the enemy’s Divine Kingdom, spread corpse poison, and infect lives.
Greatly weakening the opponent’s living forces, and even destroying the entire civilization system from within.
More importantly, in Yang Fan’s perception.
The growth method of these zombies was extremely special.
They almost didn’t need to actively Cultivate; they only needed to devour flesh and blood, or absorb the surrounding corpse Qi, and their strength would slowly improve.
This kind of growth originated entirely from instinct, without any Bottleneck, and required no comprehension.
Compared to the complex and lengthy Cultivation process of other systems.
The zombie path was much simpler and cruder instead.
As long as Resources were sufficient, as long as time was sufficient.
They would be able to grow continuously.
And time was precisely the thing Yang Fan lacked the least.
Possessing the Hundredfold Evolution Talent, the accumulation that others needed a hundred years to complete, he might only need a year for it.
Therefore, he could completely afford to wait.
Time slowly passed, and in the blink of an eye, ten days had passed.
Yang Fan could clearly feel.
The first Zombie King was born within the Divine Kingdom.
However, he didn’t pay too much attention to this.
His consciousness didn’t even enter the Divine Kingdom to check.
A mere Zombie King comparable to the Foundation Establishment Realm was still far from enough.
However, early the next morning, a hurried voice suddenly sounded in Yang Fan’s mind.
“Master, a minor problem has arisen, and it requires you to make a personal decision.”
Yang Fan slowly opened his eyes.
At this moment, Gu Le was sleeping soundly, pillowing her head on his arm.
He carefully pulled out his arm, tucked the quilt back over her, and then sat up cross-legged.
His consciousness instantly descended into the Divine Kingdom.
“What is the matter?” Yang Fan asked.
“Please take a look, Master.” Yang Da raised his hand and pointed toward the Eternal Corpse Mine.
As a deity, Yang Fan’s gaze instantly penetrated layers of space and landed in the center of the mine.
With just a single glance, even he was slightly stunned.
At this moment, the Eternal Corpse Mine was no longer in its initial gloomy and chaotic appearance.
With the birth of the first batch of Zombie Kings, the entire zombie ethnic group seemed to have a core.
The tens of billions of zombies that originally wandered aimlessly actually began to possess the most basic order.
In the center of the mine, countless alien skeletal remains were transported and gathered, piled up into a bone altar hundreds of meters high.
At the very front of the altar, dozens of Zombie Kings stood quietly.
Their bodies were tall, and their whole bodies were coiled with thick corpse Qi.
In their crimson red eyes, there was no longer only bloodlust and madness, but instead a trace of thought belonging to Intelligent Life.
Behind them, millions of Zombie Generals were neatly arranged, forming an endless black ocean.
Further outward were tens of billions of ordinary zombies.
Although they still lacked complete intelligence, under the coercion and rule of the Zombie Kings, they simultaneously knelt and prostrated towards the direction of the altar.
A pitch-black sea, as if the entire world was worshipping.
At this moment, the Zombie King at the very front slowly knelt down, its voice hoarse and deep.
“Our God... Please open your eyes and look at us...”
“We are all your most pious believers...”
“We were framed by treacherous sycophants and turned into this neither-human-nor-ghost appearance.”
“We don’t know where this place is.”
“No family, no direction.”
“Nor do we know where the future should lead us.”
“We ask the deity for guidance...”

chapters.title: Chapter 266: It Is I Who Have Arrived Late
paragraphs: As the words fell, dozens of Zombie Kings behind him knelt in unison, followed by millions of Zombie Generals.
The voices swept across the entire mine like a wave.
“We ask the deity for guidance!”
“We ask the deity for guidance!”
“We ask the deity for guidance!”
Countless voices converged, resounding through the heavens and earth.
Seeing this, Yang Fan furrowed his brows slightly. “What is going on?”
Yang Da immediately explained.
“Reporting to Master.”
“As ordinary zombies experience a Breakthrough to become Zombie Generals, parts of their memories from when they were alive begin to gradually recover.”
“This includes their experiences of being thrown into the Interdimensional Research Institute by the robots arranged by Yang San.”
Yang Fan nodded thoughtfully. “Do you have any suggestions?”
Yang Da spoke after pondering for a moment.
“This subordinate believes it is not a big problem.”
“After these zombies regain their intelligence, they are essentially still your believers.”
“Right now, they are confused, uneasy, and even terrified.”
“And a Divine Decree is precisely the best placebo for believers.”
“As long as Master bestows a Divine Decree to give them a new goal and a sense of belonging,”
“this matter will naturally be resolved.”
Yang Fan was silent for a moment, then spoke.
“Go, call Yang San over.”
“Yes.”
Yang Da sighed softly and turned to leave.
Just a few breaths later, Yang San followed Yang Da back into the grand hall.
“Yang San.”
“You already know about the matter, right?”
Yang Fan spoke calmly.
Hearing this, Yang San immediately knelt on the ground.
“Master, this matter was indeed due to this subordinate’s lack of thorough consideration.”
“Back when the decision was made to develop the Zombie System, ordinary zombies were already sufficient to participate in the Divine Kingdom War.”
“This subordinate...”
Yang Fan did not speak, simply gazing at him quietly. The atmosphere in the grand hall gradually grew oppressive.
After a moment, Yang Fan spoke once more.
“Then what are your views on this matter?”
Yang San took a deep breath and said in a deep voice:
“Reporting to Master, this subordinate believes that we only need to launch a war.”
“Let them unleash their final value.”
“As for the future Zombie System, we can completely use clones to continue development, and naturally these problems will not arise.”
As the words fell, the grand hall instantly plunged into dead silence.
Yang Fan shook his head slowly.
“Yang San, back when you chose to use believers to develop the Zombie System,”
“what was your reason?”
“The highest cost-performance ratio.” Yang San lowered his head and replied.
“Not bad.” Yang Fan took a slow step forward, his gaze turning sharp.
“Then do you know—”
“how many resources I invested to cultivate these tens of billions of zombies?”
“The Eternal Corpse Mine, the Life Essence Conversion Pool, a large number of alien corpses, and countless corpse Qi resources.”
“Along with the continuous investment in purchasing Spirit Plants over the past ten days.”
“Is this what you call the highest cost-performance ratio?”
Yang San’s body trembled violently, instantly realizing where the problem lay.
These zombies were no longer the cannon fodder they were initially, but a strategic asset of astonishing value.
If they were all discarded due to memory issues, the loss would be even greater than fighting a Divine Kingdom War.
Thinking of this, Yang San slammed his forehead heavily against the ground.
“Master, please forgive me!”
“This subordinate acted in haste and came up with such a foolish move!”
“Please punish me, Master!”
Inside the grand hall, only the sound of heavy kowtowing continued to echo.
Yang Fan quietly watched this scene, then slowly stood up and walked to Yang San’s side.
He reached out and patted his shoulder.
“I have never doubted your loyalty.”
“It’s just that this time, you were wrong.”
“These zombies are not burdens, so naturally they cannot become consumables.”
“Since they have regained their intelligence, they are a part of my divine kingdom’s future.”
“You will just have to be wronged for a period of time.”
Yang San’s body trembled slightly, then he nodded heavily.
“This subordinate understands.”
Yang Fan was silent for a moment, then turned to look at Yang Da.
“Create an image and prepare for projection.”
“You should understand what I mean.”
Yang Da was stunned at first, and then his eyes suddenly lit up.
“Rest assured, Master! This subordinate understands!”
In just a few breaths, everything was ready.
Meanwhile, within the Eternal Corpse Mine,
a grand and vast Divine Decree suddenly descended.
Endless golden light tore through the pervasive corpse Qi, illuminating the entire mine.
Tens of billions of zombies raised their heads simultaneously.
Countless murky, scarlet, and bewildered eyes looked up at the sky.
The next moment, a majestic yet compassionate voice slowly resounded.
“My believers, you have suffered.”
The voice echoed across heaven and earth, and the entire mine instantly fell silent.
“I have already investigated this matter thoroughly; all of you were harmed by a treacherous villain.”
“My spokesperson, Yang San, committed the crimes of embezzling the divine kingdom’s resources, concealing believers’ casualties, deceiving the deity, and abusing power.”
“Furthermore, he privately threw a large number of believers into the experimental grounds.”
“Causing all of you to endure such suffering is a grave crime.”
“Unforgivable.”
“Boom—”
The sky suddenly shook, and a huge screen of light slowly unfolded.
Countless zombies subconsciously looked up.
Within the light screen, Yang San could be seen fleeing frantically with a terrified expression.
Behind him was an endless tide of corpses, and countless zombies tackled him down.
Biting, devouring, scratching.
Piercing screams constantly rang out.
That face was filled with despair and remorse.
“No!”
“I was wrong!”
“Please spare me!”
The shrill screams resounded through heaven and earth.
Seeing this scene, the high-tier zombies turned red-eyed, and their long-suppressed resentment finally erupted completely.
“Kill him!”
“Bite him to death!”
“Make sure he can never reincarnate for all eternity!”
“Kill!!!”
Millions of Zombie Generals roared in unison, rolling soundwaves sweeping across the heavens and earth.
It wasn’t until a long time later that the light screen slowly dissipated.
And the voice of the Divine Decree sounded once more.
“According to the laws of the divine kingdom, Yang San will be cast into another realm.”
“To endure the exact same torment as all of you for ten thousand years.”
“After ten thousand years, he will be executed with extreme punishment.”
As soon as these words were spoken, the entire mine instantly boiled over.
Countless zombies kowtowed frantically.
They didn’t care whether Yang San died or not.
What they cared about was that the deity had seen them, and the deity had not abandoned them.
Right at this moment, endless divine light converged between heaven and earth.
An extremely majestic light and shadow slowly appeared above the sky.
Its height seemed to connect heaven and earth, and its eyes were like two blazing suns.
It was precisely Yang Fan’s Divine Thought Incarnation.
At this moment,
the Zombie Kings trembled violently and knelt on the ground one after another.
Millions of Zombie Generals followed closely behind, and even those ordinary zombies that had not yet given birth to intelligence knelt down under the drive of instinct.
They had all once been Yang Fan’s believers; that awe and worship originating from the depths of the Soul had long been carved into their bones.
“Greetings, our deity!”
“The deity has manifested!”
“Our deity has not abandoned us!”
“We give thanks to our deity!”
“Praise our deity!”
Countless voices converged into an ocean, resounding through the entire mine, causing even the corpse Qi in the air to vibrate.
Looking at this scene, Yang Fan was quite satisfied in his heart.
This was not entirely his improvisation on the spot.
In fact, these methods were all things he had once learned from a book titled “How to Be an Excellent Deity”.
The book clearly recorded that believers do not necessarily need a deity’s constant help, but they must be made to feel the deity’s attention.
Whether it was sincere or a performance,
as long as the believers believed that the deity cared about them, they would repay with even more pious faith.
Thinking of this, Yang Fan slowly spoke, a trace of pity added to his voice.
“My believers.”
“You have suffered.”
“It is I who have arrived late.”
“Causing you to endure such great grievances.”

chapters.title: Chapter 267: The Greatest Loyalty
paragraphs: As soon as those words were spoken, countless zombies trembled violently.
“We are terrified!”
“The deity still remembers us!”
“Even if we die now, we have no regrets!”
“Praise my deity!”
Countless Zombie Generals trembled with excitement, some of their rotting flesh even continuously falling off due to their emotional fluctuations.
Yet they didn’t care in the least, leaving only fanaticism and gratitude in their eyes.
After the voices subsided slightly,
Yang Fan continued,
“This place is far too secluded.”
“Even I was unable to notice it at the very first moment.”
“That is why I have let you suffer until now.”
“However, too much time has passed now.”
“Your family and friends from the past have long since passed away.”
“If you rashly leave this place, the corpse poison within your bodies will instead bring a huge disaster to the Divine Kingdom.”
Hearing this, the gazes of quite a few Zombie Kings instantly dimmed.
But soon, the Zombie King at the very front heavily kowtowed.
“My deity! We only ask for justice!”
“Now that the chief culprit has received punishment, we have no more regrets in our hearts!”
“Our family is gone, and our hometown is far away.”
“We monsters who are neither human nor ghost are unwilling to become a burden to the Divine Kingdom!”
“Whether we stay here dragging out our ignoble existence or end it ourselves,”
“We have no complaints whatsoever!”
“We deeply love the Divine Kingdom!”
“We deeply love our hometown!”
“We will never let this virus return to our homeland!”
As the voice fell, numerous Zombie Kings kowtowed and echoed in unison.
“We will never implicate the Divine Kingdom!”
“We will never implicate our hometown!”
Seeing this scene, Yang Fan slowly nodded, then spoke in a deep voice.
“Who says you are monsters?”
A single sentence plunged the entire mine into silence.
“Your current state is called zombies.”
“It is an alternative path to Cultivate.”
“Originally, even I did not know that such a civilization had appeared within the Divine Kingdom.”
“Until today, when I investigated the truth, did I discover that a traitor had privately brought this vicious path into the Divine Kingdom.”
“Now that it is a fait accompli, naturally I will not abandon you to your fate.”
“Starting from today, I will invest a massive amount of resources to nurture you.”
“Allowing you to possess a future of your own.”
“Whether it is fighting for the Divine Kingdom or guarding your hometown,”
“If one day you Cultivate to the realm of a jiangshi,”
“There may not be a lack of opportunity to step foot onto that homeland once again.”
Rumble—
At the exact moment the voice fell,
Yang Fan waved his large hand, and the massive amount of alien corpses that Yang Da had prepared long ago were simultaneously thrown into the Life Essence Conversion Pool.
Billowing corpse Qi soared into the sky, like a black ocean sweeping across the entire Eternal Corpse Mine.
The density even materialized into substance, and countless zombies absorbed it frantically.
Their strength grew at a speed visible to the naked eye.
At this moment, all the Zombie Kings and Zombie Generals that had given birth to spiritual intelligence knelt flat on the ground simultaneously, their foreheads smashing heavily against the floor.
“Many thanks, my deity!”
“My deity is merciful!”
“We will surely work hard to Cultivate!”
“Fight for the Divine Kingdom!”
“Fight for my deity!”
Fanatic shouts resounded through heaven and earth.
And Yang Fan could clearly sense that the entire corpse race had completely surrendered their hearts to him.
Yang Fan returned to the grand hall.
At this moment, only Yang Da was left inside the hall.
“Master.”
“I have already purchased a villa and hidden Yang San deep underground in the Divine Kingdom.”
“He absolutely will not be discovered by anyone.”
“Furthermore, those zombie believers all live in the Eternal Corpse Mine; they will not leave, nor is there any risk of exposure.”
Yang Da reported earnestly.
Yang Fan nodded with satisfaction.
“Very good. Next, extract the genes of some outstanding believers.”
“Begin cloning utilizing one-tenth of the production capacity of the cloning nutrient pod.”
“After a while, have Yang San change his name, appearance, and voice.”
“By then, he will be able to come back out.”
“Yes, Master.” Yang Da immediately revealed a knowing smile.
Meanwhile, within the Eternal Corpse Mine.
A large number of high-tier zombies were frantically devouring the alien corpses that had been thrown in.
Corpse Qi rolled turbulently, and roars shook the heavens.
It was like a carnival feast belonging solely to the corpse race.
As for those ordinary zombies, although they did not know what had happened,
Whenever alien corpses were thrown into the mine, they would still instinctively pounce forward to snatch and bite them.
As for those Zombie Kings and Zombie Generals who had recovered their sanity, they had completely surrendered their hearts.
“I knew it!”
“The divine beings will not forget us!”
“With a deity who cares for believers like this, how could the Divine Kingdom not flourish!”
“My guess back then was indeed correct!”
“The deity is definitely good; it’s just that those Intelligent Life forms below executed things with problems!”
“Justice will eventually arrive!”
“I am willing to offer everything for the Divine Kingdom!”
“Long live the Divine Kingdom! Long live my deity! Long live the future!”
Meanwhile,
Deep underground in the Divine Kingdom.
An independent space had been specially carved out here.
Overhead were simulated blue skies and white clouds, surrounded by lush green trees.
An extremely luxurious villa quietly sat in the center.
At this moment, Yang San was sitting alone in the courtyard, his expression somewhat desolate.
Although Master had not truly punished him,
Losing military power and being unable to continue fighting across all directions
Was already a form of torment for him.
Right at this moment, a familiar voice suddenly sounded.
“Yang San, why are you in such low spirits?”
Yang Da slowly appeared, followed behind by two exquisitely featured bionic women.
Yang San hurriedly stood up, “Greetings, Milord.”
Yang Da waved his hand.
“These are bionic people I bought for you.”
“I was afraid you’d be bored alone.”
Hearing this, Yang San instantly gave a bitter smile.
“Milord, I am not the same as you.”
“I have no interest in these things.”
“The battlefield is my true destination.”
“Expanding territory for the Divine Kingdom and capturing cities for Master is what I truly want to do.”
Hearing these words, Yang Da instantly revealed an expression of “as expected.”
Then he gently snapped his fingers.
Swish!
Two hundred Mechanical Hearts appeared out of thin air, suspended in mid-air.
Each one was crystal clear, and countless data torrents seemed to flow within them.
“M... Milord?”
Yang San’s pupils shrank violently, and his whole person froze on the spot.
“What is the meaning of this?”
“Am I not currently accepting punishment?”
Looking at the other’s shocked appearance, Yang Da couldn’t help laughing.
“Punishment?”
“Who told you this was punishment?”
“It was merely to give those believers an explanation.”
“On the surface, it’s not good to reward you with anything.”
“These count as secret rewards.”
Yang San was completely stunned.
Yang Da continued,
“The zombie route was proposed by you.”
“Although the final result was different from Master’s expectations, your starting point has only been one from beginning to end.”
“That is for the Divine Kingdom, and for Master.”
“Furthermore, you have never concealed anything.”
“All plans were laid out openly on the surface.”
“This is the greatest loyalty.”
Hearing this, Yang San instantly knelt on one knee, his face full of panic.
“Milord speaks too seriously.”
“As an Intelligent Life form,”
“My existence is for the development of the Divine Kingdom.”
“My significance is to dedicate knowledge and wisdom to Master.”
“These are things I should be doing in the first place.”

chapters.title: Chapter 268: Trade Comes Knocking
paragraphs: Yang Da nodded with satisfaction.
“That is why the Master has never blamed you.”
“It is just that those zombies have now gained intelligence.”
“Someone has to stand up and take responsibility.”
“And you are the most suitable.”
Speaking of which, Yang Da pointed at those Mechanical Hearts.
“Use these resources to improve yourself.”
“In the next Divine Kingdom War, you will still be the Grand Marshal.”
Yang San’s body shuddered violently, and a look of pleasant surprise instantly burst out in his eyes.
“This...”
“But I am now in the identity of a sinner...”
Hearing this, Yang Da laughed out loud.
“A sinner?”
“We are Intelligent Life after all.”
“Changing voices, changing appearances, changing identities.”
“Are merely the most basic operations.”
“From now on, you will no longer be called Yang San.”
“Instead, you will be called Yang Eleven.”
Yang San was slightly stunned, and then showed a thoughtful look.
Yang Da suddenly paused and lowered his voice to say:
“This name was personally chosen by the Master.”
“His naming sense is just like this.”
“You know how it is.”
Yang San instantly felt deep respect.
“This subordinate understands.”
“This name embodies the Dao in its simplicity, returning to truth and innocence.”
The corners of Yang Da’s mouth twitched fiercely.
Good grief, he could even forcefully praise this?
However, he couldn’t be bothered to expose him and directly waved his hand.
“Alright, from now on, the zombie legion, this surprise force, will be under your charge.”
“Come out after absorbing the Mechanical Heart.”
“Remember to go to the Divine Shop to pick a favorite voice and appearance to load.”
“Don’t let those zombie believers recognize you.”
Having said that, Yang Da’s figure slowly dissipated.
Inside the villa courtyard, Yang Eleven looked at the two hundred floating Mechanical Hearts before him and slowly clenched his fists.
A burning fighting spirit reignited in his eyes.
“Master, this subordinate will definitely not disappoint you!”
On the other side.
Real World.
Yang Fan slowly opened his eyes.
Sunlight spilled in through the window, and Gu Le was snuggling in his arms.
Sensing that Yang Fan had woken up, Gu Le asked softly:
“Husband.”
“Entering the Divine Kingdom early in the morning.”
“Did you encounter something?”
Yang Fan smiled and shook his head.
“Just some trivial matters of no consequence.”
Having said that, his gaze fell on Gu Le’s slightly bulging lower belly.
His gaze involuntarily softened a bit.
“As for you.”
“Your belly is getting bigger and bigger.”
“Do you want to rest a bit more?”
Hearing this, a happy smile instantly appeared on Gu Le’s face.
That afternoon, the doorbell suddenly rang.
After opening the door, Yang Fan was slightly stunned.
The newcomer was dressed in a black robe with a gentle smile on his face.
It was actually Gu Tianyu, whom they had seen at the banquet.
That big figure of the Gu Family who controlled countless commercial channels.
“Brother Gu?” Yang Fan was somewhat surprised.
Gu Tianyu smiled and cupped his hands.
“Brother Yang.”
“Pardon my abrupt visit, please do not blame me.”

“I just rushed back from the Canghe Star Domain, crossed several stargates all the way, traversed several light-years, and after arriving at Taichu City, I didn’t even return home before coming to see Brother Yang first.”
“Such great affection really flatters me a bit.”
Yang Fan smiled and stepped aside.
“Brother Gu, please come in.”
“Pardon the intrusion.” Gu Tianyu stood on no ceremony and stepped into the villa.
Inside the living room, Gu Le immediately stood up upon seeing the newcomer, “Uncle Tianyu.”
Gu Tianyu nodded slightly, “Long time no see.”
Gu Le wore a proper smile on her face and didn’t ask an extra question.
Soon the reception room was arranged, spirit tea was brewed, and some Spirit Fruit were brought over.
Then she voluntarily left the room.
Before leaving, she also casually closed the room door, leaving the space entirely to the two of them.
Seeing this scene, a flash of approval crossed Gu Tianyu’s eyes.
“As expected of the Third Elder’s daughter, Brother Yang is truly blessed.”
Yang Fan smiled and did not pick up the conversation.
Instead, he went straight to the point.
“I wonder what business Brother Gu has looking for me today?”
Gu Tianyu picked up the spirit tea and took a sip, a smile unique to businessmen appearing on his face.
“I am a businessman.”
“Coming to find Brother Yang is naturally to do business.”
“Business?”
A trace of doubt flashed in Yang Fan’s eyes.
Gu Tianyu put down the teacup, and his expression gradually turned serious.
“Since everyone is from the Gu Family, I won’t beat around the bush.”
“I already know about Brother Yang defeating that Undead Demigod of the Primordial Academy a few days ago.”
“Some things are not convenient to say in the Virtual World.”
Yang Fan’s gaze flickered slightly, vaguely guessing something.
Sure enough.
The next second.
Gu Tianyu asked directly:
“That Eternal Corpse Mine, has Brother Yang handed it over?”
Yang Fan shook his head, “Not yet.”
Hearing this, a flash of joy instantly crossed Gu Tianyu’s eyes.
“That’s good.”
“To be honest, if it were handed over, the value would instead be the lowest.”
“I am willing to offer one trillion Divinity Points, plus the ownership of a habitable planet only one light-year away from Xiling Planet.”
“In exchange for the Eternal Corpse Mine.”
As the words fell.
Even with Yang Fan’s mental preparation, his heart still couldn’t help beating fiercely.
One trillion Divinity Points, plus a habitable planet.
This was no longer an ordinary transaction, but an astronomical price in the true sense.
After a moment of silence, Yang Fan couldn’t help asking:
“Brother Gu.”
“As far as I know, although the Eternal Corpse Mine is precious.”
“It is mainly applicable to dark-attribute creatures.”
“Its value to the Human Race is limited.”
“It shouldn’t be able to sell for this price, right?”
Hearing this, Gu Tianyu smiled.
“Brother Yang, today I didn’t choose to contact you in the Virtual World, but came to your house in person.”
Speaking of this, he lowered his voice.
“To not hide it from Brother Yang, I have a smuggling channel in my hands.”
“The Eternal Corpse Mine indeed has limited value within the Human Race territory.”
“But if placed in the hands of other races, it is a top-tier S-Rank Building.”
“This is a priceless treasure; countless gods would trade more than half of their net worth for it.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan raised his brows slightly.
“The risk shouldn’t be small, right?”
“Risk?”
Gu Tianyu smiled and shook his head.
“Business has never been about looking at risk.”
“It is about expectation.”
“As long as the profit is sufficient, someone will venture into even the greatest risk.”
“What’s more.”
“Aren’t the most profitable businesses in this world written in the Federal Supreme Law?”
Speaking of this, Gu Tianyu couldn’t help sighing with emotion.
“Ordinary people see the law.”
“Businessmen see the market.”
“And those with backgrounds see the threshold.”
“Others cannot get in, which is why the profit is high.”
Hearing this, the corners of Yang Fan’s mouth twitched slightly.
This business tycoon of the Gu Family really didn’t avoid anything at all.
“However, Brother Gu is likely to be disappointed.”
Yang Fan said, shaking his head.
“The Eternal Corpse Mine has other uses for my Divine Kingdom.”
“I do not plan to sell it for the time being.”
Hearing this, Gu Tianyu was obviously somewhat disappointed.
“The price can still be discussed.”
“Or I can consign it on your behalf.”
“I will only charge a partial commission fee.”
“Sorry.”
Yang Fan shook his head again.
“It’s not a price issue.”
“It’s just that I really have use for this thing.”
“Otherwise, given the conditions Brother Gu offered, I simply couldn’t find a reason to refuse.”

chapters.title: Chapter 269: Dark Web
paragraphs: Gu Tianyu was silent for a moment, and in the end, could only sigh helplessly.
“It’s a pity.”
“This deal could have made quite a profit.”
Just at this moment, Yang Fan suddenly had a thought.
Several architectural cards appeared in his hand, and then he handed them over.
“The Eternal Corpse Mine is not for sale.”
“However, I wonder if Brother Gu is interested in these things?”
Gu Tianyu took the cards and glanced down at them.
The next second, his eyes suddenly lit up.
“Of course I’m interested!”
“S-grade Void Realm energy cores, things like this have quite a market within the Human Race.”
“As for the Land of the Undead... it is even one of the Undead Race’s favorite strategic-level buildings.”
“And so many Skeleton Soldier barracks, Brother Yang’s harvest this time is not small.”
Speaking of this, the smile on Gu Tianyu’s Face was obviously much more sincere.
“I wonder what price Brother Yang plans to sell them for?”
Yang Fan leaned against the sofa with a calm expression.
“Brother Gu can just name the price.”
“I don’t understand the black market trends.”
“Nor have I ever contacted these channels.”
“As long as the price is reasonable, I will sell.”
Gu Tianyu did not reply immediately, but gently tapped on the tabletop.
The crisp sound of the table slowly echoed in the room.
He seemed to be weighing something.
After a long while, Gu Tianyu’s movements suddenly stopped, and there was a hint of determination in his eyes.
“Brother Yang, I know a special channel.”
“With your identity, you are already qualified to contact it.”
“I’ll do you a favor and tell you.”
Yang Fan’s gaze flickered slightly. “What channel?”
Gu Tianyu said, “Dark Web.”
Yang Fan frowned slightly.
Gu Tianyu did not explain too much, but continued:
“There are many special beings trading there.”
“Some things are ignored when placed in the Federal Mall.”
“But there, they can be sold for prices far exceeding the market several times over.”
“The buildings in your hands can perhaps be taken there for auction.”
Speaking of this, Gu Tianyu paused.
“Not only that.”
“To ensure absolute safety there,”
“ordinary high-level Intelligent Life cannot even connect, and it must be mediated by the divine kingdom’s supreme Intelligent Life.”
“Otherwise, a connection simply cannot be established.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan was even more surprised in his heart.
Gu Tianyu had already stood up and came to the desk.
He picked up pen and paper and quickly wrote down a string of coordinates composed of special characters.
Those characters were very strange.
They neither looked like text nor numbers.
Instead, they looked more like some encrypted rule symbols.
After writing, Gu Tianyu pushed the paper in front of Yang Fan.
“Brother Yang, I won’t participate in this transaction.”
“Consider it making a friend.”
“I have two more meetings this afternoon, so I won’t disturb you any longer.”
Speaking of this, Gu Tianyu showed a trace of a smile.
“However, when you go to The Frontline in the future, if you have any good things, remember to give me priority.”
After finishing, Gu Tianyu did not drag his feet at all, turned around, and left the villa.
Vigorous and resolute, extremely decisive.
After Gu Tianyu left, Yang Fan returned to the living room.
Gu Le had already brewed a new pot of spirit tea.
“Husband, are you done talking?”
Yang Fan nodded, then sat down beside her.
“How much do you know about Gu Tianyu?”
Gu Le was obviously stunned for a moment.
“Uncle Tianyu?”
“What’s wrong?”
Yang Fan smiled.
“I’m a bit curious.”
Gu Le pondered for a moment and slowly spoke.
“Speaking of the strength of divine kingdom believers, he is actually not considered the strongest in the Gu Family.”
“But when it comes to money-making ability, he is definitely one of the most legendary figures in the Gu Family.”
“It is said that when he was over a hundred years old, he had already accumulated wealth that made countless gods envious.”
“And over the years, many big figures in the Gu Family hold shares in his industries.”
“The dividends alone every year are an astronomical figure.”
“My father is also one of them.”
Speaking of this, Gu Le couldn’t help but sigh with emotion.
“Actually, when I saw him at the banquet back then, I was still a bit surprised.”
“Although he is not very old, if we talk solely about influence and the resources he masters,”
“even many people of my father’s generation have to give him some Face.”
Yang Fan nodded thoughtfully, then asked as if unintentionally:
“Have you ever heard of the Dark Web?”
Gu Le was stunned immediately.
“Dark Web?”
“What Dark Web?”
“The Virtual Universe Company combined with the federal supreme intelligent life to build today’s network system.”
“It is simply impossible for a so-called Dark Web to exist.”
“No data fluctuation can escape monitoring.”
“At least I have never heard of it.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan’s eyes flickered slightly, but he didn’t continue to ask, just smiled and waved his hand.
“It’s nothing.”
“Just asking casually.”
However, waves had already stirred up in his heart.
Even a direct descendant of the Gu Family like Gu Le did not know of the existence of the Dark Web.
The value of the string of coordinates left by Gu Tianyu was probably far beyond his imagination.
And there was another point, Gu Tianyu specially chose to visit offline today instead of contacting through the Virtual World.
That in itself already explained a lot of problems.
Some things can be done, but cannot be spoken of.
Some transactions can exist, but cannot be recorded.
Yang Fan was not that kind of pedantic person.
He was very clear on one principle.
The weak obey the rules, while the strong make the rules.
And those who truly stand at the top of the world
often both make rules and utilize rules.
The Human Race is like this, and alien races are as well.
Even those ordinary Divine Beings would find ways to evade taxes through offline transactions.
Let alone a figure like Gu Tianyu who controlled a huge business Empire.
The so-called rules were never meant to restrict everyone, but rather to screen people.
After returning to the room,
Yang Fan directly put on the virtual helmet.
At the same time,
within the divine kingdom, Yang Da had already received that string of special coordinates.
“Yang Da, based on these coordinates, take my consciousness over together.” Yang Fan ordered.
“As you command, Master.”
The next moment,
Yang Fan suddenly felt his consciousness gently touched by some force.
That feeling was completely different from ordinary virtual teleportation.
There was no space jumping, nor any data stream shuttling.
Instead, it was as if he was slowly dragged into deeper darkness by an invisible giant hand.
Constantly sinking, constantly deepening.
As if he was breaking away from the surface network and entering a more secretive area.
The surrounding torrent of data became less and less.
The sense of rules belonging to the Universe even began to gradually fade.
Until a certain moment,
Swish!
The light suddenly returned before his eyes.
Yang Fan and Yang Da appeared in a small room at the same time.
The room furnishings were extremely simple, with only a table, chairs, and a huge floor-to-ceiling window.
Yang Fan slowly walked to the window.
The next moment, his pupils suddenly constricted.
Outside the window, countless small houses identical to the room he was in were suspended.
Layer after layer, circle after circle.
Spaces overlapped with each other, extending endlessly into the distance, as if there was never an end.
And right in the center of all the houses, a huge sphere floated.
That was not a real object, but was piled up from countless numbers, symbols, and rule fragments.
Like a star composed of data,
it slowly operated, exuding a mysterious and ancient aura.

chapters.title: Chapter 270: A New Channel
paragraphs: Yang Fan tried to look toward the other rooms.
But he found that his line of sight seemed to be blocked by a certain force.
He could only see vague outlines and was completely unable to peek inside.
However, he could feel faint auras continuously coming over.
There were auras as scorching as the sun, fluctuations as cold as the abyss, the vast coercion of an ancient ocean, and mental fluctuations as cold and rational as a Mechanical Civilization.
The Flame Demon Race, Sea Siren Race, Orcs, Shadow Race, Zerg...
And even the auras of Human Race gods.
When Yang Fan was young and studying in middle school in Yang County, the school had specially offered an alien race identification course.
It’s just that these auras now were countless times more powerful than the descriptions in the textbooks.
Gods!
These were all existences at the level of gods!
Thinking of this, Yang Fan couldn’t help drawing a sharp breath.
Those who could enter this place were probably no simple figures.
What gathered here were not only Human Race experts, but also a large number of Alien Gods.
And what shocked Yang Fan even more was:
Who on earth had the ability to build such a trading place spanning across ten thousand races?
The Gu Family?
Yang Fan quickly dismissed this guess.
Although the Gu Family was powerful, facing the endless rooms before him and those terrifyingly tyrannical auras,
I’m afraid it far exceeded the scope of the Gu Family.
Just as Yang Fan was observing his surroundings, a cold, synthesized Mechanical voice suddenly rang out.
[ New member detected. ]
[ Verifying recommendation permissions... ]
[ Verification complete. ]
[ Member source: Level 3 customer recommendation. ]
[ Basic browsing permissions have been automatically activated. ]
The next moment, a huge rule light screen appeared in the center of the room.
[ Trading rules are as follows. ]
[ First: All commodities on this platform adopt a bidding auction model. ]
[ Second: Each member only has one bidding opportunity, please fill it in carefully. ]
[ Third: After the bidding ends, the highest bidder acquires ownership of the commodity. ]
[ Fourth: Members can submit commodities for hosted auctions at any time. After the transaction is completed, the platform automatically charges a 5% operating fee. ]
[ Sixth: Investigating member identities is prohibited. ]
[ Seventh: Attacking the platform is prohibited. ]
[ Eighth: Those who violate the rules will have their membership permanently revoked. ]
The voice was very concise without any redundant nonsense.
After speaking, it completely disappeared.
At the same time, Yang Da’s eyes kept flickering.
Countless data streams flashed past the depths of his pupils, clearly frantically receiving the information here.
After a long time, he slowly let out a breath.
“Master, I have a preliminary understanding of the rules here.”
“The entire website itself is incarnated by an Intelligent Life.”
Yang Fan frowned slightly.
“Intelligent Life?”
“Transformed into a website?”
“What do you mean?”
Yang Da was silent for a moment, seeming to organize his words.
“Master, Intelligent Life essentially still belongs to program life.”
“Code is our Foundation.”
“Theoretically speaking, a sufficiently powerful Intelligent Life can indeed take over the network and even evolve into a special form.”
Speaking of this, Yang Da’s expression gradually turned solemn.
“But the existence before us...”
“Has exceeded my scope of understanding.”
Yang Fan’s expression changed slightly; this was the first time he had heard Yang Da give such an evaluation.
“Exceeded your understanding?”
“Yes.”
Yang Da nodded.
“Every race has its own network.”

“The Human Race has the Virtual Universe, the Mechanical God Race has the Data Sea, the Zerg has the Psychic Nest Network, and the Sea Siren Race has the Abyss Resonance Network. Their names are different, but their essence is all a trading network.”
“Yet this Dark Web before us connects the networks of all races together.”
“Although it is limited to member entrances, it can still be called incredible.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan slowly took a breath and did not continue to delve into it.
Some things were clearly not something he could touch at present.
When strength is not enough, knowing too much is not necessarily a good thing.
Thinking of this, he forced himself to calm down.
“Yang Da, is trading on this website convenient?”
“Reporting to Master, it is not real-time trading.”
“The Dark Web holds a centralized auction once a month. If you want to sell commodities, you only need to seal the building into a card, and then upload and host it through a special channel.”
“The platform will automatically push commodity information to all members.”
“Interested parties fill in the price, and the highest bidder finally obtains ownership.”
“After the handling fee is deducted, the Divinity Points are automatically credited to the Divine Kingdom account.”
“If you want to buy commodities, it is the same process.”
Speaking of this, Yang Da added another sentence.
“In addition, this place only accepts high-value commodities, and the minimum transaction threshold is one billion Divinity Points.”
Hearing this, a sharp glint lit up in Yang Fan’s eyes instead.
“In other words...”
“We can similarly purchase S-Rank Buildings through here?”
“That’s right.”
Yang Da nodded seriously.
“And the quantity is far greater than the outside world.”
After speaking, he suddenly gave Yang Fan a wink.
“Master, let’s talk about it after returning to the Divine Kingdom.”
Yang Fan instantly understood, and then immediately exited the Dark Web.
Inside the Divine Kingdom main hall.
The figures of Yang Fan and Yang Da appeared.
As soon as they landed, Yang Da spoke first.
“Master, the Dark Web data has been organized.”
“The upcoming conversation may involve the Hundredfold Evolution Talent, and the interior of the Divine Kingdom is the safest.”
Yang Fan nodded, “Understood.”
An Intelligent Life that even Yang Da could not see through.
Coupled with that network system covering all races, who knows if there are any special monitoring methods.
Being cautious is always right.
The next moment.
Yang Da opened his arms.
Boom——
A huge light screen appeared in the center of the palace.
Countless commodity information began to scroll.
[ SS-Rank Building: Eternal Divine Tree ]
[ Insufficient permissions, unable to view. ]
[ SS-Rank Building: Myriad Realms Reincarnation Pool ]
[ Insufficient permissions, unable to view. ]
[ SS-Rank Building: Star Sea Broodmother ]
[ Insufficient permissions, unable to view. ]
[ S-Rank Building: Dragon Blood Reincarnation Pool ]
[ Current status: Bidding ]
[ Bidding amount: Fillable ]
[ S-Rank Building: Mechanical Shrine ]
[ Core building of the Mechanical God Race ]
[ Bidding amount: Fillable ]
[ S-Rank Building: Ancient Tree of Life Matrix ]
[ Core building of the Elf Race ]
[ Bidding amount: Fillable ]
[ S-Rank Building: Immortal Bone Mausoleum ]
[ Strategic building of the Undead Race ]
[ Bidding amount: Fillable ]
[ S-Rank Building: Sea of Elements ]
[ Elemental life birth building ]
[ Bidding amount: Fillable ]
Looking at the densely packed information, Yang Fan was stunned, and couldn’t help drawing a sharp breath.
Within the Primordial Academy, S-Rank Buildings were all limited-quota resources.
As a result, here, they could actually be purchased directly with Divinity Points!
Even SS-Rank Buildings had appeared!
At this moment, Yang Fan’s breathing became heavy.
If he could steadily obtain these buildings,
coupled with his Hundredfold Evolution Talent,
what level would the future Divine Kingdom grow to?
Thinking of this, his gaze stared fixedly at the light screen.
“Yang Da, what are the closing prices of these buildings?”

chapters.title: Chapter 271: Resource Star Trading Area
paragraphs: “The Dark Web has provided historical transaction records over the years.”
“Since it adopts an anonymous auction mode, the prices fluctuate drastically.”
Yang Da waved his hand to bring up a set of data.
“For example, resource-type buildings like the Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nest.”
“Demand is stable, and supply is relatively sufficient.”
“The transaction price is usually maintained between 1 billion and 1.5 billion Divinity Points.”
“However, strategic-level military buildings like the Great Void Warship are completely different.”
“When it is low, it can be traded for 50 or 60 billion, and when it is high, it can even be driven up to 400 or 500 billion.”
“After all, most of the bidders are gods.”
“They cannot confirm each other’s identities, nor can they judge the other’s true needs.”
“If it is something they truly fancy, in order to secure it, many people will directly offer a price far exceeding its market value.”
After listening to the explanation, Yang Fan was stunned at first.
Then he could not help but laugh out loud.
“Hahaha! Gu Tianyu, oh Gu Tianyu.”
“This time you have made me owe a huge favor.”
“The Dark Web, S-Rank Building, Divinity Points...”
The light in Yang Fan’s eyes grew brighter and brighter.
Possessing the SSS-Rank Evolution Talent.
For others, the most difficult thing is having enough Resources.
As for him, as long as there are channels, the rest is not a problem.
“Yang Da, what is the trading volume of these buildings?”
“Reporting to Master, Dark Web members are spread across many races.”
“The trading scale is extremely huge.”
“A unified auction is opened once a month.”
“The circulation speed of various high-order buildings far exceeds the Federal Mall.”
Speaking of this, even Yang Da’s voice carried a hint of excitement.
“Master.”
“We might need to replan the investment direction of the Divine Kingdom.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan was not surprised; Yang Da was an extension of his own will, so it was completely normal for them to think alike.
The Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nest, in the hands of ordinary gods, yields no more than one million Divinity Points per month.
However, after Hundred-fold Evolution, the income can directly skyrocket to 100 million.
Even though the Dark Web selling price is as high as over 1 billion Divinity Points.
For Yang Fan, it would take only a year in the Real World to break even.
And a Spirit Vein Planet yields no more than 1 billion Divinity Points per month.
However, if its coordinates are sold, it can exchange for hundreds of billions of funds.
What does this mean?
It means selling one Spirit Vein Planet is enough to buy nearly a hundred Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nests.
The income directly skyrockets tenfold!
More importantly, this kind of income can continue to stack and expand.
Under the compound interest effect formed by the Hundredfold Evolution Talent.
Yang Fan can completely gradually sell large Divine Kingdom assets such as the Dragon Marsh Water Mansion and Spirit Vein Planet.
Free up more area and load them all with Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nests.
In this way, the Spiritual Qi concentration of the Divine Kingdom will continue to rise.
The income of Divinity Points will show explosive growth.
What Spirit Vein Planets, what Resource planets.
In front of Hundred-fold Evolution, they will all become transitional products.
In the future, all believers stationed on Resource stars can be completely withdrawn back to the Divine Kingdom to concentrate on Cultivate.
Relying solely on the Resource output inside the Divine Kingdom is enough to support the entire civilization.
Thinking that his future Divine Kingdom will be filled with hundreds, thousands, or even hundreds of thousands of Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nests.
Yang Fan felt a bit dry in his mouth.
With that scale of income, Divinity Points would probably be so much that they could never be spent out.
After a long time, Yang Fan took a deep breath and forcibly suppressed the excitement in his heart.
“Has this month’s Dark Web transaction started?”
“There are still five days.” Yang Da replied immediately.
“How many Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nests are currently for sale?”
“One hundred and forty-two orders have been listed.”
“Only a hundred-plus?”
Yang Fan frowned slightly.
For him, naturally, the more the better.
If the quantity is sufficient, he is even willing to start selling off all Spirit Vein Planet coordinates right now.
“Master, this is already an extremely huge quantity, after all, it is an S-Rank Building.”
“According to historical statistics.”
“During the peak period of circulation, there were once thousands of Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nests participating in transactions at the same time.”
“And this time belongs to the middle-lower level.”
Yang Da explained.
Hearing this, Yang Fan nodded slowly.
“In that case, first sell the coordinates of two Spirit Vein Planets through the Gu Family’s channels to exchange for sufficient working capital.”
“Yes.” Yang Da nodded immediately, then hesitated and said:
“Master, besides the Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nest.”
“There are also many S-Rank Buildings on the Dark Web that are of great help to the current Divine Kingdom. Should we participate in the auction in advance?”
Hearing this, Yang Fan shook his head.
“No rush.”
“Sharpening the axe does not delay the wood-chopping.”
“The Dark Web has existed for unknown years and will not suddenly disappear.”
“What we really need to do is not to rush to improve combat power, but to first build our own wealth system.”
“As long as we have a sufficiently stable source of income.”
“In the future, those buildings that enhance believers’ strength and strengthen combat capabilities will just be a matter of time.”
Speaking of this, Yang Fan looked up at the firmament of the Divine Kingdom, his eyes exceptionally calm.
“Besides, I am very safe now.”
“Being in Taichu City, backed by the Gu Family.”
“And who dares to easily make a move against me?”
“To take a step back, even if a demigod really comes knocking on the door, do you think that with my current Divine Kingdom foundation, which demigod can break through the Divine Kingdom Core area?”
Hearing this, Yang Da’s body trembled slightly, as if understanding something.
“Master means...”
The corners of Yang Fan’s mouth raised slightly, revealing a meaningful smile.
“The plan needs to be adjusted.”
“Originally, I thought about breaking through to the Realm of gods as soon as possible.”
“But now it seems there is no such necessity.”
“Now I am only a sophomore.”
“Since I possess such a channel that can obtain a large number of S-Rank Buildings, why not take advantage of the demigod stage to pile up the Divine Kingdom foundation to the extreme?”
Yang Fan’s consciousness slowly withdrew from the Divine Kingdom.
At the same time.
Meanwhile, Yang Da used the authority granted by Yang Fan to enter the Gu Clan Resource Star Trading Area and began contacting buyers.
A moment later.
Yang Fan put on the virtual helmet, and his consciousness entered the Virtual World.
Light and shadow flowed before his eyes.
When his vision was restored, a boundless trading area had already appeared in front of him.
This was the first time he came to the Resource star trading area of the Gu Family Territory in his own identity.
As one of the five most powerful families of the Human Race, the Resources controlled by the Gu Family far exceeded the imagination of ordinary forces.
Looking around, the entire trading area was divided into countless different zones.
Spirit Vein Planets, Spirit Plant Stars, and ore vein stars were just the most basic main categories.

In addition, there were Yao Beast stars specially cultivating rare Yao Beasts, Secret Realm stars producing various special spiritual materials, and life stars capable of nurturing believing races and assisting the development of the Divine Kingdom.
Information on various Resource stars constantly scrolled and refreshed in the Void Realm.
At every moment, astronomical transactions were being completed.
Yang Fan gently clicked on a transaction invitation.
The next moment, his consciousness entered an independent room specially used for receiving guests.

chapters.title: Chapter 272: A Single Thought
paragraphs: Inside the room, a middle-aged man wearing a black robe had been waiting for a long time.
Beside him stood an Intelligent Life consciousness entity emitting a light blue glow.
As for Yang Da, he had also entered the room in advance.
Seeing Yang Fan appear, the middle-aged man immediately stood up with a very respectful attitude.
“Young Lord Yang Fan, it is a pleasure to do business with you.”
“Spirit Vein Planet holds immense value, so it requires you to be personally present to sign the transfer contract.”
Yang Fan waved his hand, “It’s fine.”
Resource star transactions are different from ordinary commodities.
Especially for large assets like Spirit Vein Planet, the real delivery location is within the Divine Kingdom.
The contract signed in the Real World is more like a legally binding transaction certificate.

Otherwise, after the funds arrive, if the original owner refuses to evacuate the stationed believers and continues to occupy Spirit Vein Planet to mine Resources, that would be equivalent to eating a free meal.
By then, even if subjected to federation sanctions.
Yang Fan briefly browsed the contract, and the transaction amount was exactly one hundred billion Divinity Points.
Not a single point more, not a single point less.
In fact, the price of Spirit Vein Planet has always been very transparent.
A standard Spirit Vein Planet can produce approximately one billion Divinity Points worth of Spirit Stone Resources every month.
That is one hundred and twenty billion Divinity Points a year.
In other words, the buyer needs at least eight years to recoup the cost.
For Divine Kingdom assets, such a rate of return can only be considered mediocre.

Coupled with the fact that Spirit Vein Planet is usually located in the neutral area outside the Divine Kingdom, it can neither enhance the Divine Kingdom itself nor increase the combat power of believers.
Therefore, the market price has long stabilized around one hundred billion Divinity Points.
Regardless of buying or selling, the fluctuations will not be too large.
Soon, both parties completed the signing.
The smile on the middle-aged man’s face noticeably deepened.
He handed the contract to the Intelligent Life beside him for safekeeping, and then handed over a card.
“Young Lord Yang, this is my business card.”
“I mainly engage in various resource star transactions.”
“If you have any resource star selling or purchasing needs in the future, you can contact me at any time.”
“In addition, the funds have been deposited into your Divine Kingdom account.”
Yang Fan took the business card and nodded slightly.
“You can dispatch believers to take over Spirit Vein Planet at any time.”
“For the remaining matters, you can just hand them over to my Intelligent Life.”
“Understood.”
The middle-aged man respectfully replied.
Subsequently, Yang Fan’s consciousness exited the Virtual World.
The following days returned to peace once again.
The development of the Divine Kingdom has never been a matter of overnight.
However, under the Hundredfold Evolution Talent, a large number of believers continuously made Breakthroughs.
Strands of feedback force continuously poured into Yang Fan’s body.
His Divine Power and mental strength were growing slowly and steadily.
Aside from paying attention to Divine Kingdom affairs,
Yang Fan would still set aside one or two hours every day to read various books.
From the history of civilization to Divine Kingdom management, and then to classic warfare cases of major pantheons,
he continuously accumulated his own knowledge foundation.
Occasionally, he would also stroll around Taichu City together with Gu Le, witnessing the bustling scene of this top-tier city of the Human Race.
Or enter the Virtual World, head to Xiling Planet, and briefly reunite with parents and friends.
Although nowadays both parties were long no longer figures of the same level,
but every time he saw his family’s familiar smiles, Yang Fan could still feel a long-lost relaxation.
Work and life always maintained a well-balanced equilibrium.
In the blink of an eye, five days quietly passed.
Today was precisely the day for completing transactions at the Dark Web auction.
Early in the morning, Yang Fan’s consciousness had already appeared in the central hall of the Divine Kingdom.
Below the towering divine seat, Yang Da had been waiting for a long time.
Seeing Yang Fan descend, Yang Da immediately bowed in salute.
“Reporting to Master.”
“Considering the existence of the Divine Kingdom’s Evolution Talent, the earlier the Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nest is put into use, the higher the future returns will be.”
“Therefore, in this auction, I conducted concentrated bidding at the price of 1.5 billion Divinity Points according to your request.”
“We ultimately successfully acquired 130 Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nests, consuming a total of 195 billion Divinity Points.”
Yang Fan nodded slightly, signaling to continue.
Yang Da continued to report.
“In addition, the void energy core captured from the Undead Demigod’s divine kingdom was sold at the auction for 80 billion Divinity Points.”
“The Land of the Undead and the Skeleton Soldier barracks were sold via a combined auction method, with a final transaction price of 40 billion Divinity Points.”
“For this Dark Web transaction, the total net expenditure was 75 billion Divinity Points.”
“The current remaining liquid funds of the Divine Kingdom are 158 billion Divinity Points.”
After listening to the report, Yang Fan pondered for a moment, then slowly spoke.
“Next, except for the Resources needed for believers to Cultivate, the Divine Kingdom will suspend purchasing other buildings.”
“All remaining funds will be prioritized for bidding on the Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nest.”
Speaking of this, his gaze flickered slightly.
“If funds are insufficient, continue to sell Spirit Vein Planet coordinates.”
Yang Da immediately bowed to receive the order, “Yes, Master.”
In fact, adding the Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nests originally possessed,
the total number of Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nests inside Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom had now reached 156.
Relying solely on selling Earth Heart Milk, he could steadily obtain an income of 15.6 billion Divinity Points every month.
Such earning capacity was far from what Spirit Vein Planet could compare to.
After all, under the blessing of the SSS-Rank Evolution Talent, the output of the Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nest was much stronger than that of Spirit Vein Planet.
According to past Dark Web auction records,
the Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nest would occasionally experience large-scale concentrated sales.
If a powerful deity urgently needed funds, it was not impossible to list thousands of them at once.
Therefore, Yang Fan must always ensure that he had sufficient cash flow in his hands.
His idea was very simple.
Fanatically expand Divine Kingdom assets, utilizing the SSS-Rank Evolution Talent to continuously magnify the Divine Kingdom’s revenue.
Then invest the obtained revenue into warfare-type S-Rank Buildings or top-tier treasures like the War God Codex.
For the Divine Kingdom,
funds will always be the primary element restricting development.
The faster the Divine Kingdom developed,
Yang Fan in reality appeared even calmer instead.
Ever since defeating that Undead Demigod in the Alien Divine Kingdom Zone, he had become completely famous in Taichu City.
Inside the Gu Family, more and more people began to recognize this future son-in-law.
Even Gu Xuanting valued him increasingly more.

Not only did he personally take Yang Fan to attend some gatherings between deities, but he also intentionally or unintentionally let him contact the core circle of the Gu Family, completely posing in the stance of grooming him as a successor.
During this period, Gu Xuanting also specially reminded Yang Fan to purchase Divine Kingdom coordinates as soon as possible and acquire the Divine Kingdom Core.
Strive to make a Breakthrough to a deity early on.
That way, he could head to The Frontline, form an offensive and defensive alliance with the many deities of the Gu Family, and the security of the Divine Kingdom would also be greatly enhanced.
Regarding this, Yang Fan naturally appeared very humble, showing a look of humbly accepting teachings.
But in reality, if he was willing, he could make a Breakthrough to a deity at any time.
After all, inside his Divine Kingdom, dozens of unabsorbed Divine Kingdom Cores were still lying quietly.
Breakthrough to a deity.
It is just a matter of a single thought.

chapters.title: Chapter 273: Elven Warriors
paragraphs: Time flew by.
In the blink of an eye, another month passed.
This time at the Dark Web auction, the quantity of Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nests increased significantly.
A full six hundred-odd of them appeared.
To ensure sufficient funds, Yang Fan simply sold off all his remaining Spirit Vein Planets, gaining another 900 billion Divinity Points.
When the auction finally ended, he successfully secured 523 Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nests among them.
With this, the total number of Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nests owned by Yang Fan’s divine kingdom officially reached 679.
The revenue generated solely by the Earth Heart Milk every month reached as high as 67.9 billion Divinity Points.
As a large number of Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nests landed, the environment of the entire divine kingdom underwent another transformation.
Countless streams of dense Spiritual Qi continuously gushed out from the underground, resembling long rivers of Spiritual Qi flowing between heaven and earth.
And these Spiritual Qi were endlessly absorbed by the Heavenly Court suspended above the firmament.
After being transformed, they were once again turned into higher-purity Immortal Qi that sprinkled down over the divine kingdom.
For a time, the divine kingdom was shrouded in immortal mist, with rosy clouds filling the sky.
Whether it was mountains and rivers, or forests and plains,
the aura of life was dense to the extreme.
Looking out, the entire divine kingdom seemed to have transformed into a super-large blessed land.
Even the most ordinary flowers, plants, and trees grew rapidly under this environment.
But very soon, Yang Fan discovered a realistic problem.
The Dark Web was simply too capable of devouring money; by now, all of his Spirit Vein Planets had been sold.
If such a scale of Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nests appeared again in the future,
even he would only be able to purchase a portion of them.
Originally, he had always felt that he could be considered wealthy.
But after truly coming into contact with the Dark Web, he realized that he had just barely stepped into that circle.
Out of curiosity, Yang Fan had once specifically watched the complete transaction process of the Dark Web.
To ensure openness and transparency, all transaction prices were displayed in real-time.
And those prices refreshed his understanding time and time again.
Resource-type buildings like the Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nest were actually considered the very bottom tier among S-Rank Buildings.
The transaction prices of those special-type top S-Rank Buildings were often above 5 trillion or even 10 trillion Divinity Points.
Every single fluctuation in the bid was enough to bankrupt a god.
As for the higher-level SS-Rank buildings,
with Yang Fan’s current membership Rank, he didn’t even have the qualification to participate in the bidding.
The wealth he currently controlled could indeed be considered top-notch among demigods.
But in the eyes of truly powerful gods, perhaps it was just a drop of water in a river.
Thinking of this, a sense of emotion involuntarily arose in Yang Fan’s heart.
The more he came into contact with the truth of this world,
the more he could discover that the gap between gods was far more exaggerated than Mortals imagined.
They were all gods alike.
Some people exhausted their entire lives just guarding a single life planet to manage it with difficulty.
While others, with a single sentence, could mobilize tens of trillions of Divinity Points in resources to easily buy an entire life planet.
Take for example Luo Hai, the head of the Luo Family in Yang County.
A dignified Tier 3 God was already a high-and-mighty existence placed within a county town.
Yet Yang Fan had absolute certainty that all of the other party’s divine kingdom assets combined probably couldn’t even compare to a fraction of his current wealth.
However, within the Dark Web,
those existences who casually pulled out tens of trillions of Divinity Points to bid
were likewise gods, and some of them might not even have a higher Rank than Luo Hai.
Why was the wealth gap so enormous?
The past Yang Fan had also thought about this question.
At the very beginning, he thought wealth came from compound interest.
Purchasing more assets, earning more returns,
and then purchasing even more assets in an endless cycle.
Later, entering Taichu City and joining the Gu Family,
he learned that outside the divine kingdom, there were special assets like resource stars.
Even later, after he became the master of Xiling Planet,
he understood another matter.
It turned out that taxation was truly a lucrative business.
Those Divine Beings worked hard to manage industries, frantically invested, and desperately made money.
While he, as the planet master,
only needed to formulate rules to extract profits from all transactions.
As for how much to extract, how to distribute it, and whether to feed it back,
it was all within a single thought of his.
Until this moment, Yang Fan gradually understood:
What decided wealth was never strength itself,
but rather the position one occupied.
When people stood at different tiers,
the world they saw was completely different.
The ways to make money were naturally completely different as well.
Some sources of wealth were things that bottom-tier Divine Beings couldn’t even imagine.
Sometimes, Yang Fan had to admit that he was indeed very lucky.
If it weren’t for becoming a son-in-Law of the Gu Family and entering their core circle,
he might never have known the true appearance of this world.
Those resource stars, divine kingdom taxes, Dark Web transactions, the Divine Alliance...
every single one of them far exceeded the cognition of ordinary people.
The Gu Family pushed open a door for him, allowing him to catch a glimpse of the very top corner of this world.
However, Yang Fan was never one to be content with relying on others.
Since he already stood at this level,
what he needed to do was forge a legend of his own within this broader world.
Just at this moment,
Yang Fan’s expression suddenly stirred.
A special fluctuation came from the depths of the divine kingdom.
His consciousness instantly descended into the divine kingdom.
The next moment,
his gaze landed directly on the center of the Elf Kingdom, upon that giant Ancient Spirit Tree.
“Has it finally begun?” A trace of anticipation flashed in Yang Fan’s eyes.
Even with the Hundredfold Evolution Talent, he was after all too young.
The total development time of his divine kingdom was far from having experienced a million years.
Yet the environment of his divine kingdom had long since far surpassed those of the same Rank.
Under the combined action of a large number of Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nests, the Heavenly Court, the Immortal Qi system, and various life-type buildings,
the aura of life throughout the entire divine kingdom was startlingly dense.
It was precisely because of this that this Adult Elf Ancient Spirit Tree finally welcomed its moment of transformation.
Boom—
Accompanied by a low roar, the Ancient Spirit Tree began to grow frantically.
Its thick trunk continuously soared upward, and countless branches extended in all directions.
The sky-filling aura of life seemed to be summoned by something, converging from all corners of the divine kingdom.
It turned into a green torrent, continuously pouring into the interior of the Ancient Spirit Tree.
The tree canopy expanded rapidly.
Ten miles, a hundred miles, a thousand miles!
In just a brief moment, the sky above the entire Elf Kingdom was covered by the giant canopy.
Countless Adult Elves knelt on the ground, piously kowtowing towards the direction of the Ancient Spirit Tree.
They could feel that the true holy item of the Elf Race was about to be born.
Hum—
Accompanied by a low chant that seemed to come from ancient times, countless golden patterns began to surface on the surface of the Ancient Spirit Tree; those patterns resembled flowing Laws of life.
The originally emerald-green leaves also gradually became dyed with a layer of faint golden radiance.
Looking from afar, it was like countless leaves crafted from gold hanging from the branches.
At this moment, the Ancient Spirit Tree officially transformed.
The elf holy tree appeared!
Yet the changes did not stop.
Following the birth of the elf holy tree, a massive life fluctuation swept across the entire divine kingdom.
All Adult Elves simultaneously emitted low chants interwoven with pain and excitement.
Their life tiers began a collective leap.
Their originally slender ears lengthened further, faint golden patterns appeared on the edges, and their eyes became even brighter.
The weapons in their hands—those longbows originally crafted from ancient elf wood—began to evolve automatically.
A large number of intricate patterns surfaced on the bow bodies.
There were vines entwining and moonlight flowing.
Countless elves simultaneously completed their transformation, officially promoting to Elven Warriorss.
