chapters.title: Chapter 274: Just Call Me Sister
paragraphs: Seeing this scene, a hint of satisfaction inevitably appeared on Yang Fan’s face.
Elven Warriorss themselves possessed combat power comparable to believers in the Foundation Establishment Realm.
And their truly terrifying aspect was never close combat, but archery.
At a sufficient distance,
it was almost impossible for an ordinary Foundation Establishment believer to defeat an Elven Warriors.
They possessed dynamic vision far surpassing ordinary people, as well as a terrifying talent for archery.
Every arrow released was guaranteed to hit its mark, piercing targets with peerless precision.
According to the information introduction in the Divine Shop,
if they formed a scale, these Elven Warriorss could even pose a threat to believers in the Core Formation Realm.
Although they could not provide the Power Of Faith,
after experiencing so many Divine Kingdom Wars, Yang Fan had long since witnessed the value of the elf legion.
Now that the elf holy tree was born, the combat power of the entire divine kingdom had undoubtedly risen to another level once again.
Just at this moment, Yang Da’s voice suddenly sounded.
“Master, after the Ancient Spirit Tree grew into the elf holy tree, the Moon Well and Sun Spring have lost their original functions.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan nodded slightly.
“Since that is the case,”
“notify the Elf Kingdom that all these C-grade structures are to be sold.”
“Also tell them,”
“that if they render great service on the Divine Kingdom Battlefield in the future,”
“I will purchase more Fountain of Life for the entire Elf Kingdom.”
Yang Da immediately bowed respectfully, “Understood, Master.”
Having said that, he did not leave; instead, a look of hesitation appeared on his face.
“Master,”
“regarding the Dark Web, there is another matter that needs to be reported to you.”
“Speak.”
“Because we have long been purchasing a large number of Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nests at a price of 1.5 billion Divinity Points,”
“it has already attracted the attention of quite a few sellers.”
“This month, a total of over 1,300 Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nests appeared on the Dark Web auction list.”
“With the divine kingdom’s current capital reserves, we can no longer swallow them all up.”
“If possible, I suggest appropriately lowering the bid price in the future, such as 1.2 billion or 1.3 billion Divinity Points.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan’s expression remained calm, without the slightest surprise.

For other divine kingdoms, purchasing an Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nest for 1.5 billion Divinity Points had an excessively long capital recovery period, and could even be called a losing investment.
But he was different. Possessing an SSS-grade divine kingdom Evolution Talent, his investment time cost was only one percent of other people’s.
The earlier it was acquired, the greater the accumulated advantages in the future, and the larger the snowball would roll.
Yang Fan shook his head slowly, “No need. Leave the issue of funds to me.”
Finished speaking, his consciousness slowly withdrew from the divine kingdom.
Yet deep within his eyes, he was already beginning to ponder new sources of funding.
“Husband, why did you stay in the divine kingdom for so long today?”
Gu Le asked curiously while preparing breakfast.
“Intelligent Life reported some progress, so it took a little longer,”
Yang Fan explained casually.
Hearing this, Gu Le rolled her eyes.
“I really don’t know what’s so interesting to look at. The development of a divine kingdom naturally requires a massive amount of time.”
“Everyone else only goes in to check on the changes once every few decades or even centuries.”
“Even if you have the Hundredfold Time Sequence, could you possibly keep your talent active all the time? There’s no need to go in and take a stroll every few days.”
Hearing these words, Yang Fan merely smiled without explaining.
He did not possess some mere Hundredfold Time Sequence talent; not only his believers, but everything in the divine kingdom was developing at a hundredfold speed of time.
Every time he entered the divine kingdom, he might see a completely different scene.
However, he would not tell this secret to anyone, not even Gu Le.
As for the problem of the funding gap,
Yang Fan likewise did not mention it to Gu Le.
The Gu Family had already helped him too much.
Resource stars, monthly subsidies, various special resources, and even a living planet were delivered directly into his hands.
In the eyes of the Gu Family, what he possessed was an SS-grade Hundredfold Time Sequence talent.
Although his resource consumption far exceeded that of ordinary demigods, he definitely shouldn’t be short on money right now.
If he brought it up again at this time, it would simply be impossible to explain.
Furthermore, Yang Fan did not want to leave Gu Le’s parents with the impression that he was insatiably greedy.
What’s more, he was no longer the newcomer who had just entered Taichu City.
As both the son-in-law of the Gu Family and a universally recognized Peerless Prodigy of the Human Race,
sometimes, identity itself was a form of wealth.
As long as one’s status was high enough, wanting to finance and borrow funds
was far easier than ordinary people imagined.
Regarding the source of funds, Yang Fan already had a target.
After finishing breakfast,
Yang Fan returned to his room and put on the virtual helmet.
His consciousness entered the Virtual World and opened the communication list.
He found a contact he had added not long ago — Qin Xue.
At the banquet specially hosted for him by Gu Xuanting back then, not a single person who was able to receive an invitation and attend was a simple character.
Not only did Yang Fan save the contact information of all these people,
but he had also long since arranged for Yang Yi to collect relevant information through public channels.
Among them, Qin Xue was one of them.
The publicly listed companies directly controlled under her name exceeded fifty.
They spanned multiple Domains such as divine kingdom trade, resource development, financial investment, and interstellar logistics.
Her most core business, however, was helping others with financing, or in other words — lending.
If Ma Yu’s Elephant Loan targeted ordinary Divine Beings and demigods, belonging to typical microloans,
then Qin Xue’s business targets were deities and big shots with special backgrounds and identities.
She almost never took small orders.
Once she made a move, it was invariably fund borrowings amounting to hundreds of billions or even tens of trillions of Divinity Points.
For clients at this level,
although the profit margin was lower, the risk was similarly extremely small.
Throughout the entire financial circle, Qin Xue could be considered a prominent and renowned figure.
After pondering for a moment,
Yang Fan edited a message and sent it over.
“Hello, President Qin.”
“Recently, there is a divine kingdom investment plan that requires partial financing.”
“I wonder if you have time recently to meet and discuss the details?”
Less than ten seconds after the message was sent out,
a reply came from the other side, consisting only of a string of virtual coordinates and a simple sentence.
“I’m free, come right over.”
Yang Fan’s eyebrows raised slightly.
The next moment,
his consciousness directly teleported away.
As light and shadow shifted, Yang Fan appeared in a spacious private room.
The entire room was decorated very simply, without any luxurious embellishments.
The walls were crafted from warm white jade, and a few pots of expensive Spirit Plants were placed around the surroundings.
In the center was a huge log tea table.
Through the floor-to-ceiling windows, one could even overlook the bustling scene of the entire virtual city.
Simple, yet exuding a low-key magnificence everywhere.
Just at this moment, a figure rose from beside the tea table.
“Young Lord Yang, I didn’t expect to be doing business with you so soon.” Qin Xue wore a faint smile and proactively extended her right hand.
Yang Fan likewise shook hands politely.
“You jest, President Qin.”
“This isn’t Taichu City.”
“I can hardly bear the title of Young Lord here.”
Hearing this, Qin Xue could not help laughing.
“Since that’s the case,”
“then don’t keep calling me President Qin at every turn.”
“I’m only about four hundred years older than you.”
“Just call me Sister.”

sentences.text: Seeing this scene, a hint of satisfaction inevitably appeared on Yang Fan’s face.
Elven Warriorss themselves possessed combat power comparable to believers in the Foundation Establishment Realm.
And their truly terrifying aspect was never close combat, but archery.
At a sufficient distance,
it was almost impossible for an ordinary Foundation Establishment believer to defeat an Elven Warriors.
They possessed dynamic vision far surpassing ordinary people, as well as a terrifying talent for archery.
Every arrow released was guaranteed to hit its mark, piercing targets with peerless precision.
According to the information introduction in the Divine Shop,
if they formed a scale, these Elven Warriorss could even pose a threat to believers in the Core Formation Realm.
Although they could not provide the Power Of Faith,
after experiencing so many Divine Kingdom Wars, Yang Fan had long since witnessed the value of the elf legion.
Now that the elf holy tree was born, the combat power of the entire divine kingdom had undoubtedly risen to another level once again.
Just at this moment, Yang Da’s voice suddenly sounded.
“Master, after the Ancient Spirit Tree grew into the elf holy tree, the Moon Well and Sun Spring have lost their original functions.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan nodded slightly.
“Since that is the case,”
“notify the Elf Kingdom that all these C-grade structures are to be sold.”
“Also tell them,”
“that if they render great service on the Divine Kingdom Battlefield in the future,”
“I will purchase more Fountain of Life for the entire Elf Kingdom.”
Yang Da immediately bowed respectfully, “Understood, Master.”
Having said that, he did not leave; instead, a look of hesitation appeared on his face.
“Master,”
“regarding the Dark Web, there is another matter that needs to be reported to you.”
“Speak.”
“Because we have long been purchasing a large number of Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nests at a price of 1.5 billion Divinity Points,”
“it has already attracted the attention of quite a few sellers.”
“This month, a total of over 1,300 Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nests appeared on the Dark Web auction list.”
“With the divine kingdom’s current capital reserves, we can no longer swallow them all up.”
“If possible, I suggest appropriately lowering the bid price in the future, such as 1.2 billion or 1.3 billion Divinity Points.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan’s expression remained calm, without the slightest surprise.

For other divine kingdoms, purchasing an Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nest for 1.5 billion Divinity Points had an excessively long capital recovery period, and could even be called a losing investment.
But he was different.
Possessing an SSS-grade divine kingdom Evolution Talent, his investment time cost was only one percent of other people’s.
The earlier it was acquired, the greater the accumulated advantages in the future, and the larger the snowball would roll.
Yang Fan shook his head slowly, “No need.
Leave the issue of funds to me.”
Finished speaking, his consciousness slowly withdrew from the divine kingdom.
Yet deep within his eyes, he was already beginning to ponder new sources of funding.
“Husband, why did you stay in the divine kingdom for so long today?”
Gu Le asked curiously while preparing breakfast.
“Intelligent Life reported some progress, so it took a little longer,”
Yang Fan explained casually.
Hearing this, Gu Le rolled her eyes.
“I really don’t know what’s so interesting to look at.
The development of a divine kingdom naturally requires a massive amount of time.”
“Everyone else only goes in to check on the changes once every few decades or even centuries.”
“Even if you have the Hundredfold Time Sequence, could you possibly keep your talent active all the time?
There’s no need to go in and take a stroll every few days.”
Hearing these words, Yang Fan merely smiled without explaining.
He did not possess some mere Hundredfold Time Sequence talent; not only his believers, but everything in the divine kingdom was developing at a hundredfold speed of time.
Every time he entered the divine kingdom, he might see a completely different scene.
However, he would not tell this secret to anyone, not even Gu Le.
As for the problem of the funding gap,
Yang Fan likewise did not mention it to Gu Le.
The Gu Family had already helped him too much.
Resource stars, monthly subsidies, various special resources, and even a living planet were delivered directly into his hands.
In the eyes of the Gu Family, what he possessed was an SS-grade Hundredfold Time Sequence talent.
Although his resource consumption far exceeded that of ordinary demigods, he definitely shouldn’t be short on money right now.
If he brought it up again at this time, it would simply be impossible to explain.
Furthermore, Yang Fan did not want to leave Gu Le’s parents with the impression that he was insatiably greedy.
What’s more, he was no longer the newcomer who had just entered Taichu City.
As both the son-in-law of the Gu Family and a universally recognized Peerless Prodigy of the Human Race,
sometimes, identity itself was a form of wealth.
As long as one’s status was high enough, wanting to finance and borrow funds
was far easier than ordinary people imagined.

chapters.title: Chapter 275: Ten Trillion Divinity Points
paragraphs: Yang Fan accepted the advice gracefully, “Then I shall greet Sister Qin Xue.”
“That’s more like it.”
Qin Xue nodded with satisfaction, then raised her hand to gesture.
“Have a seat.”
“This is freshly brewed Dao Enlightenment Tea.”
“Brewed using Mermaid tears as a guide, combined with millennium-old spiritual tea.”
As she spoke, she personally poured a cup of tea for Yang Fan.
Her movements were natural and fluid, without the slightest condescending posture, yet without a shred of deliberate flattery.
She looked more like a top-tier investor who was used to keeping the big picture under control.
Gentle, calm, yet impossible for anyone to ignore her presence.
The two sat facing each other, tea fragrance curling upwards.
Qin Xue picked up her teacup and took a gentle sip, then smiled and spoke:
“As far as I know, Little Brother, you only recently accepted an investment from the Gu Family.”
“And you just defeated that Undead Demigod in the Alien Divine Kingdom Zone.”
“Logically speaking, your funds should be very abundant.”
Yang Fan likewise picked up his teacup, “In the development of a Divine Kingdom, is there ever a time when funds are enough?”
Hearing this, Qin Xue smiled slightly.
“That’s true as well.”
“I wonder how much funds Little Brother plans to borrow this time?”
Yang Fan tasted the Dao Enlightenment Tea in his mouth.
As the tea slid down his throat, a cool sensation rushed straight to his Divine Soul, making even his thoughts become somewhat more active.
Afterward, he put down his teacup and slowly uttered a sentence.
“However much there is, I want it all.”
As his voice fell, a brief silence descended upon the private room.
The smile remained on Qin Xue’s face, yet a subtle change appeared in her eyes.
She suddenly realized that she seemed to have somewhat underestimated this son-in-law of the Gu Family before her.
A person who could say such words was definitely not simply lacking money.
Rather, they were plotting a major event.
However, she did not press further.
In the financial industry, one of the most important rules was never to inquire how a client planned to spend their money.
It was only necessary to judge whether the other party could afford to pay it back.
That was all.
Thinking of this, Qin Xue smiled and spoke:
“Easy to talk about. In the loan business, we never ask about the customer’s use of funds.”
“Little Brother is now the son-in-law of the Third Elder of the Gu Family, and has been rated as a Peerless Prodigy by the Federation.”
“Regardless of status or potential, you belong to our top-tier clients.”
“The company’s Intelligent Life has already completed the risk assessment.”
“Although Little Brother is currently only at the Demigod Realm, you can still enjoy a credit limit of ten trillion Divinity Points.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan’s gaze shifted slightly.
Ten trillion.
This number had far exceeded his expectations.
However, he was even more concerned about the interest.
“I wonder what the interest rate is?” Yang Fan asked directly.
After all, the price of the Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nest on the Dark Web had been forcibly driven up to 1.5 billion Divinity Points by him.
This belonged to a typical ultra-high premium acquisition.
Although the Hundredfold Evolution Talent existed, a single Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nest could currently only bring in a monthly income of 100 million Divinity Points.
The annualized rate of return was around 80%.
If the financing cost was too high, then this deal might not be cost-effective.
When all was said and done, it was because S-Rank Buildings were far too scarce.
Although he now possessed procurement channels, he had to endure a high premium, which also greatly compressed the room for investment returns.
Qin Xue put down her teacup with a calm expression.
“Most of my clients are deities and controllers of large factions, possessing extremely high credibility.”
“The default rate is infinitely close to zero.”
“Therefore, the interest rate naturally won’t be too high—an annualized twenty percent. This is already one of the most favorable prices on the market.”
Hearing this, even Yang Fan was slightly stunned.
An annualized twenty percent was shockingly cheap within the Divine Kingdom’s financial system.
Just like Elephant Loan under Ma Yu, the monthly interest rates of many products far exceeded this figure.
Sure enough, the richer a person was, the lower their financing cost turned out to be.
However, before Yang Fan could speak, Qin Xue continued to add:
“And this belongs to an unrestricted contract.”
“The model is similar to perpetual bonds issued by the Federation.”
“As long as the interest is paid on time, the principal can be repaid with an indefinite extension.”
“Theoretically speaking, Little Brother can even keep borrowing indefinitely.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan finally revealed a trace of surprise.
Only repaying the interest without needing to repay the principal?
“The capital cost is actually this low?”
Yang Fan couldn’t help but speak out.
In his understanding, casually carrying out some Divine Kingdom investments would be sufficient to cover this portion of interest expenses.
Such a loan model was almost no different from giving away money.
“Sister Qin Xue, isn’t your company’s capital utilization rate too low?”
“Which shareholders would be willing?”
Hearing this, Qin Xue couldn’t help laughing.
“Of course they are willing.”
“Because once you reach our level, many things are different from what you imagine.”
She leaned back slightly, her gaze looking out the window.
“Those partners of mine—”
“Which Divine Kingdom hasn’t been planned by a team of high-tier actuaries?”
“The area of a Divine Kingdom is limited.”
“Resource buildings, development buildings, war buildings—every single area has been utilized to the absolute limit.”
“You will understand once you make a Breakthrough to godhood.”
“What truly powerful deities lack is never money-making projects.”
“Rather, it is sufficient Divine Kingdom area.”
“Only those Loose Cultivator deities without any background would calculate every day which building has higher yields and which investment yields returns faster.”
“Because they have no choice.”
“As for those powerful deities, there is long no longer any room for continued expansion inside their Divine Kingdoms.”
“If they want to obtain more returns, they instead have to go to the Real World to invest in companies, purchase living planets, and lay out industrial chains.”
“Although an annualized return of twenty percent is not high, its advantage lies in its stability.”
“And there is completely no need to worry about it.”
Speaking of this, she looked at Yang Fan with a smile.
“Furthermore, if these ten trillion Divinity Points of mine were lent to an ordinary demigod—”
“Background checks, audits, risk control, collection, debt chasing... all kinds of intermediary costs added together would be enough to give anyone a headache.”
“As for clients like Little Brother—”
“To be honest, you might not encounter one in several years.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan finally understood.
The other party simply had too much money and couldn’t lend it out.
After a moment of silence, Yang Fan looked at the contract in front of him and slowly spoke.
“Since that’s the case, I wonder if Sister Qin Xue can lend me a bit more?”
As his voice fell, the smile on Qin Xue’s face paused for the first time.
“Ten trillion Divinity Points... still not enough?”
She looked at Yang Fan, the curiosity in her eyes almost unable to be suppressed.
You must know that this number could be called a large fund even for controllers of many listed companies.
Clients who borrowed ten trillion Divinity Points in one go were extremely rare to begin with.
Yet Yang Fan actually still felt it wasn’t enough.
At this moment, even Qin Xue was somewhat curious.
What on earth was this son-in-law of the Gu Family planning to do?
Qin Xue was silent for a moment.
Then she slowly put down the teacup in her hand.
“Little Brother Yang Fan.”
“Although I am very optimistic about you.”
“However, the company isn’t solely mine after all.”
“These credit limits are all results given after a comprehensive evaluation by Intelligent Life.”
“If we are to continue increasing the limit—”
“Then collateral must be provided.”

chapters.title: Chapter 276: Enlightenment Ancient Tree
paragraphs: Yang Fan’s expression was calm.
“What collateral?”
Qin Xue raised her finger and tapped it lightly.
Two virtual projections immediately appeared in mid-air, which were exactly the Eternal Corpse Mine and the War God Codex.
“According to the public information I possess.”
“Little brother once obtained an S-Rank War God Codex in a gambling duel.”
“Recently, you also obtained an Eternal Corpse Mine from an Undead Demigod’s Divine Kingdom.”
“If you are willing to use these two S-Rank Buildings as collateral.”
“I can make the decision to increase the loan limit to thirty trillion Divinity Points.”
When saying this, Qin Xue was constantly observing Yang Fan’s expression.
In fact, the moment she received the news.
She had already arranged for an Intelligent Life to conduct a comprehensive investigation of Yang Fan.
And according to existing data, these two S-Rank Buildings were undoubtedly Yang Fan’s most valuable assets at the moment.
“That’s acceptable.”
Yang Fan did not hesitate in the slightest and nodded directly in agreement.
This action instead made Qin Xue slightly stunned; she clearly had not expected Yang Fan to be so decisive.
However, she didn’t waste any words and snapped her fingers.
Three contracts instantly appeared on the tabletop.
“These contracts have all been certified by the federal supreme intelligent life.”
“If little brother is worried, you can have your own Intelligent Life check them over.”
“After confirming there are no errors, we can sign.”
Yang Fan nodded slightly, took the contracts into his hands, and quickly browsed through them.
As Mechanical Civilization continued to develop, his mental strength and computational power were also continuously improving.
Now, in terms of information processing ability alone, he was not inferior to an ordinary Intelligent Life in the slightest.
A mere few contracts didn’t need Yang Da to check them at all.
Just a few seconds later, Yang Fan had already taken in all the terms.
Confirming there were no issues, he directly signed his name.
Hum—
Accompanied by the completion of the final signature, the contracts immediately turned into streams of light and dissipated.
This meant the agreement was officially in effect.
Seeing this scene, the smile on Qin Xue’s face became noticeably richer.
“Happy cooperation.”
“Additionally.”
“The moment the contract was established.”
“The company account has already transferred thirty trillion Divinity Points into little brother’s Divine Kingdom account.”
“It should have arrived by now.”
Speaking of this, she suddenly revealed a meaningful smile.
“However, big sister still wants to give you a piece of advice.”
“Thirty trillion Divinity Points is not a small amount.”
“Even if it were all used to purchase A-Rank resource buildings, many low-Rank gods’ Divine Kingdoms might not be able to hold them.”
“Also, little brother is only a Demigod after all.”
“If subsequent special transactions are involved, our company also provides fund custody and intermediary guarantee services.”
“Regarding the service fees, big sister can give you a discount.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan nodded politely.
“Many thanks for the reminder, Sister Qin Xue.”
“If I have a need, I will contact you.”
After exchanging a few simple pleasantries, Yang Fan quickly exited the Virtual World.
Inside the Divine Kingdom.
Yang Fan’s consciousness descended once again.
He checked his account balance at the first opportunity.
Even though he had been prepared, his gaze still fluctuated slightly.
Thirty trillion Divinity Points were already lying quietly in the account.
“Master.”
“So many Divinity Points...”
Yang Da looked at the account balance, and even his voice showed a trace of fluctuation.
Clearly, he also hadn’t expected that Yang Fan would bring back such astonishing funds after going out for a trip.
Yang Fan smiled.
“These are all loans.”
“We need to pay twenty percent interest annually.”
“However, it’s not a big problem.”
“As long as the Evolution Talent is still there, even if we pay a high premium to purchase resource buildings, the returns will be enough to cover the cost of capital.”
Yang Fan didn’t delay any further and continued to speak:
“Yang Da, search the Dark Web for all S-Rank resource buildings.”
“Apart from the Earth Core Spirit Milk Source Nest, what others are suitable for the current Divine Kingdom’s development?”
“Yes, Master.”
Yang Da immediately began the search.
In just a few breaths of time, a large amount of data had already been organized.
“Reporting to Master, the number of S-Rank resource buildings is not very large.”
“Currently, the most suitable for Divine Kingdom investment, apart from the Earth Core Spirit Milk Source Nest, is the Enlightenment Ancient Tree.”
“It can stably produce Enlightenment Tea Leaves.”
Speaking of this, Yang Da paused for a moment.
“However...”
“The premium for this type of building on the Dark Web is also extremely high.”
“According to my calculations, one Enlightenment Ancient Tree can only produce about eighty million Divinity Points worth of revenue every three thousand years.”
“Yet its transaction price is almost the same as the Earth Core Spirit Milk Source Nest.”
“If we purchase on a large scale, even accounting for the time advantage brought by the Evolution Talent, the annualized return rate is only about sixty-four percent.”
After hearing the report, Yang Fan couldn’t help but frown slightly.
“Are there so few S-Rank resource buildings suitable for investment?”
Yang Da immediately shook his head.
“Master, it is not that the number is small, but that there are too few suitable for us.”

“There are a large number of Alien Gods on the Dark Web; many resource buildings require special environments to cultivate, and some buildings must be equipped with believers of corresponding occupations.”
“The current Divine Kingdom simply cannot meet the conditions.”
“Therefore, after screening, there are very few targets truly suitable for Master to invest in.”
After a moment of silence, Yang Fan quickly made a decision.
“Purchase extensively!”
For others, this behavior might be no different from a madman’s.
If one were to purchase S-Rank resource buildings through regular official channels like Taichu City.
Buildings similar to the Earth Core Spirit Milk Source Nest might only cost around one hundred million Divinity Points.
But the problem is, the quantity is limited.
For a Peerless Prodigy like him, there are strict quotas every year.
And the existence of the Dark Web is more like providing a high-premium trading platform for those who are in urgent need.
Spending more than ten times the price to purchase resource buildings.
In the eyes of the vast majority of gods, it is simply a losing business.
If not for the existence of the Hundredfold Evolution Talent.
Even Yang Fan himself would not do such a stupid thing.
Rather than purchasing these resource buildings with long payback periods.
It would be better to invest the funds in the real world.
Whether it is starting a company, investing in industries, or purchasing life planets to collect taxes, the returns are far higher than these resource buildings.
In terms of return rate alone, whether it is the Dragon Fish farm or the Spirit Vein Planet, they actually far exceed the Earth Core Spirit Milk Source Nest.
But the problem is, the area of the Divine Kingdom is limited after all.
With continuous compound growth, those low-Rank resource buildings will eventually be gradually phased out.
And S-Rank resource buildings are the core production units of his future Divine Kingdom.
One day, these buildings will cover the entire Divine Kingdom.
The time advantage brought by the Hundredfold Evolution Talent is enough to amplify any investment a hundredfold.
Even an investment that looks extremely stupid will eventually turn into astonishing returns.
As for Yang Fan now, the utilization rate of his Divine Kingdom’s area is already approaching its limit.
For him now, continuing to improve the quality of resource buildings is far more important than simply increasing the quantity.
“Yes, Master.”
“I will start placing bids immediately.”
Yang Da respectfully accepted the order.

chapters.title: Chapter 277: Batch Bidding
paragraphs: After arranging everything, Yang Fan’s consciousness returned to reality.
Thirty trillion Divinity Points is likely a level of wealth that is unattainable for the vast majority of gods.
But for Yang Fan, this amount of capital might not even last him very long.
After all, he is purchasing S-Rank Buildings.
Even if the Dark Web’s trading volume is large enough, with this scale of capital being poured in, there will eventually come a day when it runs out.
As for top-tier development buildings like the Heavenly Court, Yang Fan does not intend to purchase them for the time being.
The reason is very simple.
Currently, there are still a large number of A-Rank and even B-Rank resource buildings within his Divine Kingdom.
These buildings occupy valuable space but cannot provide sufficient returns.
Compared to development buildings, prioritizing the upgrade of the resource system is clearly the most profitable choice.
Once the profits generated by the Divine Kingdom’s investments are sufficiently extravagant, it won’t be too late to purchase top-tier development buildings then.
Soon, this month’s Dark Web auction began as scheduled.
To ensure he obtained a sufficient quantity, Yang Da directly raised the bidding price for the Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nests and enlightenment ancient trees to 1.5 billion Divinity Points.
As the auction ended, the statistical results were quickly released.
This time, he obtained a total of:
1,052 Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nests.
480 enlightenment ancient trees.
The total capital consumed exceeded two trillion Divinity Points.
A large number of Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nests were placed throughout the Divine Kingdom, continuously releasing Spiritual Qi.
And those enlightenment ancient trees were all planted in the Heavenly Court.
As the ancient trees took root, a faint Dao aura began to permeate the world.
Countless Cultivation believers only needed to sit cross-legged and Cultivate to be able to perceive the Laws of heaven and earth more clearly.
Time passed in a hurry, and in the blink of an eye, another month went by.
This time, the number of listings for Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nests and enlightenment ancient trees on the Dark Web surged significantly.
The Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nests exceeded 2,000, and the enlightenment ancient trees reached over 3,000.
The reason is actually very simple: the price is too high.
1.5 billion Divinity Points is far higher than the normal market price.
After seeing such profits, a large number of gods successively listed the stock in their Divine Kingdoms for auction.
Some even specifically used their networks to purchase them everywhere, preparing to earn the price difference.
The market is never short of profit-seekers. As long as there is sufficient profit, the supply will appear continuously.
It was as if an invisible hand was constantly pushing the entire market to operate.
And Yang Fan still maintained the same bid, purchasing everything at 1.5 billion Divinity Points.
Finally, this round of auctions ended.
Yang Fan successfully obtained:
2,200 Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nests.
3,100 enlightenment ancient trees.
The total expenditure was close to eight trillion Divinity Points.
At the same time, he himself did not realize that the entire Dark Web market had already begun to undergo subtle changes because of his existence.
In a distant Star Domain, a skyscraper over a thousand stories tall stood under the starry sky.
Inside the top-floor office, Gu Tianyu was bowing his head, reviewing documents.
Knock, knock, knock—a knock on the door suddenly sounded.
“Come in,” Gu Tianyu said without even raising his head.
An assistant walked quickly into the room.
“General Manager Gu, there is a matter that needs to be reported to you.”
“What is it?” Gu Tianyu asked casually.
“Recently, a mysterious buyer has appeared on the Dark Web.”
“They are purchasing Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nests and enlightenment ancient trees on a large scale.”
Hearing this, Gu Tianyu finally raised his head.
“Resource-type buildings?”
“What is the price?”
“1.5 billion Divinity Points,” the assistant replied.
Gu Tianyu’s movements paused instantly, and his brows furrowed slightly.
“1.5 billion? Is he crazy?”
“What kind of profit can there be at this price?”
The assistant shook his head with a bitter smile.
“It is currently unclear.”
“However, some speculate that the other party might possess a resource-growth type Divine Kingdom talent.”
Gu Tianyu sneered upon hearing this.
“Even if it is an S-Rank resource growth talent, they can’t make money at this price.”
After pondering for a moment, he suddenly spoke.
“Notify the core members of the group to hand over all Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nests and enlightenment ancient trees in their Divine Kingdoms to the company, to be sold uniformly by the group.”
“Since someone is sending money, there is no reason to refuse.”
“Yes, General Manager Gu.”
The assistant nodded immediately, just about to leave.
Gu Tianyu seemed to suddenly think of something and added another sentence.
“By the way, I recently met a young friend.”
“A sophomore at Primordial Academy, named Yang Fan.”
“Notify him in my name and tell him that the prices of these two types of buildings have surged on the Dark Web recently.”
“According to the information, he should also have quite a bit of stock of Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nests on hand.”
“Tell him to seize the opportunity to sell them, and he can just find another chance to buy them back later.”
Gu Tianyu smiled and shook his head. Apparently, even he felt that when faced with such an outrageous price, a normal person should choose to cash out and leave.
“Understood.”
The assistant respectfully responded and then turned and left.
But Gu Tianyu did not know that the little guy he had kindly reminded was precisely the person who had forcibly driven up the entire market price.
In the real world, Yang Fan was sitting at the dining table having dinner with Gu Le.
Suddenly, his communicator vibrated slightly. Yang Fan looked down, and the sender was none other than Gu Tianyu.
[Yang Fan, the prices of the Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nests and enlightenment ancient trees on the Dark Web have been a bit abnormal recently.]
[If you have any stock in your Divine Kingdom, you might want to consider selling at a high price.]
[According to the current market trend, even if you sell them and wait for the price to drop before buying them back, you can still earn a considerable price difference.]
[Opportunities like this are rare.]
After reading the message, Yang Fan couldn’t help but be slightly stunned, and then a strange look appeared on his face.
He didn’t expect that the commotion he had caused had actually reached Gu Tianyu’s ears.
A moment later, a smile slowly curled at the corners of Yang Fan’s mouth.
“That’s fine too.”
“The more people who notice, the better.”
Others see an opportunity, but what he sees is a continuous supply of goods.
The livelier the market, the more sellers there will be. And the more sellers there are, the faster the capital in his hands will be consumed.
Thinking of this, Yang Fan’s eyes flickered slightly.
At this moment, there was still a full twenty trillion Divinity Points of idle capital lying in his Divine Kingdom account.
For someone like him who possesses the Hundredfold Evolution Talent, leaving this money there without moving it is actually a waste.
Soon, it was time for this month’s Dark Web auction to begin again.
This time, the number of listings far exceeded everyone’s expectations.
Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nests—10,000!
enlightenment ancient trees—20,000!
Clearly, more and more gods were being attracted to enter the market by the high profits.
Many forces even specifically purchased stock from other gods and then listed them uniformly for sale on the Dark Web.
The entire market had become exceptionally hot.
Inside the Divine Kingdom’s main hall, Yang Fan looked at the auction list before him. A meaningful smile suddenly appeared on his face.
“Yang Da, this time we will bid in batches.”
“First, select 5,000 Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nests and bid 1 billion Divinity Points.”
“For the rest, bid 1.1 billion for all of them.”
“The same goes for the enlightenment ancient trees.”

chapters.title: Chapter 278: A Thoroughly Good Person
paragraphs: Upon hearing this, Yang Da’s eyes lit up instantly.
“Does Master mean...”
Yang Fan leaned back on his divine throne, his tone calm.
“With so much supply suddenly appearing, where would there be so many buyers?”
“Everyone only has one chance to bid.”
“Right now, everyone thinks the market is hot, but in reality, there aren’t many people truly willing to take over the market.”
“If not for the Dark Web’s rule that the minimum bid cannot be lower than one billion Divinity Points...”
“I would even dare to try bidding one hundred million.”
Speaking of this, a mischievous smile appeared on the corner of Yang Fan’s mouth.
Upon hearing this, Yang Da immediately felt a sense of reverence.
“Master is wise!”
Subsequently, he immediately began calculating.
Combining the Dark Web’s transaction data from previous years, he continuously calculated the most reasonable bidding range.
He strove to utilize the funds in his hands to the absolute limit.
The bid was submitted.
It took only a few breaths of time.
The transaction results were already calculated.
“Master!”
“Good news!”
Yang Da’s voice carried a hint of excitement.
“We successfully purchased three thousand Earth Core Spirit Milk Source Nests and five thousand enlightenment ancient trees at the price of one billion Divinity Points!”
“We successfully purchased six thousand Earth Core Spirit Milk Source Nests and five thousand enlightenment ancient trees at the price of one point one billion Divinity Points!”
“The entire twenty trillion Divinity Points of liquid funds have been traded!”
Hearing this result.
Even Yang Fan revealed a look of satisfaction.
And Yang Da was even more excited.
“Master’s calculations are divine! This operation can be described as the God of Capital descending to the world!”
“By merely adjusting the bidding strategy, we saved trillions of Divinity Points in funds!”
“Such a stroke of Genius, even the top-tier financial Intelligent Life of the Federation would have to concede defeat upon seeing it!”
Yang Fan rolled his eyes upon hearing this.
“Don’t learn that style from Ling Xuzi, and stop flattering me.”
“Those gods selling resource buildings aren’t fools.”
“In their view, selling them for one billion Divinity Points is still profitable.”
“Moreover, there have been many records of resource buildings failing to sell on the Dark Web throughout history.”
“They didn’t lose out.”
Speaking of this, Yang Fan suddenly smiled.
“However...”
“Some business tycoon is probably going to feel like they wasted their effort for nothing.”
In his mind, the image of Gu Tianyu couldn’t help but appear.
If not for that reminder message from the other party, he might not have thought of this move.
As a result of this operation, he directly saved three to four trillion Divinity Points.
[Earth Core Spirit Milk Source Nest: 12,931 (S-Rank)]
[enlightenment ancient tree: 13,580 (S-Rank)]
Looking at the data before him, even Yang Fan couldn’t help but feel a bit emotional.
Now, with the support of the Hundredfold Evolution Talent.
The Earth Core Spirit Milk Source Nests can generate 1.2931 trillion Divinity Points in monthly revenue.
The enlightenment ancient trees can generate 1.0864 trillion Divinity Points in monthly revenue.
Combined, the monthly income has reached a staggering 2.3795 trillion Divinity Points.
Yet, just a few months ago, his total monthly income for his Divine Kingdom was less than one hundred billion.
Now, it has increased by dozens of times.
Although he still needs to pay six trillion Divinity Points in interest to Qin Xue annually, Yang Fan didn’t take it to heart at all.
Because he never intended to start saving money now.
Every subsequent bit of revenue will continue to compound and continue to expand.
Continue purchasing Earth Core Spirit Milk Source Nests and enlightenment ancient trees.
Until the revenue rolls into an even more terrifying amount.
As for the interest?
It won’t be too late to deal with it three months before the repayment date.
According to the current rate of development.
It won’t be long before his single-month income has a chance to break through ten trillion Divinity Points.
By that time, the Divine Kingdom investment system will be completely formed.
And he will finally be able to free up his hands, while continuing to expand the scale of his assets.
And start purchasing top-tier treasures like the War God Codex to supplement the foundation of his Divine Kingdom.
Meanwhile.
In a distant Star Domain.
Gu Tianyu was looking at the latest Dark Web transaction report that had just been delivered.
A moment later, he put down the document and couldn’t help but shake his head.
“This was a setup by someone.”
The assistant beside him said in a low voice:
“General Manager Gu, many people thought the market was hot this time, but when the actual transaction happened, the price dropped.”
Gu Tianyu, upon hearing this, was completely indifferent.
“It doesn’t matter; selling for one billion Divinity Points is still quite profitable.”
“In fact, for us sellers, the Dark Web’s minimum transaction price of one billion Divinity Points is actually a form of protection.”
“The return rate of these resource-type S-Rank Buildings itself isn’t high.”
“Under normal circumstances, they wouldn’t sell for such a price at all.”
“As long as they can be successfully sold, it’s a profit no matter how you calculate it.”
Speaking of this, Gu Tianyu waved his hand.
“Continue listing small batches in the future.”
“If someone is willing to buy at a high price, we have no reason to refuse.”
“Yes, General Manager Gu.”
The assistant nodded respectfully.
Just as he was preparing to leave, Gu Tianyu suddenly remembered something.
“By the way, how has Yang Fan been recently?”
The assistant was stunned.
“Yang Fan? The one from the Primordial Academy?”
“Yes.”
Gu Tianyu nodded, then smiled and said:
“If the price of the Earth Core Spirit Milk Source Nests he sold is too low, he might lose out on the handling fees.”
“Help me send him a message and ask if he needs these buildings.”
“If he needs them, I can sell them to him for nine hundred million.”
Upon hearing this, a strange look appeared on the assistant’s face.
“General Manager Gu, aren’t you taking too much care of him?”
“No matter what, he is only a Demigod.”
Gu Tianyu smiled upon hearing this, his body slowly leaning back against the chair.
“The Third Elder is a shareholder of the group; taking care of his son-in-law is only right.”
Speaking of this, he paused for a moment, a trace of thought flashing in his eyes.
“And... I’ve been in business for so many years, and I’ve seen countless Geniuses.”
“Some people’s confidence comes from their background, some people’s confidence comes from their strength, and others’ confidence is just an act.”
“But Yang Fan is different; that is a kind of near-absolute confidence.”
“I haven’t seen this kind of look in other peerless prodigies.”
Gu Tianyu tapped the table lightly and spoke slowly:
“Such a person must have something to rely on.”
“Building a good relationship in advance can never be wrong.”
“Yes.” The assistant nodded and withdrew.
On the other side.
Yang Fan was checking the latest data within his Divine Kingdom.
Suddenly, he received a message from Gu Tianyu.
He opened the message content.
Yang Fan was silent, the expression on his face even somewhat strange.
After a long while, he couldn’t help but rub his nose, feeling somewhat awkward and helpless.
After all, the other party was sincerely trying to help him.
But the problem was, the entire price surge on the Dark Web was something he had single-handedly driven.
Now Gu Tianyu was even prepared to lose one hundred million Divinity Points to sell him goods...
This gave Yang Fan a feeling of inexplicable guilt.
After thinking about it, he still replied seriously.
“Thank you, General Manager Gu, for your concern.”
“Currently, there is no financial pressure.”
After sending the message, Yang Fan couldn’t help but smile.
Thinking back carefully, Gu Tianyu had really helped him quite a bit.
The Dark Web platform was something the other party told him about.
When the prices fluctuated, he took the initiative to remind him.
Now, he was even thinking about selling him goods at a discount.
‘A thoroughly good person.’
Thinking of this, Yang Fan couldn’t help but sigh.
“If there were a few more people like General Manager Gu...”
“The development speed of my Divine Kingdom would be at least twice as fast.”

sentences.text: Upon hearing this, Yang Da’s eyes lit up instantly.
“Does Master mean...”
Yang Fan leaned back on his divine throne, his tone calm.
“With so much supply suddenly appearing, where would there be so many buyers?”
“Everyone only has one chance to bid.”
“Right now, everyone thinks the market is hot, but in reality, there aren’t many people truly willing to take over the market.”
“If not for the Dark Web’s rule that the minimum bid cannot be lower than one billion Divinity Points...”
“I would even dare to try bidding one hundred million.”
Speaking of this, a mischievous smile appeared on the corner of Yang Fan’s mouth.
Upon hearing this, Yang Da immediately felt a sense of reverence.
“Master is wise!”
Subsequently, he immediately began calculating.
Combining the Dark Web’s transaction data from previous years, he continuously calculated the most reasonable bidding range.
He strove to utilize the funds in his hands to the absolute limit.
The bid was submitted.
It took only a few breaths of time.
The transaction results were already calculated.
“Master!”
“Good news!”
Yang Da’s voice carried a hint of excitement.
“We successfully purchased three thousand Earth Core Spirit Milk Source Nests and five thousand enlightenment ancient trees at the price of one billion Divinity Points!”
“We successfully purchased six thousand Earth Core Spirit Milk Source Nests and five thousand enlightenment ancient trees at the price of one point one billion Divinity Points!”
“The entire twenty trillion Divinity Points of liquid funds have been traded!”
Hearing this result.
Even Yang Fan revealed a look of satisfaction.
And Yang Da was even more excited.
“Master’s calculations are divine!
This operation can be described as the God of Capital descending to the world!”
“By merely adjusting the bidding strategy, we saved trillions of Divinity Points in funds!”
“Such a stroke of Genius, even the top-tier financial Intelligent Life of the Federation would have to concede defeat upon seeing it!”
Yang Fan rolled his eyes upon hearing this.
“Don’t learn that style from Ling Xuzi, and stop flattering me.”
“Those gods selling resource buildings aren’t fools.”
“In their view, selling them for one billion Divinity Points is still profitable.”
“Moreover, there have been many records of resource buildings failing to sell on the Dark Web throughout history.”
“They didn’t lose out.”
Speaking of this, Yang Fan suddenly smiled.
“However...”
“Some business tycoon is probably going to feel like they wasted their effort for nothing.”
In his mind, the image of Gu Tianyu couldn’t help but appear.
If not for that reminder message from the other party, he might not have thought of this move.
As a result of this operation, he directly saved three to four trillion Divinity Points.
[Earth Core Spirit Milk Source Nest: 12,931 (S-Rank)]
[enlightenment ancient tree: 13,580 (S-Rank)]
Looking at the data before him, even Yang Fan couldn’t help but feel a bit emotional.
Now, with the support of the Hundredfold Evolution Talent.
The Earth Core Spirit Milk Source Nests can generate 1.2931 trillion Divinity Points in monthly revenue.
The enlightenment ancient trees can generate 1.0864 trillion Divinity Points in monthly revenue.
Combined, the monthly income has reached a staggering 2.3795 trillion Divinity Points.
Yet, just a few months ago, his total monthly income for his Divine Kingdom was less than one hundred billion.
Now, it has increased by dozens of times.
Although he still needs to pay six trillion Divinity Points in interest to Qin Xue annually, Yang Fan didn’t take it to heart at all.
Because he never intended to start saving money now.
Every subsequent bit of revenue will continue to compound and continue to expand.
Continue purchasing Earth Core Spirit Milk Source Nests and enlightenment ancient trees.
Until the revenue rolls into an even more terrifying amount.
As for the interest?
It won’t be too late to deal with it three months before the repayment date.
According to the current rate of development.
It won’t be long before his single-month income has a chance to break through ten trillion Divinity Points.
By that time, the Divine Kingdom investment system will be completely formed.
And he will finally be able to free up his hands, while continuing to expand the scale of his assets.
And start purchasing top-tier treasures like the War God Codex to supplement the foundation of his Divine Kingdom.
Meanwhile.
In a distant Star Domain.
Gu Tianyu was looking at the latest Dark Web transaction report that had just been delivered.
A moment later, he put down the document and couldn’t help but shake his head.
“This was a setup by someone.”
The assistant beside him said in a low voice:
“General Manager Gu, many people thought the market was hot this time, but when the actual transaction happened, the price dropped.”
Gu Tianyu, upon hearing this, was completely indifferent.
“It doesn’t matter; selling for one billion Divinity Points is still quite profitable.”
“In fact, for us sellers, the Dark Web’s minimum transaction price of one billion Divinity Points is actually a form of protection.”
“The return rate of these resource-type S-Rank Buildings itself isn’t high.”
“Under normal circumstances, they wouldn’t sell for such a price at all.”
“As long as they can be successfully sold, it’s a profit no matter how you calculate it.”
Speaking of this, Gu Tianyu waved his hand.
“Continue listing small batches in the future.”
“If someone is willing to buy at a high price, we have no reason to refuse.”
“Yes, General Manager Gu.”
The assistant nodded respectfully.
Just as he was preparing to leave, Gu Tianyu suddenly remembered something.
“By the way, how has Yang Fan been recently?”
The assistant was stunned.
“Yang Fan?
The one from the Primordial Academy?”
“Yes.”
Gu Tianyu nodded, then smiled and said:
“If the price of the Earth Core Spirit Milk Source Nests he sold is too low, he might lose out on the handling fees.”
“Help me send him a message and ask if he needs these buildings.”
“If he needs them, I can sell them to him for nine hundred million.”
Upon hearing this, a strange look appeared on the assistant’s face.
“General Manager Gu, aren’t you taking too much care of him?”
“No matter what, he is only a Demigod.”
Gu Tianyu smiled upon hearing this, his body slowly leaning back against the chair.
“The Third Elder is a shareholder of the group; taking care of his son-in-law is only right.”
Speaking of this, he paused for a moment, a trace of thought flashing in his eyes.
“And...
I’ve been in business for so many years, and I’ve seen countless Geniuses.”
“Some people’s confidence comes from their background, some people’s confidence comes from their strength, and others’ confidence is just an act.”
“But Yang Fan is different; that is a kind of near-absolute confidence.”
“I haven’t seen this kind of look in other peerless prodigies.”

chapters.title: Chapter 279: The Most Powerful Force in the Divine Kingdom
paragraphs: The days that followed returned to peace once again.
Aside from accompanying his family and Gu Le, Yang Fan rarely appeared in public anymore.
Most of his time was dedicated to the development of the Divine Kingdom.
Every month, the Dark Web auctions still took place punctually.
And Yang Fan continuously utilized compound interest to expand the scale of his assets.
“Reporting to Master.”
“This month, we purchased over 1,500 Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nests and 23 enlightenment ancient trees.”
“Reporting to Master.”
“This month, we purchased 1,800 Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nests.”
“Reporting to Master.”
“This month, we purchased over 1,900 Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nests and 106 enlightenment ancient trees.”
“Reporting to Master...”
Time continued to flow.
Although Yang Fan had not deliberately raised the overall combat power of the Divine Kingdom during this period,
for his Divine Kingdom,
for every month that passed in the Real World, three thousand years passed internally.
Over such long years, a large number of high-tier believers passed away after reaching their lifespan limits,
while new geniuses continuously rose up.
Generation after generation of believers followed one another, allowing the entire Divine Kingdom to constantly maintain an upward trend.
And the place with the greatest change among them was undoubtedly the Eternal Corpse Mine.
After over ten thousand years of continuous Evolution,
under the nourishment of massive amounts of corpse qi, the entire mine had long since turned into a true kingdom of the dead.
Looking out, the earth was pitch black, and the corpse qi blotted out the sky and sun.
Countless zombies wandered among the wilderness.
Most importantly, they had no lifespan restrictions.
The Zombie King would not die of old age, and the Zombie General would not perish either.
Their numbers would only continue to accumulate as time passed.

As for those human believers manufactured by the cloning factory, they were continuously thrown into the mine, eventually transforming into new zombies and causing the scale of the entire race to continuously expand.
Nowadays, the Eternal Corpse Mine was already filled with the figures of zombies everywhere.
Even because the number was too huge, ordinary zombies had already begun to devour and kill each other.
However, those Zombie Kings and Zombie Generals who had given birth to spiritual intelligence were completely different.
They knew of the existence of the gods and also knew their own mission.
Therefore, they never engaged in meaningless internal friction, but instead lurked in the areas where the corpse qi was densest.
Constantly absorbing power, they quietly awaited the summons of the gods.
Waiting for the day they would conquer a new world for the gods.

[Believers: Foundation Establishment Realm (31 million), Martial Master Realm (29 million), Qi Refining Realm (10 billion), Martial Disciple Realm (14.4 billion), Second-class Intelligent Life (45 million), First-class Intelligent Life (14.5 billion), Zombie King (61 million), Zombie General (2.42 billion)...]
Looking at the current believer information of the Divine Kingdom, even Yang Fan felt a bit emotional.
If external factors such as Formations, equipment, and technological weapons were not considered,
the current Zombie Kingdom had instead become the most powerful force in the entire Divine Kingdom.
Yang Fan said thoughtfully,
“Under the blessing of Evolution Talent, these zombies have no lifespan restrictions, and their development speed is indeed not slow.”
“It seems it is time to prepare a complete Cultivation system for them. In the future, they can completely take the zombie faction route within the Cultivation system.”
Thinking of this, Yang Fan immediately opened the Divine Shop and began searching.
Soon, several Cultivation Techniques suitable for zombies to Cultivate appeared before his eyes.
Yin Fiend Corpse Refining Art (C-rank)
Price: 1.2 million Faith Points
Can actively absorb heaven and earth Yin Qi and corpse qi to temper the Physical Body, increasing the strength of the zombie bodies.
Corpse King Heaven Swallowing Technique (B-rank)
Price: 13.8 million Faith Points
Grows rapidly by devouring corpse qi and the Origin of the same kind, suitable for high-tier zombies to Cultivate.
Ten Thousand Corpses Return to Origin Scripture (B-rank)
Price: 8.5 million Faith Points
Can condense a corpse pill, greatly improving the utilization efficiency of corpse qi.
Looking at these Cultivation Techniques, Yang Fan directly chose to purchase all of them.
For him now, these Faith Points could not even be considered a drop in the bucket.
He was even too lazy to look closely at the specific effects.
He casually bought a transmission tower directly, and then threw all the Corpse Cultivator Cultivation Techniques into it.
The next moment, the transmission tower turned into a stream of light and descended upon the center of the Eternal Corpse Mine.
Boom—
Accompanied by the shaking of the earth, a ten-thousand-zhang-tall ancient black pagoda rose from the ground.
At the same time,
Yang Fan’s voice also resounded over the entire Zombie Kingdom.
“My believers, I have always seen your efforts in my eyes.”
“For countless years, you have guarded the corpse mine and continuously strengthened the power of the Divine Kingdom.”
“You are not outcasts, nor are you the forgotten ones.”
“You are likewise the most important component of the Divine Kingdom.”
“Today, I have expended a huge price to find the corpse-dao Legacy for you.”
“I hope you all will diligently Cultivate and fight for the Divine Kingdom.”
“And carve out a true path of Evolution for yourselves.”
The divine voice was mighty, echoing through heaven and earth.
Countless zombies raised their heads at the same time.
The next moment, figures covering the mountains and plains knelt down on the ground one after another.
“Many thanks to my god for your mercy!”
“We are willing to forever follow the footsteps of the gods!”
“The Divine Kingdom is immortal!”
“The gods live forever!”
“The Divine Kingdom is immortal!”
“The gods live forever!”
The sound swept through the entire corpse mine like a tsunami.
Even those aloof Zombie Kings prostrated themselves respectfully on the ground, their eyes filled with fanaticism.
After finishing all this, Yang Fan nodded with satisfaction.
Then, with a slight movement of his mind, his figure disappeared in place.
When he appeared again, he had already arrived in the villa deep underground.
It was still quiet here, with only one Intelligent Life and two bionics responsible for maintaining various equipment.
Perceiving Yang Fan’s descent, one of the figures immediately knelt on one knee.
“Subordinate Yang Eleven greets Master!”
Yang Fan’s gaze fell upon the other party.
Compared to Yang San of the past, Yang Eleven had already undergone tremendous changes.
The original rugged and resolute face had completely disappeared, replaced by a warm, jade-like young face.
With sword-like eyebrows and starry eyes, long hair tied in a crown, and a set of immaculate white robes,
the whole person looked like a suave Young Master stepping out of an ancient academy.
Yang Fan gently snapped his fingers.
A Formation Legacy instantly sank into Yang Eleven’s brow.
“This is the C-rank Array—Zombie Tide Dance.”
“You have studied Formations the longest and have the most experience.”
“Starting from today, you will be responsible for guiding the Zombie Kingdom to Cultivate this array.”
“Perhaps it won’t be long before a new Divine Kingdom War begins.”
“And they will become an indispensable force of the Divine Kingdom.”
Hearing this, Yang Eleven’s eyes instantly erupted with a blazing light.
“Yes, Master!”
“Subordinate will definitely not fail your expectations!”
There was even a hint of excitement in the voice.
He had already stayed underground for over ten thousand years.
Now he finally waited for the opportunity to repay the gods.
For Yang Eleven, this was even more worth rejoicing than receiving a reward.
Looking at the other party’s reaction, Yang Fan couldn’t help smiling.
He was not worried that Yang Eleven would have any prejudice against those zombie believers.
Yang Eleven was different from Yang Da.
As Intelligent Life, they possessed independent thinking, yet they would not be swayed by emotions.
Most of the time, they would only make the most rational judgments.
In Yang Eleven’s eyes, the so-called Zombie King and Foundation Establishment Cultivator perhaps had no essential difference.
Everyone was simply a force under the command of the gods.
Whoever was stronger and more valuable would be given priority for Cultivation.
As for racial prejudice?
Such a thing would never appear within the logic modules of Intelligent Life.

chapters.title: Chapter 280: Oratory
paragraphs: Not long after Yang Fan’s consciousness left the Divine Kingdom.
A figure in white appeared above the Eternal Corpse Mine.
It was none other than Yang Eleven.
Almost at the moment he descended,
Deep within the mine, amidst mountains of corpses, countless Zombie Kings who were Cultivating opened their eyes simultaneously.
Swoosh! Swoosh! Swoosh!
Gazes filled with oppression looked toward the sky simultaneously, and the air seemed to congeal.
Although they had never seen the person before them,
But the aura unique to Intelligent Life allowed all the Zombie Kings to instantly recognize the other’s identity.
In an instant, a fury suppressed for ten thousand years erupted.
“Intelligent Life!”
A Zombie King let out a low roar.
“You are not welcome here!”
“Get out!”
Another Zombie King roared as well.
“Get out!”
“Get out!”
The roars rang out one after another, and more and more Zombie Kings stood up, their eyes staring coldly at Yang Eleven in the sky.
They had never forgotten the pain Yang San had once inflicted upon them.
Even though the person before them looked completely different from Yang San,
But in their eyes, Intelligent Life was Intelligent Life.
Facing countless hostile gazes, Yang Eleven’s expression did not change in the slightest.
“Silence!”
Boom—
Accompanied by a cold shout, a terrifying pressure instantly swept across the entire mine.
“I have come by the Divine Decree to teach Formations and increase your strength.”
“To prepare for the future Divine Kingdom War.”
“This is the decision of the Deity; do you intend to defy the Deity’s will?”
Hearing the word ‘Deity,’ all the Zombie Kings fell silent instantly.
A moment later, they knelt on one knee one after another.
“We dare not!”
There was still unwillingness in their voices, but no one dared to defy Yang Fan’s orders.
Seeing this, Yang Eleven slowly raised his right hand and snapped his fingers lightly.
Snap—
The sky suddenly lit up, and a huge light screen slowly unfolded.
The next moment, countless Zombie Kings were stunned simultaneously.
Because the person appearing in the image was none other than Yang San.
Only now, Yang San had long lost his former spirit and was being crazily torn apart by countless zombies.
His body was devoured time and time again, only to recover again and again, until finally, he died completely.
The light in those eyes had also long since extinguished completely.
“This person is the Intelligent Life Yang San, who committed a grave crime back then.”
“His ten-thousand-year sentence has been served, and the Deity personally passed judgment.”
“Now, he has been executed.”
The entire mine fell into dead silence.
All the Zombie Kings stared fixedly at that image, speechless for a long time.
Yang Eleven sighed softly, a touch of heartache appearing on his face.
“The Divine Kingdom is so vast that there will always be parasites and scum.”
“I deeply regret what happened back then.”
“But the Divine Kingdom will not stop its progress because of one sinner, and you will not live in the past forever because of one sinner.”
He slowly scanned the crowd, his voice becoming increasingly resonant.
“Look at yourselves!”
“Have you become stronger?”
“Have you surpassed the past?”
“Or are you just treading water, clinging to past hatred?”
Countless Zombie Kings’ bodies trembled slightly.
“Then what... should we do?”
Finally, a Zombie King spoke up, his voice filled with confusion.
Yang Eleven’s gaze was burning.
“Become stronger!”
“Constantly become stronger!”
“Become the sharpest blade in the Deity’s hand!”
“Even if you have turned into zombies, you are still believers of the Divine Kingdom!”
“Even if you lose your life, you still possess value!”
“Even if the world fears you, the Deity still needs you!”
“The past cannot determine the future! Identity cannot determine value!”
“Only power can prove the meaning of your existence!”
Yang Eleven waved his hand abruptly.
The transmission tower shook violently, and countless Cultivation Technique light images illuminated the firmament.
“The Deity has bestowed the Legacy!”
“The future is at your feet!”
“Tell me!”
“Are you willing to continue sinking!”
“Or are you willing to follow the Deity!”
“Fight for the Divine Kingdom!”
“Fight for the Deity!”
After a brief silence, one Zombie King was the first to stand up and raise the weapon in his hand.
“Fight for the Deity!”
Immediately following, the second, the third, the fourth...
Countless Zombie Kings roared simultaneously.
“Fight for the Deity!”
“Fight for the Deity!”
“Fight! Fight! Fight!”
The roars shook heaven and earth, and even those ordinary zombies without intelligence began to instinctively roar along.
Corpse Qi soared to the sky, and the sound waves swept in all directions.
The entire Zombie Kingdom seemed to regain its vitality.
Meanwhile, on the other side of the Divine Kingdom,
Yang Da was watching all of this through a real-time feed.
Looking at the completely boiling Zombie Kingdom, he couldn’t help but open his mouth in shock.
“Holy crap!”
“Yang San, that guy, was locked underground for ten thousand years; could it be that he spent every day studying ‘Oratory’?”
“This brainwashing ability is almost catching up to certain ‘experts’!”
Yang Da touched his chin, thoughtful.
However, soon, he nodded again, feeling that Yang Eleven’s method was very effective.
Because after believers possess a common belief, the efficiency of executing the Divine Decree will significantly increase.
In the Divine Kingdom War, this kind of cohesion is often more important than pure strength.
The development of the Divine Kingdom never relies solely on resources and strength.
For a Deity, letting believers have a common goal is also an extremely important ability.
And everything Yang Eleven just did was essentially reshaping the sense of identity of the entire Zombie Kingdom.
Judging from the results, he undoubtedly succeeded.
In the following days, Yang Fan gradually quieted down.
He did not participate in any more Divine Kingdom Wars.
Sima Bang would invite him to dine at Yuexiang Pavilion every month, but Yang Fan could always find various reasons to decline.
There were even a few geniuses who were also Peerless Prodigies who took the initiative to visit, hoping to join forces with him to invade Alien Divine Kingdoms.
Regarding this, Yang Fan likewise politely declined them all.
Nowadays, he was no longer lacking that bit of resources.
Compared to taking risks and fighting, he was more willing to invest his time in the development of the Divine Kingdom.
Every month, Yang Da would purchase a large number of Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nests and enlightenment ancient trees from the Dark Web.
After these buildings were loaded into the Divine Kingdom, the revenue generated the next month would be reinvested into purchasing new resource buildings.
It kept cycling in this way, and wealth continued to grow like a snowball.
And as the number of purchases increased, those sellers on the Dark Web selling resource-type S-Rank Buildings seemed to have noticed something.
At the beginning, there were only a few hundred resource buildings listed for sale each month.
Later on, the number of listed items began to gradually increase.
It was as if more and more forces began to actively offload their goods.
Under such circumstances, Yang Fan’s funds were naturally insufficient.
However, with supply exceeding demand, his current buying price had dropped to 1.1 billion Divinity Points.
Besides the development of the Divine Kingdom, the thing Yang Fan did most was attending various banquets and cocktail parties.
His and Gu Le’s birthday banquets were always organized personally by the Gu Family.
He would also attend birthday banquets, exchange meetings, and various private gatherings held by the younger generation of various major Families.
Over time, Yang Fan discovered that the area where he had made the most progress was not the Divine Kingdom, but social etiquette in reality.
He was becoming increasingly adept at dealing with the scions of those major Families.
The smile on his face was always just right, and his speech always left room for maneuver.
Unless absolutely necessary, he never lied easily, because many times, one lie requires more lies to cover it up.
And in these top-tier circles, reputation is often more important than profit.
Besides that, those Divine Kingdom investment projects that everyone knew about required even more caution.
Because when everyone thinks it is a guaranteed profit, that is often the moment of greatest risk.

sentences.text: Not long after Yang Fan’s consciousness left the Divine Kingdom.
A figure in white appeared above the Eternal Corpse Mine.
It was none other than Yang Eleven.
Almost at the moment he descended,
Deep within the mine, amidst mountains of corpses, countless Zombie Kings who were Cultivating opened their eyes simultaneously.
Swoosh!
Swoosh!
Swoosh!
Gazes filled with oppression looked toward the sky simultaneously, and the air seemed to congeal.
Although they had never seen the person before them,
But the aura unique to Intelligent Life allowed all the Zombie Kings to instantly recognize the other’s identity.
In an instant, a fury suppressed for ten thousand years erupted.
“Intelligent Life!”
A Zombie King let out a low roar.
“You are not welcome here!”
“Get out!”
Another Zombie King roared as well.
“Get out!”
“Get out!”
The roars rang out one after another, and more and more Zombie Kings stood up, their eyes staring coldly at Yang Eleven in the sky.
They had never forgotten the pain Yang San had once inflicted upon them.
Even though the person before them looked completely different from Yang San,
But in their eyes, Intelligent Life was Intelligent Life.
Facing countless hostile gazes, Yang Eleven’s expression did not change in the slightest.
“Silence!”
Boom—
Accompanied by a cold shout, a terrifying pressure instantly swept across the entire mine.
“I have come by the Divine Decree to teach Formations and increase your strength.”
“To prepare for the future Divine Kingdom War.”
“This is the decision of the Deity; do you intend to defy the Deity’s will?”
Hearing the word ‘Deity,’ all the Zombie Kings fell silent instantly.
A moment later, they knelt on one knee one after another.
“We dare not!”
There was still unwillingness in their voices, but no one dared to defy Yang Fan’s orders.
Seeing this, Yang Eleven slowly raised his right hand and snapped his fingers lightly.
Snap—
The sky suddenly lit up, and a huge light screen slowly unfolded.
The next moment, countless Zombie Kings were stunned simultaneously.
Because the person appearing in the image was none other than Yang San.
Only now, Yang San had long lost his former spirit and was being crazily torn apart by countless zombies.
His body was devoured time and time again, only to recover again and again, until finally, he died completely.
The light in those eyes had also long since extinguished completely.
“This person is the Intelligent Life Yang San, who committed a grave crime back then.”
“His ten-thousand-year sentence has been served, and the Deity personally passed judgment.”
“Now, he has been executed.”
The entire mine fell into dead silence.
All the Zombie Kings stared fixedly at that image, speechless for a long time.
Yang Eleven sighed softly, a touch of heartache appearing on his face.
“The Divine Kingdom is so vast that there will always be parasites and scum.”
“I deeply regret what happened back then.”
“But the Divine Kingdom will not stop its progress because of one sinner, and you will not live in the past forever because of one sinner.”
He slowly scanned the crowd, his voice becoming increasingly resonant.
“Look at yourselves!”
“Have you become stronger?”
“Have you surpassed the past?”
“Or are you just treading water, clinging to past hatred?”
Countless Zombie Kings’ bodies trembled slightly.
“Then what... should we do?”
Finally, a Zombie King spoke up, his voice filled with confusion.
Yang Eleven’s gaze was burning.
“Become stronger!”
“Constantly become stronger!”
“Become the sharpest blade in the Deity’s hand!”
“Even if you have turned into zombies, you are still believers of the Divine Kingdom!”
“Even if you lose your life, you still possess value!”
“Even if the world fears you, the Deity still needs you!”
“The past cannot determine the future!
Identity cannot determine value!”
“Only power can prove the meaning of your existence!”
Yang Eleven waved his hand abruptly.
The transmission tower shook violently, and countless Cultivation Technique light images illuminated the firmament.
“The Deity has bestowed the Legacy!”
“The future is at your feet!”
“Tell me!”
“Are you willing to continue sinking!”
“Or are you willing to follow the Deity!”
“Fight for the Divine Kingdom!”
“Fight for the Deity!”
After a brief silence, one Zombie King was the first to stand up and raise the weapon in his hand.
“Fight for the Deity!”
Immediately following, the second, the third, the fourth...
Countless Zombie Kings roared simultaneously.
“Fight for the Deity!”
“Fight for the Deity!”
“Fight!
Fight!
Fight!”
The roars shook heaven and earth, and even those ordinary zombies without intelligence began to instinctively roar along.
Corpse Qi soared to the sky, and the sound waves swept in all directions.
The entire Zombie Kingdom seemed to regain its vitality.
Meanwhile, on the other side of the Divine Kingdom,
Yang Da was watching all of this through a real-time feed.
Looking at the completely boiling Zombie Kingdom, he couldn’t help but open his mouth in shock.
“Holy crap!”
“Yang San, that guy, was locked underground for ten thousand years; could it be that he spent every day studying ‘Oratory’?”
“This brainwashing ability is almost catching up to certain ‘experts’!”
Yang Da touched his chin, thoughtful.
However, soon, he nodded again, feeling that Yang Eleven’s method was very effective.
