chapters.title: Chapter 281: Gu Chengye
paragraphs: Time passed slowly, and Gu Le’s belly gradually grew larger.
Soon, the second semester of the second year at the Primordial Academy ended.
Yang Fan officially advanced to his third year.
Not long after starting his third year, the day finally arrived for Gu Le to give birth.
Accompanied by a crisp cry, a baby boy was born safely.
That same day, Gu Xuanting and Lu Qinglan met with Yang Fan through the Virtual World.
It was evident that the two of them attached great importance to this eldest grandson.
“Xiao Fan, this is the first child for you and the girl Le, and also your eldest son.”
Gu Xuanting wore a smile on his face.
“What name do you intend to give him?”
Upon hearing this, Yang Fan immediately stood up and cupped his hands, “Everything is up to you, Father.”
Hearing this, Gu Xuanting burst into laughter.
“You child, you certainly know how to save yourself some trouble.”
“However, some things still need to be made clear in advance.”
“The Gu Family has never treated geniuses of other surnames unfairly, and we certainly won’t treat our own people unfairly.”
“However, if this child takes the surname Gu, it will ultimately be more convenient for him to act within the Family in the future.”
“After all, there are always some old fogeys in the clan who cling to old rules.”
“Although it won’t affect the overall situation, it’s always better to have fewer troubles.”
Speaking of this, Gu Xuanting looked at Yang Fan.
“Xiao Fan, if you have other thoughts, you can also bring them up.”
Yang Fan hurriedly shook his head.
“Father, you speak too seriously.”
“If it can allow the child to have a smoother path in the future, the surname is not important.”
“It is just a name.”
Gu Xuanting nodded with satisfaction.
“Not bad. The Five Great Families have countless intermarriages.”
“Some follow the father’s surname, some follow the mother’s surname; it is a common occurrence.”
“Being able to see past this shows that you are more mature than many young people.”
Then, he waved his hand.
“Since that is the case, the surname is settled.”
“As for the name, the two of you can discuss it slowly.”
Consciousness withdrew from the Virtual World.
Yang Fan returned to reality.
In the room, Gu Le was holding the baby while sitting by the bed, her face full of the joy of becoming a mother for the first time.
Seeing Yang Fan return, Gu Le immediately blinked.
“Husband, what did Father want with you?”
“This is his first grandson, after all.”
“Didn’t he give you the ownership of a hundred or eighty life planets?”
Yang Fan rolled his eyes upon hearing this, “You are truly filial.”
As he spoke, he reached out his finger and flicked Gu Le on the forehead.
“Ouch!”
Gu Le hurriedly covered her head, then said righteously, “When you marry a chicken, you follow the chicken; when you marry a dog, you follow the dog.”
“Anyway, that old man is filthy rich, so we should take the opportunity to ask for more resources now.”
“Later, when the three of us develop our Divine Kingdom, it will be much easier.”
The corners of Yang Fan’s mouth twitched slightly.
He suddenly wondered if Gu Xuanting would fly into a rage and scold his precious daughter if he heard this.
“Alright, I know what you’re thinking.”
“But Father is, after all, the Third Elder of the Gu Family, and his every move is watched by countless people.”
“The Gu Family’s resources cannot be tilted toward us without limit.”
Yang Fan explained with a smile, “Father called me over today mainly for the child’s name.”
“I have already decided.”
“This kid will take the surname Gu, and his name will be Gu Chengye.”
“In the future, he will inherit his father’s career.”
Hearing this, Gu Le was stunned for a moment.
Immediately after, her eyes turned slightly red.
Then, she didn’t say anything, just quietly leaned into Yang Fan’s embrace.
Her face was full of unconcealable happiness.
Regarding this matter, Yang Fan actually saw it very clearly.
The Gu Family is, after all, one of the Five Great Families of the Human Race.
And as of now, even though he is rated as a Peerless Prodigy, he is ultimately just a demigod.
Sometimes, attitude is more important than ability.
It’s just a surname; if it can make Gu Xuanting of the Gu Family feel comfortable, the support the Gu Family gives him in the future will naturally be greater.
As for whether the child is surnamed Gu or Yang, Yang Fan actually doesn’t care.
When he breaks through to become a God in the future, unless the Divine Kingdom Core is breached, he can possess near-endless lifespan.
Whether the child is surnamed Gu, Yang, or even Lu, it doesn’t matter.
To him, there is no essential difference.
The world is bustling, all for profit.
The world is clamoring, all for profit.
The name Gu Chengye is a bond for the Gu Family to maintain the relationship between both sides.
It is also a channel for Yang Fan to continue receiving investment from the Gu Family.
If he insisted on the surname Yang, Gu Xuanting would most likely agree.
But the resources flowing from the Gu Family to him in the future might not be as smooth.
Life is like a game of chess; every move has its gains and losses.
If a name can be exchanged for greater benefits.
Then why bother competing with others for meaningless obsessions?
Following Gu Chengye’s birth, people coming to offer congratulations arrived in an endless stream.
Various congratulatory gifts were sent continuously.
Some sent divine kingdom buildings, some directly transferred Divinity Points, and some even gifted company shares.
Among them, the most generous were Gu Tianyu and Qin Xue.
Gu Tianyu waved his hand and directly gifted an S-tier Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nest.
Although Qin Xue did not attend in person, she still sent a super red envelope worth two billion Divinity Points.
It also had a note attached, “Used for maintaining customer relations.”
When he saw this sentence, Yang Fan couldn’t help but laugh.
A month later, to celebrate his eldest grandson’s full-month milestone, Gu Xuanting specially held a full-month banquet of unprecedented scale.
The banquet was held in Taichu City.
Those who could receive an invitation were all big shots with status from various sides.
Besides this, Gu Xuanting also specially invited Yang Fan’s parents, Yang Tiexin and Sun Rou.
One must know that Taichu City is the core region of the Human Race, and ordinary outsiders have no qualifications to enter at all.
But Gu Xuanting, not knowing what method he used, managed to secure temporary access permits for the two of them.
When Yang Tiexin and Sun Rou stepped into the banquet hall, they were both a bit dazed.
Their presence always felt out of place with everything around them.
And shortly after the banquet began, Gu Xuanting took the initiative to raise a wine glass and walk towards the two of them.
“You two, thank you for raising a child like Xiao Fan.”
After speaking, he raised his glass to signal.
At this moment, the entire banquet hall quieted down a bit.
Yang Tiexin and Sun Rou stood up instantly, at a loss.
Even though Gu Xuanting had deliberately restrained his aura.
Facing a High-Order God, the two of them still felt their consciousness go into a daze.
It was as if what stood before them was not a person, but a vast and boundless starry sky.
It wasn’t until long after Gu Xuanting left that the two of them gradually came back to their senses.
Their faces still retained a look of shock.
The entire full-month banquet lasted for a long time.
Yang Fan always maintained a proper smile, constantly communicating with guests from various sides.
Many of them he didn’t know at all, but judging from the aura emanating from them, they were all at least much stronger than Ma Yu.
After the banquet ended.
Yang Tiexin and Sun Rou found Yang Fan alone.
The Family of three chatted for a long time.
“Seeing that you have such achievements today, we are relieved.”
Yang Tiexin said with emotion.
“A big Family like the Gu Family is not like the outside world; keep your wits about you in everything, and be cautious in your speech and actions.”
Sun Rou also nodded, then as if remembering something, suddenly added:
“And there is also Chengrou.”
“Now that you have Chengye.”
“But Chengrou is also your child, so you cannot favor one over the other.”
Yang Fan was slightly stunned, then nodded seriously.
“Dad, Mom, I understand.”
Hearing this, the two Elders finally felt completely at ease.
Then they said goodbye to Yang Fan and returned to the real world.

chapters.title: Chapter 282: Warfare-Type Buildings
paragraphs: Yang Fan watched his parents leave, and then his consciousness descended into the Divine Kingdom once more.
With a slight movement of his thoughts, the current information of the Divine Kingdom instantly surfaced in his mind.
“Divine Master: Yang Fan
Divine Kingdom Area: 80 million square kilometers
Talent: Omitted

Believers: Foundation Establishment Realm (180 million), Martial Master Realm (61.4 million), Qi Refining Realm (11 billion), Martial Apprentice Realm (14.4 billion), Second-class Intelligent Life (89 million), First-class Intelligent Life (34.3 billion), Zombie King (220 million), Zombie General (34.4 billion)...
Occupations: Alchemist (1.41 billion), Blacksmith (240 million), Talisman Master (110 million), Formation Master (250 million)...
Vassals: Elven Warriors (3.4 billion)
Techniques: Zombie Tide Dance (C-Rank, Major Achievement)...
Divinity Points: 8 trillion (reality provides 245 Divinity Points daily)

Buildings: Fountain of Life x990,000, War God Codex (S-Rank), Heavenly Court (S-Rank), Goddess of Wisdom (S-Rank), Great Void Warship x2 (S-Rank), Mechanical War Puppet x2 (S-Rank), ten thousand dao evolution sanctuary x1 (S-Rank), Nine Nether River x1 (S-Rank), Life Essence Conversion Pool x1 (S-Rank), Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nest x58,432 (S-Rank), enlightenment ancient tree x55,220 (S-Rank), divine weapon world-forging platform (S-Rank), Spiritual Vein x420,000 (A-Rank), Alchemy Tower x180,000 (B-Rank), prison-suppressing body-refining tower x10,000 (B-Rank), immortal nurturing tower x200,000 (B-Rank), Special Life Building elf holy tree (million-year, gestating Elven Warriors), Special Building Enlightenment Stone x1 million...
Wonders: Worlds Number One Martial Arts Arena x20,000 (deployed), myriad manifestation battle stele x10,000...

Assets: Spirit Plant Star x10, f-class transformation pod x30 million, Second-class Intelligent Life x450 million, First-class Intelligent Life x50 billion, Mechanical Heart x1.2 million, cloning nutrient pod x2 billion, ordinary zombies (x223.8 billion)...”

Under the blessing of the Hundredfold Evolution Talent, relying solely on the yields brought by the Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nest and the enlightenment ancient tree, the monthly income had already exceeded 10 trillion Divinity Points.
This could also be considered completing the first small goal in Yang Fan’s heart.
At the same time, as more and more S-Rank resource buildings were loaded into the Divine Kingdom, the environment of the entire Divine Kingdom underwent earth-shaking changes.
Looking afar, the heaven and earth were wreathed in immortal mist, and the dense Immortal Qi had almost turned into substance.
Precisely because of this, under tens of thousands of years of Divine Kingdom Evolution, the number of believers in the Foundation Establishment Realm surged explosively.
Had it not been for the restrictions of the Divine Kingdom’s rules, many of those believers would likely have long broken through to the Core Formation Realm.
Nowadays, many believers walking the Cultivation and Martial Arts routes had Physiques far surpassing ordinary people right after birth.
Upon reaching adulthood, even if they had never cultivated, they would possess at least a Tier 5 life level.
Upon learning this news, Yang Fan suddenly felt that the f-class transformation pod that he and Yang Da had painstakingly purchased back then was not so appealing anymore.
Inside the Divine Kingdom today, a full 30 million f-class transformation pods were piled up, yet their actual utilization rate was getting lower and lower.
After all, believers with normal Aptitude possessed Tier 5 strength upon reaching adulthood.
Those who needed to rely on transformation pods to grow were mostly individuals with poorer talents.
The Cultivation value of such believers was naturally limited.
In response to this, Yang Fan specifically called Yang Da over and conducted a three-hour ideological education session.

Yang Fan nodded.
“Pull out the S-Rank warfare-type buildings suitable for my current status.”
“The Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nest and the enlightenment ancient tree can continue to be purchased in the future.”
“But now is also the time to expand the military and prepare for war.”
The current Yang Fan had absolute confidence.
Solely in terms of wealth, almost no one across the entire Demigod stage could compare with him.

Problems that could be solved with Resources did not need believers to risk their lives.
The current Yang Fan was like a super wealthy tycoon hidden in the dark.

Steady.
And steadier.

Core warfare building of the Cultivation Human Race
Suggested quotation: 60 billion Divinity Points

Warfare building of the Martial Arts Human Race
Suggested quotation: 72 billion Divinity Points
[ flesh disaster hive ]
Core warfare building of the Cultivation Human Race
Suggested quotation: 50 billion Divinity Points”
“Master, these are the S-Rank warfare-type buildings I screened out from among them.”
Yang Da waved his hand to bring up the light screen.
“Among them, the Great Void Warship and Mechanical War Puppet can be directly operated by Intelligent Life.”
“The God-Slaying Tower can greatly enhance the lethality of Cultivation believers.”
“The Immortal Army Soul Stele is suitable for Martial Arts legion combat.”
“As for the flesh disaster hive, it perfectly adapts to the Corpse Cultivator civilization.”
“With the current investment returns of the Divine Kingdom, if we large-scale configure these warfare buildings, even if we encounter an invasion by ordinary gods, we won’t fear it in the least.”

chapters.title: Chapter 283: Core Formation Believer
paragraphs: At this point, Yang Da’s tone became excited. After all, an S-Rank Building used for war was enough to sway the outcome of a Divine Kingdom War.

Take the Mechanical War Puppet, for example. Even if controlled by just a first-tier Intelligent Life, it could easily slaughter a Core Formation Realm Cultivator. This was a war weapon created by a high-level Mechanical Civilization.

Often, whether the believers themselves were strong or not didn’t matter. As long as there were enough Divinity Points, one could continuously create terrifying legions. In the era of Divine Kingdoms, Divinity Points could solve almost any problem.

Yang Fan’s thoughts stirred, and his consciousness entered the Divine Shop directly to examine the detailed information on these buildings. A moment later, his consciousness returned to the Divine Kingdom. A look of satisfaction appeared on his face.
“Very good. From now on, when bidding on the Dark Web, we can appropriately pay a premium to purchase these types of war buildings.”
“Use the remaining funds to continue purchasing resource-type buildings.”
“I will give you another three months.”
“In three months, I will head to the Alien Divine Kingdom Zone for the final battle of the demigod stage. After that, I will achieve a Breakthrough to become a God.”

He had just started his junior year, and Yang Fan was not in a hurry to achieve a Breakthrough. According to past data from the Primordial Academy, even top-tier Prodigies like Sima Tianci, who were groomed as successors to their Family, only achieved a Breakthrough to become a God in the second semester of their junior year.

If he achieved a Breakthrough too early, it would easily attract too much attention. Furthermore, he still had to pay interest to Qin Xue in the fourth month. It would just so happen to be the time for the final battle of the demigod stage; at that time, he would no longer need to purchase resources from the Dark Web, and his finances would be much easier to manage.
“Yes, I will obey your command.” Yang Da bowed respectfully.

In the following time, Yang Fan returned to a peaceful life. Apart from his daily studies, he spent his time with Gu Le and Gu Chengye. Whenever the Dark Web auction began, he would enter the Divine Kingdom to discuss the bidding prices with Yang Da.

Unfortunately, S-Rank Buildings for war were already rare, and those suitable for the current Divine Kingdom system were even rarer. The number that appeared each time was no more than a dozen. To ensure a successful bid, Yang Fan would almost always pay a 20% premium on top of the original price.
As for the remaining majority of the funds, they were all still being poured into the Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nest and the enlightenment ancient tree.

Time passed quietly, and it was soon the beginning of the third month. In the courtyard, the sunlight was just right. Gu Chengye was riding on Yang Fan’s shoulders, his two little hands gripping his hair tightly, and he kept giggling.
“Giddy up!” “Giddy up!” The milky voice rang out continuously.

Yang Fan carried his son and ran back and forth in the yard. Every now and then, he would intentionally sway, making Gu Chengye laugh non-stop. Nearby, Gu Le sat on a rattan chair, watching the father and son playing, the smile on her face never fading.
A breeze blew by, and the sunlight spilled down. The time at this moment felt exceptionally peaceful.

However, at this very moment, the smile on Yang Fan’s face suddenly froze, and his footsteps stopped in place. Gu Le immediately sensed something was wrong and quickly stood up to take Gu Chengye into her arms.
“Husband.” “Is something wrong with the Divine Kingdom?”
Yang Fan nodded slightly. “Just a small situation.”
Gu Le smiled gently. “Then hurry and go. I’ll take care of things at home.”
Yang Fan glanced at the mother and son, then turned and returned to his room, his consciousness instantly entering the Divine Kingdom.
Heavenly Court, Lingxiao Treasure Hall. At this moment, the hall was bustling with activity as tens of thousands of Foundation Establishment Cultivators gathered together.

Everyone looked respectful, their gazes all fixed on the highest point of the hall. There, a figure was sitting upright on the main seat. Spiritual light flowed around his body, and his aura was vast. He had clearly transcended the Foundation Establishment level and stepped into the Core Formation Realm!

At this moment, this Core Formation Immortal Master was explaining his own insights on the Breakthrough to the people below, every word a gem. Every sentence left many Foundation Establishment Cultivators with a sense of enlightenment.
Yang Fan had just descended when he sensed a special fluctuation coming from the depths of the Divine Kingdom, as if the rules of the entire Divine Kingdom were undergoing some kind of change.

“Yang Da, what is going on?” Yang Fan frowned slightly. In a demigod’s Divine Kingdom, a Core Formation Cultivator had actually appeared. This had already exceeded the original rules of the Divine Kingdom.

“Reporting to Master,” Yang Da said, bowing. “The Immortal Qi within the Divine Kingdom is now overly dense. For the path of Cultivation, this place is already almost a top-tier Holy Land for Cultivating.”

“After tens of thousands of years of Evolution, the number of Foundation Establishment Cultivators in the Divine Kingdom has long exceeded hundreds of millions. A large number of geniuses with exceptional Aptitude are constantly being born.”

“Although the Divine Kingdom is restricted by rules, in essence, it is a complete world. And within this world, there will always be born some children of destiny favored by Luck. They may not be able to change the world, but they have the opportunity to break the shackles the world imposes upon them. This probability is extremely low, but it is not non-existent.”
At this point, Yang Da looked up at the Lingxiao Treasure Hall, a hint of emotion flashing in his eyes.

Hearing this, Yang Fan couldn’t help but ask, “Since a believer has already broken the rules, will my current Divine Kingdom welcome a qualitative change? For example, a large number of Foundation Establishment Cultivators achieving a Breakthrough to Core Formation?”

Yang Da shook his head upon hearing this. “Reporting to Master. The rules of the Divine Kingdom are extremely strict. It is very difficult to produce Core Formation believers during the demigod stage.”
“This is the same reason why, ever since I obtained the Goddess of Wisdom’s Legacy, I have still been unable to gestate a third-tier Intelligent Life.”
At this point, Yang Da’s tone was also somewhat helpless. “Rules are rules. Even with the SSS-Rank Evolution Talent, it is very difficult to break them easily.”
Yang Fan frowned slightly. “In other words, this is just an unexpected gain?”

When that Core Formation Cultivator was born just now, the Divine Kingdom’s rules clearly fluctuated. It even brought him a not-insignificant feedback. If he could produce Core Formation Cultivators in batches, the changes would be absolutely astonishing. But if it was just an isolated case, that would be a pity.
“Master,” Yang Da took a deep breath. “Although it cannot be replicated on a large scale, this Core Formation Cultivator can still bring huge improvements to the Divine Kingdom.”
“Oh?” Yang Fan became interested.

“The believers are still practicing the C-rank Array, the Ten Kings of Hell Formation. Its biggest problem is the lack of high-level Cultivators to serve as the array eyes. The appearance of the Core Formation believer just happens to fill this gap.”
“Although the Divine Kingdom is still in the demigod stage, it now meets the conditions for practicing a B-rank Array.”

Hearing this, Yang Fan nodded immediately. “Then purchase a B-rank Array; you can arrange such small matters yourself. With the current Aptitude of the believers, comprehending a B-rank Array should not be difficult.”
“Yes.” Yang Da nodded in agreement. However, after hesitating for a moment, he spoke again. “Master, I have one more question.”
“What question?”
“Are you really prepared to keep dragging this out?” Yang Da’s expression was serious.

“According to the database, even among demigods with special Divine Kingdom Cultivation talents, it is extremely rare for believers to break the rules of the Divine Kingdom. And we not only possess over one hundred thousand S-Rank Buildings for resources, but the believers have broken the rules, and even the Divine Kingdom’s environment has begun to show signs of upgrading.”

“To put it bluntly, with the current foundation of the Divine Kingdom, I fear it is already capable of contending with ordinary Gods. There is not much point in continuing to stay in the demigod stage.”

Yang Fan smiled upon hearing this. “Don’t worry. Once the Dark Web auction ends this month, I will head to the Alien Divine Kingdom Zone. Once I’ve sheared the last bit of wool, I will naturally achieve a Breakthrough to become a God.”

chapters.title: Chapter 284: Level 3 Zone
paragraphs: Inside the Divine Kingdom.
Looking at the bustling scene below, Yang Da couldn’t help rubbing his forehead.
He saw a large number of believers bathing in spiritual springs.
Quite a few babbling children were using precious Spirit Stones as pebbles to play with.
As for those high-level Cultivators, they couldn’t even be bothered to take ordinary Medicinal Pills, with the reason actually being that the taste was too bad.
Seeing this scene, Yang Da felt both helpless and somewhat amused.
The SSS-Rank Evolution Talent was simply too Heaven-Defying.
Yet his own deity was ridiculously steady, delaying the Breakthrough again and again.
He was still thinking about squeezing the final batch of benefits from Primordial Academy.
The problem is... are they really still lacking this bit of Resources now?
As the highest Intelligent Life of the Divine Kingdom, Yang Da truly could not comprehend this behavior logic.
However, thinking of his own palace that had just been unsealed not long ago, he ultimately decided to remain silent.
There were still more than twenty days left until the end of this month.
It wasn’t considered long for the Real World.
Yet under a hundredfold time flow rate, a full two thousand-plus years had already passed in the Divine Kingdom.
Following Yang Fan’s instructions, Yang Da quickly purchased a B-Rank Formation from the Divine Shop — [ Four Symbols Heaven Derivation Array ].
This Formation integrated offense, defense, and mobility into one.
It was an extremely comprehensive, all-around warfare Formation.
Although it wasn’t famous for slaughter, it was still a B-Rank Formation after all.
Its might was still far superior to the Ten Kings of Hell Formation.
As the Formation Legacy was distributed down.
The entire Divine Kingdom quickly entered a state of drill.
That believer who had just broken through the Core Formation Realm personally took charge of the Formation core.

Millions of Cultivation Cultivators were responsible for spiritual energy circulation, the martial arts legion was responsible for frontal defense, and the Mechanical legion undertook firepower coverage.
Even the Elven Warriors were incorporated into the Formation system.
Accompanied by deduction after deduction, the entire grand Formation began to gradually take shape.
An aura of stern killing intent far surpassing the past was slowly condensing within the Divine Kingdom.
On this day.
Yang Da once again successfully auctioned five God-Slaying Towers, three Immortal Army Soul Steles, and two flesh disaster hives through the Dark Web.
The remaining funds were all used to purchase Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nests and enlightenment ancient trees.
After more than two thousand years of development, the number of warfare buildings inside Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom had now reached an extremely astonishing figure.
[ God-Slaying Tower × 12 ]
[ Immortal Army Soul Stele × 15 ]
[ flesh disaster hive × 6 ]
[ Mechanical War Puppet × 24 ]
[ Great Void Warship × 15 ]
In addition, the total number of Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nests and enlightenment ancient trees broke through 150,000 structures.
The entire Divine Kingdom seemed to transform into a black hole that could never be filled, continuously devouring various S-Rank Buildings.
Fortunately, all transactions were completed through the Dark Web.
If such a scale of S-Rank Buildings were publicly purchased in the virtual Divine Shop, I am afraid even the Five Great Families would be startled.
Thinking of this, Yang Fan felt both excitement and a faint trace of vigilance rising in his heart.
150,000 resource-type S-Rank Buildings, and dozens of warfare-type S-Rank Buildings.
If such exaggerated wealth were exposed, anyone would detect the abnormality.
And as the number of transactions increased more and more, Yang Fan grew increasingly curious about the Dark Web.
The Divinity Points of his cumulative transactions had long reached an astronomical figure.
Yet even so, he was still only a Level 1 member.
Then just how many Resources had a Level 3 member like Gu Tianyu traded over these years?
And what kind of existence was that Intelligent Life managing everything behind the Dark Web?
The more Yang Fan contacted the Dark Web, the more he could feel its unfathomable depth.
While rejoicing that he hadn’t been exposed, the doubts in his heart also became heavier and heavier.
However, very quickly, Yang Fan pressed these thoughts down.
“Thinking about these has no meaning.”
“What’s most important now is still breaking through to a deity.”
“As long as one is strong enough oneself, all problems are not problems.”
Yang Fan slowly stood up, a sharp gleam flashing through his eyes.
In order to accumulate foundation, he had stayed at the demigod stage for too long, and now it was time to end all this.
Breaking through to a deity in his junior year belonged to the top tier even placed in Primordial Academy, yet it was still far from reaching a shocking degree.
Therefore, his Breakthrough now was completely reasonable in the eyes of outsiders.
After leaving his residence.
Yang Fan did not notify Gu Le, and went alone to the Alien Divine Kingdom Zone.
Along the way, quite a few junior schoolmates who were searching for Alien Divine Kingdom coordinates bowed in salute one after another.
“Greetings, Young Lord!”
“Greetings, Young Lord!”
Facing these voices, Yang Fan only nodded slightly, his footsteps not pausing in the slightest.
Soon he arrived at the Level 2 zone.
The location where that Undead Demigod was originally sealed had been cleared out, leaving only an empty space.
Yang Fan glanced at it, then continued forward.
According to Lu Wan’s introduction back then.
Not far ahead was the Level 3 zone.
It was also the most cruel trial ground of Primordial Academy.
When Yang Fan crossed that invisible boundary, the surrounding space suddenly twisted slightly.
The scene before his eyes instantly changed.
“Identity detection in progress...”
“Junior student Yang Fan.”
“Rating: Peerless Prodigy.”
“Permission verification passed, entry into the Level 3 zone is permitted.”
The cold Intelligent voice slowly sounded.
The next moment, Yang Fan’s vision blurred.
When his vision recovered again, he had already appeared inside a cramped room.
The room’s area was not even a hundred square meters.
Compared to the huge space of the Level 2 zone, it appeared exceptionally crowded.
And what was most eye-catching were the silver sealing devices placed around the surroundings.
There were only a score and more here, the quantity pitifully small.
Right at this moment, a voice suddenly sounded.
“Brother Yang.”
“I didn’t expect you to be ready to use your last chance so early.”
Yang Fan turned his head to look, only to see a figure sitting in the corner.
The other party slowly raised his head, carrying a gentle smile on his face.
Han Jue, a senior student of Primordial Academy, one of the most dazzling geniuses of this generation of the Han Family among the Five Great Families.
A few months ago, the other party had even invited him to join hands to invade an Alien Demigod’s Divine Kingdom.
“Greetings, Brother Han.” Yang Fan cupped his fists slightly, “I didn’t expect you to be here too.”
Han Jue gave a bitter smile, “Being a senior, one always has to fight for it once.”
“Yet when truly arriving here, there is some hesitation again.”
Speaking of this, he looked towards those sealing devices, his expression clearly becoming a bit solemn.
“The fellows inside here... are much more ruthless than those in the Level 2 zone.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan did not reply, instead walking straight towards the nearest sealing device.
Soon, a piece of simple information emerged.
[ Race: Star-Devouring Ghost Clan ]
Other than that, there was no other introduction at all.
Yang Fan’s brows instantly knitted together.
Back then, that Undead Demigod at least had some intelligence that could be referenced, but here there was actually only a race name left.
Right at this moment, Han Jue slowly spoke.
“Don’t look anymore; the Alien Demigods locked up here are at least over two thousand years old at the minimum.”
“Some long-lived species have even lived for five to six thousand years.”
“They all killed their way up all the way from the Level 1 zone.”
“The ordinary geniuses, Human Race Prodigy, and even Peerless Prodigy who died in their hands are countless.”
“Therefore, Primordial Academy simply no longer provides detailed information.”
Speaking of this, Han Jue paused for a moment, then earnestly reminded:
“If Brother Yang is truly prepared to challenge.”
“It’s best to go back to the Gu Family and ask first.”
“There is intelligence sharing among the Five Great Families; for those Alien Demigods who once perished in the hands of Human Race Prodigy, some information can more or less be found out.”
“At least what S-Rank Buildings they possess, there is still a chance to figure it out.”

chapters.title: Chapter 285: Just Like That?
paragraphs: Hearing this, Yang Fan nodded. “Thank you for the reminder.”
Afterward, he did not leave, instead walking along to inspect each sealing device.
[Gold-Devouring Zerg, Crimson Moon Wolf Clan, Nether Ghost Clan, Undead Race, Vajra King Monkey...]
Yang Fan’s gaze swept across quickly, finally stopping in front of one of the sealing devices.
“Vajra King Monkey.”
Seeing this name, a trace of interest flashed in Yang Fan’s eyes.
There are thousands of alien races, and even within the same demon monkey lineage, many special species exist.
The Vajra King Monkey belongs to an extremely powerful branch among them.
Having just searched through the federal database, Yang Fan had already obtained some public information.
The believers of this race possess astonishing innate Divine Power, and upon reaching adulthood, their Physical Body is comparable to divine weapons, impervious to blades and spears.
Whether it is strength, defense, or burst capability, they far surpass creatures of the same rank.
Similar to those special professionals within the Human Race who possess S-rank combat talent.
The reason for choosing them was also because Yang Fan had learned from the lesson of the previous time.
That Undead Demigod back then.
It was only because a zombie civilization happened to develop within his divine kingdom that the Eternal Corpse Mine could unleash its true value.
Otherwise, in the end, there was a high probability it could only be converted into Divinity Points for sale.
However, civilizations like the Zerg and Ghost clans are different.
A large number of core buildings within their divine kingdoms are almost useless to the Human Race.
Since they were going to plunder, naturally they should plunder the things of greatest value to himself.
As for how strong the opponent was...
Yang Fan didn’t care at all.
As he is now, he dares to even challenge ordinary gods.
How could he fear a mere demigod?
Thinking of this, Yang Fan did not hesitate in the slightest.
He directly pressed his palm onto the sealing device.
The next moment, a cold intelligent voice resounded throughout the entire Level 3 Area.
“Student Yang Fan, target Alien Demigod—Vajra King Monkey.”
“Target lifespan: 3,600 years.”
“The comprehensive combat power of this alien’s believers far exceeds humans of the same rank.”
“Please confirm again whether to initiate the challenge.”
“Special warning: Once the challenge is confirmed, if you fail to win, you must persist until graduation in your senior year, and no external support is allowed during this period.”
“Do you confirm?”
“Confirmed.” Yang Fan spoke calmly, without a shred of hesitation.
Hum—
Along with the falling voice, a special coordinate instantly appeared within his divine kingdom.
At the same time, he could clearly sense it.
His own divine kingdom had already established a connection with another distant divine kingdom.
As if with just a single thought, both sides could officially start a war.
It was just different from that Undead Demigod back then.
This Vajra King Monkey demigod did not launch an invasion immediately; it seemed to be waiting for Yang Fan’s choice.
On the other side, Han Jue was completely stunned.
“Brother... Brother Yang...”
“Did you just choose like that?”
His voice even carried a hint of trembling.
You must know that he still retained his last chance to challenge.
Over the years, every once in a while he would come to the Level 3 Area to check.
Then he would collect intelligence through his Family, connections, and various channels, trying to find a target that he could restrain.
But the more he understood, the heavier his mood became.
Because the Alien Demigods locked up here...
Looking across the entire Human Race demigod circle, they belonged to the very top tier of beings.
Many even walked all the way here by stepping on the bones of Peerless Prodigies.
As a result, what did he see today?
Yang Fan entered the Level 3 Area for the first time.
Without even carefully investigating the intelligence, he took a few glances and directly confirmed the challenge.
What kind of absurd confidence is this?
Or could it be... that he got drunk last night, and the alcohol hasn’t worn off yet?
Facing Han Jue’s shocked gaze, Yang Fan only nodded slightly, then turned and left.
He wasn’t very familiar with Han Jue, and the two didn’t have much friendship, so there was no need to continue communicating.
As for him now, he had already loaded over 100,000 S-rank resource buildings.
The foundation of his divine kingdom had reached an unimaginable degree.
At the demigod stage, there were fewer and fewer people who could truly make him take them seriously.
At the same time, along with the confirmation of the challenge,
a special piece of information was instantly transmitted out, and the federal supreme intelligent life synchronously completed the record.
Primordial Academy, the Five Great Families, and some high-level figures with Advanced permissions
received notifications almost simultaneously.
After all, in the entire Alien Divine Kingdom Zone Level 3 Area, there were only a little over twenty Alien Demigods in total.
Some of them had existed for thousands of years.
In some years, an entire batch of students wouldn’t dare to initiate a challenge.
Therefore, every time a Level 3 Area challenge was opened, it would attract considerable attention.
Inside the villa.
Gu Le was holding Gu Chengye, sitting in the courtyard basking in the sun.
The little fellow was waving his chubby little hands, babbling words that no one could understand.
Right at this moment, a message notification suddenly popped up.
Gu Le casually tapped it open.
The next second.
The smile on her face instantly froze, and she stood straight up from the chair.
The hand holding Gu Chengye involuntarily increased its strength a bit.
“Wah—”
Gu Chengye immediately let out a loud cry.
Gu Le only then reacted, hurriedly holding her son in her arms and gently rocking him.
It took a long time to coax the child, and then she looked at her son in her arms with a bitter face.
“Chengye oh Chengye, your dad really doesn’t give people peace of mind.”
“He even dares to go to the Level 3 Area.”
“And he didn’t even discuss it with me.”
“Are we really going to become an orphan and a widow?”
As soon as the words fell, the courtyard door was suddenly pushed open.
Yang Fan strode in.
With his Mental Energy, he naturally heard Gu Le’s words crystal clear.
“What? Have so little confidence in your husband?”
Gu Le glared at him with annoyance.
“Confidence? What do you expect me to have confidence in?”
“That’s the Level 3 Area!”
“Any Alien Demigod in there is an old monster that has lived for thousands of years.”
“They killed their way up from the Level 1 Area, and who knows how many Geniuses have died in their hands.”
“The divine kingdom foundation of such existences is ridiculously strong.”
“The number of believers, war buildings, and divine kingdom Resources are among the absolute top tier across all demigods.”
“Not to mention ordinary students, even among those senior Peerless Prodigies, very few dare to actually go in and challenge them.”
Speaking to the end, Gu Le’s eyes even turned a bit red.
There is still more than a year until graduation now.
If Yang Fan really couldn’t match them, she wouldn’t even know how he could endure the remaining time.
However, Yang Fan just smiled.
“I’m already steady enough; being any steadier would just be a waste of time.”
“Rest assured, it probably won’t be long before I achieve a Breakthrough to a god.”
“Tell my father-in-law and mother-in-law later, let them not worry.”
Finishing his words, Yang Fan walked straight into the room, and the door slowly closed.
Gu Le looked at the tightly closed door and couldn’t help gritting her teeth.
“Bastard.”
“Every single time.”
“Don’t you know I worry about you?”

chapters.title: Chapter 286: A Somewhat Different Monkey
paragraphs: Inside the divine kingdom, war mobilization had already been completed.
Looking as far as the eye could see, the space between heaven and earth was filled with a dense, black mass of figures.
Millions of Martial Master legions stood at the very front, clad in battle armor and holding weapons.
A chilling aura of slaughter soared into the sky.
Behind them, tens of millions of Second-class Intelligent Life formed a torrent of steel.
Mechanical battle armor gleamed with a cold light, and dense arrays of gun barrels were all primed and ready.
Even further back was an even larger legion of Foundation Establishment Cultivators.
Spiritual Qi surged, and Magical Artifacts hovered in the air.
At the very rear of the army, vast ranks of Elven Warriors drew their bows and nocked arrows, resembling a green ocean.
Just the vanguard army alone exceeded one hundred million in number.
As for the Corpse Cultivator kingdom and war weapons, they had not even been deployed yet.
“Master, after obtaining the coordinates, I have already arranged for Ling Xuzi to conduct reconnaissance first.”
“Should we...”
Before Yang Da could finish speaking, he was directly interrupted by Yang Fan.
“Have the entire vanguard army enter the enemy’s divine kingdom.”
“Also, notify Yang Er to lead the Outworld Collectors and follow behind.”
“The offensive and the land reclamation will proceed simultaneously.”
Yang Da was somewhat surprised; why had his master suddenly become so brave?
“Yes!”
As the divine kingdom passage opened, the mighty army poured into the Alien Divine Kingdom.
Through his believers’ perspective, Yang Fan also saw the Vajra King Monkey demigod’s divine kingdom clearly for the first time.
What met his eyes was a boundless green ocean.
Towering ancient trees blotted out the sun, and a rich aura of life rushed over him.
Looking as far as the eye could see, almost no bare ground was visible.
The entire world seemed completely covered by forest.
In the center of the divine kingdom, an unimaginable ancient tree pierced straight into the sky.
It seemed to connect heaven and earth, its trunk so thick that its edges could not be seen at a single glance.
Countless branches stretched out in all directions, forming a massive canopy that blanketed the entire world.
As a gentle breeze blew, countless leaves swayed gently.
Seen from afar, it looked as if dense swarms of ants were crawling on the canopy.
But Yang Fan could see very clearly that those were not ants at all, but active monkey-race believers.
It was only because the distance was too great that it created a visual illusion.
Without a doubt, this ancient tree was by no means an ordinary plant, but an extremely special divine kingdom building.
For the monkey-race believers living on the ancient tree, their living space was increased by at least two-thirds.
“What a good item...”
Yang Fan could not help but lick his lips.
If this kind of building could be moved back to his divine kingdom, its value would be absolutely immeasurable.
Just then, the distant forest suddenly shook violently.
A legion of demon monkeys was rapidly approaching.
These Vajra King Monkeys had extremely exaggerated builds, each standing over thirty meters tall like a moving building.
Their muscles bulged high, and their skin gleamed with a metallic luster.
With every leap, the massive tree trunks emitted an overburdened creaking sound.
However, seeing this, Yang Fan frowned slightly.
Too weak!
Their number was only ten thousand, and their strength was merely that of Tier 5 Beings.
With the other party’s capabilities as a demigod, it was impossible for him not to detect the scale of Yang Fan’s vanguard army.
Sending this kind of force to intercept them was completely meaningless.
Yet strangely, there was not a trace of fear on the faces of these demon monkeys.
Instead, their eyes were cold, and they looked ready to face death.
Just then, the sky and earth suddenly darkened.
A phantom that blotted out the sun slowly emerged.
It was a terrifying demon monkey standing tens of millions of feet tall, with divine light flowing around its body.
Just by appearing, it seemed to suppress the entire world.
Its appearance was identical to a Vajra King Monkey, and it was none other than the master of this divine kingdom.
The Vajra King Monkey Demigod!
“Human Race Genius—”
“Why not show yourself!”
The mighty divine voice resounded through heaven and earth, and countless trees shook frantically.
The entire divine kingdom trembled slightly.
Hearing this, Yang Fan did not hesitate in the slightest.
His consciousness instantly descended into the opponent’s divine kingdom along the spatial passage.
Boom—
Divine light gathered, and a majestic phantom slowly appeared between heaven and earth.
Seeing Yang Fan appear,
the tens of millions of feet tall demon monkey phantom, far from showing any hostility, instead revealed an extremely bright smile.
“Uh, no.”
“I should say, this monkey.”
The demon monkey scratched his head. Having apparently not communicated with outsiders for a long time, his speech was somewhat rusty.
“Translated into the language of your Human Race,”
“my name should be Qi Tian.”
“Nice to meet you.”
After speaking, he even imitated Human Race etiquette and solemnly extended his right hand.
Yang Fan stood in place without moving, but a flash of surprise crossed his eyes.
“What do you mean?”
“Ahem.”
Qi Tian coughed dryly and withdrew his hand somewhat awkwardly.
Then, his expression gradually turned serious.
“I want to make a deal with you.”
“A deal?”
Yang Fan raised an eyebrow slightly.
He had already fought his way inside the opponent’s divine kingdom, yet the first thing the opponent did was not declare war, but talk about a deal.
This was the first time he had ever encountered such a situation.
The monkey in front of him seemed somewhat different from what he had imagined.
“Exactly.”
Qi Tian nodded.
“You are so young, yet your believers possess such strength.”
“Your status within the Human Race must not be low.”
“I hope you can pull some strings for me to see if your Human Race higher-ups can let me out.”
“As compensation, all of these things can be given to you.”
Snap!
Qi Tian lightly snapped his fingers.
Below, a demon monkey believer immediately ran out carrying a strange device.
As the device started up, a huge light screen appeared in the sky.
And the images on the light screen made even Yang Fan’s eyes flicker slightly.
It was a vast, boundless complex of buildings.
Dense clusters of A-Rank Buildings were piled up like mountains.
War types, resource types, auxiliary types—they had everything.
With just a single glance, the quantity already exceeded a million.
There were even many buildings among them that even Yang Fan could not name.
In addition, he also saw Great Void Warships, Mechanical War Puppets, and several S-Rank Buildings emitting terrifying fluctuations.
Even through the light screen, those buildings still made one feel their extraordinary nature.
“These are just the stock that hasn’t been loaded yet,”
Qi Tian quickly added:
“Aside from these, there are also a large number of already loaded resource buildings within my divine kingdom.”
“Spiritual Veins, spiritual springs, herb gardens, and mines.”
“As long as you can let me out, they will all belong to you too.”
“These are all the savings I’ve accumulated over thousands of years. Most of them came from your Human Race Prodigies, so they will definitely be of no small help to you.”
By the end, Qi Tian’s gaze was locked onto Yang Fan, his eyes actually carrying a bit of nervousness.
As if he was terrified that Yang Fan would refuse.
In fact, he was truly going crazy.
Qi Tian was strong, extremely strong.
At least in the demigod stage, he had always believed himself to be invincible among his peers.
Even within the Vajra King Monkey race, his talent was of the absolute highest tier.
Yet, so what if he was strong?
Today, he was still nothing but a prisoner.

chapters.title: Chapter 287: Finally No Longer Cautious
paragraphs: In the Real World, over three thousand years had passed, while inside the divine kingdom, a million years had slipped away.
It was despairingly long.
His divine kingdom had long since developed to its limit. He only needed the Fusion of the Divine Kingdom Core to achieve a Breakthrough to a deity.
Yet he dared not, because once he made the Breakthrough,
what awaited him could not possibly be freedom, but rather death at the hands of Human Race deities.
Over the years, he had acquired countless wealth and plundered the divine kingdom Resources of numerous Human Race Prodigies.
Yet those things were ultimately lifeless objects.
He had always been imprisoned here, utterly devoid of freedom and completely cut off from the outside world.
At the very beginning, Human Race Geniuses would enter here almost every year.
Later, it gradually became one every few years, then one every few decades.
Even later, not a single living person could be seen for hundreds of years.
During those long years, Qitian could only chat with his believers to pass the time.
Sometimes he even talked to trees.
Now, having finally managed to see a newcomer,
even though the other party was an enemy, he felt an extraordinary sense of familiarity.
“You want freedom?”
Yang Fan suddenly smiled.
“That’s right!”
Qitian’s eyes instantly lit up.
“As long as you can let me leave this place,”
“I’m willing to give you anything!”
“Divine kingdom Resources, military buildings, S-Rank Buildings, or even the most core supreme treasure of my divine kingdom can be yours!”
“As long as I can be free!”
By the end, Qitian’s voice had grown somewhat agitated.
In fact, the very moment he obtained Yang Fan’s divine kingdom coordinates,
his consciousness had already peeked through the spatial passageway.
And that single glance had completely shocked him.
The Immortal Qi that was so dense it was nearly liquefied, along with the sky-shrouding Resource buildings, completely shattered his worldview.
Qitian instantly determined that this Human Race before him
was undoubtedly the Genius with the highest status and deepest background he had seen in these three thousand years.
Therefore, instead of sending out believers to attack, he patiently waited for Yang Fan to manifest.
Because three thousand years of imprisonment had long since made him understand one principle:
What divine kingdom Resources, what racial hatred, what glory and dignity—
they were utterly worthless in the face of freedom.
If he could leave this place, he was willing to forsake everything he owned.
Even all the wealth within his divine kingdom, even all the foundations accumulated over these thousands of years.
Watching Qitian’s excitement border on madness,
Yang Fan slowly shook his head.
“You might have gotten one thing wrong.”
Qitian slightly frowned, “What thing?”
Yang Fan looked up at the light screen in the sky, his gaze calm.
“Those things you just showed me were originally mine to begin with.”
“Since that’s the case, how can you use them to trade with me?”
As soon as these words came out, the smile on Qitian’s face instantly froze.
“What do you mean?”
“The meaning is very simple.”
A flash of sharpness crossed Yang Fan’s eyes.
“Let me see your strength.”
As his voice fell, the Human Race legions below raised their weapons in unison.
Countless spiritual energy began to converge, and a terrifying aura of slaughter soared into the sky.
Seeing this scene, Qitian’s expression turned completely cold.
“Junior.”
“I admit your divine kingdom foundation is not weak.”
“But you must understand, there is a full three thousand years and more between us.”
“My believers reached their limit hundreds of thousands of years ago.”
“And what about you? You’re probably not even a hundred years old yet, right?”
Yang Fan smiled slightly, “Twenty-one.”
The air suddenly quieted for a moment, and the corners of Qitian’s eyes twitched fiercely.
Twenty-one years old?
So honest!
A mere twenty-one-year-old Human Demigod actually dared to come challenge him?
After taking a deep breath, Qitian forcefully suppressed the shock in his heart.
“If you are willing to help me leave this place, I will naturally reward you handsomely.”
“Do not court death.”
The voice already carried a trace of threat.
However, Yang Fan only gently shook his head.
“Not to mention whether I can do it or not,”
“Even if I could do it, you are not qualified to trade with me.”
“Start the war.”
Boom——
As the voice fell, Yang Fan’s divine phantom instantly dissipated.
At the same time, over a hundred million vanguard troops began to advance.
Dozens of spiritual energy cannonballs fell first.
Accompanied by heaven-shaking roars, the more than ten thousand demonic monkeys in front were directly blown into a sky full of blood mist.
Seeing this scene, Qitian let out a cold snort, and his divine phantom also disappeared.
Inside the Divine Kingdom Core, he slowly opened his eyes, looking toward the direction of the battlefield with a cold gaze.
“Since we can’t talk things out, let’s fight a battle first.”
“I’d like to see, when I fight my way to your Divine Kingdom Core,”
“whether you can still be as tough as you are right now.”
On the other side, Yang Fan’s consciousness had returned to the divine kingdom.
“Continue mobilizing troops, and throw all the recently purchased military buildings into the battlefield.”
“For this battle, I want to see absolute domination.”
Yang Fan’s voice was calm, yet it carried an unquestionable meaning.
“Yes!”
Yang Da’s expression was spirited, and he was even faintly excited.
Finally.
Their master was finally no longer keeping a low profile.
Accompanied by one command after another being issued,
the entire divine kingdom began to operate completely.
Billions of Qi Refining Cultivators, Martial Apprentices, and first-class Intelligent Life began assembling toward The Frontline.
In the sky, one Great Void Warship after another soared into the air.
War-type Intelligent Life such as Yang Four through Yang Ten personally led their armies to rush toward The Frontline.
At the same time, deep within the Eternal Corpse Mine,
the ground slowly split open, and massive flesh-and-blood spheres thousands of meters in diameter were slowly pushed out.
The six flesh disaster hives opened, and densely packed figures walked inside.
Corpse Qi soared into the sky, and every single one of them was at the Zombie King level.
At the lead, Yang Eleven stood upon the high platform, coldly scanning the crowd below.
“This is your first battle.”
“The enemy is the Vajra King Monkey clan.”
“Remember, your mission is not to kill them all.”
“Instead, it is to injure them.”
“Let the corpse poison spread, let the virus permeate the entire divine kingdom.”
“Weaken all of their living forces.”
“Understood?”
“Understood!” Countless Zombie Kings roared simultaneously, their voices shaking the heaven and earth.
Their eyes were filled with fanaticism.
Having been locked inside the Eternal Corpse Mine for so many years, they had finally welcomed the opportunity to campaign for a deity.
Feeling the various legions within the divine kingdom begin to operate,
Yang Fan nodded with satisfaction.
Afterwards, his consciousness exited the divine kingdom, and he pushed open the door to walk out.
“Le’er, what are we eating tonight?”
Gu Le was originally anxiously guarding outside the door.
Hearing those words, her expression instantly darkened.
“Eat, eat, eat!”
“All you know is eating!”
“What time do you think it is?!”
“Father just sent a message telling you to go to the Virtual World immediately!”
Yang Fan smiled, stepped forward, and pinched Gu Chengye’s chubby little face.
“Don’t worry, it’s no big deal.”
“It will be resolved soon.”
In fact, the area of the divine kingdom was too massive, and mobilizing a large army also required time.
Even in a war of absolute domination,
from the official start of the war to its complete end, at least three to four decades would pass within the divine kingdom.
Converted to Real World time, it would also take more than a month.
Seeing Yang Fan’s light and breezy appearance, the tension in Gu Le’s heart eased somewhat.
It was just that she still couldn’t quite figure it out.
That was an Alien Demigod in the Tier 3 area, a universally recognized restricted zone of the Primordial Academy that even the Peerless Prodigies of the senior year didn’t dare to easily challenge.
Where on earth did Yang Fan’s confidence come from?

chapters.title: Chapter 288: Driving Straight In
paragraphs: “Husband, Father asked you to go over because he wants to help you!”
“Stop thinking about eating!”
“Hurry up and go!”
Gu Le urged.
Upon hearing this, Yang Fan couldn’t help but chuckle.
It was obvious that his wife had gone to squeeze some benefits out of his father-in-law for him again.
Unable to refuse her, he had no choice but to put on his virtual helmet and enter the Gu Family Territory with his consciousness.
Gu Family Territory.
In the courtyard, Gu Xuanting was sitting by a stone table, leisurely sipping tea.
His expression was calm, lacking any of the nervousness Gu Le had shown.
Seeing Yang Fan arrive, Gu Xuanting set down his teacup.
“Greetings, Father.” Yang Fan bowed with cupped hands.
“Sit.” Gu Xuanting nodded.
After Yang Fan sat down, he spoke slowly.
“How many chances of success do you have against the Alien Demigod in the Level 3 zone?”
“About seventy percent.” Yang Fan’s expression remained unchanged.
“Seventy percent, you say?”
Gu Xuanting nodded slightly.
“That is not low at all.”
“It seems that even if you cannot win, defending your divine kingdom should not be a problem.”
“I have caused you worry, Father.”
Yang Fan said with a smile.
Upon hearing this, Gu Xuanting shook his head.
“What do I have to worry about?”
“After all, I am a High-Order God, and having lived for so many years, I still have an eye for people.”
“Over this past year, every time I see you, your aura has grown stronger.”
“Although you are only a third-year student now, your true strength likely already surpasses many fourth-year peerless prodigies.”
“So, I was not surprised to hear that you are challenging the Level 3 zone.”
Having said this, Gu Xuanting suddenly revealed a hint of helplessness.
“However, that girl Gu Le was quite frightened by you.”
“She has been pestering me ever since she received the news.”
“She almost tore down my courtyard gate.”
Thinking of this, Gu Xuanting couldn’t help but rub his brow.
He and Lu Qinglan had married too late.
After long years, they only had one daughter, Gu Le.
She had been spoiled since childhood; previously, she was just whimsical and liked to play little tricks.
But now that she was married, things had changed.
She kept running back every few days to fleece her old father.
Yet, he really couldn’t bear to refuse her.
Thinking of this, Gu Xuanting couldn’t help but laugh himself, then raised his hand to take out a card.
“Take this.”
Yang Fan looked down and saw that the card contained two Great Void Warships.
“This is?”
“My personal sponsorship.”
Gu Xuanting waved his hand.
“It is not an investment from the Gu Family.”
“Your divine kingdom has a large number of Intelligent Life, and the Great Void Warships are just right for them.”
“It should increase your chances of winning a bit.”
Yang Fan’s face immediately broke into a smile, “Thank you, Father.”
“That is enough.”
Gu Xuanting waved his hand.
“Go back.”
“If you really cannot win, just drag it out until you graduate in your fourth year.”
“In the future, do not let Gu Le worry so much.”
“Yes.”
Yang Fan bowed respectfully, then exited the Virtual World.
Watching his departing back, Gu Xuanting suddenly stroked his chin, a hint of doubt appearing in his eyes.
“That is not right...”
“Two Great Void Warships, why does this kid not seem excited at all?”
“Could I have misjudged him?”
Gu Xuanting frowned slightly.
Logically speaking, even a Peerless Prodigy would covet such war constructs.
Yet, looking at Yang Fan’s reaction just now, it seemed as if he had just received an ordinary gift.
Thinking of this, Gu Xuanting shook his head.
He just assumed he was overthinking it.
That night.
Yang Fan entered his divine kingdom again.
At this moment, the number of troops that had entered the Vajra King Monkey divine kingdom had exceeded twenty billion.
On the other side.
In the core area of the Vajra King Monkey divine kingdom, Qi Tian’s expression had long lost its initial composure, and was even faintly pale.
“How is it possible...”
“How could this be...”
Qi Tian stared fixedly at the images transmitted from the front line.
His body was trembling slightly.
“Twenty-one years old...”
“How could such a foundation appear in a twenty-one-year-old Demi-god?”
“Fake!”
“It must be fake!”
“This guy is not a student at all!”
“He must be some old guy from the Human Race who has lived for thousands of years in disguise!”
Countless thoughts flashed through Qi Tian’s mind, and the more he thought about it, the more reasonable it seemed.
Gods cannot directly attack Demi-gods.
But he had killed too many Human Race Prodigies over these years.
If some high-level Human Race figures had secretly arranged for a monster to come and take his Divine Kingdom Core, it would seem plausible.
Thinking of this, Qi Tian’s eyes gradually became serious.
Then he stood up abruptly, and a vast Divine Decree instantly spread throughout the entire divine kingdom.
“My kin, heed my command! A powerful Human Race enemy is attacking!”
“This battle concerns the survival of our race!”
“All adult clansmen, assemble immediately!”
“Stop Cultivating! Stop production! Pick up your weapons! Build a defensive line!”
“Advance to the outer perimeter of the divine kingdom!”
“Anyone who retreats, execute!”
“Anyone who fears battle, execute!”
“Anyone who performs meritorious service, heavy rewards!”
Boom—
The Divine Decree descended, and the entire Monkey race divine kingdom was in a complete uproar.
Countless Demon Monkey Army members rushed out of their treehouses and frantically gathered towards the battlefield.
But Qi Tian’s expression grew even uglier.
Because in just half a year, Yang Fan’s army had already advanced through a quarter of his divine kingdom’s territory, almost unimpeded.
Only now did Qi Tian faintly feel a trace of regret.
It had been too long.
It had really been too long since he had experienced a Divine Kingdom War.
For hundreds of thousands of years, his divine kingdom had always been in an absolutely safe state.
His powerful strength had caused him to gradually lose his sense of crisis.
He had not deployed heavy troops in the outer areas at all.
Now that the enemy army had driven straight in, he had lost many opportunities to intercept them.
Soon, the armies of both sides officially clashed.
Rumble—
The forest shook violently.
Vajra King Monkeys leaped from the treetops.
They were dozens of meters tall, with muscles knotted all over their bodies.
Their skin shimmered with a faint golden light, as if cast from steel.
Bang!
A psionic shell hit squarely, and the explosion sent flames into the sky.
However, after the smoke cleared, that Qi Refining Realm Vajra King Monkey only had a charred chest and did not die on the spot.
Such defensive power shocked even Yang Four.
At the same time, these Demon Monkey Army members utilized the forest environment to the extreme.
Each towering ancient tree became a natural cover.
They leaped continuously using the treetops, flickering in and out of sight.
Making it difficult for long-range firepower to lock onto them.
For a time, even with Martial Arts believers responsible for defense, Cultivation believers casting spells from a distance, and Intelligent Life firing wildly.
The speed of advancement still slowed down significantly.
However, soon, the Elven Warriors legion began to take action.
This forest was also suitable for Elven Warriorss to fight in.
Between the treetops, green figures moved quickly, like ghosts.
Swish—
Arrows pierced the air.
A Foundation Establishment Realm Vajra King Monkey just poked its body out, and its forehead instantly exploded, its massive body crashing down.
Swish! Swish! Swish!
As the rain of arrows continued to fall.
More and more Demon Monkey Army members fell into pools of blood.
Those Elven Warriorss were like hunters hidden in the darkness.
Every time they drew their bows, it meant a life vanished.
Gradually, the Demon Monkey Army didn’t even dare to show their heads easily.
Qi Tian had also dispatched elite shock troops in an attempt to decapitate the leadership.
But as soon as they approached, they were blocked by a large number of Martial Master legions, and no matter how they charged, they could not advance even a step further.

chapters.title: Chapter 289: Thorny Jungle
paragraphs: Thus, a bizarre scene appeared on the battlefield.
Although Yang Fan’s army advanced slowly, it suffered almost no major casualties.
Instead, the demon monkey legion kept falling, and large piles of corpses accumulated in the forest.
At the rear of the battlefield, Yang Er led the alien collectors closely behind.
While advancing, he skillfully packed up the loot.
As soon as those demon monkey corpses fell, they were quickly transported away.
The whole process was smooth and flowing, as if it had been rehearsed countless times.
“My God, those aliens are too strong, what should we do?”
At the Divine Kingdom Core, a Vajra King Monkey at the Foundation Establishment Realm knelt on the ground with an anxious face.
Qitian swept his gaze across the battlefield and slowly spoke after a moment.
“Next is the thorny jungle, which is a special Spirit Plant I planted myself millions of years ago.”
“After growing through long years, it has long become the most powerful natural defense line of the Divine Kingdom.”
“Pass down my Divine Decree, all believers retreat immediately, do not make meaningless sacrifices.”
“Lure them into the thorny jungle.”
“Yes, my God!”
Meanwhile, on the other side of the Alien Divine Kingdom.
Six huge flesh disaster hives were moving slowly.
Each one was like a living mountain of flesh, writhing constantly, emitting a disgusting rotting aura.
Whenever a Vajra King Monkey appeared, several Zombie Kings would jump out from the flesh disaster hive.
They never fought head-on, but tried every means to create wounds.
Scratching, biting, tearing flesh.
Then they deliberately let the opponent leave.
As if they didn’t care about the prey escaping at all.
Yang Eleven stood on top of a flesh disaster hive, looking at those panicked and fleeing demon monkeys, the corners of his mouth slowly rising.
“Run as far as you can.”
“It is best to run through the entire Divine Kingdom.”
“The virus concentration in the Zombie King is not something ordinary zombies can compare to.”
“The water you have drunk, the places you have relieved yourselves, will all become new sources of infection.”
A Zombie King below finally couldn’t help asking:
“General, this efficiency is too low.”
“Why not let us go to The Frontline?”
“We might not necessarily lose to those Cultivation believers.”
Hearing this, Yang Eleven glanced at him coldly.
“You idiot, it is precisely because the opponent’s main force is pinned down.”
“That we can spread the virus unscrupulously.”
“If the opponent’s deity discovers our existence in advance, they will definitely block the source of infection at all costs.”
“What we want is not just one infection spot, but blossoming everywhere.”
“The more infection points there are, the harder it is for the opponent to control.”
“By the time they react, the entire Divine Kingdom will already be incurably ill.”
“Yes, General!”
Numerous Zombie Kings lowered their heads together.
In fact, for thousands of years, Yang Eleven had always lived with them.
Teaching Formations, guiding Cultivate, formulating training plans, and helping them grow step by step.
Although in essence they were still Intelligent Life.
But this unreserved dedication had long won the recognition and respect of all Zombie Kings.
After meditating for a moment, Yang Eleven suddenly nodded.
“However, what you said makes sense.”
“The efficiency is indeed a bit low.”
The next moment, a new order spread through the six flesh disaster hives.
“Pass down the order, all troops are divided into six routes.”
“There is only one task, spread the virus.”
“Let them go immediately after biting.”
“Meet a river, cut off a piece of flesh and throw it in.”
“Meet a lake, go in and soak a circle before coming out.”
“Meet a main road, all of you come down and spit a few more mouthfuls of saliva.”
“If you see a group of monkeys, remember to protect them well.”
“Don’t kill them, just scatter them, every monkey must carry some injuries on its body.”
As soon as these words were spoken, the eyes of the many Zombie Kings instantly lit up.
“As you command!”
Soon, the six flesh disaster hives began to disperse and act.
Like six spreading plague sources, they constantly spread in all directions of the Divine Kingdom.
Yang Eleven looked at the fleeing demon monkeys in the distance, his eyes becoming more and more excited.
“Deity of the Alien Divine Kingdom... you must discover it a little later.”
“In this way, the first merit of this battle will be mine.”
Meanwhile, Yang Fan was sitting in his own Divine Kingdom, leisurely watching the battle situation at The Frontline.
Through the perspective of believers, the entire battlefield was like a real-time broadcast war movie.
Beside him, Ling Xuzi knelt on one knee, carefully pouring tea for Yang Fan.
“Master, the tea temperature is just right.”
“Hmm.”
Yang Fan took the teacup, took a light sip, and then said indifferently:
“When this battle ends, I will bestow a Divine Kingdom Core.”
“To help you make a Breakthrough to a deity as soon as possible.”
Hearing this, Ling Xuzi trembled all over and hurriedly knelt on the ground.
“Master, absolutely not! Your subordinate did not make great achievements in this exploration.”
“There are very few traps inside this Vajra King Monkey Divine Kingdom, and its strength entirely stems from its own foundation.”
“The intelligence brought back by the Void Spirit Race is limited.”
Yang Fan waved his hand.
“It doesn’t matter, I Cultivate you precisely for the future.”
“Now your value has been reflected.”
“When I make a Breakthrough to a deity, the enemies I face will also be deities.”
“By then I will still need a stronger you.”
Hearing this, Ling Xuzi was so moved that his tail trembled slightly.
“Your subordinate will surely give his all.”
“Until death do us part!”
Inside the Alien Divine Kingdom, the army at The Frontline suddenly stopped.
A Void Spirit Race believer quickly appeared and knelt on one knee.
“General! An abnormal area was discovered ahead!”
“One of my clansmen once tried to cross the dense forest.”
“As soon as he appeared, countless thorns attacked as if they came alive.”
“After his body was stabbed, in just a few breaths, his flesh began to rot and finally turned into a puddle of pus and blood.”
“Those plants are extremely poisonous!”
After hearing the report, Yang Four gently snapped his fingers.
A large number of detection flying machines immediately soared into the sky.
A moment later, complete data was transmitted back.
Yang Four glanced at it, the corners of his mouth slightly rising.
“Thorny jungle, I see.”
“I didn’t expect such a large scale to have been cultivated.”
Afterwards, he immediately sent an application to the rear.
“My Lord, I apply to mobilize ten Mechanical War Puppets and two Great Void Warships.”
Almost instantly, Yang Da’s voice came over.
“Granted.”
After obtaining permission, the ground began to vibrate violently.
Rumble— —
Ten Mechanical War Puppets standing a thousand zhang tall slowly descended onto the battlefield.
The steel bodies covered the sky and blocked the sun.
Every step down made the ground tremble violently.
At the same time, two Great Void Warships thousands of meters long slowly descended from the clouds.
Hovering on both sides of the army.
Countless Intelligent Life transformed into streams of light and frantically poured into them.
The next moment, the Mechanical War Puppets took a step forward first.
Boom!
Boom!
Boom!
The huge steel soles directly stepped into the thorny jungle, and countless poisonous vines and thorns along the way were crushed into fragments.
The two Great Void Warships also set off.
“Formation conversion!”
“All Intelligent Life push to the very front, and the remaining believers advance in the center to avoid being injured by the vegetation here!”
Yang Four ordered in a deep voice.
Intelligent Life were originally Mechanical bodies.
Not to mention poison, even ordinary corrosive power could hardly affect them.
It couldn’t be more appropriate to use them to clear the way at this moment.
“Yang Yi, prepare one hundred thousand detoxification pills in advance and send them to The Frontline.”
“The army is too large, to prevent high-level believers from accidental injuries.”
“Understood, the Alchemy Tower has already started stocking up.” Inside the Heavenly Court, Yang Yi responded immediately.
