chapters.title: Chapter 290: Utterly Shameless
paragraphs: As the command was issued, ten Mechanical War Puppets took the lead and stepped forward.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
Their massive steel bodies suddenly transformed, limbs retracting and armor closing.
In the blink of an eye, they turned into ten giant steel spheres hundreds of zhang in diameter, then rolled all the way to crush the thorny jungle.
Wherever they passed, countless poisonous vines and thorns were forcefully crushed into dust.
High above in the sky, two Great Void Warships moved forward slowly.
They did not fire their main cannons, but instead opened the lower thrusters.
Monstrous flames swept out, and large patches of surviving thorns were burned to ashes.
In just a few hours, the thorny jungle, known as the strongest defense line of the divine kingdom, was more than ninety percent destroyed.
Those Vajra King Monkeys hidden in the dark could finally no longer sit still.
Attack after attack crashed down, yet when hitting the Mechanical War Puppets, it could only spark a few minor flames.
Let alone destroying them, it could not even slow down their advancing speed.
The most powerful defense line in the words of the deity.
Actually failed to play even the slightest role.
Instead, it caused Yang Fan’s army’s advance speed to surge several-fold.
At the Divine Kingdom Core, Qitian looked at the scene of The Frontline through the believers’ perspective, collapsing directly onto his throne.
“How is this possible...”
“Twelve war-type S-Rank Buildings!”
“How could a demigod possibly possess such a foundation!”
Qitian’s eyes widened, and his voice was slightly trembling.
“Human Race...”
“You are cheating!”
“Imprisoning me here for thousands of years is not enough, and now you even bring out this kind of foundation!”
At this moment, he became more and more certain.
Yang Fan was definitely not some ordinary student.
But an existence specially sent by the higher-ups of the Human Race to reap him.
Right at this moment, a Foundation Establishment Realm Vajra King Monkey stumbled into the main hall.
“My God! I have an important situation to report!”
“What is it?”
Qitian spoke irritably.
“Recently, many clansmen have experienced physical abnormalities after drinking water.”
“Their skin is unbearably itchy.”
“Even some Foundation Establishment Realm clansmen have appeared with the same situation.”
Hearing this, Qitian was instantly furious.
“Itchy?”
“The Frontline is almost unable to be defended, and you ran over to tell me it’s itchy?”
“If it is uncomfortable, pick up your weapon and go to the battlefield!”
“Get out!”
“Yes... My God...”
That believer hurriedly retreated.
However, the next moment, Qitian suddenly froze.
“That’s not right!”
“How could the Foundation Establishment Realm inexplicably develop such symptoms?”
“The water is problematic!”
Thinking of this, Qitian’s expression changed drastically.
His Divine Sense instantly covered the entire divine kingdom.
In just a moment, his face turned completely pale.
In the rivers, a large amount of rotting flesh and blood was slowly floating.
And at the edge of the divine kingdom, six massive flesh disaster hives were constantly pushing forward.
A large number of Zombie Kings scattered in all directions, scratching and releasing the monkey groups whenever they encountered them.
Throwing flesh and blood into rivers whenever they met them, and even some water sources were specially “taken care of”.
Seeing this scene, Qitian trembled all over with anger.
“Shameless!”
“Utterly shameless!”
“Human Demigod! You actually released the zombie virus!”
“Do you have any demeanor of an expert left!”
However, after the angry curse, Qitian slowly took a step back, collapsing weakly to the ground, despair emerging in his eyes for the first time.
Zombie King, it was actually a virus of Zombie King level.
And it was discovered too late; now nearly thirty percent of the believers in the divine kingdom had been infected.
Among them, it even included a large number of Foundation Establishment Realm experts.
What made him most despairing was that he was completely unable to connect to the network to purchase antidote potions.
These believers could no longer be saved.
After a long silence, a fierce look flashed in Qitian’s eyes.
Since they couldn’t be saved, then squeeze out their last bit of value!
The next moment, a mighty Divine Decree spread across the entire divine kingdom.
“My people!”
“From now on, all believers are forbidden from drinking any river water sources in the central region!”
“Those with bodily abnormalities must immediately stop to Cultivate! Report to military camps everywhere!”
“Join The Frontline legion!”
“Fight for the divine kingdom!”
“Fight for the race!”
“War and slaughter can delay the spread of symptoms.”
“All infected individuals are incorporated into the vanguard army; without permission, no one is allowed to retreat!”
As the Divine Decree fell, countless Vajra King Monkeys knelt on the ground one after another.
And Qitian slowly closed his eyes. Since these infected individuals were destined not to survive, they would all be sent to the battlefield.
Even if he had to pile them up with corpses, he had to drag down the pace of Yang Fan’s army’s advance.
Countless Vajra King Monkeys poured out from the Divine Kingdom Core area.
Under the command of the high-tier king monkeys, hundreds of millions of demon monkeys quickly formed a battle array, resembling a black torrent meeting Yang Fan’s army head-on.
At the beginning of the battle array’s formation, it still had some order.
However, under the crushing of the Great Void Warships and Mechanical War Puppets, these so-called military arrays appeared exceptionally fragile.
The giant steel war puppets rampaged wildly, resembling moving war fortresses.
The Great Void Warship hovered high in the sky. Before the artillery fire arrived, mere energy pressure caused the formation to continuously collapse.
The demon monkey legion could only barely slow down the advance speed, but could never inflict effective casualties.
Soon, the battlefield situation on The Frontline began to change.
The movements of those Vajra King Monkeys gradually began to show stagnation.
Their eyes became chaotic and irritable, and they even began indiscriminate attacks on their fellow clansmen around them.
The formation collapsed, and the battle line disintegrated.
The situation of mutual slaughter rapidly spread.
As the marshal of the entire war, Yang Four detected the source of the abnormality at the first moment, “Infection spread is accelerating.”
He didn’t have any hesitation.
“All war weapons, execute indiscriminate sweeping.”
“All infected targets are listed in the priority elimination sequence.”
In his view, these Vajra King Monkeys eroded by the zombie virus had essentially degenerated into high-combat-power out-of-control units.
If not cleared in time, once they approached his own believers, it would only cause a larger-scale infection.
Rather than wasting detoxification resources, it was better to directly erase them.
Looking at the large area of chaotic, collapsing, and mutually slaughtering demon monkey legion on The Frontline, a trace of ease even arose in Yang Four’s heart.
This war was even smoother than expected.
It could even be said... overly smooth.
He silently gave Yang Eleven a thumbs-up in his heart.
As the army continued to penetrate deeper, the life aura of the divine kingdom became increasingly rich.
The surrounding vegetation began to reveal a weird “activity”.
Originally ordinary trees and vines now appeared as if they possessed consciousness.
The vines expanded wildly, entangling the limbs of the Mechanical War Puppets, attempting to forcibly restrict their actions.
Even giant ancient vines rose from the ground, growing to thousands of meters high in the sky, coiling toward the Great Void Warship like giant pythons, attempting to drag it down from the sky.
Yang Fan observed all this through the believers’ perspective, a trace of surprise flashing in his eyes, “Yang Da, what is this?”
“Reporting to Master, it should be an S-Rank defensive building, life-system branch.”
“Specific information can only be parsed and compared after bringing it back to the divine kingdom.”
Yang Da quickly responded.
“Defensive S-Rank Building?” Yang Fan chuckled lightly, but a hint of interest grew deep in his eyes.
“As expected of an Alien Demigod in the tier-3 area, the foundation is indeed not bad.”
He slightly raised his hand.
“In the next Dark Web auction, focus on filtering S-Rank defensive buildings.”
“Our divine kingdom also needs to make up for this kind of shortcoming.”
“Yes, Master.”
Yang Da immediately acknowledged.
Only he couldn’t help muttering inwardly.
With the current divine kingdom’s combat power, who the hell needs it! It’s clearly just having too much money with nowhere to spend it!

chapters.title: Chapter 291: This Is Impossible
paragraphs: As the infected Vajra King Monkeys died off continuously, the battle line pushed forward.
The closer they got to the Divine Kingdom Core, the stronger the resistance became.
A large number of Vajra King Monkeys at the Foundation Establishment Realm began entering the battlefield.
They were tall and massive, with muscles and bones like iron; their sheer Physical Body strength alone was enough to tear rocks apart.
Their defense was even more astonishing; except for war weapons, ordinary Spells could barely break through their armor.
Even Spell bombardments released by Foundation Establishment Cultivators could only trigger faint ripples on their skin.
Only coordinated Formations firepower and long-range arrows from the Elven Warriorss posed a truly lethal threat to them.
Yang Fan watched this scene quietly, a faint trace of envy flashing in his eyes.
This pure combat-type racial talent was indeed absurdly strong.
Among the Geniuses he had seen, only Ma Huainan’s SS-rank Martial God Body could contend with it head-on.
“No wonder so few people dare to mess with the Alien Demigods in the level-three area.”
Yang Fan spoke in a calm tone.
“If it were a head-on clash relying purely on believers, even I might not win.”
The reason he could completely crush the opponent now was entirely due to a massive number of S-Class war weapons—put simply, throwing money at the problem.
It was as if the enemy was still an agrarian civilization while he was already holding a Gatling gun.
Even if the enemy were all special forces, they were no match for his ordinary believers under such firepower.
“Yang Da, order Yang Four to elevate war authorization and end this Divine Kingdom War as quickly as possible!” Yang Fan said indifferently.
“Yes, Master.”
Yang Da immediately synchronized the order to The Frontline.
At this moment, on The Frontline battlefield.
Yang Four stood in the command center, his cold gaze sweeping across the endless ocean of Vajra King Monkeys, a chilly murderous intent rising in his eyes.
“Deploy ten more Mechanical War Puppets and five Great Void Warships! Have all of them taken over and piloted by Second-class Intelligent Life, full firepower!”
“Yes, Marshal!”
“Activate all twelve God-Slaying Towers! Allocate one million Foundation Establishment believers and one billion Qi Refining believers to each tower!”
“Unlimited Spirit Stone supply, regardless of cost! Crush their active forces to pieces!”
“Yes, Marshal!”
Hearing this, the Cultivation believers felt their Battle Intent instantly boil.
The frustration from the earlier prolonged stalemate turned entirely into violent murderous intent at this moment.
“Deploy fifteen Immortal Army Soul Steles at the core of the line!”
“These monkeys have formidable Physical Bodies? Then let them see the true power of Martial Arts!”
“With the army soul’s blessing, full advance!”
“Yes!”
The Martial Master believers on The Frontline roared in unison, their vital Qi soaring to the sky and murderous intent surging like a tide directly toward the Vajra King Monkeys.
In the next instant, the battlefield shifted dramatically.
Heaven and earth rumbled as if the Divine Kingdom’s space was being torn apart by force.

Ten Mechanical War Puppets descended with a crash. Their massive metal bodies were like war behemoths; terrifying vines were forcibly ripped apart and shattered the moment they touched them, unable to delay them even for a split second.

Five Great Void Warships rose into the sky, Void Realm patterns flowing across them. The energy cannon arrays around their hulls lit up simultaneously, beginning an indiscriminate Void Realm bombardment against the monkey swarm.
Beam after beam from the Void Cannons pierced through heaven and earth; wherever they passed, swaths of Vajra King Monkeys were directly evaporated into nothingness.
Meanwhile, high above in the sky, giant towers shrouded in Immortal Qi rose up into the air.

The God-Slaying Towers hovered in midair, their Formation runes flowing like a galaxy. A multitude of Cultivation believers flew into the towers like rain, rapidly taking their positions in the array.
In the next moment, tens of thousands of Spells exploded at once!
Seas of fire, thunderbolts, glaciers, sword rains, falling meteors...
The offensive released by each God-Slaying Tower was as terrifying as a miniature Void Cannon.
A single strike obliterated tens of thousands of Vajra King Monkeys along with the ground beneath them, leaving not even wreckage behind.
The battlefield turned into an apocalyptic purgatory in an instant.
Right after, fifteen Immortal Army Soul Steles slammed down into position.
The steles were black as the abyss, yet emitted a sky-piercing Battle Intent.

Blessed by the army soul power, the bodies of the Martial Master believers instantly underwent drastic changes. Muscles bulged like mountains, bones rumbled, and vital blood surged backward like a torrent.
In an instant, their combat power exploded by tens, even hundreds of times!
The battle line that had barely been holding its own against the Vajra King Monkeys was now completely crushing them.
In terms of Physical Body strength alone, these Martial Master believers had even begun to faintly suppress the Vajra King Monkeys.
“Kill—!!!”
Angry roars shattered the Void Realm as the military Formation surged forward like a tide.
The entire battlefield completely lost its balance at this moment.
With so many s-class war structures descending at once, it was no longer a war, but a one-sided purge.
The Vajra King Monkey line, which had been fighting while retreating, collapsed instantly.
Flee!
Flee frantically!
Countless Vajra King Monkeys were turned into shredded meat amidst the Void Cannon fire and torrents of Spells.
Corpses piled up like mountains, and the land of the Divine Kingdom was blasted to pieces, riddled with craters like a post-apocalyptic wasteland.
“Our God... save us...”
“We can’t hold on... This is impossible to win...”
“This is a slaughter... This is a slaughter!!”
Desperate wails echoed across the battlefield, only to be swiftly and completely drowned out by the next round of bombardment.
The Divine Kingdom Core.
Qi Tian, witnessing the collapse of The Frontline through his believers, felt as if he had been struck by lightning.
His face was pale and his eyes trembled violently, as if his worldview were shattering.
“Impossible... This is impossible...”
“How could he have so many s-class war structures...”
“Who on earth are you... Who on earth are you!!”
He staggered backward, a crumbling fear appearing in his voice for the first time.
“Even the divine elders of my race couldn’t possibly achieve something to this extent...”
“How could you be a Demigod... How on earth are you still just a Demigod!!”
On the battlefield, the defeat was like a landslide.
In just a few short months of Divine Kingdom time, the Vajra King Monkey race was wiped out.
Tens of billions of believers perished, their corpses covering the ground.
Severed limbs and flesh were swiftly packaged and recovered by planar collectors, transported into the interior of the Divine Kingdom.
Before the Life Essence Conversion Pool, robots were processing all these administrative tasks.
The Physical Body energy of these Vajra King Monkeys was extremely abundant, perfect for converting into Corpse Qi.
On the other side.
Yang Eleven was leading six flesh disaster hives, advancing toward the Divine Kingdom Core region.
After receiving the battle report from The Frontline, he couldn’t help but give a bitter smile.
“This gap... is way too big.”
“The zombie army I worked so hard to train didn’t even get a chance to take the field.”
He shook his head and looked at the flesh hives behind him.
These entities, hailed as s-class war structures, now seemed more like pure transport vehicles and resource transit nodes.
Before the real trump cards could even be deployed, the war was already nearing its end.
Even the “Zombie Tide Dance” Formation he had prepared for so long had no room to be utilized at all.
The enemy didn’t even have time for the zombie virus to spread before their frontline was completely crushed.
“Have Squads One through Six catch up. We’ll head to the main battlefield to score some credit too; we can’t let the other believers take it all,” Yang Eleven ordered.
“Yes, General!” Excitement instantly appeared in the eyes of numerous Zombie Kings.

Even the “Zombie Tide Dance” Formation he had prepared for so long had no room to be utilized at all.
The enemy didn’t even have time for the zombie virus to spread before their frontline was completely crushed.
“Have Squads One through Six catch up.
We’ll head to the main battlefield to score some credit too; we can’t let the other believers take it all,” Yang Eleven ordered.
“Yes, General!” Excitement instantly appeared in the eyes of numerous Zombie Kings.

chapters.title: Chapter 292: He Is a Good Person
paragraphs: Ever since joining the war, these zombie armies had been wandering at the edge of the battlefield.
Responsible for spreading poison and polluting the Divine Kingdom’s environment.
They had never directly engaged with any high-tier alien believers.
Now that they finally had the opportunity to step onto the true main battlefield, they naturally could not suppress their Battle Intent and curiosity.
Meanwhile, the advance of the main battlefield had reached the Divine Kingdom Core.
The once-prosperous Divine Kingdom of the Vajra King Monkey had long since withered away.
A large number of adult warriors were slaughtered at The Frontline, and even young monkeys that had not yet grown up were forcibly conscripted into the battlefield.
Now, inside the entire Divine Kingdom, fewer than one hundred million survivors remained.
What remained were merely the elderly, weak, sick, and disabled, barely clinging to life.
Above the sky of the Divine Kingdom, an illusory figure slowly condensed.
Qitian stood between heaven and earth; his originally golden monkey fur had completely turned white, and his entire person seemed to have aged tens of thousands of years in an instant.
With believers dying on a large scale and the Foundation of the Divine Kingdom being destroyed, he, as a deity, naturally suffered severe backlash.
“Human Race...”
His voice was hoarse, carrying an undisguised exhaustion and dead intent.
“I have lost.”
“Before I completely perish, can you show yourself and meet me?”
The moment the voice fell, space twisted slightly.
Yang Fan’s consciousness followed the Divine Kingdom passage and directly descended above the Divine Kingdom Core.
Qitian looked up, his gaze falling on Yang Fan, and his expression was extremely complex.
“Who on earth are you?” he asked in a low voice.
“My name is Yang Fan, a junior student at the Primordial Academy of the Human Race.” Yang Fan spoke calmly, without any concealment.
Qitian had already been suppressed and sealed by the Primordial Academy at this moment, and his consciousness was isolated from the outside world.
Naturally, Yang Fan did not worry about exposing himself.
“A student?” Qitian’s pupils suddenly constricted. “Impossible! You are lying to me!”
“Why would I lie to you?” Yang Fan looked at him. “You are going to die soon.”
Qitian froze for a moment.
Immediately afterwards, as if he had suddenly lost all his energy, he murmured in a low voice:
“That’s right...”
“You indeed have no need to lie to me.”
“I... am already going to die.”
He suddenly laughed out loud, but there was not a trace of joy in his laughter.
“A student... actually possesses so many s-class war structures...”
“Could it be that I have been locked up for too long, and now your Human Race has annexed all the clans?”
“That’s not right... Impossible...”
He shook his head violently, his eyes gradually becoming chaotic.
“I have only been suppressed for thousands of years, and The Frontline has at most been a few local Divine Kingdom Wars... How could it become like this...”
Qitian grabbed his already whitening fur, his expression on the verge of collapse.
Confusion, absurdity, and despair continuously intertwined in the depths of his eyes.
Yang Fan, however, did not explain.
His gaze crossed over Qitian, landing on the surviving Vajra King Monkeys, and he slowly spoke:
“Before your Divine Kingdom Core is completely seized, do you want to fight another battle?”
Hearing this, Qitian was stunned, then shook his head with a bitter smile.
“Fight another battle? Is there any meaning?”
“Right now, I only have a group of remnants and defeated soldiers left.”
“Any random S-Class War Structure of yours is enough to crush them.”
His eyes had long lost their light, as if he had completely accepted the outcome.
“I won’t use any S-Rank Buildings, only a Formation.” Yang Fan said calmly.
Qitian paused slightly and looked up at him:
“Why do this?”
“Your strength is too weak.” Yang Fan’s tone remained calm. “I still have a Formation that I haven’t used, and I want to see if I can defeat the strong with the weak.”
Qitian was silent for a long time.
Suddenly, he waved his hand, his tone surprisingly relaxed:
“Whatever, but before I die, can you let the Human Race Divine Shop help me buy some things?”
He looked up at Yang Fan, his eyes actually holding a hint of relief.
“Spirit Peaches, Monkey Wine... a greater variety.”
“I’ve been locked up for too long.”
“Before I die, I want to change my taste.”
Yang Fan nodded in consent, then issued instructions through his authority, ordering Yang Da to make purchases.
The next instant, high up in the ten-thousand-meter sky, a long table unfolded out of thin air.
The two consciousness Incarnations of Yang Fan and Qitian sat opposite each other.
The table was covered with spirit peaches and Monkey Wine, with Spiritual Qi lingering, resembling a celestial banquet.
Qitian had no deity image whatsoever, directly grabbing a spirit peach and biting into it. High-tier spirit peaches were swallowed by him one by one in a single bite.
A large pot of Monkey Wine was poured into his mouth, and he let out a long breath, a long-lost slight intoxication appearing on his face.
As if he had briefly escaped the reality of being “on the verge of death.”
Meanwhile, the battlefield below had also unfolded simultaneously.
Yang Da clearly understood Yang Fan’s intention, deliberately suppressing the scale of combat power and adjusting the number of believers on both sides to the same tier.
The Four Symbols Heaven Derivation Array slowly unfolded, its Formation patterns spreading like the meridians of heaven and earth.
Qitian drank his wine while overlooking the battlefield below.
Soon, he captured the Core Formation Realm believer at the center of the Formation.
“Core Formation Realm...”
“B-Rank Formation...”
He made a casual comment, his tone extremely flat.
At this moment, he didn’t even have a shred of surprise.
After all, everything he had seen recently had long completely shattered his cognition.
Compared to those overwhelming s-class war structures, a Core Formation Cultivator could no longer even be considered an “anomaly.”
He just continued to drink, his expression numb and relieved.
Even the interest in making comments had vanished.
For him, this battle felt more like a final “condemned meal.”
Perhaps death was liberation.
The Four Symbols Heaven Derivation Array below completely unfolded.

The Formation patterns spread like a heavenly canopy, with the four symbols illusory shadows crouching on all four sides: the Azure Dragon soared into the air, the White Tiger split the earth, the Vermilion Bird burned the heavens, and the Black Tortoise suppressed the seas.

Even though the overall combat power of Yang Fan’s subordinates’ believers was slightly weak, under the command and blessing of the B-Rank Formation, their power was forcibly twisted into a single rope.
Offense and defense integrated, circulating endlessly.
Every rotation of the Formation array was like the operation of a precise annihilation machine.
As soon as the Vajra King Monkeys rushed into the Formation, they were divided, restrained, and shredded by the power of the Four Symbols.
Blood and severed limbs exploded within the Formation light, leaving almost no room for resistance.
Across the earth, corpses piled up in patches.
The battlefield quickly transformed from a stalemate into a one-sided crushing defeat.
Above the sky, Qitian’s figure also became increasingly illusory at this moment.
His divinity was being extracted bit by bit, and his consciousness began to become transparent.
If all believers within the Divine Kingdom were completely annihilated, even if the Divine Kingdom Core had not yet been seized, he would completely dissipate along with it.
Yang Fan’s gaze swept across the battlefield, his tone faint:
“A B-Rank Formation is indeed much stronger than a C-Rank one.”
“Once the number of believers is sufficient, the power will be infinitely amplified.”
He paused and casually added:
“However, that’s about it.”
It wasn’t that the Formation wasn’t strong, but in front of his dozens of s-class war structures, this level of power already appeared too “orderly” and lacked true suppressive force.
At this moment, Qitian had tasted all the Spirit Fruit and Monkey Wine on the table.
He leaned lazily against the back of the chair, his expression even carrying a long-lost satisfaction.
As if the tension before death right now was instead a belated rest.
He looked up at Yang Fan and said softly: “Human Race Yang Fan... Thank you for treating me to this meal.”
“You... are considered a good person.”

chapters.title: Chapter 293: Breakthrough to Deity
paragraphs: Qitian could clearly perceive that within his Divine Kingdom, the last believer had also perished.
His divine nature was collapsing, and his consciousness was heading toward its end.
Yang Fan took a sip of Monkey Wine, his tone calm:
“I just think you are a bit interesting.”
“Furthermore, my first pot of gold in life also came from a monkey-race demigod.”
Qitian was slightly stunned, then laughed in a low voice:
“I see... Then I should thank this Karma.”
“At least it allowed me to drink these things in the end.”
He slowly stood up.
At this moment, there was no fear in his eyes, but rather a sense of relief after long-term suppression.
During the thousands of years he was imprisoned, he could only let his consciousness wander outside the Divine Kingdom, while the real world was dead silent.
He had witnessed countless Divine Kingdom Wars, devourings, and reconstructions, yet he could never truly touch the world.
Freedom had become his only obsession.
And now, this obsession had finally come to an end.
Qitian looked toward the distant shattered sky and suddenly spoke.
“Once I stepped on the golden sea to break the star tides, smiling and pointing at the gods as they dared not stand high.”
“Youthful madness swallowed the heavens and earth, a single thought sealed the myriad realms’ prison.”
“A thousand years of cage ground bones and blood, ten thousand heavy shackles locked the wind and waves.”
“If today you ask what I am, I am merely a strand of hair in the wind.”
The moment his voice fell, his figure completely blurred.
Like the wind scattering, like dust perishing.
Qitian’s consciousness completely dissipated between the heavens and earth.
“This monkey is quite interesting.”
Yang Fan uttered softly and casually drained the Monkey Wine in his cup.
“Pity that those who know my Divine Kingdom coordinates must die.”
The next moment, he transformed into a deity’s phantom, standing tall in the firmament.
“Greetings, My God!”
Countless believers knelt in unison.
“Immediately complete the reclamation work, then return to the Divine Kingdom.”
A Divine Decree descended, and the heavens and earth shook.
Yang Fan waved his right hand lightly, and a Divine Kingdom Core standing fully ten meters tall was taken into his palm, whereupon he crossed the space channel and returned to his own Divine Kingdom.
At this moment, Yang Fan did not immediately return to reality.
The final war in the Alien Divine Kingdom Zone had already ended, and remaining in Primordial Academy no longer held much meaning.
The only thing he needed to do now was a Breakthrough to become a deity.
At this moment, within his Divine Kingdom, a large number of unabsorbed Divine Kingdom Cores were piled up.
Without any hesitation, Yang Fan sat cross-legged, starting from the smallest Divine Kingdom Core, refining and absorbing them one by one.
In an instant, the Divine Kingdom shook.
Fragmented Alien Divine Kingdom continents were pulled by an invisible mighty force, breaking away from their original plane and slowly merging into Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom territory.
The Alien Divine Kingdom that was originally dead silent completely disintegrated at this moment.
And Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom was expanding frantically.
83 million square kilometers...
85 million square kilometers...
92 million square kilometers...
100 million square kilometers!
The vast land continuously extended, rules were reshaped, and Spiritual Qi boiled.
Sitting with his eyes closed, Yang Fan felt his spirit and Physical Body being simultaneously washed by an ultimate and massive World Force.
That was a sense of satisfaction akin to sublimation.
It felt as though everything about him was transforming toward a higher level.
As the area of the Divine Kingdom broke through the critical point of 100 million square kilometers, changes occurred silently.
At that instant, it was as if some sort of boundary was forcibly torn apart.
The boundaries of the Divine Kingdom, which tended to be stable, suddenly trembled, and then began to extend outward frantically.
200 million square kilometers... 300 million square kilometers...
1 billion square kilometers... 2 billion square kilometers...
10 billion square kilometers!
The Divine Kingdom seemed to be completely unlocked, expanding its territory by nearly a hundred times in a short period.
This magnitude of increase far surpassed even the transformation amplitude of a Divine Being breaking through to a demigod, which could be called exaggerated to the extreme.
However, within the newly expanded territory, there were no mountains, rivers, forests, or hills.
There was only a boundless wasteland.
Vast, empty, and primitive.
The Immortal Qi of his Divine Kingdom’s original territory flowed freely between the heavens and earth like an invisible tide.
In Yang Fan’s perception, that extremely dense Immortal Qi environment was instantly diluted to one percent of its original amount within less than a month in the Divine Kingdom.
But precisely because of this Immortal Qi, those wastelands began to undergo subtle changes.
Fine weeds quietly grew from the surface, like awakened vitality.
The flower and grass seeds from the old land of the Divine Kingdom were rolled up by the wind, crossing the new and old boundaries, and slowly spreading outward.
Everything was undergoing Natural Evolution.
And the more intense changes came from the rule level.
Yang Fan could clearly perceive that the underlying rules of the Divine Kingdom were being completed.
No longer incomplete, no longer restricted.
A more complete and grander system was gradually taking shape.
At the same time, the believers left behind in the Divine Kingdom were also undergoing a chain reaction.
His army of believers had not yet returned, but the believers left behind in the Divine Kingdom had already broken through collectively.
A large number of Foundation Establishment Cultivators stepped into the Core Formation realm without any Bottlenecks.
In the Martial Arts system, quite a few people directly crossed the shackles and ascended to become Martial Kings.
And the most exaggerated was the Mechanical Civilization system.

Over eighty percent of the Second-class Intelligent Life completed the transition as if conditions were ripe and success naturally followed the moment the rules were reshaped, directly advancing to Third-class Intelligent Life.
It was as if the entire civilization level had been forcibly raised by a tier.
Even though his consciousness was still within the Divine Kingdom, Yang Fan could clearly feel the changes in his real Physical Body.
That was a reconstruction from the inside out.
Flesh and blood, spirit, consciousness, and even the essence of life were all sublimating synchronously.
In a short fleeting moment, his overall strength surged by a hundred times, a thousand times.
It was as if he had stripped away from the concept of a human and transitioned into some brand-new form of existence.
Yang Fan’s consciousness returned to reality, slowly raising his arm, his eyes growing increasingly bright.
“Is this... a deity?”
He whispered to himself.
“No wonder as long as the Divine Kingdom does not perish, a deity does not die.”
“The so-called Physical Body is merely changing a shell.”
The deity’s Breakthrough did not have any earth-shattering anomalies, and it was even overly calm.
Yang Fan did not walk out of the room, and Gu Le in the outside world was completely unaware.
The entire Primordial Academy continued to operate as usual.
But only Yang Fan himself knew what this moment meant.
His spirit had completely shaken off the Physical Body’s shackles and formed a deep binding with the Divine Kingdom.
In a sense, he could exist in both worlds simultaneously.
Even if his real Physical Body was destroyed, his consciousness would instantly return to the Divine Kingdom, and with minimal cost, he could reshape his Physical Body to manifest in reality.
His consciousness could also possess it again.
From then on, the definition of life and death was completely rewritten.
The path of deities truly began.
Yang Fan took a deep breath, forcibly calming his state of mind, and then his consciousness sank into the Divine Kingdom once more.
And during the brief moment he stayed in reality, huge changes had already taken place within the Divine Kingdom.
The expeditionary army had all returned.
But many people showed looks of astonishment at the first instance; they clearly felt that the world had changed.
The Immortal Qi had become thin.
But the next instant, the Breakthrough followed.
Core Formation, Martial King, Third-class Intelligent Life... emerged like bamboo shoots after a spring rain.
It was as if the entire Divine Kingdom was upgrading.

The expeditionary army had all returned.
But many people showed looks of astonishment at the first instance; they clearly felt that the world had changed.
The Immortal Qi had become thin.
But the next instant, the Breakthrough followed.
Core Formation, Martial King, Third-class Intelligent Life... emerged like bamboo shoots after a spring rain.
It was as if the entire Divine Kingdom was upgrading.

chapters.title: Chapter 294: Origin Evolution
paragraphs: Yang Fan stood high above the Divine Kingdom, overlooking all living beings.
The next moment, he spoke, issuing the first Divine Decree after breaking through to a deity:
“The Divine Kingdom has expanded to ten billion square kilometers.”
“The territory has just opened, and order has yet to be established.”
“You must diligently practice without slackening, expand your clans and reproduce, and strengthen the Foundation of the Divine Kingdom.”
“This deity will bestow Spiritual Veins, reshape the mountains and rivers, and expand dwellings.”
“The future of the Divine Kingdom will far surpass today.”
“The meaning of your existence is to make the Divine Kingdom eternally glorious.”
“The Divine Kingdom exists because of you, and is great because of you.”
The moment the voice fell, heaven and earth resonated.
The rules responded accordingly, and the divine will surged like a tide, sweeping across all directions.
At that very moment, all believers knelt on the ground.
Instinctive awe was thoroughly ignited.
“Gratitude to my deity!”
“Die for the Divine Kingdom!”
“Die for my deity!!”
The roar shook the heavens, echoing across the newly born ten-billion-square-kilometer territory.
Not long after, Yang Fan’s consciousness had just withdrawn from the lingering resonance of the Divine Decree when Yang Da’s voice rang out in the main hall.
He slowly opened his eyes. Inside the main hall, there were only Yang Fan and Yang Da.
“Congratulations to Master on breaking through to a deity.”
Yang Da’s tone was uplifting, then as if remembering something, he hurriedly spoke:
“Master, the Divine Kingdom Cores of that Vajra King Monkey and the Undead Race... you didn’t absorb them, did you?”
Yang Fan nodded slightly: “No.”
For him, breaking through to a deity only required the Divine Kingdom to reach one hundred million square kilometers.
Adhering to the principle of “conservation,” he did not use those two largest Divine Kingdom Cores.
Yang Da’s eyes instantly lit up:
“That’s great!”
“Master, you can absorb them now!”
“Perhaps you can even directly absorb their Divine Kingdom Talents!”
Yang Fan paused:
“What do you mean?”
Yang Da was stunned for a moment, then said speechlessly,
“Master... you haven’t checked the Divine Kingdom information after breaking through to a deity, have you?”
“The Evolution Talent has already upgraded!”
With a thought, the latest information of the Divine Kingdom appeared before Yang Fan’s eyes.
“God Lord: Yang Fan”
“Divine Kingdom Area: Ten billion square kilometers”
“Talent: SSS-Rank Talent: Evolution [First Divine Authority: Time Evolution (One Hundredfold); Second Divine Authority: Origin Evolution]”
“F-rank Resource Talent (All resources within the Divine Kingdom accelerate growth by 10%)”
Just as Yang Da said, after breaking through to a deity, his Divine Kingdom Talent had indeed undergone new changes.
As the Lord of the Divine Kingdom, Yang Fan only needed a sweep of his thoughts to understand the true meaning of [Origin Evolution].
The so-called Origin Evolution.
Was not simply Evolution.
But a higher-level devouring and plundering.
It could absorb the Origin of other Divine Kingdoms, strip away the opponent’s Divine Kingdom Talent, and transform it into his own talent.
“This...”
Yang Fan’s pupils slightly constricted.
Even with his Heart-Nature, it was difficult to conceal his shock at this moment.
Such an ability was simply unheard of.
One could even say it had no upper limit!
This meant that in the future, every time he devoured a Divine Kingdom Core, he would have the opportunity to acquire the opponent’s Divine Kingdom Talent.
Ever since Awakening the Divine Kingdom, the greatest help [SSS-Rank Talent: Evolution] brought him had always been resources.
From the initial tenfold return to the hundredfold return after becoming a demigod.
With this talent, utilizing Divine Kingdom investments brought him an endless stream of Divinity Points.
Then using these Divinity Points to purchase resources, improve the Divine Kingdom environment, cultivate believers, and purchase defense and war buildings.
Only then did he develop step by step to this day.
Yang Fan had always been very clear that his advantage was resources, not the believers themselves.
When it came to the combat power of believers in the same Realm, those Human Race Prodigies possessing war talents were much stronger than him.
Take Ma Huainan, who possessed the SS-rank Divine Kingdom Talent [Martial God Body], for example.
Even though the development time of his Divine Kingdom was a hundred times that of the opponent, he still won extremely bitterly in the end.
The further along the Late Stage of Divine Kingdom development, the smaller this advantage of resource dimensionality reduction strikes became.
Because at the same stage, the growth of believers itself had a limit.
Qi Tian had been imprisoned by the Primordial Academy for over three thousand years, and his believers had long reached the limit achievable at the demigod stage.
Even if given another three thousand years, there would be no improvement whatsoever.
And now, the appearance of Origin Evolution allowed Yang Fan to see another path.
Those Divine Kingdom Talents that countless Genius took pride in were strong?
But I can seize your Divine Kingdom Core and make it my own!
When others were still relying on a single talent to dominate the same rank.
Yang Fan could plunder countless talents and bless them upon a single Divine Kingdom.
One talent was not strong enough.
What about ten?
What about a hundred?
If one day, millions of Divine Kingdom Talents converged in the same Divine Kingdom.
To what extent would he become strong by then?
Thinking of this, even Yang Fan could not help feeling his heart surge.
This was not simply becoming stronger, but stepping towards true invincibility step by step!
Yang Fan took a deep breath, forcibly suppressing the ripples in his heart.
Then he waved his hand, and two massive Divine Kingdom Cores appeared before him simultaneously.
They were precisely the Divine Kingdom Cores left behind by the Undead Demigod and Qi Tian.
If it were during the demigod period, facing this level of Divine Kingdom Core, he probably would have started absorbing it impatiently long ago.
But now after breaking through to a deity, Yang Fan did not have that strong desire.
He could clearly sense that the two largest Divine Kingdom Cores he collected now had extremely limited help to him.
Originally keeping them was to prepare them as a reward to bestow upon Ling Xuzi to help him break through to a deity in the future.
But now Yang Fan wanted more to verify the ability of Origin Evolution.
With a thought, the two Divine Kingdom Cores began to rapidly dissolve.
At the same time.
In the Divine Kingdom plane, the originally remaining Alien Divine Kingdom completely collapsed.
Only a tiny portion of the area was guided by the Divine Kingdom rules, crossing space and merging into the outer periphery of Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom.
However, this time, Yang Fan did not feel the comfort that used to make even his Soul tremble.
The growth of the Divine Kingdom area was even less than one hundred thousand square kilometers, and even the Divine Kingdom information panel had no changes whatsoever.
Yang Fan was not surprised by this. Now his Divine Kingdom area had reached ten billion square kilometers, and the rules tended to be complete.
Compared to his Divine Kingdom, the demigod Divine Kingdom Core was merely a drop in the ocean.
The larger the Divine Kingdom, the higher the difficulty of continuing to grow would naturally become.
After absorbing the Divine Kingdom Cores, Yang Fan immediately cast his gaze onto the Divine Kingdom Talent column, and sure enough, changes had appeared.
“B-rank Vajra Body Talent, B-rank Breeding Talent”
Before Yang Fan could react, Yang Da on the side loudly offered congratulations.

“Congratulations, Master, on acquiring two more B-rank Divine Kingdom Talents. Newly born believers all have a certain probability of acquiring the special Physique of the Vajra Body, which will greatly increase the combat power of believers on the Martial Route!”

“With the B-rank Breeding Talent, there is no need to purchase Breeding Cards from the Divine Shop in the future. The impact brought by one’s own Divine Kingdom Talent is much better than the effect of an A-rank Breeding Card!”
“Why is it only a B-rank talent?” Yang Fan was somewhat puzzled.
You must know that whether it was Qi Tian or that Undead Demigod, they belonged to top-tier existence among all demigods.
The Divine Kingdom Talents they possessed should at least be S-rank.

chapters.title: Chapter 295: Keep It in Your Heart
paragraphs: Yang Da heard this and immediately explained:
“Reporting to Master, Origin Evolution is not without loss.”
“During the plundering process, the Origin itself will lose a portion of its power.”
“And the talent transformation between different races has an even greater consumption.”
“Take that Undead Demigod for example; its original divine kingdom talent was named [Proliferation].”

“The undead do not need Breeding, they only need to consume resources of the Death Qi category to continuously give birth to new undead units, thus they can easily spawn troops with the ‘Proliferation’ talent.”
“However, the Human Race is different; Human Race believers need to mate to reproduce offspring and nurture life.”
“The same talent placed on the Human Race cannot be used directly at all, so Origin Evolution will automatically adjust its effect to make it fit the divine kingdom’s own civilization system.”
“And this transformation process requires consuming a large amount of Origin power, ultimately forming the current Grade B talent [Breeding].”
“And the result Master obtained is a talent downgrade!”
Hearing this, Yang Fan nodded.
Regarding this result, he was actually quite satisfied.

A Grade B divine kingdom talent, placed in a small place like Yang County, would be a proud daughter of heaven like Luo Bing, a top-tier Genius whom the entire Family would exhaust resources to cultivate.
Yet in just a few breaths of time, he had acquired two.
If this kind of harvest were to spread out, who knows how many gods it would drive mad.
Of course, Yang Fan also understood a principle.
Getting a Grade B talent today makes one think about getting a Grade A one.
After getting a Grade A one, they would then think about getting a Grade S one.
Human desires never have an end.
If one thinks about perfection in everything, it will only make oneself live in dissatisfaction forever.
A snake tries to swallow an elephant with an insatiable heart; sometimes knowing contentment is precisely what allows one to go further.
“Master, if you feel the consumption is too great, then you need to absorb the Divine Kingdom Cores of Human Race gods; their divine kingdom talents will be more adaptable,” Yang Da reminded.
As soon as these words came out, Yang Fan’s gaze instantly turned dangerous, staring straight at Yang Da.
The air seemed to freeze for a split second.
Yang Da’s heart skipped a beat.
As an extension of Yang Fan’s will, he instantly realized he had said the wrong thing, and dropped to his knees with a thud.
“Master, calm your anger!”
“This is your divine kingdom, absolutely safe, no one will know the conversation between you and me!”
Hearing this, Yang Fan’s expression eased a bit.
“Yang Da, you must understand my current identity.”
“I am the core Genius painstakingly cultivated by the Gu Family, the Peerless Prodigy certified by the Human Federation, and also one of the important pillars of the Human Race in the future.”
“In the future, I will inevitably be involved in affairs between the federation’s upper echelons, the military, financial conglomerates, and various families.”
“Some words, even if no one hears them, cannot be casually spoken aloud.”
As Yang Fan spoke, he leisurely tidied his collar.
Then, with his hands behind his back, his tone became increasingly solemn.
“The current me is a big shot with status in the Real World.”
“In the future, I am even an existence competing for seats in the Human Race’s upper echelons.”
“As a decent upper-class person.”
“Even if you really think so in your heart, you must never say it out; it is not conducive to unity.”
“This is a matter of principle.”
Yang Da: “...”
“Master’s teaching is correct.”
Yang Fan nodded with satisfaction.
“A child that can be taught; in the future, just keep such things in your heart.”
“Never say them out.”
Yang Da: “???”
Consciousness returned to the Real World.
Yang Fan slowly opened his eyes, stood up, and pushed open the room door.
Just as the door opened, Gu Le’s figure came into view.
At this moment, she had obviously been waiting outside the door for a long time, pacing back and forth, her pretty face full of shock.
Seeing Yang Fan appear, she immediately hurried forward to greet him.
“Hu... Husband!”
Gu Le’s voice was somewhat trembling.
“Father just sent me a message saying that the Alien Demigod in the level-three area has fallen!”
Gu Le opened her mouth, her eyes full of disbelief.
Ever since receiving the news, she had been guarding the door.
Until now, she still hadn’t completely digested this astonishing news.
That was an Alien Demigod from the level-three area!
An existence that hadn’t been resolved even after being imprisoned by Primordial Academy for over three thousand years.
Yet in just a short month, it actually died!
And right at this moment, Gu Le suddenly froze.
The words she originally prepared to say were forcefully stuck in her throat.
Her body trembled slightly, her gaze fixed dead on Yang Fan.
As if she saw something incredible.
The aura of a god!
Although extremely restrained.
As Gu Xuanting’s daughter, Gu Le had come into contact with too many god-level powerhouses since childhood.
That sense of oppression on the level of life, she would never misrecognize it.
The Yang Fan before her eyes was clearly still that familiar person, yet it was as if he had completely transformed into a life form of another level.
Just standing there gave people a feeling of facing a vast world.
“Husband, you are now...”
Gu Le’s voice even became somewhat stuttering.
Her beautiful eyes widened more and more, and a thought that even she felt absurd surfaced in her mind.
No way?
Could it be...
Looking at her own wife’s completely dazed appearance,
Yang Fan couldn’t help but smile, then reached out and rubbed her head.
“That’s right, the Alien Demigod has been resolved.”
“Additionally—”
Yang Fan paused slightly, the smile on his face growing thicker.
“Your husband, me, has already made a Breakthrough to the god Realm.”
“According to the rules of Primordial Academy, it’s time to graduate.”
Boom—
Gu Le only felt her mind go blank.
Breakthrough to a god?
Graduate?
So fast?
She stood blankly in place, not recovering her wits for a long time.
After calming down, Gu Le seemed to suddenly think of something, and hurriedly spoke:
“That’s right, Husband!”
“Father just sent me a message telling you to enter the Virtual World to meet with him immediately after finishing the matters of the divine kingdom.”
“He said there are very important matters to instruct.”
As she spoke, Gu Le took out a virtual helmet from under Gu Chengye’s crib and handed it into Yang Fan’s hands.
Seeing this, Yang Fan did not delay either.
Although he had already made a Breakthrough to a god now, compared to Gu Xuanting, the Third Elder of the Gu Family, he was still just a Junior.
Regardless of strength, status, or influence, the two sides were not on the same level.
Towards this father-in-law who had supported him all the way, Yang Fan naturally did not dare to neglect him in the slightest.
After putting on the virtual helmet, his consciousness rapidly descended into the Virtual World.
Following the coordinates sent by Gu Xuanting, the familiar Gu Family Territory came into view.
In the courtyard, Gu Xuanting stood with his hands behind his back, obviously having waited for a long time.
The moment he saw Yang Fan appear, a hint of gratification suddenly appeared in the eyes of the Third Elder of the Gu Family.
“Made a Breakthrough?”
Gu Xuanting spoke.
Although it was a question, his tone was exceptionally certain.
“Solving that Vajra King Monkey Demigod in such a short time, I guessed that upon our meeting this time, you would probably already be a First-Order God.”
“You truly did not disappoint me.”

chapters.title: Chapter 296: Ten Years of Gilding
paragraphs: Yang Fan quickly bowed and saluted, “Everything is thanks to Father’s nurturing.”
Gu Xuanting waved his hand.
“None of that nonsense.”
“I originally thought you would only break through to a God near your senior year.”
“I didn’t expect you to reach this step in the first semester of your junior year. Your potential is even more outstanding than I imagined.”
Speaking of this, Gu Xuanting’s expression gradually turned serious.
“According to federal laws and regulations, any citizen must serve ten years at The Frontline after graduating from university.”
“Your transfer order will come down soon.”
As he spoke, Gu Xuanting took out a pitch-black token and placed it in Yang Fan’s hand.
“This is the proof of identity for The Frontline Ninth Legion.”
“From now on, you will be under the command of that kid Gu Jiuheng.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan was slightly stunned.
Yang Fan naturally knew Gu Jiuheng; he still had to call him cousin through Gu Le.
“I have already planned it out for you.”
Gu Xuanting continued:
“After going to The Frontline, no one will assign you mandatory missions; you can just stay in the rear garrison normally.”
“Unless a large-scale Divine Kingdom War breaks out, your Physical Body in reality will not be in any danger.”
“As for military achievements, Gu Jiuheng will find a way for you.”
Speaking of this, Gu Xuanting’s tone suddenly became a bit heavier.
“Remember, this time going to The Frontline.”
“Your core purpose is not killing enemies, but gilding.”
Hearing this, a trace of surprise flashed through Yang Fan’s eyes.
“Father, ten years of gilding?”
“Isn’t this a bit too long?”
Gu Xuanting glanced at him.
“What? Think the time is too long?”
“If it were placed ten thousand years ago, there would still be room for manipulation in such matters.”
“But nowadays, federal supreme intelligent life has long blocked all loopholes.”
“The ten-year service period is a rigid rule that no one can change.”
Gu Xuanting paused and continued:
“Furthermore, you have just broken through to a God. The most important thing right now is to accumulate your foundation, rather than running off to risk your life with Alien Gods.”
“Most of the Gods rushing to the very front are Loose Cultivators without a background.”
“They lack resources, war structures, and military achievements.”
“That’s why they can only risk their lives.”
“But you are different.”
Gu Xuanting looked at Yang Fan, a faint smile appearing on his face.
“You are Gu Xuanting’s son-in-law.”
“Your path has always been different from ordinary people.”
“The Gu Family will handle the resources for your Divine Kingdom’s development.”
“Ten years later, whether you want to join the military, go into politics, or do business, I will pave the way for you.”
“You only need to develop your Divine Kingdom with peace of mind.”
In fact, for the vast majority of newly advanced Gods, ten years cannot be considered long at all.
After the Divine Kingdom’s area skyrocketed by a hundred times, the number of believers, civilization system, resource development, and population reproduction all required a long time to digest.
If the federation hadn’t made service mandatory, many Gods would probably choose to seclude themselves for decades or even centuries.
After the Divine Kingdom’s development reached a Bottleneck, they would then participate in Divine Kingdom Wars to obtain resources.
But Yang Fan was completely different; he possessed Hundred-fold Evolution speed, and even dozens of s-class war structures.
Now, after breaking through to a God, he had further awakened Origin Evolution.
Divine Kingdom Wars, which were extremely dangerous to other Gods,
in Yang Fan’s eyes, meant Divine Kingdom Cores, various Divine Kingdom talents, and opportunities to grow stronger rapidly.
If he stayed in the rear to gild himself for ten years, that would undoubtedly be a waste of time.
Of course, Yang Fan did not voice these thoughts.
He knew very well that everything Gu Xuanting did was for his own consideration.
“Thank you, Father.”
Yang Fan solemnly saluted once again and put away the legion token.
As for how to arrange things at The Frontline, it wouldn’t be too late to make a decision once he actually arrived there.
Gu Xuanting seemed to see through Yang Fan’s thoughts and slowly spoke:
“Since you have already broken through to a God, it’s time to tell you some things.”
“The biggest difference between Gods and demigods is not strength, but the Divine Kingdom itself.”
“During the demigod period, the Divine Kingdom’s rules are not yet perfect, and there is always an upper limit to the growth of believers.”
“But once you break through to a God, the heaven and earth rules of the Divine Kingdom completely take shape, and the growth shackles of believers will be broken.”
“In theory, as long as there are enough resources, your believers can grow infinitely.”
Yang Fan listened attentively. This was the first time he had learned about knowledge concerning the Realm of Gods.
“Gods are divided into nine tiers, and the criteria for division are very simple.”
“That is the Divine Kingdom’s area.”
Gu Xuanting extended his finger.
“From one billion square kilometers to twenty billion square kilometers, it is a First-Order God.”
“From twenty billion to thirty billion square kilometers, it is a second-order God.”
“From thirty billion to forty billion square kilometers, it is a Tier 3 God.”
“And so on.”
“Reaching ninety billion square kilometers makes one a ninth-order God.”
Yang Fan silently memorized it.
Gu Xuanting continued:
“However, you must remember that in Divine Kingdom Wars, it is never a matter of just attacking whoever is weak.”
“The Divine Kingdom rules themselves will also restrict Gods.”
“Just like Gods cannot easily make a move against demigods.”
“By the same token, if the area gap between two Divine Kingdoms is too large, the space channel will be suppressed by the heaven and earth rules.”
“The larger the Divine Kingdom’s area, the more severe the restrictions it suffers.”
“When First-Order Gods go to war with second-order Gods, the restrictions are not obvious, and the same is true for second-order and Tier 3 Gods.”
“However, once you cross a major Realm, the situation is completely different.”
“For example, if Mid-tier Gods like fourth-order Gods want to forcefully invade Tier 3 and below Gods, the space channels will be heavily suppressed.”
“Even believers cannot be teleported on a large scale.”
“Similarly, if High-Order Gods want to invade Mid-tier Gods, they also need to pay an extremely heavy price.”
“This is the rule of the Divine Kingdom world, and also the reason why countless weak beings have been able to survive to this day.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan couldn’t help but let out a sigh of relief in his heart.
I have to say, this rule is simply tailored for himself.
Fighting within the same tier, he really wasn’t afraid of anyone.
Right at this moment, Gu Xuanting suddenly laughed.
“Is your kid thinking right now—”
“—that since you are protected by the rules, those ordinary Alien Gods are essentially yours to hunt at will?”
“When you get to The Frontline, worst case scenario you act alone, crazily plundering Divine Kingdom Cores, and breaking through all the way to second-order, Tier 3, or even ninth-order Gods?”
Yang Fan’s expression instantly turned a bit awkward.
This old father-in-law’s eyes were simply too sharp.
As soon as this thought popped into his mind, it was seen right through.
“Father sees clearly, I indeed had such a thought.”
“However, I value the safety of the Divine Kingdom more and will not act rashly.”
Gu Xuanting laughed heartily upon hearing this.
“You are a Peerless Prodigy, and it’s normal to have pride.”
“Several epochs ago, I also walked through this stage of yours.”
“I more or less know what young people are thinking in their heads.”
Speaking of this, Gu Xuanting suddenly stood up, turned around, and walked into the house.
A moment later, he walked out holding an ancient chessboard.
On the chessboard, black and white pieces of varying sizes were placed.
Gu Xuanting placed the chessboard in the center of the two of them, and then pushed all the smallest pieces to the very front.
As for the larger pieces, they were placed in the back.

chapters.title: Chapter 297: Proxy War
paragraphs: “A true battlefield is never general against general, king against king.”
“Rather, it is like this.”
Gu Xuanting pointed to the smallest chess pieces at the very front.
“What do you think they represent?”
Yang Fan thought briefly. “The people fighting on The Frontline.”
“Half right.”
Gu Xuanting shook his head.
“These smallest pieces can be demigods, or they can be gods.”
“They are responsible for slaughtering, capturing territory, and seizing the Divine Kingdom Core.”
Then, Gu Xuanting pointed to the larger chess pieces in the back.
“And these are responsible for providing resources, intelligence, weaponry, war structures, and tactical guidance.”
“When necessary, they will even directly dispatch legions into battle.”
Yang Fan’s eyes flickered slightly, faintly guessing something.
“Xiao Fan, do you know why such a war model was formed?”
Yang Fan shook his head.
Gu Xuanting spoke slowly:
“Because of the cost. If two gods personally wage a Divine Kingdom War, regardless of who wins or loses,”
“the losses caused by the aftershocks of war alone are enough to make both sides ache for hundreds or even thousands of years.”
“The outer resource zones of the divine kingdom, the cities of believers, the destruction of the divine kingdom’s environment...”
“These are all wealth.”
“No one is willing to gamble with their foundation.”
“Thus, proxy war was born.”
Gu Xuanting gently placed down a chess piece.
“Low-tier Gods will dispatch Subordinate Gods to fight, Mid-tier Gods will dispatch Low-tier Gods to fight, and High-Order Gods will hide behind the scenes.”
“It avoids exposing the coordinates of one’s divine kingdom,”
“and allows one to continuously gain benefits through war.”
Yang Fan’s brows furrowed gradually.
“But according to Father,”
“doesn’t this mean that the ones dying are all demigods and ordinary gods?”
Hearing this, Gu Xuanting showed a look of appreciation. “Correct. You’ve finally understood.”
He picked up one of the largest chess pieces and slowly placed it at the very back of the board.
“In this world, it has always been big fish eating small fish, and small fish eating shrimp.”
“Unless the two races launch an all-out war, Mid-tier Gods rarely fall.”
“As for High-Order Gods...”
An emotion flashed in Gu Xuanting’s eyes.
“It has been several epochs since I last heard of a High-Order God having their Divine Kingdom Core seized.”
At this point, Gu Xuanting slowly looked at Yang Fan, his voice turning solemn.
“Remember, the stronger you are, the more you must learn to use power, wealth, and connections to protect yourself.”
“Charging onto the battlefield personally is never something a strong person should do.”
“Allowing your own divine kingdom to become the main battlefield—even if you win by luck—is merely the favor of fate.”
“One day, luck won’t be on your side. Failing just once means the end of your path as a god!”
Gu Xuanting continued slowly.
“No one can say how many ages the Human Race and foreign races have fought.”
“To those ordinary Divine Beings, the Federation tells them that this is a war of races, a war of civilizations, a war of survival.”
“They need to invest well in their divine kingdoms, pay their taxes properly, and contribute their strength to the entire Human Race.”
“These words are naturally not wrong, but from a higher perspective, the essence comes down to a single word.”
Gu Xuanting extended a finger and tapped lightly on the table.
“Profit.”
“Resources, benefits, growth opportunities, and the future of the race.”
“Behind every war, it always comes down to this word.”
“And you must remember: the higher a person stands, the more resources they possess,”
“the safer your life and wealth will be.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan seemed lost in thought, then bowed respectfully.
“Thank you for your guidance, Father. I understand.”
Gu Xuanting nodded in satisfaction.
What he worried about most was Yang Fan becoming famous at a young age and being overly proud.
The greatest enemy of those Peerless Prodigies is often not foreign races, but themselves.
How many brilliant figures have ultimately fallen to arrogance?
“Xiao Fan, the reason I arranged for you to be at the rear of The Frontline is not to keep you from participating in the war.”
“On the contrary, I want you to engage 100% in proxy warfare.”
At this point, Gu Xuanting’s expression became solemn like never before.
“Remember, no matter the time, your Physical Body in reality must never go to the front lines.”
“If there’s anything that needs handling, let robots do it directly.”
“Once your Physical Body is destroyed, no one can save you.”
Yang Fan frowned slightly.
“Why is that?”
Gu Xuanting didn’t answer directly, but asked instead:
“If you lose your real-world Physical Body,”
“can you still get in touch with the outside world?”
Yang Fan froze for a moment.
He really hadn’t considered this question before.
A god’s greatest reliance is that as long as the divine kingdom is not destroyed, their consciousness will not die.
Even if their Physical Body in reality is destroyed, their consciousness can still be guided back by the divine kingdom.
But the problem lies in having no Physical Body.
One cannot use the virtual helmet, and the Feixun System in the wristwatch will also be destroyed along with the Physical Body.
At that time, his consciousness will be trapped inside the divine kingdom.
Unless he re-condenses a Physical Body, he won’t be able to contact the outside world at all.
Thinking of this, Yang Fan’s expression couldn’t help but change slightly.
Gu Xuanting continued:
“The coordinates of a divine kingdom are every god’s greatest secret.”
“Parents won’t know them, partners won’t know them, and children won’t know them either.”
“Because the more people who know, the greater the risk.”
“And when your Physical Body is destroyed, the rules of the divine kingdom will immediately guide your consciousness back.”
“The attacker will naturally take advantage of this to lock onto your divine kingdom’s coordinates.”
“When that time comes, what awaits you is a Divine Kingdom War.”
“Or even a one-versus-many siege.”
“Such things are not uncommon on The Frontline.”
A cold gleam flashed in Gu Xuanting’s eyes; he had clearly seen too many similar cases.
Afterward, his tone softened again.
“However, you are different from those Loose Cultivator gods.”
“You belong to the Gu Family, and you are my—Gu Xuanting’s—son-in-law.”
“There is no need to risk your future.”
“If you can’t win, abandon your Subordinate Gods and request help from the Family.”
“As long as the divine kingdom remains, everything can be earned back.”
Speaking up to here, a hint of pride appeared on Gu Xuanting’s face.
“The Gu Family possesses one of the highest-spec divine support Systems in the Federation.”
“The Family keeps a large number of divine guards, all of whom have signed highest-Rank death contracts.”
“Even if they perish, they will never leak a single secret of the Gu Family.”
“If your divine kingdom’s coordinates are known to them, you need not have any worries.”
Afterward, Gu Xuanting gently pushed a chess piece forward on the board.
“If you are outmatched, let those demigods or ordinary gods die.”
“If you can win, use their divine kingdoms as a springboard to invade the enemy.”
“This is the safest way to wage a Divine Kingdom War.”
Yang Fan was silent for a moment, then bowed solemnly. “I understand, Father.”
But the moment he lowered his head, a strange light flashed in the depths of his eyes.
“Go on.”
Gu Xuanting waved his hand.
“Primordial Academy has already learned of your Breakthrough to godhood.”
“In a month at most, the transfer order for The Frontline will arrive.”
“Take advantage of this time to enjoy a rare period of leisure.”
At this point, Gu Xuanting suddenly smiled slightly.
“In addition, many people should be coming to congratulate you soon, and there will likely be no shortage of gifts.”
“You don’t need to be polite; just accept them all.”

chapters.title: Chapter 298: World Tree
paragraphs: Yang Fan couldn’t help but chuckle upon hearing this, “Yes, Father.”
As his voice fell, his consciousness slowly withdrew from the Virtual World.
When he opened his eyes again, he had returned to reality.
The room was very quiet, and Gu Le was holding Gu Chengye while sitting to the side.
The little guy had fallen asleep at some point, his chubby little hand grasping the corner of Gu Le’s clothes, and a trace of crystal-clear saliva still hung at the corner of his mouth.
Watching Yang Fan wake up, Gu Le immediately leaned closer.
“Husband, has Father arranged everything for you over there?” she asked softly.
As a direct daughter of the Gu Family, she knew very well.
Once breaking through to a God, one must go to The Frontline to serve for ten years in accordance with federal Law.
As for the unspoken rules of The Frontline, she had long since heard about them from her elders at home.
Yang Fan reached out and rubbed her hair, his tone calm.
“Everything has been arranged.”
“When I arrive at The Frontline, I will serve under cousin Gu Jiuheng, so you don’t need to worry.”
Hearing this, Gu Le’s heart relaxed slightly.
For Yang Fan, as long as he followed Gu Xuanting’s arrangements, these ten years would most likely just be a formality of gilded processing, and the risk could be almost ignored.
Thinking of this, Gu Le stopped asking more questions.
She nodded gently, then, as if suddenly remembering something, said in a low voice:
“Then... let’s treat tonight as celebrating my husband’s Breakthrough.”
She snapped her fingers, having the robot nanny carry Gu Chengye to the guest room next door.
The room quickly quieted down.
The night grew deeper, and the lights outside the window flickered slightly.

The newly promoted God had a soaring Aura, half a step stepping out of the cloud sea tide. Le’er, a demigod, had an unsettled heart, and a single call of husband immediately led to “pleading for mercy”.
The moment before they were still talking about The Frontline, but the next moment their hearts were already in disarray.
Leaving only a soft voice: “Stop messing around...”
Gu Le fell fast asleep, her breathing even.
Yang Fan glanced at her, then sat cross-legged, his consciousness sinking into his Divine Kingdom.
Within the Divine Kingdom, in just a short time, this place had already become a completely different scene.
Utilizing the internal channels of the Gu Family, Yang Fan no longer needed to separately purchase Resources from shops in Taichu City through Feixun.
Coordinated by Yang Da, the internal Resources of the Gu Family were directly loaded into the Divine Kingdom.
Within a short period, a large number of Spiritual Veins were rapidly deployed into various areas of the Divine Kingdom.
Nowadays, within the Divine Kingdom, the total amount of Spiritual Veins had reached as high as forty million, which could stably output about four hundred billion Divinity Points per month.
If this income were placed among ordinary gods, it could already be called terrifying.
But for Yang Fan, it could only be considered regular cash flow.
Whether it was the Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nest or the benefits brought by the enlightenment ancient tree, they were far above this.
Furthermore, the real purpose of Yang Da purchasing a large number of Spiritual Veins was not for income, but to repair the Divine Kingdom’s environment.
After breaking through to a God, the Divine Kingdom expanded a hundredfold.
The Spiritual Qi that was originally close to liquefaction appeared far too thin after being suddenly diluted.
The Cultivate efficiency of the believers also dropped by a notch accordingly.
For the Divine Kingdom civilization, which had already grown accustomed to a “high-spirit environment”, this was an obvious gap.
Compared to other Low-tier Gods, Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom environment could already be called luxurious.
But the problem was—that was only “relatively speaking”.
For his believers, this was an unacceptable “downgrade”.
Yang Da laying down a large number of Spiritual Veins now was only a transition plan.
The real plan was to continuously purchase Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nests through the Dark Web in the future, gradually replacing the Spiritual Veins.
Allowing the entire Divine Kingdom to return to a state comparable to a metamorphosis cabin.
At this moment, inside the grand hall.
As soon as Yang Fan descended, the consciousness of Intelligent Life forms like Yang Da, Yang Yi, and Ling Xuzi simultaneously manifested.
Everyone knelt down in unison.
“Greetings, Master.”
The voices were neat, without the slightest hesitation.
Yang Fan nodded slightly, his figure having already appeared upon the throne.
“How are the spoils of this battle?”
Yang Da immediately stepped forward and respectfully reported.
“Reporting to Master, everything has been completely counted.”
“The Divine Kingdom inheritance of the Vajra King Monkey is as follows—”
“There are currently no s-class war structures.”
“There are a total of S-Rank Buildings: five Great Void Warships, five Mechanical War Puppets, and fifty-five Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nests.”
“In addition, there are two S-Rank Buildings, [Void Smelting Tower] and [Beast Soul Evolution Furnace], which have poor adaptability with the Human Race system.”
“Neither is recommended to be kept, and they have been marked as assets for sale on the Dark Web.”
Hearing this, Yang Yi stepped forward to supplement:
“There are a total of one million A-grade Spiritual Veins and millions of various A-grade buildings, and initial classification has been completed.”
“The parts adapted to the Divine Kingdom system have been directly loaded, and the rest have all been packaged into the Divine Shop listing list.”
“In addition, there are a large number of B-grade and C-grade defense buildings, as well as Resources such as Spirit Plants, spiritual herbs, and Spirit Stones.”
“Some useful ones are placed in the Divine Kingdom warehouse, and the rest are all listed in the Divine Shop waiting to be cashed out.”
Yang Fan listened quietly and nodded slightly.
The harvest of this battle was far more generous than he had expected.
A demigod Divine Kingdom in a tier-three region was indeed not ordinary stuff.
Many of the Resources within might have come from Human Race Geniuses who had fallen in the past.
Now, after coming full circle, they had all fallen into his hands instead.
Yang Fan’s eyes flickered slightly.
He suddenly remembered what Gu Xuanting had said.
‘Big fish eat small fish, small fish eat shrimp.’
If one day his strength was not enough...
His wealth might also become wedding attire for others.
Thinking of this, Yang Fan’s eyes became even deeper.
“Master, the most valuable thing in this Vajra King Monkey Divine Kingdom still belongs to that life-attribute S-Rank Building!”
Speaking of this, Yang Da raised his right hand.
A huge light screen appeared in the center of the grand hall.
[World Tree, S-Rank Building, Price: 100 billion Divinity Points]

[Introduction: A special life Wonder evolved from the Tianji Secret Realm, containing complete life Laws, capable of autonomously absorbing heaven and earth energy to grow, and is an extremely rare comprehensive building of the Divine Kingdom.]

[Effect 1: Life Nourishment, significantly improves the Divine Kingdom environment, increases the activity of Spiritual Qi, and greatly enhances the Cultivate speed of wood-attribute Cultivation believers.]

[Effect 2: Ten Thousand Vines Protection, the World Tree can derive countless war vines, which can autonomously attack, entangle, and bind enemy units, possessing extremely strong strategic value in Divine Kingdom defense battles.]

[Effect 3: Life Domain, within the area covered by the World Tree, the recovery ability of all friendly believers is greatly enhanced, the speed of injury recovery is increased, and vitality continues to grow stronger.]
[Effect 4: Natural Gestation, within a certain range of the World Tree, the efficiency of life gestation is increased.]

[Evaluation: A comprehensive Divine Kingdom strategic building integrating offense, defense, recovery, and development into one. Although it is not good at frontal destruction, it possesses extremely strong sustainable development capabilities and extremely high value.]
Looking at the introduction of the World Tree, Yang Fan immediately understood the origin of those sky-covering vines from back then.
During the Divine Kingdom War, it was precisely these seemingly inconspicuous vines that forcibly delayed the advancing pace of a large number of Mechanical War Puppets.
Based on this point alone, its value far exceeded the vast majority of S-Rank defense buildings.
“This is another building comparable to the Eternal Corpse Mine, what a good thing!”
Yang Fan couldn’t help exclaiming in admiration.
