chapters.title: Chapter 299: Post-War Rewards
paragraphs: With his control over the Dark Web channels, Yang Fan was already able to stably purchase ordinary S-Rank Buildings like the Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nest.
As long as he had enough Divinity Points, he would gather them all sooner or later.
However, core buildings like the War God Codex and the Heavenly Court, which could influence the entire direction of a divine kingdom’s civilization, were a completely different matter.
Such buildings rarely appeared on the Dark Web.
Yang Fan had previously checked the Dark Web’s transaction records over the years.
Some top-tier S-Rank Buildings of similar value had appeared, but they either had an extremely low compatibility with the Human Race’s divine kingdom, or their prices were utterly absurd.
“Master, this World Tree has not yet been loaded into the divine kingdom. It still requires your confirmation,” Yang Da suddenly spoke.
“Why?”
Yang Fan was slightly puzzled.
“Because this building has two loading locations.”
Yang Da raised his hand to project the map of the divine kingdom.
“The first location is the Heavenly Court.”
“The World Tree contains a rich Law of life. If placed in the Heavenly Court, it can continuously nourish the entire Cultivation system.”

“Particularly for Cultivators with a wood Spiritual Root, their speed of Cultivation will be greatly enhanced, and the probability of high-tier wood-attribute Cultivators emerging in the future will also increase.”
Saying this, Yang Da moved the map to another area.
“The second location is the Elf Kingdom.”
“The World Tree is extremely compatible with the Elf Race. Once loaded, the growth rate of the elf holy tree will receive a massive boost.”
“However, the elves are ultimately a vassal force after all. Your subordinate did not dare to make a decision on such a large-scale investment of Resources.”
Yang Fan fell silent for a moment, then spoke slowly.
“Since it is more compatible with the Elf Race, then place it in the Elf Kingdom.”
“The World Tree is not only a development-type building, but it is also an S-Rank defensive building.”
“The Heavenly Court’s location is too close to the Divine Kingdom Core. Placing it there would be somewhat of a waste.”
“It is better to have it guard the middle region.”
“This can both nurture the elven civilization and strengthen the divine kingdom’s defenses.”
Yang Da bowed slightly. “Yes, your subordinate obeys your command.”
Yang Fan continued:
“Additionally, I grant you the authority to purchase a large amount of the Fountain of Life through the Gu Family’s channels.”
“To be used as rewards for the Elf Race in the Divine Kingdom War.”
Having gone through so many Divine Kingdom Wars, Yang Fan had witnessed the Elf Race’s performance with his own eyes.
Whether in terms of war coordination, support, or direct combat.
The Elf Kingdom had never disappointed him.
Today, the overall combat power of the entire elven civilization was not the slightest bit weaker than any main believer legion in the divine kingdom.
Although they could not provide him with faith like believers did, they were still worth investing Resources into to nurture them.
“Yes, your subordinate understands.”
“Furthermore.”
Yang Fan seemed to have thought of something.
“Continue to purchase elf holy trees through various channels.”
“Now that the divine kingdom’s area has skyrocketed, relying on just a single elf holy tree to breed Elven Warriors is far too inefficient.”
“Your subordinate obeys.”
In fact, with the divine kingdom expanding to ten billion square kilometers.
For a long time to come, the divine kingdom would experience an explosive growth in population.
Whether it was the Cultivation civilization, Martial Arts civilization, or Mechanical Civilization, they all needed sufficient time to fill this vast territory.
The elven civilization was naturally no exception.
Furthermore, unlike other races.
Elves were gentle by nature; as long as they were not deliberately sent to their deaths, they would never violate a Divine Decree.
For such a stable and efficient vassal civilization, Yang Fan was naturally willing to increase his investment.
But investment was one thing; he had never thought of letting the elven civilization expand indefinitely.
Because Yang Fan knew very well that vassals could be strong, but they could never stand on equal footing with his core believers.
Currently, the Elf Kingdom possessed military strength roughly equivalent to one-fourth of the divine kingdom’s, which was the perfect ratio.
Too weak, and they would be unable to play a role in war.
Too strong, and they would cause the power structure of the entire divine kingdom to become unbalanced.
This had nothing to do with loyalty or betrayal, but was simply the most basic risk management.
When one stood high enough, one could not afford to have too much trust in their heart.
Trust could change over time, and feelings could waver because of interests.
Only systems and power structures could prevent problems from arising at their root.
Rather than believing others would not betray him, it was better to leave them with absolutely no capability to betray. This was the mindset of a ruler.
Similarly, it was just like the restrictions of the divine kingdom’s rules in this world.
All believers were loyal to their deity from the depths of their Soul and Origin.
Unable to disobey, unable to resist, and unable to question.
They were born to believe in everything about their deity.
Under such absolute rules, how could Yang Fan possibly treat his believers as real human beings!
Deities looked down upon all living things, while believers looked up to deities.
To a deity, believers were the continuation of civilization, the Foundation of the divine kingdom, and their most precious wealth.
And what a deity needed to do was to make this wealth continuously appreciate and grow.
In fact, whether believers or deities, there was essentially no difference; otherwise, so many factions would not have emerged within the divine kingdom.
All living beings desired to control their own destinies, and also desired to control the destinies of others.
Emperors were like this, monarchs were like this, and deities were like this too.
The only difference was that some people spent their entire lives chasing power.
While some, from the moment they were born, already stood at the pinnacle of power.
At this moment, Yang Fan turned his gaze toward Ling Xuzi. “These Divine Kingdom Cores are your reward.”
He gently raised his hand.
In the next instant.
Light flashed within the grand hall as over a dozen Divine Kingdom Cores slowly emerged in the Void Realm.
Some were only the size of a palm, while others were a full meter in diameter.
Among these Divine Kingdom Cores, there were those from the “Safe-grade divine kingdoms” that Yang Fan had invaded, as well as those seized from the Undead Demigod and the Qitian Divine Kingdom.
Yang Fan did not hand them all over to Ling Xuzi; those he gave were smaller in size and almost exclusively Alien Divine Kingdom cores.
Ling Xuzi froze on the spot, his throat bobbing.
For a moment, he even forgot to express his gratitude.
After a moment, he suddenly snapped back to his senses and fell to his knees with a thud.
“Thank you for your generous gift, Master! Your subordinate will surely not disappoint Master’s expectations. I am willing to die for Master, to sacrifice myself utterly, and never turn away!”
“Master’s grace is like a second heaven!”
“Even if your subordinate is ground to dust, it would be hard to repay even a ten-thousandth of it!”
His tone was so respectful that it bordered on fanatical.
Yang Fan smiled faintly and shook his head gently.
“If these Divine Kingdom Cores are not enough, then go fight for them yourself.”
His tone was calm, yet it carried an unquestionable will.
“Although you are my Subordinate God, under the restrictions of the divine kingdom’s rules, my believers cannot directly attack demigods.”
“However, do not worry. Yang Da will make arrangements for you.”
“Subsequently, a robot legion will be allocated to you, under your command, to serve as your divine kingdom’s military force.”
The Void Spirit Race itself possessed no direct combat capability. If they were to be nurtured into a true deity-level combat system, external forces were still required to supplement them.
And what Yang Fan lacked least was precisely Resources.
To the current Yang Fan, those mechanical alloy warriors comparable to the Qi Refining stage were merely low-cost products.
In a sense, this was no longer a ‘Divine Kingdom War’ in the traditional sense.
It was more like a proxy war led by Yang Fan.
The only difference was that his opponents were ordinary demigods who had not yet fully grown.
It seemed somewhat... unfair.

In a sense, this was no longer a ‘Divine Kingdom War’ in the traditional sense.
It was more like a proxy war led by Yang Fan.
The only difference was that his opponents were ordinary demigods who had not yet fully grown.
It seemed somewhat... unfair.

chapters.title: Chapter 300: Fusion
paragraphs: “Additionally.”
Yang Fan’s gaze swept across the numerous Intelligent Life.
“Your performance this time has been good. Each Intelligent Life, starting with Yang Yi, will be rewarded with fifty Mechanical Hearts.”
“Thank you, Master.”
The Intelligent Life responded in unison.
Then they slowly withdrew.
The grand hall returned to silence.
Yang Da stepped forward. “Master, the World Tree is ready to be loaded.”
Yang Fan nodded slightly.
The next instant.
Above the Elf Kingdom, spatial rifts slowly opened.
A giant tree, entirely emerald green yet exuding an ancient aura, slowly descended.
The moment it appeared, all Elven Warriors experienced a simultaneous shock in their minds.
It was as if some even older existence deep within their Bloodline had been awakened.
Even the aura of the elf holy tree seemed dimmed for a fleeting moment at this time.
Countless elves instinctively knelt on the ground, their expressions filled with shock and piety.
The World Tree landed.
Boom—!
The earth trembled slightly, its root system instantly piercing through the strata of the Divine Kingdom.
The next instant, it began to grow wildly.
Its branches extended, and its canopy propped up the sky.
In just a few breaths, it blotted out the sun and sky.
Its height even faintly rivaled the Heavenly Court region from afar.
An aura of life, rich almost to the point of being tangible, diffused like a tidal wave.
Drastic changes began to occur throughout the entire Elf Kingdom.
The barren land was rapidly nourished, the withered spiritual soil regained its vitality, and flowers, plants, and vines grew wildly.
At this very moment, Yang Fan’s Divine Thought descended.
The Divine Decree resounded throughout the entire Elf Kingdom.
“All of you have rendered meritorious service in the battles of the Divine Kingdom.”
“Your loyalty, Battle Intent, and execution have all been seen by Us.”
“Today, We bestow the World Tree upon you to consolidate the Foundation of your race.”
“It is hoped that all of you will strictly guard your original minds, protect the soil of the Divine Kingdom, and uphold the will of the deities.”
“The path of the future shall coexist with the Divine Kingdom.”
“If the Divine Kingdom exists, you shall exist.”
“If the Divine Kingdom prospers, you shall prosper.”
“If the Divine Kingdom ceases to exist, all races shall perish.”
As the voice fell, the Elf Kingdom fell into a brief dead silence, followed by an eruption of near-fanatical responses.
Countless elves prostrated themselves on the ground and shouted:
“We, the Elf Race, are willing to follow the deities for all eternity!”
“We shall live and die together with the Divine Kingdom!”
“We will protect the territory of the Divine Kingdom with our lives!”
The voices echoed beneath the World Tree for a long time without fading.
After the Divine Decree dissipated, Yang Fan’s consciousness did not return to the Real World, but instead returned to the main hall of the Divine Kingdom.
At this moment, in the Void Realm, dozens of Divine Kingdom Cores were floating quietly.
Most of these cores came from Undead Demigods and the Qi Tian Divine Kingdom.
Most of them were the Divine Kingdom Cores of former geniuses from the Primordial Academy.
Qi Tian and the Undead Demigods had been afraid of making a Breakthrough to become deities and dared not absorb them, but now it ended up benefiting him instead.
Yang Fan’s gaze flickered slightly.
The value of these Divine Kingdom Cores was not just the expansion of the Divine Kingdom’s area.
They had the chance to breed new Divine Kingdom Talents.
And this was what Yang Fan was truly interested in.
One by one, the Divine Kingdom Cores continuously merged into the Divine Kingdom.
However, unlike before, to the current Yang Fan, the level of these Divine Kingdom Cores was somewhat low.
Inside the Divine Kingdom, only slight ripples were stirred up, and the expansion of the area was negligible.
Even if Yang Fan had not deliberately perceived it, it would have been hard to notice the change.
However, he did not care about this at all.
Soon, the last Divine Kingdom Core was completely absorbed.
Yang Fan immediately cast his gaze toward the Divine Kingdom information panel.
Talent: SSS-Rank Talent: Evolution [First Divine Right: Time Evolution (A hundredfold); Second Divine Right: Origin Evolution]
[B-Rank Talent Iron Will, A-Rank Talent Innate Martial Bone, A-Rank Talent Undying Battle Body, B-Rank Talent Diamond Physique] (Can be fused)
[S-rank Talent Growth of All Things, B-Rank Talent Spiritual Field, F-Rank Talent Resources] (Can be fused)
[A-Rank Talent Spiritual Body, B-Rank Talent Lightning Spiritual Root, B-Rank Talent Clear and Bright Spiritual Rhinoceros] (Can be fused)
[A-Rank Talent Divine Craftsman]
[B-Rank Talent Breeding, C-Rank Talent Breeding] (Can be fused)
Looking at the extra row of Divine Kingdom Talents that suddenly appeared, even Yang Fan couldn’t help but swallow his saliva.
Yang Fan took a deep breath and said softly, “Yang Da.”
As his voice fell, Yang Da’s figure instantly appeared before him.
“Congratulations, Master.”
As the highest Intelligent Life of the Divine Kingdom, Yang Da naturally knew what had happened.
The Alien Demigods in the Alien Divine Kingdom Zone of the Primordial Academy were simply a Treasure Trove.
The Divine Kingdom Cores of those human geniuses had not been absorbed, but now they all benefited Yang Fan.
To the vast majority of deities, demigod-Rank Divine Kingdom Cores had almost no value.
Even absorbing hundreds or thousands of them might not expand the Divine Kingdom’s area by much.
But Yang Fan was different; the most precious wealth among these Divine Kingdom Cores was the Divine Kingdom Talents!
“Yang Da, what does ‘can be fused’ on the Divine Kingdom information panel mean?”
Yang Fan asked.
“Reporting to Master.”
“According to the rules of the Divine Kingdom, talents of the same type usually can only have one exist.”
“The so-called Fusion should be integrating multiple similar talents into a more powerful talent through Origin Evolution.”
“As for the specifics, the Master will know once he tries it.”
Yang Da was also somewhat nervous.
Divine Kingdom Talents were inherently miraculous and unpredictable; many abilities had no specific descriptions and required the deities to slowly explore them themselves.
As for an SSS-rank Talent, it was even unheard of.
Even if one searched through the entire human database, no related records could be found.
For many things, Yang Fan could only rely on his own exploration.
Yang Fan nodded.
The next moment, with a slight movement of his thoughts.
The information on the Divine Kingdom panel began to change rapidly.
Talent: SSS-Rank Talent: Evolution [First Divine Right: Time Evolution (A hundredfold); Second Divine Right: Origin Evolution]
[S-rank Talent Growth of All Things]
[A-Rank Talent Battle Body]
[A-Rank Talent Spiritual Body]
[A-Rank Talent Divine Craftsman]
[B-Rank Talent Breeding]
“This is?” Yang Fan was slightly stunned.
He found that except for the combat-type talents turning into Battle Body, all the other talents had completely disappeared.
“Did the Fusion fail?” Yang Fan furrowed his brow slightly.
But he quickly dismissed this guess.
As the Lord of the Divine Kingdom, any subtle change within the Divine Kingdom could not escape his perception.
His talent had indeed grown stronger, it just hadn’t reached the critical point of breaking through the Rank yet.
Take the simplest Breeding Talent, for example.
According to historical records, a B-Rank Breeding Talent could roughly increase the believers’ reproductive capacity by two to three hundred percent.
But this was merely a vague range.
Statistics on Divine Kingdom Talents in the Real World could never be made absolutely precise.
Even with the exact same B-Rank Breeding Talent, the effects between different deities could vary vastly.
At this moment, Yang Fan could clearly feel that the talent after Fusion had already undergone subtle changes!
“Yang Da, connect to the network immediately and help me retrieve the specific information of these talents!”
Yang Fan’s voice was even trembling slightly.
“Yes, Master.”
The next moment, a huge light curtain appeared in the center of the Divine Kingdom hall.
[S-rank Talent: Growth of All Things]

All resource production speeds within the Divine Kingdom are increased by 1000%, the concentration of life energy slowly increases, and the ecological environment of the Divine Kingdom can be continuously improved.
[A-Rank Talent: Battle Body]

Some believers will awaken a special Battle Body physique. During battle, their strength, speed, and defense are comprehensively enhanced. The longer the continuous battle time, the greater the enhancement of combat power.
[A-Rank Talent: Spiritual Body]

Believers will be naturally close to the energy of heaven and earth, their Cultivation speed will be increased by 300%, Bottlenecks will be reduced when breaking through Realms, and the efficiency of absorbing Spiritual Qi will be greatly increased.
[A-Rank Talent: Divine Craftsman]
The probability of believers with forging talents, Artifact Refining talents, and Mechanical design talents being born within the Divine Kingdom is increased.
The efficiency of forging buildings is increased by 100%.
[B-Rank Talent: Breeding]
The reproductive capacity of the believer race is increased by 260%, the offspring survival rate is increased, and the growth speed in the juvenile stage is increased.
